Stand up straight, fully extending your knees and hips, and stabilize the kettlebell overhead.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position by bending your knees and hips, and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell one arm military press to the side
exercises.description: A standing one arm kettlebell press where the path drifts out to the side. Works the shoulder and upper back while your core resists leaning.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder height.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Press the kettlebell overhead, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: kettlebell one arm push press
exercises.description: Use a small leg dip and drive to push one kettlebell overhead. It lets you move more weight than a strict press and trains shoulders, triceps and legs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand at shoulder level.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead by extending your arm and fully extending your legs.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position by bending your knees and bringing the kettlebell back to your shoulder.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: kettlebell one arm row
exercises.description: Hinge forward and row a kettlebell to your hip with one arm. Targets the lats and upper back while your core keeps you steady.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the kettlebell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat with the other arm.

exercises.name: kettlebell one arm snatch
exercises.description: You swing a kettlebell from between your legs to overhead in one fluid motion with a single arm. A power exercise for hips, shoulders and back.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand between your legs.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, lowering the kettlebell towards the ground.
Explosively extend your hips and knees, using the momentum to swing the kettlebell up towards your shoulder.
As the kettlebell reaches shoulder height, rotate your hand and punch it straight up overhead, fully extending your arm.
Lower the kettlebell back down between your legs and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell pirate supper legs
exercises.description: A kettlebell hinge and carry style move that works the hips and lower back while you keep a flat back and steady core.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise the kettlebell up to shoulder height, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Extend your arm fully overhead, straightening your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell back down to shoulder height, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: kettlebell pistol squat
exercises.description: A single leg squat holding a kettlebell at your chest as a counterweight. Builds leg strength, balance and mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your chest with both hands.
Lift your left foot off the ground and extend it forward, keeping it parallel to the ground.
Slowly lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your right foot flat on the ground and your left leg extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kettlebell plyo push-up
exercises.description: An explosive push-up with your hands on kettlebells. You push hard enough to lift off, which trains chest and arm power.
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands on the kettlebells, shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push through your hands explosively, lifting your hands off the kettlebells and extending your arms fully.
Land softly back on the kettlebells and immediately lower your chest back down for the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell seated press
exercises.description: Seated on a bench, you press a kettlebell in each hand overhead. Takes the legs out so your shoulders and triceps do the work.
steps: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the kettlebells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the kettlebells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell seesaw press
exercises.description: You press one kettlebell up while the other lowers, like a seesaw. Works the shoulders and triceps with a steady rhythm.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one kettlebell overhead while keeping the other kettlebell at shoulder height.
Lower the pressed kettlebell back to shoulder height while simultaneously pressing the other kettlebell overhead.
Continue alternating the pressing motion, creating a seesaw-like movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell sumo high pull
exercises.description: A wide stance pull where you drive through your legs and row a kettlebell up to chest height. Hits the traps, shoulders and hips.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointing outwards.
Hold a kettlebell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended downwards.
Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your back straight.
Drive through your heels and explosively extend your hips and knees, pulling the kettlebell up towards your chin.
As you pull the kettlebell up, keep your elbows high and wide, and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell swing
exercises.description: A hip hinge move where you swing a kettlebell to chest height using your hips. Great for glutes, hamstrings and posterior chain power.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointed slightly outward.
Hold the kettlebell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, pushing your butt back.
Swing the kettlebell back between your legs, keeping your arms straight and maintaining a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and swing the kettlebell up to shoulder height, using the momentum generated by your hips.
Allow the kettlebell to swing back down between your legs and repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell thruster
exercises.description: You squat with a kettlebell at your chest, then stand and press it overhead in one motion. A full body move for legs and shoulders.
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your chest with both hands, palms facing each other.
Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your heels to stand up, simultaneously pressing the kettlebell overhead.
Lock out your arms at the top of the movement, fully extending your elbows.
Lower the kettlebell back to the starting position by reversing the movement, bending your elbows and lowering the weight back to your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell turkish get up (squat style)
exercises.description: A Turkish get up where you come up through a squat style transition while keeping the kettlebell overhead. Trains full body control, stability and strength.
steps: Start by lying on your back with your legs extended and the kettlebell held in your right hand, arm fully extended above your shoulder.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot flat on the ground, keeping your left leg extended.
Pressing through your right foot, lift your hips off the ground, coming into a bridge position.
Slide your left leg underneath your body, bending your left knee and placing your left foot flat on the ground.
Rotate your torso to the left, bringing your left hand to the ground for support.
Pressing through your right foot and left hand, lift your torso off the ground, coming into a kneeling position.
From the kneeling position, stand up, keeping the kettlebell extended overhead.
Reverse the movement to return to the starting position.
Repeat the exercise on the other side, starting with the kettlebell in your left hand.

exercises.name: kettlebell two arm clean
exercises.description: You pull a kettlebell from between your thighs up to the rack position with both hands. Trains hip power, back and shoulders.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in front of your thighs with both hands, palms facing towards you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge at the hips, lowering the kettlebell towards the ground.
Explosively extend your hips and knees, using the momentum to pull the kettlebell up towards your shoulders.
As the kettlebell reaches shoulder height, rotate your wrists and catch the kettlebell in the rack position, with your elbows tucked in and the kettlebell resting on the back of your forearm.
Lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell two arm military press
exercises.description: Standing, you press a kettlebell in each hand overhead from shoulder height. Builds shoulder and triceps strength with a braced core.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the kettlebells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the kettlebells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell windmill
exercises.description: With a kettlebell held overhead, you push your hips out and reach down toward your foot. Builds shoulder stability, flexibility and core strength.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in your right hand overhead.
Rotate your left foot outwards about 45 degrees and keep your right foot pointing forward.
Bend your torso to the left side, keeping your right arm extended overhead and your eyes on the kettlebell.
Lower your torso as far as you can while keeping your right arm straight and your left arm extended to the side.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position by pushing through your right foot and engaging your obliques.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: kick out sit
exercises.description: A seated core move where you lean back and kick your legs out and in. Works the abs and hip flexors without any equipment.
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lean back slightly and place your hands on the edge of the bench or chair for support.
Engaging your hamstrings, lift your feet off the ground and extend your legs straight out in front of you.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly bend your knees and bring your feet back towards your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kicks leg bent v. 2
exercises.description: On hands and knees, you press one bent leg up toward the ceiling. It targets the glutes with a simple, controlled kickback.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Keep your core tight and your back flat.
Lift one leg with the knee bent at 90 degrees.
Press the sole of your foot toward the ceiling until your thigh is in line with your back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control and finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: kipping muscle up
exercises.description: A pull-up bar move where you use a swing to get above the bar and then press out. Trains lats, arms and chest, and needs good control.
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and use a swinging motion to generate momentum.
As you swing forward, pull your chest towards the bar, using your lats and biceps to initiate the movement.
Continue the upward motion until your chest reaches the bar, then transition into a dip position by pushing down on the bar and extending your arms.
Lower yourself back down to the starting position by bending your arms and controlling the descent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: knee to chest stretch
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you hug one knee toward your chest. It stretches the glutes and eases the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Bend one knee and clasp your hands around the shin or behind the thigh.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest.
Keep the other leg relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Release and switch sides.

exercises.name: kneeling hip flexor
exercises.description: A kneeling lunge stretch that opens the front of the hip and thigh. Good after sitting or leg training.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front of you.
Place a pad under your back knee if needed.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips gently forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: kneeling wrist flexor stretch
exercises.description: Kneeling on the floor, you press your palms down to stretch the underside of the forearms. Useful for lifters with tight wrists.
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your palms down with fingers pointing toward your knees.
Keep your palms flat and arms straight.
Slowly sit your hips back to increase the stretch.
Stop when you feel a pull along the inner forearms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Ease off gently and shake out your hands.

exercises.name: landmine 180
exercises.description: You hold a landmine barbell at chest height and rotate it in an arc from side to side. Works the obliques and core with strong hip drive.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with both hands in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and rotate your torso to the right, swinging the barbell down towards your right hip.
As you reach the bottom of the movement, quickly reverse the motion and rotate your torso to the left, swinging the barbell up and across your body towards your left shoulder.
Continue this twisting motion, alternating sides, for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lateral box jump
exercises.description: A sideways jump onto a box that builds explosive power in the legs. It also trains landing control.
steps: Stand beside a sturdy box or step.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways, landing with both feet on the box.
Land softly with bent knees and stand tall.
Step down carefully.
Repeat, then switch the side you start from.

exercises.name: lateral speed step
exercises.description: Quick side-to-side steps that build foot speed and agility. It warms up the legs and trains coordination.
steps: Stand in a slight athletic stance with knees bent.
Step quickly to one side, pushing off the opposite foot.
Bring the trailing foot in and step back the other way.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your chest up and arms moving naturally.
Work at a fast but controlled pace for the set.

exercises.name: lateral twist box jump
exercises.description: A box jump with a twist in the air that adds rotation. It builds explosive leg power and trunk control.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and rotate your hips to land sideways on the box.
Land softly with bent knees.
Step down and reset.
Alternate the twist direction each rep.

exercises.name: leg bench side bridge
exercises.description: A side plank with the top leg resting on a bench. It hits the obliques and builds side-body stability.
steps: Lie on your side with your top leg resting on a bench.
Place your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your hips stacked and your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: leg curl (on stability ball)
exercises.description: Lying on your back with heels on a ball, you curl it toward your hips. It works the hamstrings and core together.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on a stability ball and legs straight.
Press your hips up so your body forms a line.
Pull the ball toward your glutes by bending your knees.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.
Pause at the top.
Roll the ball back out slowly.

exercises.name: leg pull in flat bench
exercises.description: Seated on a flat bench, you pull your knees in toward your chest and extend them again. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on a flat bench with your legs extended straight out in front of you.
Place your hands on the bench beside your hips for support.
Engage your abs and lift your legs off the ground, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever alternating narrow grip seated row
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you pull the handles one arm at a time toward your torso with a narrow grip. Targets the lats and mid back.
steps: Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your back straight and feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with a narrow grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back throughout the exercise.
Pull one handle towards your torso while keeping the other handle stationary.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement.
Slowly return the handle to the starting position and repeat with the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever assisted chin-up
exercises.description: A machine that helps lift your body weight so you can train chin-ups at a lower load. Builds the lats and biceps.
steps: Adjust the leverage machine to your desired resistance level.
Stand on the foot platform and grip the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended, keeping your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the handles, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the handles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever back extension
exercises.description: On a machine, you extend your torso against a pad to work the lower back. Also brings in the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Adjust the machine to fit your body size and range of motion.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured.
Place your hands on the handles or grip bars.
Engage your core and slowly lean forward, allowing your back to round slightly.
Pause for a moment at the bottom position, feeling a stretch in your lower back.
Using your back muscles, slowly raise your torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever bent over row
exercises.description: A lever machine version of the bent over row. You pull the handles toward your torso to train the back and lats.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Pull the barbell towards your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever bicep curl
exercises.description: Seated at a lever machine, you curl the handles up with an underhand grip. Isolates the biceps with a smooth path.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and keep your elbows close to your sides.
Exhale and curl the handles upward, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever chest press
exercises.description: A machine press where you push the handles forward from your chest. Works the chest, front shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back flat against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, exhaling during the movement.
Pause briefly at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position, inhaling as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever chest press
exercises.description: A machine press where you push the handles forward from your chest. Works the chest, front shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back flat against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, exhaling during the movement.
Pause briefly at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position, inhaling as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever deadlift
exercises.description: A machine deadlift that lets you hinge and stand up against a set load. Works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
steps: Adjust the seat height and foot platform to your desired position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the foot platform.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and push through your heels to lift the weight up.
Keep your back straight and avoid rounding your shoulders.
Extend your hips fully at the top of the movement, squeezing your glutes.
Lower the weight back down in a controlled manner, keeping tension on your glutes and hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever front pulldown
exercises.description: Seated at a lever machine, you pull the handles down toward your chest. Builds the lats and upper back.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your chest lifted and your shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Engage your lats and pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever gripless shrug
exercises.description: A machine shrug without gripping a bar, so you lift your shoulders straight up. Focuses on the upper traps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Grasp the handles with your palms facing inwards and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight, exhale and elevate your shoulders as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a brief moment, then inhale and slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever high row
exercises.description: On a machine, you pull the handles down and back from a high position. Targets the lats and upper back.
steps: Adjust the seat height and foot platform to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the foot platform.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever kneeling leg curl
exercises.description: Kneeling on a machine, you curl your lower legs up against a pad. Isolates the hamstrings.
steps: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Kneel on the machine facing downwards, with your knees resting on the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position, fully extending your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever kneeling twist
exercises.description: Kneeling on a machine, you rotate your torso against resistance. Trains the obliques and core.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees resting on the pads and your upper body facing forward.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Keeping your core engaged, twist your torso to one side as far as comfortably possible.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever lateral raise
exercises.description: On a lever machine, you raise your arms out to the sides against resistance. Isolates the side delts.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
Exhale and raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever leg extension
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you straighten your legs against a pad. A simple quad builder.
steps: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the machine to fit your body.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footpad.
Grasp the handles or sidebars for stability.
Extend your legs forward by straightening your knees, lifting the weight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the weight back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever lying leg curl
exercises.description: Lying face down on a machine, you curl your heels toward your glutes. Isolates the hamstrings.
steps: Adjust the machine to fit your body and select the desired weight.
Lie face down on the machine with your legs straight and your heels against the padded lever.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible without lifting your hips off the pad.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever military press
exercises.description: On a machine, you press the handles overhead from shoulder height. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward until your arms are fully extended, but do not lock your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever narrow grip seated row
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you pull a narrow grip handle toward your torso. Trains the lats and mid back.
steps: Adjust the seat height and footrests to ensure proper form.
Sit on the machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handles with a narrow grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward.
Pull the handles towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement.
Slowly release the handles and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever one arm bent over row
exercises.description: A one arm row on a lever machine, pulling the handle toward your hip. Works the lats and upper back one side at a time.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a barbell with an overhand grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your head up.
Let the barbell hang in front of you with your arms fully extended.
Pull the barbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever one arm shoulder press
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you press one handle overhead at a time. Trains each shoulder separately with help from the triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the lever handle with one hand and position your elbow at a 90-degree angle.
Press the lever upward until your arm is fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the lever back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.

exercises.name: lever overhand triceps dip
exercises.description: On a dip machine, you press the handles down and extend your elbows. Focuses on the triceps and chest.
steps: Adjust the machine to the appropriate height and secure your body in position.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your body so that your arms are fully extended.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Continue lowering until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever preacher curl
exercises.description: With your arms on a preacher pad, you curl the handles up. Isolates the biceps with no swinging.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine.
Place your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles with an underhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your elbows positioned on the pad.
Exhale and curl your forearms towards your upper arms, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever reverse hyperextension
exercises.description: Lying on a machine, you swing your legs up behind you. Works the glutes and lower back.
steps: Adjust the leverage machine to fit your body and secure your feet in the foot pads.
Lie face down on the machine with your upper body hanging off the edge and your hips resting on the pad.
Cross your arms over your chest or place them behind your head.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your legs upward until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated calf raise
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you press through the balls of your feet to raise your heels. Isolates the calves, especially the soleus.
steps: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet to raise your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated crunch (chest pad)
exercises.description: Seated on a machine with a chest pad, you curl your torso forward against resistance. Works the abs.
steps: Adjust the seat height and chest pad position according to your comfort.
Sit on the machine with your back against the chest pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles or side bars for stability.
Engage your abs and slowly lean back, allowing the chest pad to move with you.
Pause for a moment at the maximum contraction, feeling the tension in your abs.
Slowly return to the starting position by contracting your abs and pulling yourself back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated fly
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you bring the handles together in front of you with arms nearly straight. Isolates the chest.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with a pronated grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Exhale and push the handles forward, bringing them together in front of your chest.
Pause for a moment, squeezing your chest muscles.
Inhale and slowly return to the starting position, allowing your chest muscles to stretch.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated hip abduction
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you push your knees apart against pads. Works the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Place your hands on the side handles for stability.
Engage your abductors and slowly push your legs apart, away from the midline of your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring your legs back together to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated hip adduction
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you squeeze your knees together against pads. Trains the inner thighs.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Place your feet on the footrests and grasp the handles for stability.
Engage your adductor muscles and slowly bring your legs together, squeezing your inner thighs.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated leg curl
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you curl your lower legs back and down against a pad. Isolates the hamstrings.
steps: Adjust the machine to fit your body and sit on it with your back against the backrest.
Place your lower legs under the padded lever, just above your ankles.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the machine for support.
Keeping your upper legs stationary, exhale and curl your legs up as far as possible.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower the lever back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated leg raise crunch
exercises.description: On a machine, you raise your legs while curling your torso. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or sidebars for stability.
Engage your abs and slowly raise your legs up towards your chest, curling your torso forward at the same time.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated reverse fly (parallel grip)
exercises.description: Chest against the pad, you pull the handles back and out with a parallel grip. Targets the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with a parallel grip, palms facing each other, and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated reverse fly
exercises.description: Chest against the pad, you pull the handles back and out in a wide arc. Targets the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms slightly bent.
Exhale and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull the handles back and outward, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever shoulder press
exercises.description: Seated at a lever machine, you press the handles overhead. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the backrest.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at shoulder level.
Push the handles upward until your arms are fully extended, but do not lock your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever shrug
exercises.description: On a lever machine, you lift your shoulders straight up and lower with control. Builds the upper traps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the leverage machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and keep your arms straight.
Keeping your back straight, lift your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever standing calf raise
exercises.description: Standing with pads on your shoulders, you rise onto your toes and lower back down. Isolates the calves.
steps: Adjust the machine to your height and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever t bar row
exercises.description: Chest on the pad, you row a T-bar style handle toward your torso. Works the lats, mid back and rear delts.
steps: Adjust the seat height and footplate position to ensure proper alignment.
Sit on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the footplate.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Pull the handles towards your torso, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever triceps extension
exercises.description: Seated on a machine, you press the handles down by extending your elbows. Isolates the triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and fully extend your arms in front of you.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the handles towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the handles back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever twist
exercises.description: A seated machine twist that trains the abs and obliques through rotation.
steps: Sit in the machine and adjust the pads so your torso is secure.
Grip the handles and keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side in a controlled way.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return to the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move slowly and avoid using momentum.

exercises.name: london bridge
exercises.description: Using a rope anchored high, you lean back and pull your body through a controlled swing. Trains the back, shoulders and core.
steps: Attach the rope to a high anchor point.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Lean forward slightly, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Pull the rope towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: low jacks
exercises.description: Jumping jacks performed from a squat position. They raise your heart rate and burn the legs.
steps: Start in a half squat with hands in front of your chest.
Jump your feet out wide, staying low.
Jump them back together and keep your knees bent.
Keep your chest up and weight on your heels.
Stay in the squat throughout.
Keep a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: lunge push up
exercises.description: A lunge flowing into a push-up. It combines leg and upper body work for a full-body challenge.
steps: Stand tall with feet together.
Step back into a lunge and lower your back knee toward the floor.
Place your hands on the floor and step into a plank.
Lower into a push-up and press back up.
Step back into the lunge and stand up.
Alternate the lunging leg each rep.

exercises.name: lunge
exercises.description: A classic step forward and drop for the legs. It builds the quads and glutes and improves balance.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Take a big step forward with one leg.
Lower your hips until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Repeat and switch legs.

exercises.name: lying (side) quads stretch
exercises.description: Lying on your side, you pull your top foot toward your glutes to stretch the front of the thigh. A gentle quad stretch.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight.
Bend your top leg and grab your ankle or foot with your hand.
Gently pull your ankle or foot towards your glutes until you feel a stretch in your quads.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds.
Release the stretch and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: lying alternate hip extension
exercises.description: Lying face down, you lift one leg at a time. It strengthens the glutes and the muscles along your lower back.
steps: Lie face down with arms by your sides or under your forehead.
Keep your legs straight and your hips pressed down.
Lift one leg off the floor while squeezing your glute.
Lower it with control.
Lift the other leg and alternate.
Avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.name: lying crossover stretch
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you cross one leg over the other. It stretches the outer hip and lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides.
Bend one knee and bring it across your body.
Let it lower toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders flat on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: lying hip flexor stretch
exercises.description: Lying near the edge of a surface, you let one leg hang to stretch the front of the hip. It eases tightness from sitting.
steps: Lie on your back near the edge of a bench or bed.
Pull one knee toward your chest and hold it.
Let the other leg hang down relaxed over the edge.
Keep your lower back flat.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: lying hip leg raise (on floor)
exercises.description: A side-lying leg lift done on the floor. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your arm and keep your core tight.
Raise your top leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your toes pointing forward.
Lower slowly without touching the other leg.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lying hip straight leg raise
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you raise a straight leg toward the ceiling. It trains the hip muscles and leg control.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Brace your abs and press your lower back down.
Lift one straight leg to about hip height.
Lower it slowly toward the floor.
Keep the other leg flat.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lying leg raise flat bench
exercises.description: Lying on a flat bench, you raise and lower straight legs. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on a flat bench with your back pressed against it.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Keep your legs straight and together, and lift them up towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lying scissor crunch
exercises.description: A crunch combined with alternating leg scissors. It targets the abs and lower belly.
steps: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Crunch your shoulders up.
Scissor your legs, crossing one over the other.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Switch which leg crosses on top each rep.

exercises.name: lying scissor kick
exercises.description: Alternating small leg kicks while lying down. It challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Raise one leg higher while the other stays low.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Breathe steadily throughout.

exercises.name: lying simultaneous alternating leg raise
exercises.description: Lying down, you lift legs in opposite directions at the same time. It works the lower abs and hips.
steps: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides.
Raise one leg toward the ceiling while the other hovers near the floor.
Switch the legs at the same time.
Keep both legs mostly straight.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Move at a controlled pace.

exercises.name: march sit (wall)
exercises.description: With your back against a wall, you hold a seated position with knees bent to 90 degrees. Builds endurance in the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet hip-width apart.
Slowly slide your back down the wall until your knees are bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lift your right foot off the ground and bring your knee towards your chest.
Lower your right foot back down and lift your left foot off the ground, bringing your knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating between lifting your right and left foot for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: medicine ball sit up (wall)
exercises.description: A sit-up that includes a ball throw to a wall. It builds the abs with an explosive finish.
steps: Sit on the floor facing a wall, knees bent, holding a medicine ball.
Lean back and lower your back to the floor.
Sit up and throw the ball at the wall.
Catch it on the rebound.
Lower back down with control.
Repeat for reps.

exercises.name: mixed grip chin-up
exercises.description: A chin-up with one hand overhand and one underhand. Builds the lats, biceps and grip, and you switch hands between sets.
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an underhand grip (palms facing towards you) and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your feet off the ground.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: monster walk
exercises.description: With a band around your ankles, you step sideways in a slight squat. Fires up the glutes and outer hips.
steps: Place a resistance band around your ankles.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Take a step to the side with your right foot, maintaining tension on the resistance band.
Follow with your left foot, stepping to the side to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: mountain climber lunge
exercises.description: A mountain climber that steps the foot all the way outside the hand into a lunge. It raises the heart rate and opens the hips.
steps: Start in a plank with hands under your shoulders.
Step one foot forward outside your hand.
Lower your hips into a lunge stretch.
Return the foot back to the plank.
Switch legs.
Keep your core tight and move at a steady pace.

exercises.name: mountain climber
exercises.description: From a high plank, you drive your knees toward your chest one after another. Works the core, shoulders and gets your heart rate up.
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and bring your right knee towards your chest, then quickly switch and bring your left knee towards your chest.
Continue alternating legs in a running motion, keeping your hips low and your core engaged.
Maintain a steady pace and breathe evenly throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: muscle up
exercises.description: You pull yourself above a bar and then press up into a dip position. Trains the lats, chest and arms in a powerful transition.
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest is above the bar and your arms are fully flexed.
Reverse the movement by slowly lowering yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: narrow leg bench bridge
exercises.description: A glute bridge with your feet close together on a bench. It places more load on the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet close together on a bench.
Bend your knees and keep arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: neck bridge prone
exercises.description: A face-down neck bridge that strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck. Start gently and keep the load light.
steps: Kneel on a mat and lean forward so the top of your head rests lightly on the floor.
Place your hands on the floor for support.
Take some weight through your neck by rocking forward and back slowly.
Keep your movements small and controlled.
Return to the start and rest between sets.
Never bounce and keep most weight on your hands at first.

exercises.name: negative crunch
exercises.description: A slow lowering crunch where you control the way down. Works the abs with extra time under tension.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: oblique crunches floor
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you crunch up and rotate toward one knee, then the other. Targets the obliques and abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulder blades off the floor, rotating your torso to one side.
Pause for a moment, then lower your shoulder blades back down to the floor.
Repeat on the other side, alternating sides with each repetition.

exercises.name: olympic barbell hammer curl
exercises.description: Standing with an Olympic barbell, you curl with a neutral style grip. Works the biceps and brachialis along with the forearms.
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold an Olympic barbell with an overhand grip.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs, with your palms facing your body.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: olympic barbell triceps extension
exercises.description: Holding an Olympic barbell overhead, you bend and straighten your elbows. Isolates the triceps.
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and holding the barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell above your head, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: one arm chin-up
exercises.description: An advanced pull-up using only one arm. Builds big lat and biceps strength and takes lots of practice.
steps: Stand facing a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an underhand grip, with one hand gripping the bar and the other hand holding your wrist for support.
Hang from the bar with your arm fully extended, keeping your body straight and your core engaged.
Pull yourself up towards the bar by bending your elbow and squeezing your back muscles.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms and repeat.

exercises.name: one arm dip
exercises.description: A dip using one arm on a bench or chair behind you. Works the triceps and shoulders on one side at a time.
steps: Stand facing away from a bench or chair, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one hand on the bench or chair behind you, fingers pointing towards your body.
Extend your legs out in front of you, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench or chair.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat with the other arm.

exercises.name: one arm slam (with medicine ball)
exercises.description: You lift a medicine ball overhead with one hand and slam it to the floor. Builds explosive power in the shoulders, core and lats.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the medicine ball with one hand in front of your waist.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Raise the medicine ball above your head, fully extending your arm.
Forcefully slam the medicine ball down to the ground, using your core and shoulders to generate power.
Catch the medicine ball on the bounce and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: otis up
exercises.description: A sit-up variation where you curl up with your hands behind your head. Works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: outside leg kick push-up
exercises.description: A push-up where you kick one leg out to the side at the top. Adds core and hip work to the chest and arm effort.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
As you push back up, kick one leg out to the side, extending it fully and engaging your glutes.
Return your leg to the starting position and repeat the push-up, alternating legs with each repetition.
Continue alternating leg kicks and push-ups for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: overhead triceps stretch
exercises.description: Reaching one arm overhead and bending the elbow, you pull gently on it with the other hand. Stretches the triceps and shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit upright with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm overhead, bending at the elbow so that your hand reaches towards the opposite shoulder blade.
With your other hand, gently pull the elbow of the extended arm towards the opposite side of your head, feeling a stretch in your triceps.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: plyo sit squat (wall)
exercises.description: A jumping variation of the wall sit. You drop into a wall squat and then explode upward, building leg power.
steps: Stand with your back close to a wall, feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a wall sit with your thighs parallel to the floor.
Drive through your feet and jump up explosively.
Land softly with bent knees.
Drop straight back into the sit and repeat.
Keep your chest tall and land quietly.

exercises.name: power clean
exercises.description: You pull the bar from the floor and catch it on your shoulders in a quarter squat. Builds explosive power in the legs, hips and back.
steps: Start with the barbell on the ground in front of you, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend down and grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As the barbell reaches your mid-thigh, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides.
As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, rotating your elbows around and catching the barbell on your shoulders in a front squat position.
Stand up with the barbell, fully extending your hips and knees.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position, keeping control of the weight throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: pretzel stretch
exercises.description: A twisting stretch lying on your side. It loosens the hips, trunk and lower back.
steps: Lie on one side and bend your top knee.
Pull the bottom foot toward your glutes.
Rotate your top knee back toward the floor behind you.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: pull-in (on stability ball)
exercises.description: Hands on the floor and feet on a stability ball, you pull the ball toward your chest. Works the abs and hip flexors while challenging balance.
steps: Start by sitting on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands on the sides of the stability ball for support.
Engage your abs and slowly roll your hips forward, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: pull up (neutral grip)
exercises.description: You hang from a bar with a neutral grip and pull your chin above it. Works the lats and biceps with a shoulder friendly grip.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: pull-up
exercises.description: You hang from a bar with an overhand grip and pull your chin above it. A classic builder for the lats and upper back.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbows and bringing your chest towards the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push-up (bosu ball)
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands on a bosu ball. The unstable surface trains the chest, arms and core stabilizers.
steps: Place the bosu ball on the ground with the flat side facing up.
Position yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the outer edges of the bosu ball.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the bosu ball by bending your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push up (knee chest)
exercises.description: A push-up where you pull a knee toward your chest on each rep. It adds core and conditioning work.
steps: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower into a push-up.
Press back up.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return that foot to the plank.
Alternate legs each rep.

exercises.name: push-up (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds core and shoulder stability work to the chest effort.
steps: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself facing down with your hands on the ball, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, balancing on your toes.
Engage your core and lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push-up (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds core and shoulder stability work to the chest effort.
steps: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself facing down with your hands on the ball, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, balancing on your toes.
Engage your core and lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push up (one arm on stability ball)
exercises.description: A push-up with one hand on a stability ball. It makes the chest and shoulders work harder to stay stable.
steps: Get into a push-up position with one hand on a stability ball and one on the floor.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight.
Finish your reps, then switch the ball hand.

exercises.name: push-up (wall) v. 2
exercises.description: A push-up against a wall, a gentle version for beginners. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: Stand facing a wall, about arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back with your feet, keeping them hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the wall, keeping your body straight.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push-up (wall)
exercises.description: A push-up against a wall, a gentle version for beginners. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: Stand facing a wall, about arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back a few feet, keeping your body straight and your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the wall, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the starting position, straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push-up close-grip off dumbbell
exercises.description: A close grip push-up with your hands on dumbbells. Puts extra focus on the triceps and gives a deeper range.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed close together, directly under your shoulders.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, resting them on the ground.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push-up inside leg kick
exercises.description: A push-up where you kick one leg inward at the top. Adds core and hip work to the chest effort.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
As you push back up, lift one leg off the ground and kick it out to the side, keeping it straight.
Lower your leg back down and repeat the push-up, then switch to the other leg.
Continue alternating leg kicks with each push-up repetition.

exercises.name: push-up
exercises.description: The classic push-up from a high plank. Works the chest, shoulders, triceps and core in one move.
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push-up medicine ball
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands on a medicine ball. The unstable base adds core and shoulder stability work.
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands on the medicine ball, shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push-up to side plank
exercises.description: You do a push-up, then rotate into a side plank. Works the chest, arms, shoulders and obliques.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Shift your weight onto your left hand and rotate your body to the right, lifting your right arm towards the ceiling.
Hold the side plank position for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the push-up and side plank on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: push up w
exercises.description: A push-up variation with the hands placed in a W shape. It focuses on the chest and shoulders.
steps: Get into a plank and place your hands in a W position.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep your elbows angled slightly out.
Press back up.
Repeat without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: raise single arm push-up
exercises.description: A push-up where you lift one arm out to the side at the top. Challenges the core and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position, using your chest muscles to lift your body.
Repeat with the other arm extended.

exercises.name: raise single leg push up
exercises.description: A push-up performed with one leg lifted. It challenges the chest, shoulders and core stability.
steps: Start in a push-up position.
Lift one leg off the floor.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up without twisting your hips.
Keep your body in a line.
Switch the lifted leg every set.

exercises.name: rear decline bridge
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you lift your hips and hold with your feet on the floor. Works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides with your palms facing down.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings, and lift your hips off the ground until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: rear deltoid stretch
exercises.description: You pull one arm across your chest to stretch the back of the shoulder. Hold it gently on each side.
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your right arm across your chest, placing your left hand on your right elbow.
Gently pull your right arm towards your left shoulder, feeling a stretch in your right shoulder.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: rear pull-up
exercises.description: A pull-up where you pull toward the back of your neck. Challenges the upper back and shoulders, so keep it controlled.
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse dip
exercises.description: You lower and press your body between parallel bars with your hands behind you. Works the triceps and shoulders.
steps: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse grip machine lat pulldown
exercises.description: Seated on a lat pulldown machine, you pull the bar down with a reverse grip. Works the lats and biceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an underhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the handles down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse grip pull-up
exercises.description: A pull-up with an underhand grip. Puts extra emphasis on the biceps along with the lats.
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse hyper extension (on stability ball)
exercises.description: Lying face down on a stability ball, you raise your legs behind you. Works the glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your legs extended straight behind you.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for stability.
Engaging your glutes and hamstrings, lift your legs up towards the ceiling as high as you can.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse lunge (leg kick)
exercises.description: A reverse lunge that ends with a forward kick. It trains the glutes and legs, and tests balance.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Kick the rear leg forward.
Place the foot down behind you for the next rep.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: ring dips
exercises.description: A dip performed on gymnastic rings. The unstable rings train the chest, triceps and shoulder stability.
steps: Start by hanging from the rings with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: rocky pull-up pulldown
exercises.description: A pull-up bar move that mixes a pull-up with a controlled pulldown. Builds the lats, upper back and arms.
steps: Stand in front of a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: rolling bridge
exercises.description: A slow bridge where you roll up and down your spine. It strengthens the abs and glutes and improves spinal control.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Curl your pelvis up and peel your spine off the floor.
Lift to a bridge position.
Pause at the top.
Roll back down one vertebra at a time.
Move slowly and breathe.

exercises.name: rope climb
exercises.description: You climb a rope using your arms and legs. A full body pull that builds the grip, lats and arms.
steps: Stand facing the rope with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grab the rope with both hands, palms facing towards you.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Begin pulling yourself up the rope by alternating hand-over-hand movements.
Use your legs to assist in the upward movement.
Continue climbing until you reach the desired height or the top of the rope.
To descend, reverse the hand-over-hand movement while controlling your descent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: rotate push up (on knees)
exercises.description: A knee push-up that adds a rotation to reach upward. It works the chest and the trunk.
steps: Start in a push-up position on your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Rotate your torso and lift one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the arm to the floor.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: rotational jacks
exercises.description: Jumping jacks with a twist added to the upper body. They raise your heart rate and engage the trunk.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet wide and twist your torso to one side.
Jump back together.
Repeat and twist to the other side.
Keep your knees soft.
Maintain a steady pace.

exercises.name: run (equipment)
exercises.description: A running style move that gets your heart rate up. Keep a steady pace for as long as you like.
steps: Start by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your upper body relaxed.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees up towards your chest and landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Maintain a steady pace and continue jogging for the desired duration or distance.
Remember to breathe deeply and maintain good posture throughout the exercise.

exercises.name: run
