exercises.description: A running style move that gets your heart rate up. Keep a steady pace for as long as you like.
steps: Start by standing upright with your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your upper body relaxed.
Begin jogging in place, lifting your knees up towards your chest and landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Maintain a steady pace and continue jogging for the desired duration or distance.
Remember to breathe deeply and maintain good posture throughout the exercise.

exercises.name: russian twist (on stability ball arms straight)
exercises.description: A rotating move with your upper back on a stability ball and arms straight. It targets the obliques and core stability.
steps: Lie with your upper back on a stability ball.
Lift your hips so your body is flat like a table.
Extend your arms straight above your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center and rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips lifted throughout.

exercises.name: russian twist
exercises.description: Seated and leaning back, you rotate your torso from side to side. Works the obliques and abs.
steps: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Hold your hands together in front of your chest or hold a weight if desired.
Lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your sit bones.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing your hands or weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing your hands or weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: scapular pull-up
exercises.description: Hanging from a bar, you pull your shoulder blades down without bending your arms. Builds shoulder control and the lower traps.
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your arms fully extended.
Retract your shoulder blades by pulling them down and back.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, focusing on squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: seated leg raise
exercises.description: Seated on a bench, you lift your legs and lower them again. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on a flat bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Keeping your legs straight, slowly raise them up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: seated lower back stretch
exercises.description: Seated on a chair, you lean forward to stretch the lower back. Hold it gently and breathe slowly.
steps: Sit on the edge of a chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on your thighs or on the sides of the chair for support.
Slowly lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Feel the stretch in your lower back and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: seated side crunch (wall)
exercises.description: Seated against a wall, you crunch from side to side. Works the obliques with back support.
steps: Sit on the floor with your back against a wall and your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lean to one side, bringing your elbow towards your hip.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: seated single leg hamstring stretch
exercises.description: Sitting with one leg extended, you reach toward the foot. It stretches the back of the thigh.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight and the other bent.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Stop when you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: seated straight leg calf stretch
exercises.description: Seated with a straight leg, you pull your toes toward you. It stretches the calf muscles.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg straight.
Loop a towel around the ball of your foot, or hold your toes.
Pull your toes toward you.
Keep your knee straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: seated twist (on stability ball)
exercises.description: Seated on a stability ball, you rotate your torso. It warms up the trunk and trains balance.
steps: Sit tall on a stability ball with feet flat.
Hold your arms in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Return to center and twist the other way.
Move slowly and controlled.

exercises.name: self assisted inverse leg curl (on floor)
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you slide your heels toward your glutes to train the hamstrings. Uses only your body weight.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Lift your hips off the ground, engaging your glutes and hamstrings.
Slowly curl your legs towards your glutes, keeping your hips lifted.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly extend your legs back to the starting position.
Lower your hips back down to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: self assisted inverse leg curl
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you curl your heels toward your glutes. A body weight move for the hamstrings.
steps: Lie flat on your back on a mat or bench with your legs extended.
Place your hands by your sides or under your glutes for support.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: shoulder press (with band)
exercises.description: An overhead press using a band for resistance. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Stand on the band with feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band at shoulder height.
Press your hands overhead until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight.
Lower slowly back to the shoulders.
Avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: shoulder tap push-up
exercises.description: From a high plank, you tap one shoulder with the opposite hand. Works the shoulders and core stability.
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you push back up, lift your right hand off the ground and tap your left shoulder.
Return your right hand to the ground and repeat the push-up, this time lifting your left hand and tapping your right shoulder.
Continue alternating shoulder taps with each push-up repetition.
Maintain a stable core and avoid excessive hip rotation throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: side bend (on stability ball)
exercises.description: Lying sideways over a stability ball, you bend toward the ceiling. It targets the side of the waist.
steps: Lie sideways over a stability ball with feet braced.
Place your hands behind your head.
Lower your upper body over the ball.
Lift back up by contracting the obliques.
Keep your hips steady.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side bridge (bent knee)
exercises.description: An easier side plank with the knees bent. It builds the obliques and side stability.
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent.
Place your forearm under your shoulder.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

exercises.name: side bridge (knee tuck)
exercises.description: A side plank with a knee tuck for extra core work. It trains the obliques and hip flexors.
steps: Start in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top leg slightly.
Pull your top knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg back.
Keep your hips lifted.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side bridge hip abduction (star)
exercises.description: A side plank with the top leg raised in a star shape. It works the outer hip and obliques.
steps: Start in a side plank on your forearm.
Keep your body straight.
Lift your top leg toward the ceiling.
Hold briefly.
Lower the leg with control.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: side bridge v. 2
exercises.description: Lying on your side, you hold your hips up off the floor on your forearm. Works the obliques and core.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your forearm on the ground directly below your shoulder, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: side bridge
exercises.description: A side plank held on one forearm. It strengthens the sides of your trunk.
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Place your elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips until you form a straight line.
Brace your abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch sides.

exercises.name: side crunch v. 2
exercises.description: A side-lying crunch that brings the ribs toward the hip. It works the obliques.
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your upper body and legs toward each other.
Squeeze your side.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side crunch
exercises.description: A crunch focusing on the sides of the waist. It strengthens the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and tilted to one side.
Place your hands behind your head.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulders.
Squeeze your side.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side hip (on parallel bars)
exercises.description: Between parallel bars, you lift your body and swing your hips side to side. Works the obliques and core.
steps: Stand between two parallel bars with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands on the bars and lift your body off the ground, supporting your weight on your arms.
Engage your abs and slowly lift your legs to the side, keeping them straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: side hip abduction
exercises.description: Standing on one leg, you lift the other leg out to the side. Works the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight to one leg and lift the opposite leg out to the side, keeping it straight.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: side lunge stretch
exercises.description: A wide lunge to the side that stretches the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: side lying feet raise
exercises.description: A side-lying lift of both feet at once. It works the inner thighs and the sides of the waist.
steps: Lie on your side with legs straight.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift both feet off the floor together.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side neck stretch
exercises.description: A simple side-bend stretch for the muscles along the side of your neck and top of the shoulders.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Keep the opposite shoulder pressed down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Don't pull hard on your head, a light weight of the hand is enough.

exercises.name: side plank v. 2
exercises.description: A side plank variation held on one forearm. It builds the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Lie on your side and prop up on your forearm.
Stack your feet or stagger them.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Keep your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: side plank
exercises.description: A sideways plank balanced on one forearm. It builds strength in the obliques and the muscles that stabilise your trunk.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Keep your hips high and your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower with control and switch sides.
Don't let your hips drop or roll forward.

exercises.name: side push neck stretch
exercises.description: Tilting your head to one side, you add gentle pressure with your hand. Stretches the side of the neck.
steps: Stand or sit up straight with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head to the right, bringing your right ear towards your right shoulder.
Place your right hand on the left side of your head and gently apply pressure to increase the stretch.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Repeat on the other side, tilting your head to the left and applying pressure with your left hand.
Repeat the stretch 2-3 times on each side.

exercises.name: side push-up
exercises.description: Lying on your side, you push your body away from the floor with one arm. Works the chest, shoulder and triceps.
steps: Start by lying on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom hand on the ground directly under your shoulder, fingers pointing forward.
Press through your bottom hand to lift your body off the ground, keeping your legs straight and your core engaged.
Extend your top arm straight up towards the ceiling, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side sit up
exercises.description: A sit-up performed with a sideways angle. It emphasizes the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Place your hands behind your head.
Sit up while reaching one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly.
Keep your feet planted.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: side stretch crunch
exercises.description: A side crunch that combines a side stretch and a contraction. It works the obliques.
steps: Lie on your side with your bottom arm extended overhead.
Place your top hand behind your head.
Stretch along your side.
Crunch your top elbow toward your hip.
Return to the stretch.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: side-to-side chin
exercises.description: You pull yourself up to one side of the bar, then slide across to the other. Builds the lats, arms and grip.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Pull yourself up by bending your elbows and bringing your chin towards the bar, while keeping your body straight.
Once your chin is above the bar, lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: side wrist pull stretch
exercises.description: You pull your wrist gently with the other hand to stretch the forearm. Hold on each side.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended in front of you.
Extend your right arm out to the side, parallel to the ground, with your palm facing down.
With your left hand, grab your right hand and gently pull it towards your body, feeling a stretch in your right forearm.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: sideway leg bridge
exercises.description: A bridge with a sideways leg shift. It trains the glutes and hips.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step or shift your legs to one side.
Return to the center.
Alternate sides.
Keep your hips lifted.

exercises.name: sideways lifts vertical (straight legs)
exercises.description: Lying down with legs straight and vertical, you lift your hips sideways. It targets the lower abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight up.
Place your arms by your sides.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Tilt your legs slightly to one side.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: sideways lifts vertical turn (straight legs)
exercises.description: A leg-up hip lift with a rotation. It works the lower abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight up.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips and rotate them to one side.
Lower slowly.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep legs straight.

exercises.name: single arm push-up
exercises.description: An advanced push-up using one arm. Works the chest, shoulder, triceps and core.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and one hand placed slightly wider than the other.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight.
As you lower yourself, shift your weight to one side and lift the opposite arm off the ground, extending it straight out to the side.
Push through your chest and triceps to raise your body back up to the starting position, while simultaneously lowering your extended arm back to the ground.
Repeat the movement, alternating the arm you extend with each repetition.

exercises.name: single leg bridge
exercises.description: A glute bridge on one leg. It builds glute strength and hip stability.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Extend one leg straight.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg calf raise (on a dumbbell)
exercises.description: Standing on one leg, you rise up onto your toes with the ball of your foot on a dumbbell. Works the calves with extra range.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Lift one foot off the ground and balance on the other foot.
Slowly raise your heel as high as possible, using your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.

exercises.name: single leg extension (on stability ball)
exercises.description: Balancing on a stability ball, you extend one leg at a time. It works the quads and balance.
steps: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat.
Keep your torso tall.
Extend one leg until it is straight.
Hold briefly.
Lower the foot back down.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg platform slide
exercises.description: Standing on one foot on a slide board, you slide your other leg back and forth. Works the legs and glutes with a balance challenge.
steps: Start by standing with one foot on a platform or slide board.
Bend your knee slightly and slide the foot on the platform backward, extending your leg.
Keep your core engaged and maintain a straight posture throughout the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by sliding your foot back to the initial position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg sit (wall)
exercises.description: A one-legged wall sit that doubles the load on each leg and challenges balance and quad endurance.
steps: Lean your back against a wall and slide down into a wall sit.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg and extend it in front of you.
Hold for 10-30 seconds while keeping your back flat on the wall.
Lower the leg and rest, then switch sides.
Keep your standing knee over your ankle.

exercises.name: single leg step up
exercises.description: A step-up on a box or bench using one leg. It builds the legs and balance.
steps: Stand in front of a sturdy step.
Place one foot fully on the step.
Press through that heel and stand up.
Bring the other foot up to the step.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: sit (wall)
exercises.description: The wall sit, a hold that builds endurance in the thighs without any equipment.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and walk your feet forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your back flat against the wall and your weight on your heels.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-60 seconds, then slide back up the wall to finish.

exercises.name: sit-up v. 2
exercises.description: You lie on your back and curl your torso up toward your knees. Works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: sit up
exercises.description: The classic sit up, curling your torso from the floor to upright. It builds strength in the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or rest your fingertips by your head.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Avoid yanking on your neck; lead with your chest.

exercises.name: sled 45° calf press
exercises.description: On a 45 degree sled, you press the platform with your toes. Isolates the calves.
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Place your feet on the sled platform with your toes pointing forward.
Push the sled platform away from you by extending your ankles and calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the sled platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: sled 45° leg press
exercises.description: On a 45 degree sled, you press the platform away with your feet. Works the quads and glutes.
steps: Adjust the seat and footplate of the sled machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grip the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your legs, keeping your heels on the footplate.
Continue pushing until your legs are almost fully extended, but without locking your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the footplate back towards your body by bending your knees.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: sled 45° leg wide press
exercises.description: On a 45 degree sled, you press with a wide stance. Works the inner thighs, glutes and quads.
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the foot platform.
Position your feet wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push against the foot platform to extend your legs and straighten your knees.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bend your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: sled closer hack squat
exercises.description: On a sled hack squat machine, you squat with your feet close together. Puts more focus on the quads.
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself with your back against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Grip the handles on the sides of the machine for stability.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to extend your legs and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: sled forward angled calf raise
exercises.description: On a sled, you raise your heels with the machine angled forward. Works the calves.
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight and position yourself on the machine with your toes on the platform and your heels hanging off.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the machine for support.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels as high as possible, pushing against the resistance of the sled.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: sled hack squat
exercises.description: On a sled machine, you squat with your back against the pad. Works the quads and glutes.
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable position for your height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Hold onto the handles or bars for stability.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: sled lying squat
exercises.description: Lying on a sled, you bend your knees and press the platform away. Works the quads and glutes.
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Lie on your back on the sled machine with your feet on the footplate.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly angled outwards.
Grip the handles of the sled machine for stability.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push through your heels and extend your legs to lift the sled.
Lower the sled back down by bending your knees and hips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith back shrug
exercises.description: On the smith machine, you lift your shoulders straight up with the bar. Builds the upper traps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and allow the barbell to hang in front of your thighs.
Lift your shoulders straight up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith behind neck press
exercises.description: On the smith machine, you press the bar overhead from behind your neck. Works the shoulders and triceps, so keep it controlled.
steps: Adjust the seat height of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder level.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Lower the bar down to the back of your neck, keeping your elbows pointing forward.
Press the bar up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith bench press
exercises.description: Lying on a bench, you press a smith machine bar up from your chest. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Lie flat on the bench with your feet firmly planted on the ground.
Grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar touches your chest.
Push the bar back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith bent knee good morning
exercises.description: On the smith machine, you bend your knees slightly and hinge forward with the bar on your upper back. Works the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to raise your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith chair squat
exercises.description: On the smith machine, you squat down until you touch a chair. Works the quads and glutes with a clear depth marker.
steps: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to a comfortable position.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Place the barbell across your upper back, resting it on your traps.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you slowly lower your body by bending your knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith close-grip bench press
exercises.description: On the smith machine, you bench press with a close grip. Puts more focus on the triceps and inner chest.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the bench with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with a close grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith deadlift
exercises.description: On the smith machine, you lift the bar from hip height or lower with a hip hinge. Works the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
steps: Set up the smith machine with the bar at hip height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Bend at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight and chest up, and grip the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lift the bar by extending your hips and knees, keeping the bar close to your body.
Stand up straight, fully extending your hips and knees.
Lower the bar back down by bending at the hips and knees, maintaining control and keeping your back straight.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith decline bench press
exercises.description: On a decline bench, you press a smith machine bar from your lower chest. Works the lower chest and triceps.
steps: Adjust the decline bench to the desired angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith decline reverse-grip press
exercises.description: On a decline bench, you press the smith machine bar with a reverse grip. Works the chest and triceps.
steps: Adjust the smith machine to a decline position.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith hack squat
exercises.description: On the smith machine, you squat with your feet forward of the bar. Works the quads and glutes.
steps: Adjust the barbell on the smith machine to an appropriate height for your body.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly pointed outwards.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you unrack the barbell.
Take a step back and position your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Continue descending until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith hip raise
exercises.description: On the smith machine, you press your hips up with the bar across them. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Position yourself on the smith machine with your back against the pad and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands on the barbell, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and glutes, then push through your heels to raise your hips off the ground.
Continue lifting until your body forms a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith incline bench press
exercises.description: On an incline bench, you press the smith machine bar up. Works the upper chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Sit on the bench with your back flat against the pad and feet firmly on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your upper chest, keeping your elbows slightly tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith incline reverse-grip press
exercises.description: On an incline bench, you press the smith machine bar with a reverse grip. Works the upper chest and triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat of the smith machine to a comfortable incline angle.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip that is slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment when the bar is just above your chest.
Push the bar back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith incline shoulder raises
exercises.description: On an incline setup, you raise the smith machine bar in front of you. Works the front shoulders.
steps: Adjust the smith machine to an incline position.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the barbell up towards the ceiling, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith leg press
exercises.description: A leg press done on a smith machine setup, pushing the footplate away with both legs. It builds the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
steps: Adjust the seat and footplate of the smith machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Grasp the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push the footplate away from you by extending your legs, keeping your back against the backrest.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position.
Slowly bend your knees and lower the footplate back towards you, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith narrow row
exercises.description: A row with a narrow grip on the smith machine, pulling toward the torso. It works the mid back and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith rear delt row
exercises.description: A wide-grip row that pulls toward the upper chest to hit the back of the shoulders. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged as you pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith reverse calf raises
exercises.description: A calf raise done with the smith bar for support and the toes on a raised edge. It trains the calves through a full range of motion.
steps: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height just below your shoulders.
Stand facing the bar with your feet hip-width apart and toes pointing forward.
Place the balls of your feet on the edge of a step or platform, with your heels hanging off.
Hold onto the bar for support, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith reverse-grip press
exercises.description: A press with an underhand grip on the smith bar, lowering to the chest and pressing back up. It trains the upper chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to chest level.
Stand facing the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back and position yourself with a slight bend in your knees.
Keep your chest up and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Lower the bar towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith seated shoulder press
exercises.description: A seated overhead press on the smith machine, with the back supported. It builds the shoulders and triceps along a fixed path.
steps: Adjust the seat height so that the handles are at shoulder level.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and lift them off the supports, extending your arms fully.
Lower the handles down to shoulder level, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Press the handles up overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith shoulder press
exercises.description: An overhead press using the smith bar, pressed from shoulder height to full extension. It builds strong shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and position it at shoulder level, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the bar upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the bar back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith shrug
exercises.description: A shrug with the smith bar, lifting the shoulders straight up toward the ears. It builds the upper traps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your arms straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulders up towards your ears, squeezing your traps at the top.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith single leg split squat
exercises.description: A single-leg split squat using the smith bar for balance, with the back foot raised. It trains the quads and glutes one side at a time.
steps: Stand in front of the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place one foot behind you on a bench or step, with your toes pointing forward.
Hold onto the smith machine bar for stability.
Bend your front knee and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

exercises.name: smith sprint lunge
exercises.description: A lunge variation on the smith machine, stepping back and lowering into a lunge. It works the glutes and thighs and challenges balance.
steps: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at hip height.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step back with your right foot and place it on the barbell, resting the top of your foot on the bar.
Bend your left knee and lower your body into a lunge position, keeping your back straight.
Push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping back with your left foot.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith squat
exercises.description: A back squat with the bar guided by the smith machine. It builds the thighs and glutes with extra stability.
steps: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at an appropriate height for your squat.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Position yourself under the barbell, resting it on your upper traps and shoulders.
Grip the barbell with a wide grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and unrack the barbell, stepping back to clear the rack.
Keeping your chest up and back straight, initiate the squat by bending at the hips and knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground or slightly below.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith standing back wrist curl
exercises.description: A wrist curl with the smith bar held behind the body. It strengthens the forearms and grip.
steps: Stand facing the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your body.
Slowly curl your wrists upwards, bringing the barbell towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith standing behind head military press
exercises.description: A standing overhead press with the smith bar lowered behind the head. It builds the shoulders and triceps and needs good shoulder mobility.
steps: Adjust the seat height of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder level.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the bar off the rack and step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Position the bar behind your head, resting on your upper traps.
Keep your core engaged and your chest lifted throughout the exercise.
Press the bar overhead by extending your arms, fully straightening them.
Pause briefly at the top of the movement, then slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith standing leg calf raise
exercises.description: A standing calf raise with the smith bar resting across the shoulders. It loads the calves for strength and size.
steps: Adjust the smith machine bar to a height that allows you to stand with your feet flat on the ground and your shoulders under the bar.
Position yourself under the bar with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing forward.
Place your hands on the bar for stability.
Engage your calves and slowly raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith standing military press
exercises.description: A standing overhead press with the smith bar, starting at shoulder height. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and bring it down to shoulder level, with your palms facing forward.
Press the barbell upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: smith upright row
exercises.description: An upright row with the smith bar, pulling the bar up toward the chin with the elbows leading. It trains the side delts and traps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the smith machine.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the barbell up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: snatch pull
exercises.description: An Olympic lifting pull that drives the barbell from the floor to chest height with a powerful extension and shrug. It builds explosive power in the hips, legs and back.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the barbell on the ground in front of you.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips to lower into a squat position, gripping the barbell with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you drive through your heels to lift the barbell off the ground, extending your hips and knees.
As the barbell reaches hip level, explosively pull it upwards, shrugging your shoulders and pulling your elbows high and to the sides.
As the barbell reaches its highest point, quickly drop underneath it, pulling yourself into a deep squat position.
Catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your knees bent.
Stand up by extending your hips and knees, keeping the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: spell caster
exercises.description: A rotational move with a dumbbell, sweeping the weight across the body from low to high. It trains the abs and obliques and builds control.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the waist, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arm with the dumbbell towards the opposite foot, rotating your torso as you do so.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: spider crawl push up
exercises.description: A push-up combined with a knee drive toward the elbow, like a crawling spider. It trains the chest, core and hips together.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bring your right knee towards your right elbow, keeping it off the ground.
As you bring your right knee back, simultaneously lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows.
Push back up to the starting position and repeat with your left knee towards your left elbow.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: split squat
exercises.description: A staggered-stance squat where the back leg stays put. It works the quads and glutes one side at a time.
steps: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and the other back.
Keep your torso upright and core tight.
Bend both knees and lower until the back knee hovers just above the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: square hop
exercises.description: A quick hopping drill where you jump around the corners of an imaginary square. It builds foot speed, agility and leg power.
steps: Imagine a square on the floor and stand at one corner.
Hop on both feet to the next corner, staying light on your toes.
Keep hopping around the square in order.
Land softly with slightly bent knees.
Reverse direction halfway through your set.

exercises.name: squat (arms overhead)
exercises.description: A bodyweight squat with arms reaching overhead. It trains the legs and challenges shoulder mobility and trunk stability.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and reach both arms overhead.
Keep your arms in line with your ears and your ribs down.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your heels down and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up through your feet to stand tall.

exercises.name: squat (with band)
exercises.description: A squat with a loop band around the legs or under the feet to add resistance. It builds the quads and glutes and keeps the knees pushing out.
steps: Place the band as set up for the drill and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat.
Push your knees out against the band.
Stand up by driving through your heels.

exercises.name: squat jacks
exercises.description: A cardio move that mixes a squat with a jumping jack. It raises your heart rate and burns the legs.
steps: Start in a squat with hands together at your chest.
Jump your feet wide while staying low in the squat.
Jump your feet back together, still low.
Keep your chest lifted and knees over your toes.
Continue at a steady, quick pace.

exercises.name: squat jerk
exercises.description: An Olympic lift where you dip, drive the bar overhead and catch it in a split stance. It builds explosive power and overhead stability.
steps: Start with the barbell resting on your shoulders, with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your legs and push the barbell overhead.
As the barbell reaches its peak, quickly drop into a split position, with one foot forward and one foot back.
Catch the barbell overhead with your arms fully extended and your back knee slightly touching the ground.
Stand up from the split position, bringing your feet back together.
Lower the barbell back to your shoulders and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: standing behind neck press
exercises.description: A standing barbell press from behind the neck to overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps and calls for good shoulder mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell behind your neck with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Press the barbell overhead by extending your arms, fully extending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: standing hamstring stretch
exercises.description: A simple standing stretch for the back of the thigh. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.
steps: Stand tall and place one heel forward on the floor with the toes up.
Keep that leg straight and the other knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: standing hip abduction (bent knee)
exercises.description: Lifting a bent knee out to the side while standing. It works the outer hip and glutes and trains balance.
steps: Stand tall and hold onto a support if needed.
Shift your weight onto one leg and bend the other knee.
Lift the bent knee out to the side without leaning.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: standing hip abduction
exercises.description: Raising a straight leg out to the side while standing. It strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Stand tall beside a wall or chair for balance.
Keep your hips square and toes pointing forward.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing hip extension (bent knee)
exercises.description: Driving a bent knee back behind you while standing. It targets the glutes with a short, controlled range.
steps: Stand tall holding a support, with your core tight.
Shift onto one leg and bend the other knee.
Press that heel back and up, squeezing your glute.
Do not arch your lower back.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: band standing lateral raise
exercises.description: A lateral raise using a band underfoot. It builds the side delts for broader-looking shoulders.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band and hold an end in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
Avoid shrugging or swinging your body.

exercises.name: standing lateral stretch
exercises.description: A standing side bend that stretches the lats and the muscles along the side of the torso. It loosens up the sides and improves mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Slowly lean your upper body to one side, feeling a stretch in your side and lats.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds.
Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: standing single leg curl
exercises.description: A bodyweight hamstring curl done standing on one leg, bringing the heel toward the glutes. It trains the hamstrings and balance.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your hands on your hips.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot off the ground, bending your knee.
Slowly curl your right heel towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstring.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your right foot back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing wheel rollerout
exercises.description: A standing ab wheel rollout, rolling the wheel out in front while hinging at the waist. It is a tough core exercise for the abs.
steps: Start by standing tall with your feet shoulder-width apart and the wheel roller in front of you.
Bend at your waist and slowly roll the wheel forward, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Continue rolling forward until you feel a stretch in your abs and your body is extended as far as possible.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your body, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: stationary bike walk
exercises.description: Easy, steady pedaling on a stationary bike at a walking-like pace. It builds endurance and warms up the legs.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position on the stationary bike to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Start pedaling at a comfortable pace, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Maintain a steady rhythm and increase the resistance level if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Cool down by gradually reducing your pace and resistance level.
Stretch your leg muscles after the workout to prevent tightness and promote recovery.

exercises.name: step up crossover
exercises.description: A step up where you cross a knee or foot over your body. It raises your heart rate and works the legs and trunk.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy step or box.
Step up with one foot and bring the other knee across your body.
Step back down with control.
Keep your chest tall and core tight.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

exercises.name: step up opposite elbow to knee twist
exercises.description: A step up that finishes with a twist, bringing an elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the legs, trunk and coordination.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy step with hands by your head.
Step up with your right foot and drive the left knee up.
Twist to bring your right elbow toward your left knee.
Step down carefully and reset.
Repeat on the other side, alternating.

exercises.name: step up
exercises.description: Stepping onto a bench or box one leg at a time. It builds leg strength and single-leg control.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy step or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Press through that heel to lift your body up until the leg is straight.
Lower back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: superman push-up
exercises.description: A push-up in which you lift the opposite arm and leg at the top, like Superman. It trains the chest, back and core stability.
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
As you lower your body, simultaneously lift your right arm and left leg off the ground, extending them straight out.
Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your arm and leg back down while pushing yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time lifting your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: suspended abdominal fallout
exercises.description: A fallout with suspension straps, leaning forward and lowering the body with straight arms. It builds deep core strength in the abs.
steps: Attach a suspension trainer to a high anchor point and adjust the straps to waist height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point and hold the handles with your arms extended in front of you.
Lean forward at the waist, keeping your body straight and your core engaged.
Lower your body as far as you can while maintaining control and tension in your abs.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: suspended push-up
exercises.description: A push-up with the hands in suspension handles, so the body has to stay stable. It trains the chest, shoulders, triceps and core.
steps: Find a suspension trainer and adjust it to an appropriate height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point and hold the handles with an overhand grip.
Walk your feet forward, leaning your body forward until your weight is supported by the suspension trainer.
Keep your body straight from head to heels, engage your core, and lower your chest towards the handles.
Push through your chest and arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: suspended reverse crunch
exercises.description: A hanging reverse crunch, curling the knees and pelvis up toward the chest. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees up towards your chest, curling your pelvis towards your ribcage.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: suspended row
exercises.description: A bodyweight row with suspension handles, leaning back and pulling the chest to the hands. It trains the back and biceps.
steps: Set up a suspension trainer at an appropriate height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the handles with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
Lean back, keeping your body straight and your heels on the ground.
Pull your chest towards the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: suspended split squat
exercises.description: A split squat with the rear foot in a suspension strap. It builds the quads and glutes and challenges balance.
steps: Stand facing away from a suspension trainer with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one leg forward and place the top of your foot in the foot cradle of the suspension trainer.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down into a lunge position, keeping your chest up and your knee in line with your toes.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

exercises.name: toe touch sit (wall)
exercises.description: A wall sit with a toe touch added. The reach makes your trunk work while your legs hold the squat.
steps: Lean against a wall and slide down into a wall sit.
Hold the squat position with your feet flat.
Reach forward and down with your hands toward your toes.
Return to an upright position against the wall.
Repeat for the set, keeping the sit steady.
Slide back up when finished and keep your knees at about 90 degrees.

exercises.name: trap bar deadlift
exercises.description: A deadlift standing inside a hex bar, lifting by extending the hips and knees. It builds the glutes, quads and back with a friendly lifting position.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and the trap bar on the ground in front of you.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower yourself down and grip the handles of the trap bar with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and chest up as you begin to lift the trap bar off the ground by extending your hips and knees.
As you lift, focus on driving through your heels and squeezing your glutes at the top of the movement.
Lower the trap bar back down to the ground by bending at the hips and knees, keeping your back straight throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: triceps dip (bench leg)
exercises.description: A bench dip with the legs extended on the floor or a bench, lowering and pressing the body up. It trains the triceps.
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Walk your feet forward, sliding your butt off the bench, and straighten your arms.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: triceps dip (between benches)
exercises.description: A triceps dip with the hands on one bench and the feet on another. It trains the triceps and shoulders.
steps: Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge of the bench, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: triceps dip
exercises.description: A triceps dip using the edge of a bench or chair, lowering the body and pressing back up. It builds the triceps.
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: triceps dips floor
exercises.description: A triceps dip with the hands on a chair behind you and the body lowered toward the floor. It builds the triceps and shoulders.
steps: Sit on the edge of a chair or bench with your hands next to your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the front of the chair with your legs extended in front of you.
Straighten your arms, keeping a little bend in your elbows to keep tension on your triceps and off your elbow joints.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower your body toward the floor until your elbows are at about a 90-degree angle.
Once you reach the bottom of the movement, press down into the chair to straighten your elbows, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: triceps press
exercises.description: A bodyweight triceps press that lowers the body by bending the elbows, then presses back up. It works the triceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your upper arms close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: triceps stretch
exercises.description: An overhead stretch for the back of the upper arm, pulling the elbow toward the head. It loosens the triceps and shoulders.
steps: Stand or sit upright with your back straight.
Extend one arm overhead, bending it at the elbow.
Place your opposite hand on the bent elbow and gently pull it towards your head.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling a gentle stretch in your triceps.
Release the stretch and repeat on the other arm.

exercises.name: twin handle parallel grip lat pulldown
exercises.description: A lat pulldown with two handles and a neutral parallel grip. It trains the lats and biceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself facing the cable machine.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Sit down and position your thighs under the thigh pads, keeping your feet flat on the floor.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a neutral spine.
Pull the handles down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, feeling the contraction in your lats.
Slowly release the handles and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: twist side bridge
exercises.description: A side bridge with a rotation of the top arm under your body. It challenges the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Lie on your side and prop up on one forearm, feet stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Reach your top arm under your torso, twisting slightly.
Return to the straight line.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: twist sit up
exercises.description: A sit up with a twist at the top. It adds oblique work to the usual abs focus.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Curl your torso up off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: twist squat
exercises.description: A squat that adds a torso twist as you stand. It trains the legs and rotational control.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands together at your chest.
Sit down into a squat.
As you stand, rotate your torso to one side.
Return to the centre and squat again.
Alternate twisting sides.

exercises.name: twisting crunch (arms straight)
exercises.description: A crunch with straight arms reaching across to the side. It focuses on the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms extended toward the ceiling.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Reach your straight arms toward one side of your knees.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides, keeping your neck relaxed.

exercises.name: vertical leg raise (on parallel bars)
exercises.description: A leg raise done hanging or supported between parallel bars, lifting straight legs in front. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Hang from the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or slightly higher.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: vertical mountain climber
exercises.description: A standing take on the mountain climber with fast knee drives. It lifts your heart rate and works the core.
steps: Stand tall with hands raised in front of you at chest height.
Drive one knee up toward your hands.
Switch legs quickly, running in place.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady, brisk pace.

exercises.name: walk (equipment)
exercises.description: Easy walking on a machine or track at a steady pace, great for warming up or building a base of aerobic fitness.
steps: Step onto the machine and set a comfortable speed.
Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Swing your arms naturally as you walk.
Land on your heel and roll through to your toes.
Walk for 10-30 minutes at a pace where you can still talk.
Slow down gradually at the end.

exercises.name: walk (high knees)
exercises.description: Walking while lifting your knees high. It warms up the legs and gets your heart pumping.
steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee to hip height.
Step down and lift the other knee.
Swing your arms naturally.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set duration.

exercises.name: weighted bench dip
exercises.description: A bench dip with added weight on the lap or hips. It builds the triceps and chest.
steps: Sit on a bench with your hands gripping the edge, fingers pointing forward.
Slide your butt off the bench, supporting your weight with your hands.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted crunch (bent knee)
exercises.description: A crunch with a weight held on your chest. The added load makes the abs work harder.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Curl your shoulders up off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: weighted crunch
exercises.description: A crunch holding a weight on the chest. It strengthens the abs with added resistance.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell on your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your shoulder blades are off the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted donkey calf raise
exercises.description: A donkey calf raise with extra weight, bent at the hips with the toes on a platform. It works the calves through a long range of motion.
steps: Stand on a raised platform with your toes on the edge and your heels hanging off.
Hold onto a stable object for support.
Raise your heels as high as possible by extending your ankles.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted front raise
exercises.description: A front raise with weights, lifting straight arms to shoulder height. It builds the front delts.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and lift the dumbbells in front of you until they are at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted hyperextension (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A back extension over a stability ball while holding a weight. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Position yourself face down on a stability ball with your hips resting on the ball and your feet against a wall for stability.
Place your hands behind your head or cross them over your chest.
Engage your core and slowly lift your upper body off the ball, extending your back until your body forms a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted leg extension crunch
exercises.description: A crunch where your legs extend as you curl up, holding a weight. It hits the abs and lower abs hard.
steps: Lie on your back holding a weight at your chest.
Start with knees bent and lifted.
Curl up while straightening your legs forward.
Bring your knees back in as you lower.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.

exercises.name: weighted lying hip abduction
exercises.description: A side-lying leg lift with added weight. It strengthens the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with a weight on your top thigh or ankle.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: weighted lying side lifting head (with head harness)
exercises.description: A side-lying neck raise using a head harness with a weight. It builds strength in the muscles at the side of the neck.
steps: Lie on your side on a bench with your head just past the edge, wearing a head harness with a light weight.
Let your head hang slightly toward the floor.
Lift your head up toward the ceiling, moving only your neck.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Use a light weight and a controlled pace.

exercises.name: weighted lying twist
exercises.description: A lying trunk twist holding a weight. It works the obliques and the core.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a weight above your chest.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower your knees to one side.
Return to centre and lower to the other side.
Move slowly and keep control.

exercises.name: weighted overhead crunch (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A weighted crunch on a stability ball with the arms overhead. It trains the abs through a larger range of motion.
steps: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Engage your abs and slowly curl your torso forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your torso back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted pull-up
exercises.description: A pull-up with added weight on a belt or vest. It builds the lats and biceps and increases strength.
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted pullover (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A pullover with a weight while lying across a stability ball. It stretches and works the lats and chest.
steps: Lie with your upper back on the ball, hips lifted.
Hold a weight with both hands above your chest.
Lower it back over your head with slightly bent arms.
Pull it back up over your chest.
Keep your core tight and hips high.

exercises.name: weighted reduction triangle
exercises.description: A weighted inner-thigh squeeze, bringing the legs together in a triangle shape. It works the adductors.
steps: Sit or lie with knees bent and a weight resting on your thighs.
Let your knees open into a triangle.
Squeeze your knees together against the weight.
Pause briefly.
Open slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: weighted round arm
exercises.description: A bent-over lateral raise with weights, lifting the arms out to the sides. It trains the rear and side delts.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Continue lifting your arms until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted russian twist (legs up)
exercises.description: A weighted Russian twist with the feet lifted, rotating the torso side to side. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet lifted off the ground, keeping your legs together.
