Hold the weight with both hands in front of your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Lean back slightly to engage your core muscles.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the ground on your right side.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight towards the ground on your left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted russian twist
exercises.description: A seated Russian twist holding a weight, rotating side to side. It trains the obliques and abs.
steps: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a weight or medicine ball with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight or medicine ball towards the floor on your right side.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight or medicine ball towards the floor on your left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted seated bicep curl (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A seated biceps curl on a stability ball holding a medicine ball. It trains the biceps and balance.
steps: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a medicine ball with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and let your arms hang down by your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the medicine ball up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the medicine ball back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted seated neck extension (with head harness)
exercises.description: A seated neck extension with a weighted head harness, working the muscles at the back of the neck.
steps: Sit on a bench wearing a head harness with a light weight hanging in front.
Lean slightly forward and rest your hands on your thighs.
Let your chin drop toward your chest in a controlled way.
Raise your head back up until your neck is neutral.
Repeat slowly for the set.
Keep your back straight and use a light load.

exercises.name: weighted seated twist (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A seated twist on a stability ball holding a weight at the chest. It trains the obliques and builds core control.
steps: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell with both hands close to your chest.
Engage your core and slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted side bend (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A side bend on a stability ball holding a weight in one hand. It trains the obliques.
steps: Sit on a stability ball with your feet shoulder-width apart and flat on the ground.
Hold a weight in one hand and place your other hand on your hip.
Engage your core and slowly bend sideways towards the weighted side, keeping your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: weighted sissy squat
exercises.description: A sissy squat with added weight, leaning back while the knees travel forward. It isolates the quads.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands, or place a barbell across your upper back.
Keeping your chest up and your core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending at the knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted squat
exercises.description: A squat with weight held at the chest or shoulders. It builds the glutes and thighs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest or on your shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your hips down and back, as if sitting into a chair.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Push through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted standing curl
exercises.description: A standing curl with weights in both hands. It trains the biceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and exhale as you curl the weights up to shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the weights back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted standing hand squeeze
exercises.description: A standing hand squeeze holding weights, squeezing the hands together. It works the forearms and grip.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight in each hand.
Extend your arms straight in front of you, palms facing each other.
Squeeze your hands together as hard as you can, engaging your forearms.
Hold the squeeze for a few seconds, then release.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted standing twist
exercises.description: A standing torso rotation holding a weight. It builds the obliques and trunk control.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart holding a weight at your chest.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Move smoothly without jerking.

exercises.name: weighted svend press
exercises.description: A chest squeeze press holding a plate between the palms and pushing it forward. It trains the inner chest and shoulders.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a weight plate in front of your chest with both hands.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your palms facing each other.
Press the weight plate straight out in front of you, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly bring the weight plate back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: wheel rollerout
exercises.description: An ab wheel rollout from the knees, rolling forward and back with control. It builds a strong core and abs.
steps: Kneel on the floor and place the wheel roller in front of you.
Place your hands on the handles of the wheel roller and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Engage your core muscles and slowly roll the wheel forward, keeping your back straight and your abs tight.
Continue rolling forward until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your knees, maintaining control and keeping your abs engaged.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: wind sprints
exercises.description: Short, all-out runs followed by rest. They build speed, stamina and a strong cardio base.
steps: Find an open space or a track to perform the exercise.
Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Begin running as fast as you can, pumping your arms and driving your knees up.
Continue sprinting for a specific distance or time period.
Rest and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: wrist rollerer
exercises.description: A wrist roller that winds a weight up on a rope or bar by turning the wrists. It builds the forearms and grip.
steps: Attach a weight to one end of a rope or bar.
Hold the other end of the rope or bar with both hands, palms facing down.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms fully extended in front of you.
Slowly roll the weight up towards your hands by flexing your wrists.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the weight back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable kickback
exercises.description: A cable triceps kickback, hinging forward and extending the forearm back. It isolates the triceps.
steps: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with your right hand and step back to create tension in the cable.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Keep your upper arm close to your body and your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your forearm backward, straightening your arm fully.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable seated row
exercises.description: A seated cable row, pulling the handles toward the torso. It trains the back and biceps.
steps: Sit on the cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, keeping your back straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable twist (up-down)
exercises.description: A cable twist that rotates the torso with a handle held at the chest. It trains the obliques and abs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the cable machine.
Hold the cable handle with both hands in front of your chest, keeping your arms slightly bent.
Engage your core and slowly rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips and legs stable.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the rotation to the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying external shoulder rotation
exercises.description: A side-lying rotation with a light dumbbell, turning the forearm upward with the elbow at the side. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
steps: Lie on your side on a flat bench with your upper arm against your side and your elbow bent 90 degrees.
Hold a dumbbell in your hand with your palm facing down.
Keeping your upper arm against your side, slowly rotate your forearm upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell upright shoulder external rotation
exercises.description: A shoulder exercise raising the arms to the side and rotating the dumbbells upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff and delts.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Rotate your arms externally, bringing the dumbbells up towards your head while keeping your elbows in the same position.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lying leg-hip raise
exercises.description: A lying leg raise that also lifts the hips off the floor at the top. It trains the lower abs.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, raising them towards the ceiling.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted hanging leg-hip raise
exercises.description: A hanging leg raise with added weight. It builds the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or slightly higher.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse plank
exercises.description: A plank held face up, supported on your hands and heels. It strengthens the back of the body and opens up the chest.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs straight and hands behind your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Press into your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Straighten your body from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower your hips with control.

exercises.name: cable curl
exercises.description: A standing curl using a cable and an underhand grip. It keeps constant tension on the biceps.
steps: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the cable attachment with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the cable attachment towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the cable attachment back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever shoulder press v. 2
exercises.description: A machine shoulder press with a lever arm, pressing the handles overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: butt-ups
exercises.description: A lying move where the hips lift off the floor as the knees come toward the chest. It trains the lower abs.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands by your sides, palms facing down.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs off the ground, bringing your knees towards your chest.
At the top of the movement, squeeze your abs and pause for a moment.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: tuck crunch
exercises.description: A crunch that pulls the knees toward the chest as the upper body curls up. It trains the abs.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your shoulder blades off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest, simultaneously curling your upper body towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your shoulder blades and extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: reverse crunch
exercises.description: A crunch that curls the hips off the floor with the knees bent. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended along your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your feet off the ground, bringing your thighs perpendicular to the floor.
Contract your abs and curl your hips off the floor, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable reverse crunch
exercises.description: A reverse crunch using a low cable, curling the hips off the mat. It trains the lower abs.
steps: Attach a cable to a low pulley and lie down facing up on a mat.
Hold the cable with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Bend your knees and lift your legs up, bringing your thighs towards your chest.
While keeping your upper body stable, curl your pelvis up towards your chest, lifting your hips off the mat.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable standing crunch (with rope attachment)
exercises.description: A standing cable crunch with a rope held behind the head, curling the torso forward. It strengthens the abs.
steps: Attach a rope to a cable machine at chest height.
Stand facing away from the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the rope with both hands and bring it behind your head, keeping your elbows bent.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch your torso forward, bringing your elbows towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the crunch, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell full squat (with rack)
exercises.description: A deep back squat performed in a power rack for safety. It builds strength across the legs and hips.
steps: Set the bar at upper chest height in a rack and step under it, resting it on your upper back.
Unrack and step back with your feet shoulder width apart.
Bend your hips and knees and squat down as deep as you comfortably can.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Set the safety pins just below your lowest depth.

exercises.name: cable standing hip extension v. 2
exercises.description: A cable kickback for the glutes with an ankle strap. This is a second version of the move.
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the frame for support.
Keep your core tight and kick the strapped leg back.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell curtsey lunge
exercises.description: A lunge where you step back and across behind you, like a curtsey. It works the glutes and outer hips from a different angle.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest up and hips square.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

exercises.name: dumbbell one leg squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat holding a dumbbell. It builds leg strength and balance.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or by your side.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Sit your hips back and lower under control.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press up to stand, then switch legs.

exercises.name: smith lateral step up
exercises.description: A sideways step up under the smith bar. It works the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
steps: Place a bench beside you and set the bar across your upper back.
Stand with the bench at your side.
Step up sideways with the near foot.
Straighten your leg to lift your body.
Lower slowly, finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: smith lying lift (on hip)
exercises.description: A side-lying lift using the smith machine for resistance. It targets the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side under the bar and set it at a comfortable height.
Place your top foot or leg against the bar.
Lift the leg up smoothly against the resistance.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: smith one leg deadlift
exercises.description: A single-leg deadlift using the smith bar. It trains the hamstrings, glutes and balance.
steps: Stand holding the bar at hip height on a single leg.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward, sliding the bar down your leg.
Keep your back flat and extend the free leg behind you.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band back extension
exercises.description: A back extension with band resistance. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Anchor the band and secure it across your upper back.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your torso up until your body is in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: band bent over row v. 2
exercises.description: A bent-over row with a band. It builds the muscles between your shoulder blades and the lats.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends in your hands.
Hinge forward with a flat back and soft knees.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: band bent over rear lateral raise v. 3
exercises.description: A bent-over raise to the sides with a band. It focuses on the rear delts.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends in each hand.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Raise your arms out to the sides with slightly bent elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: band calf raise
exercises.description: A calf raise with band resistance. It builds the calves and ankle strength.
steps: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly.
Press up onto your toes against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: band hammer curl
exercises.description: A hammer curl with a band. The neutral grip hits the brachialis and forearms along with the biceps.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: band hip extension
exercises.description: A band-resisted leg kick back. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Loop the band around your ankles or anchor it low.
Stand tall and hold support.
Press one leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band hyperextension
exercises.description: A hyperextension with band resistance. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Secure the band over your shoulders and under your feet or anchor.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Rise until your torso is in line with your legs.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: band kickback
exercises.description: A triceps kickback with a band. It isolates the back of the upper arm.
steps: Stand on the band, hinge forward and hold the ends.
Keep your upper arms close to your sides.
Straighten your elbows, pushing your hands back.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Bend slowly to return.

exercises.name: band kneeling pulldown
exercises.description: A kneeling pulldown with a band anchored overhead. It trains the lats and mid-back.
steps: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it.
Grab the ends with arms extended up.
Pull your elbows down toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly with control.

exercises.name: band kneeling rear kick
exercises.description: A kneeling glute kick against a band. It strengthens the glutes with a stable base.
steps: Get on all fours with the band around one foot and in your hands.
Keep your core tight.
Kick the banded leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band lateral raise
exercises.description: A lateral raise with a band. It builds the side delts.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height.
Lower slowly under control.
Avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: band low fly
exercises.description: A fly where your arms sweep upward from low to high. It targets the upper chest.
steps: Anchor the band low and stand with a staggered stance.
Hold the ends with arms slightly bent.
Sweep your arms up and together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: band lunges
exercises.description: Lunges with band resistance. They build the quads and glutes with extra tension.
steps: Stand on the band with the ends held at your shoulders.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to return.
Alternate legs.

exercises.name: band lying leg and hip raise
exercises.description: A lying raise lifting the legs and hips with a band. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with the band set around your feet or anchored.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Curl your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Keep your lower back controlled.

exercises.name: band lying leg curl
exercises.description: A leg curl while lying down using a band. It targets the hamstrings.
steps: Lie face down with a band anchored to your ankles.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstrings.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: band lying leg raise
exercises.description: A lying leg raise against a band. It works the hip muscles.
steps: Lie on your back with the band around your legs.
Keep your legs straight.
Raise one leg against the band.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: band middle fly
exercises.description: A chest fly with the band at mid-chest height. It works the pecs through a sweeping motion.
steps: Anchor the band at chest height and stand facing away.
Hold the ends with slightly bent elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: band push up
exercises.description: A push up with a band across your back for extra resistance. It strengthens the chest and triceps.
steps: Loop the band across your upper back, holding the ends under your palms.
Set up in a high plank.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up against the band.
Keep your body in a straight line.

exercises.name: band reverse curl
exercises.description: A curl with an overhand grip using a band. It builds the forearms and brachialis.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms down.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: band single stiff leg deadlift
exercises.description: A single-leg stiff-leg deadlift with a band. It builds the hamstrings and balance.
steps: Stand on the band on one leg and hold the ends.
Keep a slight bend in the standing knee.
Hinge forward with a flat back and kick the free leg back.
Return by driving your hips forward.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band standing external shoulder rotation
exercises.description: An external rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
steps: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your body.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: band standing incline chest press
exercises.description: A standing press angled upward using a band. It targets the upper chest.
steps: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at your chest.
Step into a staggered stance.
Press your hands up and forward.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: band standing internal shoulder rotation
exercises.description: An internal rotation with a band. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
steps: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the end with your elbow bent at 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm across toward your belly.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: band standing leg extension
exercises.description: A leg extension while standing with a band around the ankle. It works the quads.
steps: Anchor the band behind you and loop it around one ankle.
Hold support and lift the knee slightly.
Straighten your knee forward.
Squeeze your quad.
Bend slowly to return, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band standing straight leg raise
exercises.description: A straight-leg raise forward while standing with a band. It works the hip flexors and quads.
steps: Loop the band around your ankle and anchor it behind you.
Stand tall holding support.
Raise the straight leg forward.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band straight arm pulldown
exercises.description: A pulldown with straight arms using a band. It isolates the lats.
steps: Anchor the band overhead and stand facing it.
Hold the ends with straight arms.
Pull your hands down toward your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: band standing row
exercises.description: A standing row with a band. It works the mid-back and lats.
steps: Anchor the band at chest height and hold the ends.
Step back to create tension.
Pull your elbows back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: band twist (down up)
exercises.description: A diagonal twist with a band moving from low to high. It trains the obliques.
steps: Anchor the band low and hold it with both hands beside the anchor.
Keep your hips facing forward.
Rotate your torso, pulling the band diagonally up.
Return slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band upright row
exercises.description: Pull a band up along your body toward chest height. It works the shoulders and upper traps with gentle, joint-friendly resistance.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and grip the ends with both hands.
Let your arms hang in front of your thighs with the band slightly taut.
Pull your hands up along your body, leading with the elbows, until they reach about chest height.
Pause briefly, then lower under control without letting the band snap back.
Keep your chest tall and your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: band upright shoulder external rotation
exercises.description: Rotate your forearm outward against a band while the elbow stays at your side. It strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles that steady the shoulder.
steps: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand sideways to it, holding the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow against your side with the elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm away from your belly, keeping the elbow pinned in place.
Pause when your hand points slightly outward, then return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lever stepper
exercises.description: Climb on a lever stepper machine at a steady pace. It raises your heart rate and works the legs and glutes.
steps: Step onto the pedals and hold the handles lightly for balance.
Push one pedal down while the other rises, keeping a smooth rhythm.
Stand tall and keep your knees pointing forward.
Continue at a comfortable pace for several minutes, adjusting resistance as needed.
Slow down gradually before stepping off.

exercises.name: cat pose
exercises.description: Round your spine upward from hands and knees to stretch the back. A gentle way to loosen the spine and wake up the core.
steps: Start on all fours with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Exhale and press the floor away as you round your back toward the ceiling.
Tuck your chin toward your chest and draw your belly in.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Inhale and return to a neutral back.

exercises.name: chair pose utkatasana v. 2
exercises.description: A deeper version of chair pose where you sit lower with arms lifted. It builds leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand with feet together and arms at your sides.
Bend your knees and sit your hips back and down as if lowering into a chair.
Reach your arms up beside your ears and lengthen your spine.
Sink a little deeper while keeping your weight in your heels.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then straighten your legs to stand.

exercises.name: chair pose utkatasana
exercises.description: Sit back into an imaginary chair with arms overhead. It strengthens the thighs and glutes while challenging balance.
steps: Stand with feet together or hip-width apart.
Bend your knees and send your hips back, keeping your chest lifted.
Raise your arms overhead with palms facing each other.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your tailbone tucked slightly.
Hold for 5 slow breaths, then stand up.

exercises.name: child pose
exercises.description: Fold forward over your knees with arms extended on the floor. A restful stretch for the back, hips and shoulders.
steps: Kneel on the floor with big toes touching and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Fold forward and slide your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the floor and relax your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: crane pose bakasana
exercises.description: An arm balance where your knees rest on the backs of your upper arms and your feet lift. It builds wrist, arm and core strength.
steps: Squat with feet together and place your hands flat on the floor shoulder-width apart.
Bend your elbows slightly and rest your shins against the backs of your upper arms.
Shift your weight forward onto your hands and lift one foot, then the other.
Round your upper back, draw your belly in and gaze slightly ahead.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower your feet gently.

exercises.name: crescent moon pose
exercises.description: Stand and arch sideways with arms overhead to lengthen one side of the body. It opens the ribs, sides and shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and raise your arms overhead, palms joined.
Reach up through your fingertips and keep your hips level.
Lean your upper body slowly to one side in a gentle curve.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths without twisting forward or back.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: default pose
exercises.description: A relaxed, tall standing posture with arms by your sides. It is the neutral starting point for standing moves.
steps: Stand with feet about hip-width apart and weight even on both feet.
Let your arms hang naturally at your sides.
Lengthen your spine and gently draw your ribs down.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Breathe calmly for a few breaths.

exercises.name: downward facing dog adho mukha svanasana
exercises.description: An inverted V shape that stretches the back of the legs and spine while loading the shoulders. A classic yoga staple.
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands slightly ahead of shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Straighten your legs as far as comfortable and press your chest toward your thighs.
Spread your fingers and push the floor away.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: fish pose matsyasana
exercises.description: Lie on your back and lift your chest into a gentle arch. It opens the chest and front of the neck and shoulders.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms at your sides, palms down.
Press your forearms into the floor and lift your chest.
Arch your upper back and lower the crown of your head lightly toward the floor.
Keep your legs relaxed and breathe deeply into the chest.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: garland pose malasana
exercises.description: A deep squat with elbows pressing the knees apart and palms together. It stretches the hips, groin and ankles.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than hips and toes turned out.
Lower into a deep squat, keeping your heels down if you can.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Press your elbows against your inner knees and lengthen your spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: half moon pose ardha chandrasana
exercises.description: Balance on one leg with the torso and top leg extended sideways. It strengthens the standing leg and hips and tests your balance.
steps: Start in a wide-legged stance and turn one foot out.
Bend over that leg and place your hand on the floor or a block ahead of the foot.
Lift the back leg until it is parallel to the floor.
Open your chest and stack your hips, reaching the top arm up.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower and switch sides.

exercises.name: hands to feet pada hastasana
exercises.description: Fold forward and slide your hands under your feet. It stretches the hamstrings, calves and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at the hips and fold forward with a long spine.
Slide your hands under your feet with palms up, toes on your fingers.
Pull gently to deepen the stretch while keeping your knees slightly soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: hero pose virasana
exercises.description: Kneel and sit between your feet, stretching the thighs and ankles. A grounded seat for breathing or meditation.
steps: Kneel with knees together and feet slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips down between your heels, using a block if needed.
Rest your hands on your thighs and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and breathe evenly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, then come out slowly.

exercises.name: leg to side
exercises.description: Bring one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility and flexibility.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg and let it open out to the side, keeping the other leg down.
Keep your hips squared and your lower back relaxed.
Hold the stretch gently, breathing steadily.
Return to the middle and repeat with the other leg.

exercises.name: lotus yoga pose padmasana
exercises.description: Sit cross-legged with each foot resting on the opposite thigh. It opens the hips and encourages a calm, upright posture.
steps: Sit tall with legs stretched out in front of you.
Bend one knee and place that foot high on the opposite thigh.
Bend the other knee and place that foot on top, if your hips allow it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Breathe slowly for 30-60 seconds, then switch which leg goes on top.

exercises.name: revolved side angle pose parivrtta parsvakonasana
exercises.description: A deep lunge with a twist and hands pressed together. It strengthens the legs and wrings out the spine.
steps: Step into a long lunge with the back heel lifted.
Bring your palms together at your chest.
Twist your torso and hook the opposite elbow outside the front knee.
Press your palms together and look up or ahead.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: spread leg forward fold upavista konasana
exercises.description: Sit with legs wide and fold forward over them. It stretches the inner thighs and hamstrings.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs spread as wide as is comfortable.
Flex your feet and keep your knees pointing up.
Walk your hands forward and fold from the hips.
Keep your spine long instead of rounding.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: standing forward bend uttanasana
exercises.description: Fold forward from standing and let the head hang. It lengthens the hamstrings and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge at your hips and fold forward, keeping your knees slightly soft.
Let your hands rest on the floor or hold opposite elbows.
Relax your neck and let the weight of your head drop.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: stand spread leg forward fold
exercises.description: Fold forward from a wide-legged stance to stretch the inner thighs and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Hinge forward at the hips with a long spine.
Lower your hands to the floor or your shins.
Relax your head and neck.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: tree pose vrksasana
exercises.description: Balance on one leg with the other foot resting on your inner thigh. It builds balance, focus and hip strength.
steps: Stand tall and shift your weight onto one foot.
Place the sole of the other foot on your inner calf or thigh, never on the knee.
Bring your palms together at your chest or raise them overhead.
Fix your eyes on one point to stay steady.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch legs.

exercises.name: triangle pose trikonasana
exercises.description: From a wide stance, reach sideways over the front leg with arms in a line. It stretches the hamstrings, hips and sides.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart and turn one foot out 90 degrees.
Raise your arms to shoulder height.
Reach toward the front foot, then lower that hand to your shin or the floor.
Extend the other arm up and look toward it.
Hold for 3 to 5 breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: warrior pose virabhadrasana v. 2
exercises.description: A wide lunge with arms stretched to the sides. It strengthens the legs and builds stamina.
steps: Stand with feet wide and turn your front foot out.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Extend your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Turn your head to look over the front hand.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: warrior pose i virabhadrasana
exercises.description: A lunge with arms raised overhead. It stretches the hip flexors and chest and strengthens the legs.
steps: Step one foot back into a long stance, with the back foot turned out slightly.
Bend the front knee over the ankle.
Square your hips toward the front.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 5 breaths, then switch sides.

exercises.name: wide legged forward bend prasarita padottanasana
exercises.description: Fold forward with your feet far apart. It stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs and eases the back.
steps: Stand with feet about one leg-length apart and toes pointing slightly in.
Place your hands on your hips and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower your hands to the floor under your shoulders.
Let your head hang long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.

exercises.name: barbell deadlift (back view)
exercises.description: The barbell deadlift shown from behind. It's a full posterior chain lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.

exercises.name: barbell deadlift (front pov)
exercises.description: The barbell deadlift seen from the front. A strong lift for the glutes, hamstrings and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart, bar over mid-foot.
Hinge at the hips and grip the bar just outside your legs.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out your hips at the top without leaning back.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.

exercises.name: band alternating biceps curl
exercises.description: A band curl alternating one arm at a time. It trains the biceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and slowly curl one arm up towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps at the top.
Lower the arm back down to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band alternating v-up
exercises.description: A V-up with a band, alternating the leg position each rep. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engage your abs and lift your legs and upper body off the ground simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
As you lower your legs and upper body back down, switch the position of your legs, crossing one over the other.
Repeat the movement, alternating the position of your legs with each repetition.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band assisted pull-up
exercises.description: A pull-up with a band looped under the feet for assistance. It builds the lats and biceps while you work toward unassisted pull-ups.
steps: Attach the band to a pull-up bar or sturdy anchor point.
Step onto the band and grip the bar with your palms facing away from you, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang with your arms fully extended, keeping your core engaged and your shoulders down and back.
Pull your body up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together and driving your elbows down towards your hips.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band assisted wheel rollerout
exercises.description: An ab wheel rollout with a band to help bring you back. It trains the abs with a lighter load.
steps: Kneel on the floor and hold the handles of the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Place the band on the ground in front of you and position your hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and slowly roll the wheel forward, extending your body as far as you can while maintaining control.
Pause for a moment at the furthest point, then slowly roll the wheel back towards your knees to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band bicycle crunch
exercises.description: A bicycle crunch with a band, rotating the torso and alternating the knees. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your hands behind your head and your knees bent.
Lift your feet off the ground and bring your right knee towards your chest while simultaneously twisting your torso to bring your left elbow towards your right knee.
Straighten your right leg while bringing your left knee towards your chest and twisting your torso to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Continue alternating the twisting motion, as if you are pedaling a bicycle, while keeping your core engaged throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band calf raise v. 2
exercises.description: Rise onto your toes against band resistance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: Sit or stand with the band looped under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly so the band is taut.
Press up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your ankles straight and avoid rolling out.

exercises.name: band close-grip pulldown
exercises.description: A close-grip pulldown with a band, pulling down toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
steps: Attach the band to a high anchor point, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Stand facing the anchor point and grab the band with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your feet hip-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your back straight as you pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band close-grip push-up
exercises.description: A push-up with a band around the upper arms to keep the elbows in. It trains the triceps and chest.
steps: Place a band around your upper arms, just above the elbows.
Assume a push-up position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band concentration curl
exercises.description: A seated concentration curl with a band, with the elbow braced on the thigh. It isolates the biceps.
steps: Sit on a bench or chair with your legs spread apart and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold one end of the band in your hand and step on the other end with your foot on the same side.
Lean forward slightly and rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
With your palm facing up, slowly curl your hand towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your hand back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band front lateral raise
exercises.description: A front raise with a band, lifting straight arms to shoulder height. It trains the front delts.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and lift the band up in front of you until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band front raise
exercises.description: A front raise with a band, raising both arms forward. It builds the front shoulders.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing down.
Keep your arms straight and slowly raise them forward until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band horizontal pallof press
exercises.description: A Pallof press with a band anchored to the side, pressing out and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
steps: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand perpendicular to the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band handle with both hands and step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Bring your hands to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Engage your core and maintain a stable stance.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, pushing the band away from your body.
Hold the extended position for a few seconds, focusing on maintaining tension in your core.
Slowly bring your hands back to your chest, resisting the pull of the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band bent-over hip extension
exercises.description: A bent-over hip extension with a band, kicking one leg back. It trains the glutes.
steps: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at ankle height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and lean forward, maintaining a neutral spine.
Extend your right leg straight back, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower your right leg back down and repeat with the left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band jack knife sit-up
exercises.description: A jackknife sit-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engage your abs and lift your legs and upper body simultaneously, bringing your hands towards your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band lying hip external rotation
exercises.description: A side-lying clam-style move with a band around the knees that fires up the outer hip and glute muscles.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and a loop band around your thighs just above the knees.
Keep your feet together and your hips stacked.
Rotate the top knee upward, opening like a clamshell.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch sides.
Keep your pelvis still so the movement comes from the hip.

exercises.name: band kneeling one arm pulldown
exercises.description: A kneeling one-arm pulldown with a band, driving the elbow toward the ribs. It trains the lats.
steps: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point above your head.
Kneel down and hold the band with one hand, palm facing down.
Extend your arm fully overhead, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Engage your lat muscles and pull the band down towards your side, bringing your elbow towards your ribcage.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band lying hip internal rotation
exercises.description: A lying hip rotation with a band around the feet or legs, rotating the knees out and back. It works the glutes and hips.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and a resistance band looped around your feet.
Bend your knees and bring them towards your chest, keeping your feet together.
Slowly rotate your knees outwards, away from each other, while keeping your feet together.
Pause for a moment at the end of the rotation, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band kneeling twisting crunch
exercises.description: A kneeling crunch with a twist using a band. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Kneel down facing away from the anchor point and hold the band with both hands, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to one side, bringing your hands towards your opposite hip.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band one arm overhead biceps curl
exercises.description: A standing one-arm curl with the arm held overhead against band tension. It trains the biceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place one end of the band under your foot.
Hold the other end of the band with your arm fully extended overhead, palm facing forward.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, curl your forearm towards your shoulder, squeezing your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

exercises.name: band one arm single leg split squat
exercises.description: A single-leg split squat with a band, back foot raised. It trains the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band around your ankles.
Extend one leg forward and rest the top of your foot on a bench or step behind you.
Hold onto a support with one hand for balance.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down into a squat position, keeping your knee in line with your toes.
Push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band one arm standing low row
exercises.description: A standing one-arm low row with a band. It trains the back and biceps.
steps: Attach the band to a stable anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with one hand, palm facing inward, and step back to create tension in the band.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly release the band back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band one arm twisting chest press
exercises.description: A one-arm chest press with a band that adds a twist. It trains the chest and core.
steps: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at chest height.
Stand with your side facing the anchor point and grab the band with one hand.
Step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Bring your hand holding the band across your body, towards the opposite shoulder.
While maintaining tension in the band, push your hand forward and away from your body, extending your arm.
Slowly return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Switch sides and repeat the exercise with the other hand.

exercises.name: band one arm twisting seated row
exercises.description: A seated one-arm row with a band and a torso twist. It trains the back and obliques.
steps: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold the band with one hand and extend your arm fully in front of you.
Keeping your back straight, pull the band towards your body by bending your elbow and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
At the same time, twist your torso towards the side of the pulling arm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension in the band and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.

exercises.name: band pull through
exercises.description: A hip hinge pulling a band through the legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Attach a resistance band to a sturdy anchor point at ground level.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step forward to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and push your glutes back, maintaining a slight bend in your knees.
Lower your torso until it is parallel to the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band push sit-up
exercises.description: A sit-up that pushes a band forward as you come up. It trains the abs.
steps: Attach the band securely to a stable anchor point.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with both hands and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band reverse fly
exercises.description: A reverse fly with a band, opening the arms to the sides. It trains the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Attach the band to a stationary object at chest height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with both hands in front of you.
Keep your arms straight and lift them out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band reverse wrist curl
exercises.description: A reverse wrist curl with a band, lifting the back of the hands. It strengthens the forearms.
steps: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and wrap it around your fingers.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, with your wrists hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band seated hip external rotation
exercises.description: A seated hip rotation with a band for resistance, working the glutes and deep hip rotators.
steps: Sit on a bench or chair with a band looped around your knees or thighs.
Keep your feet planted and your back tall.
Push your knees apart against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring your knees back together slowly.
Keep your torso still and avoid leaning.

exercises.name: band seated hip internal rotation
exercises.description: A seated hip rotation against a band around the thighs. It works the glutes and hip muscles.
steps: Sit on a chair or bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Place a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Keep your knees bent at a 90-degree angle and your feet shoulder-width apart.
Engage your glutes and slowly rotate your knees outward, pushing against the resistance of the band.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band shoulder press
exercises.description: A shoulder press with a band under the feet. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band with your palms facing forward and raise your hands to shoulder height, elbows bent.
Press the band overhead, fully extending your arms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the band back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band side triceps extension
exercises.description: A triceps extension with a band, extending the arms out to the sides. It works the triceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band with both hands, palms facing down.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, keeping them parallel to the ground.
Slowly bend your elbows and bring your hands towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms still.
Pause for a moment, then slowly extend your arms back out to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band single leg calf raise
exercises.description: A single-leg calf raise with a band around the foot. It trains the calves.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your left foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance if needed.
Slowly raise your left heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your left heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the right leg.

exercises.name: band single leg reverse calf raise
exercises.description: A single-leg calf raise with a band, rising onto the ball of the foot. It trains the calves.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place the band around the ball of your foot.
Hold onto a stable object for balance.
Slowly raise your heel off the ground, lifting your body weight onto the ball of your foot.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.

exercises.name: resistance band sitting floor ankle dorsi flexion
exercises.description: Pull your toes toward your shin against a band while seated. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and loop the band around the top of one foot.
Hold the band ends or anchor them so there is light tension.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete all reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: band single leg split squat
exercises.description: A single-leg split squat with a band. It trains the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and place a resistance band around your ankles.
Take a big step forward with your right foot and a smaller step back with your left foot.
Bend your knees and lower your body until your right thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your left knee slightly above the ground.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: ball assisted lying supine hip adduction
exercises.description: Squeeze a ball between your knees while lying on your back. It targets the inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and a ball between your knees.
Rest your arms by your sides and keep your lower back relaxed.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Keep your hips level throughout.

exercises.name: band lying straight leg raise
exercises.description: A lying straight leg raise with a band held in the hands. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your feet together.
Place the band around the arches of your feet and hold the ends of the band with your hands.
Engaging your abs, lift both legs off the ground until they are perpendicular to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band squat row
exercises.description: A squat combined with a band row, pulling the handles as you stand. It works the legs and back.
steps: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and lower into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest lifted.
From the squat position, pull the band handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: finger flexion while extending thumb
exercises.description: A small hand mobility drill where you curl your fingers while holding the thumb straight. It helps finger and thumb control.
steps: Hold one hand out with your palm open.
Extend your thumb out to the side and keep it straight.
Curl your four fingers slowly toward your palm.
Open the fingers again.
Repeat 10-15 times, then switch hands.
Keep the movement smooth and pain free.

exercises.name: thumb abduction
exercises.description: A simple thumb movement where you lift the thumb away from the palm to improve hand mobility.
steps: Rest your hand on a table with the palm facing up.
Keep your fingers relaxed and straight.
Slowly move your thumb away from your palm.
Pause at the end of the range.
Return slowly to the start.
Do 10-15 reps, then switch hands.

exercises.name: dumbbell wrist supination
exercises.description: Rotating a dumbbell so your palm turns up, working the muscles that twist the forearm.
steps: Sit and rest your forearm on your thigh or a bench with the hand hanging free.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns up.
Pause at the top.
Rotate back slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms. Keep your elbow still.

exercises.name: band squat
exercises.description: A squat with a band above the knees. It trains the glutes and thighs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, with the band placed just above your knees.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, push your hips back and bend your knees to lower into a squat position.
Make sure your knees are tracking over your toes and your weight is in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing alternating cross raise
exercises.description: A raise where each dumbbell sweeps across the front of your body. It trains the front delts and upper chest.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise one arm up and across your body toward the opposite shoulder, elbow slightly bent.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating.
Keep your torso steady and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: dumbbell side plank v. 2
exercises.description: A side plank with a dumbbell added, usually held in the top hand, to make the hold harder.
steps: Lie on your side, elbow under your shoulder, with a dumbbell in your top hand.
Lift your hips into a straight line from head to feet.
Hold the dumbbell either at your side or pointing to the ceiling.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower with control, then switch sides.
Keep your hips high and don't rotate.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying floor squeeze press
exercises.description: A floor press with the dumbbells pressed together. The squeeze keeps your chest working throughout the lift.
steps: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together above your chest.
Squeeze the dumbbells against each other.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up while still squeezing.
Keep your wrists straight and elbows tucked.
Lower slowly each rep.

exercises.name: dumbbell single arm z press
exercises.description: A seated overhead press on the floor with legs straight, using one arm. It removes leg drive and challenges your trunk.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs straight out and back tall.
Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height in one hand.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps and switch arms.
Brace your abs and don't lean back.

exercises.name: dumbbell hang snatch
exercises.description: A powerful one-arm lift where the dumbbell goes from hip height to overhead in one motion.
steps: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thighs, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead and catch it with a straight arm.
Stand tall, then lower back to the hang.
Switch arms and keep the weight light enough to move fast.

exercises.name: snow angel face to floor
exercises.description: Lying face down, you sweep your arms and legs like a snow angel. It works the muscles along your back.
steps: Lie face down with arms by your sides and legs together.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Sweep your arms out and overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back to the start in the same arc.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.

exercises.name: snow angel face to sky
exercises.description: Lying face up, you sweep arms and legs out like a snow angel. It trains the abs and keeps your shoulders mobile.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs together.
Press your lower back toward the floor.
Sweep your arms overhead while opening your legs.
Bring them back together in the same arc.
Repeat at a steady pace.
Keep your abs braced and lower back flat.

exercises.name: barbell split stance rdl
exercises.description: A Romanian deadlift in a split stance, with most of the load on the front leg. It builds hamstrings and glutes and tests balance.
steps: Hold a barbell at your thighs and stand with one foot a step ahead of the other.
Put most of your weight on the front leg.
Hinge at the hips and slide the bar down your front leg.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstring.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: cable step up
exercises.description: A step-up with cable resistance that adds load to the legs and hips.
steps: Stand facing a box or bench with a cable handle in your hands.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Push through that heel to step up.
Stand tall on top of the box.
Step back down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: barbell butterfly z press
exercises.description: A seated floor press overhead with a barbell and a wide hand position. It builds strong shoulders with a stable trunk.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs out in front and the bar at upper-chest height.
Take a wide grip and brace your abs.
Press the bar overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower it back to your upper chest under control.
Keep your back tall and avoid arching.
Use a light weight at first.

exercises.name: band standing crunch
exercises.description: A standing crunch with a band, curling the torso forward. It trains the abs.
steps: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the band with both hands and bring it up to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the crunch, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: superman to push up
exercises.description: A combo move where you lift into a superman on the floor, then press into a push-up.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor and hold briefly.
Lower and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up into a push-up.
Lower your chest back to the floor.
Repeat, keeping your body straight.

exercises.name: bodyweight narrow squat lunge
exercises.description: A lunge done with a narrow stance and no weight. It targets the quads and glutes while challenging balance.
steps: Stand with feet close together and hands on your hips or in front of you.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: landmine cossack squat
exercises.description: A side-to-side deep squat holding a landmine end at your chest. It works the glutes, inner thighs and hip mobility.
steps: Stand with feet wide, holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Shift to one side and bend that knee deeply.
Keep the other leg straight with the toes up.
Push through the bent leg to return to centre.
Shift to the other side.
Keep your chest tall and heel down on the working side.

exercises.name: jump from seated position
exercises.description: An explosive jump that starts from a seated position on a box or chair, building power in the legs.
steps: Sit on a sturdy box or bench with feet flat.
Lean slightly forward with arms ready.
Explode upward, swinging your arms.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Sit back down and reset.
Repeat with a short pause each time.

exercises.name: barbell static lunge
exercises.description: A lunge held in one place with a barbell on your back, so the feet stay put while you lower and rise.
steps: Place a barbell across your upper back.
Step into a split stance with one foot forward.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your chest tall and torso upright.
Press through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell narrow squat lunge
exercises.description: A narrow-stance lunge holding a dumbbell in each hand to add load for the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand with feet close together, a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge, keeping your feet in a narrow line.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and chest up.
Push through the front heel to stand back up.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: landmine banded press
exercises.description: A landmine press with a band adding extra resistance on the way up.
steps: Set up a landmine with a band attached and hold the end of the bar at your shoulder.
Stand with feet staggered and core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower it to your shoulder under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: table top bridge jack
exercises.description: From a reverse tabletop, you hop your feet apart and together like a jumping jack. It works the glutes and legs.
steps: Sit with hands behind you, then lift hips into a tabletop with knees bent.
Squeeze your glutes to keep your hips high.
Hop your feet wide.
Hop them back together.
Keep going at a steady pace.
Keep your hips high and don't let them sag.

exercises.name: alternating kneeling to half kneeling
exercises.description: A floor-to-stand drill moving from kneeling to half kneeling, alternating sides. It builds hip mobility and control.
steps: Kneel upright with both knees on the floor.
Step one foot forward into a half-kneeling position.
Pause and keep your torso tall.
Step back to full kneeling.
Repeat with the other foot.
Move slowly and use your arms for balance if needed.

exercises.name: band rear delt row
exercises.description: Pull a band toward you with elbows flared wide. It targets the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Anchor a band at chest height and hold the ends with arms extended.
Step back until the band is taut.
Pull your hands toward your chest with elbows high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly without letting your shoulders round forward.

exercises.name: lever torso rotation
exercises.description: A machine rotation that trains the abs and obliques with controlled twisting.
steps: Sit in the machine and secure your torso against the pads.
Grip the handles.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping your hips still.
Pause at the end.
Return to centre and rotate the other way.
Go slowly and avoid momentum.

exercises.name: band standing twisting crunch
exercises.description: A standing twisting crunch with a band, bringing the elbow toward the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your upper back, crossing it in front of your chest.
Hold the ends of the band with your hands, keeping your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Engage your abs and twist your torso to one side, bringing your elbow towards the opposite knee.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band step-up
exercises.description: A step-up with a band around the thighs. It trains the glutes and quads.
steps: Place a band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Stand facing a step or platform with your feet hip-width apart.
Step up onto the platform with your right foot, pushing through your heel.
Extend your left leg behind you, keeping it straight.
Lower your left foot back down to the ground.
Repeat with your left foot stepping up onto the platform.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band stiff leg deadlift
exercises.description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and slowly lower your upper body towards the ground.
As you lower, push your hips back and allow your knees to bend slightly.
Lower the band towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
