Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell core squat
exercises.description: A barbell squat focused on bracing your core hard through the lift. It builds leg strength and trunk stability.
steps: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Take a deep breath and brace your abs.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your torso tight and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Exhale at the top and reset your brace each rep.

exercises.name: dumbbell half kneeling thor lift
exercises.description: A diagonal lift from low to high while half kneeling, working the trunk, hips and shoulders together.
steps: Kneel in a half-kneeling position and hold a dumbbell near the outside of your back hip.
Brace your abs and keep your torso upright.
Lift the dumbbell diagonally up and across your body.
Finish with it above the opposite shoulder.
Lower along the same path.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing cross clean
exercises.description: A one-arm clean where the dumbbell travels across your body to the opposite shoulder.
steps: Stand with a dumbbell hanging in front of your thigh, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug.
Pull the dumbbell up and across your body.
Catch it at the opposite shoulder.
Lower it back to the hang.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable single arm bear fly
exercises.description: A single-arm cable fly done in a braced, staggered stance, working the chest and keeping the trunk steady.
steps: Set a cable at chest height and stand with a staggered stance.
Grab the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Keep your elbow slightly bent and sweep your arm across your body.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish reps and switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell rear lunge to single arm shoulders press
exercises.description: A combo move: a rear lunge followed by a single-arm press as you stand. It works legs and shoulders together.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at one shoulder and stand tall.
Step one leg back into a lunge.
Push through the front foot to stand up.
As you rise, press the dumbbell overhead.
Lower it to your shoulder and repeat.
Switch arms or legs each set.

exercises.name: weighted plate side up squat
exercises.description: A squat holding a weight plate in front of your chest. The plate acts as a counterweight and helps keep your torso upright.
steps: Hold a weight plate at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up and elbows in.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep the plate close to your body.

exercises.name: band straight leg deadlift
exercises.description: A straight-leg deadlift with a band, hinging forward at the hips. It trains the lower back and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your feet.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing your body, and keep your arms straight.
Engage your core and maintain a slight bend in your knees.
Slowly hinge forward at your hips, keeping your back straight and chest lifted.
Lower the band towards the ground while keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then squeeze your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell high pull
exercises.description: An explosive pull taking the bar from the thighs to chest height. It builds power in the traps, hips and legs.
steps: Hold a barbell at mid-thigh with an overhand grip, hips hinged slightly.
Drive your hips forward and shrug hard.
Pull the bar up to chest height, elbows high.
Let the bar settle and lower it to the thighs.
Reset your stance.
Keep the bar close to your body.

exercises.name: barbell hang clean high pull
exercises.description: A high pull starting from the hang position above the knees, training explosive hip and shoulder power.
steps: Hold a barbell just above the knees with an overhand grip.
Hinge at the hips and keep your back flat.
Explode up through the legs and shrug.
Pull the bar to chest height with high elbows.
Lower to the hang position.
Reset and repeat. Keep the bar close.

exercises.name: medicine ball overhead toss
exercises.description: An explosive throw of a medicine ball from behind the head forward. It builds power from hips to arms.
steps: Stand holding a medicine ball overhead.
Reach back slightly and brace your abs.
Throw the ball forward powerfully.
Follow through with your arms.
Pick up the ball and reset.
Keep your back neutral.

exercises.name: medicine ball backward overhead toss
exercises.description: A backward throw of a medicine ball over the head from a squat. It builds hip and back power.
steps: Stand holding a medicine ball in front of your thighs.
Squat down and swing the ball between your legs.
Drive up and extend your hips.
Throw the ball up and backward over your head.
Retrieve the ball and reset.
Keep your arms long and make sure the space behind you is clear.

exercises.name: band seated twist
exercises.description: A seated twist with a band around the waist. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you and your back straight.
Wrap the band around your waist and hold the ends with both hands.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to one side, keeping your back straight and your feet on the ground.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell fat bar reverse curl
exercises.description: A reverse curl with a thick bar, which challenges your grip and the forearm muscles even more.
steps: Hold a fat barbell with an overhand grip.
Stand with elbows by your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your wrists straight.

exercises.name: cable seated single arm lats focused row
exercises.description: A one-arm seated cable row that keeps the pull in the lats. Great for fixing side-to-side strength gaps.
steps: Sit at the cable station with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall and let the arm extend with a slight stretch in the lat.
Pull your elbow down and back toward your hip, leading with the elbow.
Squeeze the lat for a moment, then slowly let the handle return.
Keep your torso still and shoulders down. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lever isometric squat hip abduction
exercises.description: Hold a squat while pressing out against a machine pad. It trains the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Set the machine pads against the outsides of your knees.
Lower into a half squat and keep your chest up.
Press your knees outward against the pads.
Hold the position steadily for the target time.
Release and stand up slowly.

exercises.name: weighted plate lu raise
exercises.description: A plate raise that sweeps the weight out and up in a U shape, working the shoulders and upper traps.
steps: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at thigh height.
Raise the plate out and up in a wide arc until it is about overhead.
Pause briefly, keeping your ribs down and core tight.
Lower the plate back along the same path with control.
Use a light plate and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: barbell decline close grip press
exercises.description: A close grip press on a decline bench that loads the triceps and lower chest together.
steps: Lie on a decline bench and grab the bar with hands about shoulder width apart.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your lower chest with locked elbows.
Lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked close.
Press the bar back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists stacked over your elbows and use a spotter.

exercises.name: smith incline close grip bench press
exercises.description: A close grip press on an incline bench using the guided Smith bar to hit the triceps and upper chest.
steps: Set an incline bench under the Smith bar and lie back with eyes under the bar.
Grip the bar slightly narrower than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your upper chest with elbows close to your sides.
Press the bar up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pulled back.

exercises.name: dumbbell half kneeling single arm clean press
exercises.description: A half kneeling clean and press that trains the shoulder while the stance forces your core and hips to stay stable.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the dumbbell on the floor by your front foot and grab it.
Pull the dumbbell up to your shoulder in one smooth motion, rotating your wrist.
Press it overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder, then to the floor with control.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: medicine ball overhead slam circle
exercises.description: A medicine ball slam combined with a circular sweep, building power through the core, lats and shoulders.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart holding a medicine ball overhead.
Circle the ball to one side and around as you start to bend your knees.
Slam the ball hard into the floor in front of you.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up, and reset overhead.
Alternate the circle direction every set and keep your core braced.

exercises.name: cable lateral step up
exercises.description: A sideways step up against cable tension that works the glutes and thighs and challenges balance.
steps: Stand sideways to a box with the cable handle held at your chest.
Place the near foot on the box and press through that heel.
Step up until your leg is straight and stand tall on top.
Lower slowly back to the floor with control.
Do all reps on one side, then turn around and switch.

exercises.name: band twisting overhead press
exercises.description: An overhead press with a band, twisting the torso as you press. It trains the shoulders and core.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band handles at shoulder height with your palms facing forward.
Engage your core and press the band overhead, fully extending your arms.
As you press, twist your torso to one side, keeping your hips stable.
Pause for a moment at the top, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the press and twist on the opposite side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable unilateral step up
exercises.description: A single leg step up with cable resistance that builds leg strength and balance one side at a time.
steps: Face a box with the cable handle held at your chest or by your side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel and stand up straight on the box.
Lower your trailing foot back to the floor slowly.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing isometric shoulder external rotation with towel
exercises.description: Press the back of your hand into a towel on a wall while standing. It trains the rotator cuff without moving the joint.
steps: Stand next to a wall with a towel between the back of your hand and the wall.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Press your hand outward into the towel.
Hold the effort for 10 to 20 seconds.
Relax, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band underhand pulldown
exercises.description: An underhand pulldown with a band, pulling toward the chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
steps: Attach the band to a high anchor point, such as a pull-up bar or sturdy beam.
Stand facing the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your lats and pull the band down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: standing isometric biceps hold
exercises.description: A static curl hold where you keep the elbows bent and the biceps working without moving.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and your elbows at your sides.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees with palms facing up.
Squeeze your fists and flex your biceps hard.
Hold the position for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and elbows pinned, then rest and repeat.

exercises.name: sitting isometric hamstring curl hold with exercise ball
exercises.description: Hold a ball under your heels in a curled position. It builds endurance in the back of the thighs.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs out and the ball under your heels.
Lean back on your hands.
Press your heels into the ball and slide it in until knees bend.
Hold the position steadily.
Slowly extend your legs again.

exercises.name: band v-up
exercises.description: A V-up with a band, lifting legs and torso together. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead, holding the band.
Engaging your abs, lift your legs and upper body off the ground simultaneously, reaching your hands towards your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band vertical pallof press
exercises.description: A vertical Pallof press with a band, pressing at chest height and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and wrap the band around a sturdy object at chest height.
Hold the band with both hands and step away from the anchor point, creating tension in the band.
Position yourself perpendicular to the anchor point, with your side facing the band.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping your hands at chest height.
Engage your core and press the band away from your chest, fully extending your arms.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then slowly bring the band back towards your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band wrist curl
exercises.description: A wrist curl with a band, curling the wrists upward. It strengthens the forearms.
steps: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the band with both hands, palms facing up, and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: box jump drop 2 foot land
exercises.description: A drop from a box with a soft two foot landing that trains landing control and leg power.
steps: Stand on a sturdy box with your toes near the edge.
Step off the box, do not jump.
Land on both feet at the same time with soft, bent knees.
Sink into a quarter squat to absorb the impact and hold the landing.
Step back up and repeat. Keep your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: bodyweight box squat
exercises.description: A squat that lightly touches a box behind you to teach depth, hip hinge and control.
steps: Place a box behind you and stand with feet a bit wider than shoulders.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower toward the box.
Lightly touch the box without dropping onto it.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: band y-raise
exercises.description: A Y-raise with a band, lifting the arms into a Y shape. It trains the delts and upper back.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band in front of your thighs with your palms facing inwards.
Keep your arms straight and lift them up and out to the sides, forming a 'Y' shape with your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band shrug
exercises.description: A shrug with a band, lifting the shoulders toward the ears. It trains the traps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet, holding the ends with your hands.
Keep your arms straight and relaxed, and let the band hang in front of your thighs.
Engage your traps by shrugging your shoulders upward, lifting the band as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: burpee over the dumbbell
exercises.description: A burpee where you jump sideways over a dumbbell each rep, raising the heart rate and working the whole body.
steps: Stand beside a dumbbell lying on the floor.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor, jump your feet back and do a push up.
Jump your feet forward under your hips.
Jump up and sideways over the dumbbell, landing softly.
Turn and repeat in the other direction at a steady pace.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing front raise twist
exercises.description: A front raise combined with a torso twist, working the shoulders and the obliques together.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a dumbbell in both hands at thigh level.
Raise the dumbbell in front of you to chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side, turning from the ribs while your hips face forward.
Rotate back to the center and lower the dumbbell with control.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the weight light.

exercises.name: resistance band alternating split stance pallof press
exercises.description: A Pallof press from a split stance that resists the band pull and trains anti-rotation strength.
steps: Anchor the band at chest height and stand sideways to it in a split stance.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands.
Press the band straight out in front of you without letting your torso turn.
Hold for a second, then bring the hands back to your chest.
Switch which foot is forward on each set or rep and keep your hips square.

exercises.name: dumbbell bear plank alternating row
exercises.description: A row from a bear plank position that builds back strength while the core fights to stop hip rotation.
steps: Start on all fours with a dumbbell in each hand and knees hovering just off the floor.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Row one dumbbell to your ribs without twisting your hips.
Lower it back to the floor with control.
Row with the other arm and keep alternating at a steady pace.

exercises.name: dumbbell pullover to press bridge
exercises.description: A glute bridge combined with a pullover and press, training the hips, chest and triceps in one flow.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a bridge.
Lower the dumbbell back overhead in a pullover arc.
Pull it back over your chest and press it straight up.
Lower your hips with control and repeat, keeping your ribs down.

exercises.name: jump up side jump
exercises.description: A vertical jump followed by a hop to the side, building leg power and agility.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Jump straight up, swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly and immediately hop sideways to one side.
Land on both feet with soft knees and reset your balance.
Alternate the side of each hop and keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: standing bend alternating toe touch
exercises.description: A quick standing toe touch where you reach to opposite feet in turn, warming up the hamstrings and midsection.
steps: Stand tall with your feet wider than your hips and arms out to the sides.
Hinge forward and twist to reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with arms out.
Reach the other hand to the opposite foot.
Keep a flat back and move at a lively pace.

exercises.name: weighted plate deadlift rear lunge with overhead press
exercises.description: A plate flow that links a deadlift, a reverse lunge and an overhead press for a full body hit.
steps: Stand holding a weight plate in front of your thighs.
Hinge at the hips and lower the plate toward your shins, then stand up.
Step one foot back into a reverse lunge as you press the plate overhead.
Return the foot and bring the plate back to your thighs.
Keep a flat back and repeat, alternating the lunging leg.

exercises.name: landmine single arm push press
exercises.description: A one-arm push press with a landmine, using leg drive to move the bar up and the shoulder to control it.
steps: Stand facing the landmine end and hold it at your shoulder with one hand.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up with your legs and press the bar up and forward until your arm is straight.
Lower the end back to your shoulder with control.
Keep your ribs down and brace your core. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: clock goblet squat
exercises.description: A goblet squat that steps around an imaginary clock, training the legs from several directions.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and picture a clock on the floor around you.
Step to 12 o'clock and squat down with your chest up.
Stand up and return to the center.
Step to the next position on the clock and squat again.
Work your way around the clock with control and switch direction on the next set.

exercises.name: kettlebell side swing
exercises.description: A kettlebell swing that travels to the side, adding rotation work for the obliques to the hip snap.
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and a kettlebell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward and swing the bell up toward chest height, angled to one side.
Let it swing back down with a flat back.
Finish the reps on one side, then switch.

exercises.name: burpee power sled push
exercises.description: A conditioning move that pairs a burpee with a hard sled push for a tough full body effort.
steps: Stand behind a loaded sled and drop into a burpee, chest to the floor.
Jump up to your feet explosively.
Grab the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in.
Drive with short, powerful steps to push the sled for a set distance.
Return and repeat, keeping your back flat while pushing.

exercises.name: butterfly back roll
exercises.description: Rock back and forth on your spine with legs in a butterfly position. It massages the back and loosens the hips.
steps: Sit with the soles of your feet together and knees open.
Hold your feet or ankles.
Roll back slowly along your spine.
Roll forward to sit up again.
Repeat smoothly for 8 to 10 reps.

exercises.name: barbell half kneeling thor lift
exercises.description: A half kneeling barbell lift that sweeps the bar diagonally up, training the core to control rotation.
steps: Kneel on one knee holding one end of a barbell in a landmine setup near your hip.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Lift the bar diagonally across your body and up toward the opposite shoulder.
Return the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your hips square. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell shoulders complex
exercises.description: A chained set of dumbbell shoulder moves done without rest, building shoulder strength and endurance.
steps: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Do a set of lateral raises, then straight into front raises.
Move into a set of overhead presses without putting the weights down.
Lower the dumbbells under control and rest.
Keep the weights light and your torso still throughout.

exercises.name: medicine ball horizontal smash
exercises.description: An explosive sideways medicine ball slam that builds rotational power in the chest, core and shoulders.
steps: Stand sideways to a wall or rebound surface holding a medicine ball at chest height.
Wind the ball slightly away from the target.
Rotate and throw the ball hard against the wall with both hands.
Catch it, reset your stance and go again.
Use your hips and keep your core tight. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: sled alternating single leg negative press
exercises.description: A sled leg press done one leg at a time, with a slow lowering phase to build leg strength.
steps: Sit in the sled with feet on the platform and release the safety.
Press the platform up with both legs and lock out gently.
Shift the load to one leg and lower it slowly for 3-4 seconds.
Press back up with both legs.
Alternate the lowering leg each rep and never let your lower back round.

exercises.name: dumbbell cross romanian deadlift
exercises.description: A Romanian deadlift where the dumbbells reach across the body, training the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with a soft bend in the knees.
Push your hips back and lower the weights down your legs.
Reach one dumbbell across toward the opposite foot, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Alternate the crossing side each rep.

exercises.name: band side crunch
exercises.description: Crunch sideways against a band. It works the obliques.
steps: Anchor a band overhead and kneel or stand beside it.
Hold the band at your shoulder with the near hand.
Bend sideways toward your hip.
Return to upright under control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell kneeling around head rotation
exercises.description: A kneeling dumbbell halo that circles the weight around your head to warm up and mobilize the shoulders.
steps: Kneel tall holding a dumbbell by one end at chest level.
Circle the dumbbell around your head, keeping it close.
Keep your ribs down and your hips still.
Complete the circle back to the front.
Do a few reps one way, then reverse direction.

exercises.name: band standing leg raise
exercises.description: Raise a leg forward against a band loop. It targets the hip flexors and front thigh.
steps: Loop a band around your ankles or one ankle and anchor it.
Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one straight leg forward to hip height.
Lower slowly.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band standing rear delt row
exercises.description: A standing rear delt row with a band, pulling the handles toward the chest. It trains the rear delts.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band under your feet.
Hold the band handles with your palms facing each other and your arms extended in front of you.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pull the band towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: band straight back stiff leg deadlift
exercises.description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips with a straight back. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your upper legs.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent, hinge at the hips and lower the band towards the ground.
Feel the stretch in your hamstrings as you lower the band.
Engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: assisted single leg press
exercises.description: A machine press done with one leg at a time, helping you build leg strength and fix imbalances.
steps: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Lower back with control.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: assisted standing triceps dip
exercises.description: A dip with machine assistance that lets you build triceps strength while handling less of your bodyweight.
steps: Set the assistance and stand on the pad holding the handles.
Keep your elbows close and your chest up.
Lower your body by bending the elbows until they are at 90 degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders and move smoothly.

exercises.name: lever parallel chest press
exercises.description: A seated machine press with parallel handles, working the chest with a stable path.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at mid-chest height and sit back.
Grip the handles with your elbows slightly below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

exercises.name: heel walk
exercises.description: Walking on your heels with the toes lifted, strengthening the shins and loosening the ankles.
steps: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your toes and forefoot off the floor so you balance on your heels.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your toes pulled up the whole time.
Walk for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

exercises.name: lever pec deck fly
exercises.description: A machine fly where the arms sweep together in front, isolating the chest.
steps: Sit on the pec deck with your back flat and the arms at chest level.
Place your forearms or hands on the pads with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze for a moment, then open slowly until you feel a chest stretch.
Keep your shoulders down and back.

exercises.name: lever standing hip extension
exercises.description: A standing machine move that drives one leg back to work the glutes.
steps: Stand facing the machine and rest your hands on the support.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Push the leg back and slightly up by squeezing the glute.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright without arching your back. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lever alternate biceps curl
exercises.description: A machine curl done one arm at a time, so each biceps works independently.
steps: Sit with your upper arms resting on the pad and grab the handles.
Curl one handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower it slowly while curling the other arm.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: plank jump in squat
exercises.description: A fast move from a plank to a squat jump position, raising the heart rate and training the legs and core.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet forward, landing outside your hands in a wide squat.
Stand or hop up briefly if you like, then lower your hands.
Jump your feet back to the plank.
Keep a tight core and land softly.

exercises.name: kettlebell strong russian twist
exercises.description: A seated Russian twist with a kettlebell, taking the weight side to side to work the obliques and abs.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold a kettlebell at your chest with both hands.
Rotate your torso to bring the bell beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side in a smooth motion.
Keep your chest lifted and feet raised for more challenge.

exercises.name: lever belt bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: A split squat with your back foot raised, loaded through a belt machine to hit the quads and glutes.
steps: Set up in the belt squat machine and place your back foot on the bench behind you.
Stand tall with the front foot far enough forward.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell kroc row
exercises.description: A heavy, high rep one-arm row with a little body momentum, great for lat and grip strength.
steps: Stand beside a bench with one hand and knee supported on it and hold a heavy dumbbell.
Let the weight hang with a stretch in the lat.
Row the dumbbell to your hip using controlled momentum.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back flat. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lever triceps extension v. 2
exercises.description: A seated machine extension that isolates the triceps through a stable path.
steps: Sit and adjust the seat so your upper arms rest on the pad.
Grab the handles with your elbows bent.
Press the handles down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps for a second.
Return slowly without lifting your shoulders.

exercises.name: dumbbell powell raise
exercises.description: A side-lying raise that targets the rear shoulder with a long range of motion.
steps: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with the arm hanging in front of your body.
Raise the arm out and back in an arc until it is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Use a light weight and switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: resistance band weighted standing pronation twist curl (arm wrestler)
exercises.description: A curl that adds a forearm twist, mimicking arm wrestling to build the biceps and forearms.
steps: Stand on a resistance band and hold the handle with your palm turned to the side.
Curl the handle up while rotating your wrist.
Finish with your palm facing you and the biceps squeezed.
Lower slowly and untwist back to the start.
Keep your elbow tucked. Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lever side hip abduction
exercises.description: A machine move that presses the leg out to the side, working the outer hips.
steps: Stand next to the machine and place the outer side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Push your leg out to the side in a smooth motion.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: superman pulse
exercises.description: Lie face down and lift arms and legs with small pulses. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches.
Pulse them up and down in small movements.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower and rest after your set.

exercises.name: lever side hip adduction
exercises.description: A machine move that pulls the leg across the body, working the inner thighs.
steps: Stand next to the machine with the inner side of your leg against the pad.
Hold the support for balance.
Pull your leg across your body, squeezing your inner thigh.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips level and avoid leaning. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lever standing leg raise
exercises.description: A standing machine raise that lifts the leg forward to train the hip flexors and the front of the thigh.
steps: Stand facing the machine with your hands on the support.
Place the front of your thigh against the pad.
Raise your leg forward until the thigh is about parallel with the floor.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your torso tall. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: resistance band sitting floor tibialis press
exercises.description: A seated move that pulls the toes toward the shins against a band to strengthen the front of the lower leg.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs out and loop a band around your foot, anchored in front.
Keep your leg straight and your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin against the band.
Hold briefly, then slowly release.
Do all reps on one foot, then switch.

exercises.name: kettlebell sitting tibialis press
exercises.description: A seated press that lifts a kettlebell on the top of the foot to strengthen the muscles at the front of the shin.
steps: Sit on a bench or box with a kettlebell hanging from the top of one foot.
Plant your heel on the floor.
Lift the toes up toward your shin to raise the kettlebell.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Use a light weight. Finish the reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: lever standing rear kick
exercises.description: A standing machine kickback that squeezes the glutes as you press the leg behind you.
steps: Stand facing the machine and hold the handles for support.
Place the back of your working leg against the pad.
Kick the leg back by squeezing the glute.
Pause at the top, then return slowly.
Keep your torso upright. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lever chair squat
exercises.description: A machine squat performed with a chair-like support, a stable way to train the legs.
steps: Position yourself in the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Bend your knees and sit back and down.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag deadlift
exercises.description: A deadlift with a sandbag, building hip and back strength with an awkward, grippy load.
steps: Stand over a sandbag with feet hip width apart.
Hinge at your hips, bend your knees and grip the bag.
Brace your core and drive through your feet to stand tall with the bag.
Push your hips back and lower the bag to the floor.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag squat
exercises.description: A squat holding a sandbag against the chest, training the legs and the core.
steps: Hold a sandbag in a bear hug against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand up.
Keep the bag tight to your body.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag shouldering
exercises.description: A lift that heaves the sandbag from the floor up onto your shoulder, building power and total body strength.
steps: Stand over a sandbag and grip it firmly with both hands.
Lift the bag, driving through your legs and hips.
Pull it to your lap, then heave it up onto one shoulder.
Lower it to the floor with control.
Alternate shoulders each rep.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag carry (shoulders)
exercises.description: A walking carry with a sandbag across the shoulders, building posture and trunk strength.
steps: Lift the sandbag onto your shoulders and hold it there.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps.
Keep your ribs stacked over your hips.
Carry for a set distance or time, then set the bag down carefully.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag carry (bear hug)
exercises.description: A walking carry with a sandbag held to the chest, taxing the core, arms and grip.
steps: Lift the sandbag and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady steps.
Keep your arms squeezing the bag tight.
Carry for a set distance or time, then lower the bag with care.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag military press
exercises.description: A standing overhead press using a sandbag, which shifts as you push, so your shoulders and core must stay tight.
steps: Hold a sandbag at your upper chest or shoulders.
Stand with feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Press the bag straight overhead.
Lock out the arms, then lower the bag with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag row
exercises.description: A bent-over row with a sandbag, training the back and grip.
steps: Stand over a sandbag, hinge forward and grab it with both hands.
Keep your back flat and knees slightly bent.
Row the bag toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly back to full arm extension.

exercises.name: lever full squat
exercises.description: A full range machine squat that builds the thighs and glutes with a guided path.
steps: Step into the machine with the pads on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Release the safety and brace your core.
Squat as deep as you comfortably can.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and knees over your toes.

exercises.name: lever pistol squat
exercises.description: A single leg squat on a machine that supports balance while you load one leg through full depth.
steps: Step into the machine and put one foot on the platform with the other leg lifted or extended.
Brace your core and release the safety.
Lower slowly into a deep squat on one leg.
Press through your heel to stand.
Keep your knee in line with your toes. Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lever lying chest press (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A plate-loaded press from a lying position, working the chest with a guided path.
steps: Lie back on the machine bench and grip the handles at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulders pulled back.
Press the handles up until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch in the chest.
Keep your back on the pad throughout.

exercises.name: steel mace squat (weighted)
exercises.description: A squat holding a steel mace across the shoulders or upper back. It builds leg strength and a braced trunk.
steps: Rest the mace on your shoulders and hold it with both hands.
Stand with feet about shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

exercises.name: steel mace halo (weighted)
exercises.description: Circle a steel mace around your head while standing tall. It trains shoulder control and stability under an awkward load.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and hold the mace upright near your chest.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Circle the mace around your head in a smooth, controlled arc.
Keep your elbows close and your head still.
Do all reps, then reverse the direction.

exercises.name: weighted lying neck extension
exercises.description: Lying face down, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the back of the neck.
steps: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on the back of your head.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Slowly lift your head until your neck is in line with your torso.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and the motion smooth.

exercises.name: sandbag over the shoulder toss (weighted)
exercises.description: Explosively hinge and heave a sandbag backwards over your shoulder. It trains hip power and full body force.
steps: Stand over the sandbag with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge down, grip the bag and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and pull the bag up the front of your body.
Extend fully and throw the bag back over your shoulder.
Reset and repeat, facing the same way.

exercises.name: weighted lying neck flexion
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the neck.
steps: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on your forehead.
Hold the weight with a hand for control.
Slowly curl your head up, tucking your chin.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and avoid jerking.

exercises.name: cable single arm low row (with rope)
exercises.description: A one-armed seated row with a rope handle on a low pulley. It works the lats and upper back one side at a time.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and sit facing the stack with your feet braced.
Hold the rope in one hand with your arm extended.
Pull your elbow back along your side, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause, then let the arm extend slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: alternating dead hang
exercises.description: Hang from a bar and shift your weight from side to side. It decompresses the shoulders and stretches the lats.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder width apart.
Hang with your arms long and your body relaxed.
Shift your weight toward one hand, letting that side stretch.
Shift to the other side and keep alternating.
Hold the hang for 20-30 seconds in total.

exercises.name: two ropes climb
exercises.description: Climb up using two ropes, pulling with your arms one hand over the other. It builds a strong pull and grip.
steps: Grab one rope in each hand and hang with arms long.
Pull up with one arm while you bend your elbow close to your body.
Reach higher with the other hand and pull again.
Keep your core tight and your legs steady.
Climb to a safe height, then lower under control.

exercises.name: plate pinch
exercises.description: Pinch a weight plate between your fingers and thumb and hold it. It builds finger and thumb grip strength.
steps: Pick up two smooth plates and stack them with the smooth sides facing out.
Pinch them together with your fingertips and thumb.
Stand tall with your arm hanging by your side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without letting the plates slip.
Switch hands and repeat.

exercises.name: barbell seated military press (inside squat cage)
exercises.description: A seated overhead press performed inside a squat cage so the rack gives you safe bar positions. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
steps: Set a bench inside the cage and the bar at shoulder height.
Sit tall, grip the bar just outside shoulder width and unrack it.
Press the bar straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it to your upper chest with control.
Keep your ribs down and your back against the pad.

exercises.name: cable elevated row
exercises.description: A cable row where the handle sits higher than usual, pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back.
steps: Set a cable handle at about head height and take a stable stance.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly with arms extended.
Pull toward your upper chest, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: seated hamstring stretch on a chair
exercises.description: A gentle seated stretch for the back of the thigh, done on a chair. It helps loosen tight hamstrings.
steps: Sit near the front edge of a chair.
Extend one leg straight with your heel on the floor and toes up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: seated squeeze shoulder blades chest stretch on a chair
exercises.description: Sit on a chair and squeeze your shoulder blades together to open the chest. It eases tight pecs from desk posture.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Reach your hands behind you and clasp them or hold the chair back.
Pull your shoulder blades together and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without arching your lower back.
Relax and repeat.

exercises.name: cable close grip front lat pulldown
exercises.description: A lat pulldown with a narrow grip, pulling the bar to your upper chest. It trains the lats and biceps.
steps: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs under the pads.
Grab the bar with a close grip.
Lean back slightly and pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and squeeze your lats.
Let the bar rise slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise v. 2
exercises.description: Lying on your side on a bench, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It isolates the rear shoulder.
steps: Lie on your side on a bench holding a light dumbbell in your top hand.
Start with your arm hanging in front of you, slight bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up until it is about shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: one leg kickback (with bench support)
exercises.description: Support yourself on a bench and kick one leg back and up. It works the glutes without any equipment.
steps: Place your hands on a bench and step back into a hinged position.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up, squeezing your glute.
Lower without letting your hips rotate.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: smith calf raise (with block)
exercises.description: A standing calf raise under the Smith bar with the balls of your feet on a block. The block lets you stretch deeper.
steps: Place a block under the Smith bar and rest the bar on your upper back.
Stand with the balls of your feet on the block.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: cable reverse narrow grip lat pulldown
exercises.description: A lat pulldown with an underhand, narrow grip. It uses the biceps more and works the lower lats.
steps: Sit at the pulldown station and secure your thighs.
Grab the bar with a narrow underhand grip.
Lean back a little and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: cat stretch
exercises.description: A gentle spinal stretch on hands and knees, rounding the back like a cat. It loosens the spine.
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Tuck your chin and round your back toward the ceiling.
Draw your belly button in and hold for a few breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.
Repeat slowly, holding the rounded position 15-20 seconds.

exercises.name: standing single leg hip swirl with chair support
exercises.description: Hold a chair and swirl one leg in circles. It loosens the hip joint and warms up the glutes.
steps: Stand beside a chair and hold it for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw slow, controlled circles with your leg.
Do half of the reps one way, then reverse the direction.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: fixed bar back stretch
exercises.description: Hold a fixed bar and sit your hips back to stretch your back and lats. It opens the upper body.
steps: Grip a fixed bar or post at about hip height.
Step back until your arms are straight.
Sink your hips back and let your chest drop.
Feel the stretch along your back and sides.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.description: A lunge-style stretch on one knee that lengthens the front of the hip. It helps with tightness from sitting.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward in a lunge.
Tuck your pelvis under and squeeze your back glute.
Shift your hips forward gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, keeping your torso tall.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: seated single leg knee flexion
exercises.description: Sitting down, you bend one knee by sliding your heel back. It is a gentle way to build knee mobility and hamstring control.
steps: Sit on a chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Slide one foot back under the chair, bending the knee.
Pause briefly at the end of the range.
Return the foot slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: seated single leg tibialis press
exercises.description: Press the top of your foot upward against resistance while seated. It strengthens the shin muscle.
steps: Sit with one foot resting flat and the other leg crossed over it.
Hook the toes of the lower foot under your other foot for light resistance.
Lift the toes and forefoot up toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: resistance band standing single leg knee extension
exercises.description: Standing on one leg with a band behind the knee, you straighten the other knee. It builds quad strength with gentle load.
steps: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around one ankle or behind the knee.
Stand tall and hold on for balance if needed.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Pause with the leg extended.
Bend slowly back, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: seated single leg knee extension
exercises.description: Seated on a chair, you straighten one knee to lift your foot. A gentle move that wakes up the thigh.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your feet flat.
Slowly straighten one knee to lift your foot.
Squeeze your thigh at the top for a second.
Lower the foot back to the floor with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: seated single leg knee extension v. 2
exercises.description: A variation of the seated knee extension. It builds thigh strength with a small, controlled range.
steps: Sit tall on a chair, holding the seat edge for support.
Straighten one knee until the leg is level.
Hold for a second, tightening your thigh.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: weighted seated single leg knee extension v. 2
exercises.description: A seated knee extension with a light weight on the ankle. It adds load to build thigh strength.
steps: Strap a light ankle weight on and sit tall on a chair.
Hold the seat edge for support.
Straighten the knee until your leg is level.
Hold for a second and squeeze your thigh.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: lunging straight leg calf stretch
exercises.description: Lunge forward with the back leg straight to stretch the calf. It improves ankle mobility.
steps: Step into a lunge with hands on a wall or knee.
Keep the back leg straight with heel down.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch.
Keep your foot pointing forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lying bent knee tibialis press
exercises.description: Lying on your back with knees bent, you press your foot toward your shin. It targets the front of the lower leg.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Slide one foot under the other for light resistance.
Lift the toes of the lower foot toward your shin.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: seated single leg hugging knee flexion
exercises.description: Seated, you hug one knee toward your chest and bend it. It mobilizes the hip and knee gently.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Lift one knee and clasp your hands around the shin.
Gently pull the knee toward your chest and flex it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: seated single leg hugging knee flexion with towel
exercises.description: The same hugging knee flexion, using a towel around the shin to help. It adds a gentle assisted bend.
steps: Sit tall on a chair and loop a towel around one shin.
Hold the towel ends with both hands.
Pull the knee gently toward your chest, bending it.
Hold for a moment, then release.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kneeling bend knee chair supported
exercises.description: Kneeling beside a chair for support, you gently bend the knee. It builds comfortable knee range of motion.
steps: Hold the back of a chair and kneel on one knee on a soft surface.
Keep your torso upright.
Slowly sit back toward your heel to bend the knee.
Stay within a comfortable range.
Return to the start and switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: standing single leg calf rock
exercises.description: Balance on one leg and rock between heel and toes. It warms up the calf and ankle.
steps: Stand on one leg next to a wall for balance.
Rock your weight back onto your heel, lifting the toes.
Roll forward onto the ball of your foot.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing single leg concentration calf raise
exercises.description: A one-legged calf raise performed slowly with full focus. It builds calf strength and ankle control.
steps: Stand on one leg and hold a wall or rail lightly.
Lower your heel slightly for a stretch.
Rise high onto your toes, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: elevated single leg bridge
exercises.description: A single-leg glute bridge with your feet raised. It strongly works the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot raised on a bench or step.
Extend the other leg straight up.
Drive through your heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lying floor svend press
exercises.description: Press a plate out from your chest while lying on the floor, squeezing it with both hands. It targets the inner chest.
steps: Lie on your back holding a plate between your palms at your chest.
Squeeze the plate firmly.
Press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Keep squeezing as you lower it back to your chest.
Repeat with steady control.

exercises.name: squat mobilization
exercises.description: A deep squat hold with gentle movements. It opens up the hips and ankles.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders.
Squat down as deep as is comfortable.
Press your elbows against your knees and keep your chest up.
Rock gently side to side.
Stay for 20-30 seconds, then stand.

exercises.name: medicine ball split stance torso twist
exercises.description: Rotate your torso side to side with a medicine ball in a split stance. It trains the trunk rotators.
steps: Stand in a split stance and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips steady.
Return to the centre and rotate the other way.
Complete all reps, then switch the front foot.

exercises.name: resistance band overhead hit
exercises.description: Swing a resistance band from overhead down in front of you in a chopping motion. It builds powerful chest and core strength.
steps: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handles with both hands.
Stand with a staggered stance and your arms raised.
Pull the handles down and forward in a controlled hit.
Brace your core as you finish.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: plank alternating hit the ball
exercises.description: From a plank, tap a ball with alternating hands. It challenges your core to stay stable.
steps: Start in a straight-arm plank with a ball in front of you.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the ball.
Return the hand and tap with the other.
Keep your hips as still as possible.

exercises.name: seated neck flexion to extension on chair
exercises.description: Seated, you slowly nod your head forward and back. It loosens the neck.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly lower your chin toward your chest.
Gently lift your head and look slightly upward.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.name: seated side to side neck twist on chair
exercises.description: Seated, you turn your head from side to side. It restores easy neck rotation.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly turn your head to look over one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Turn to the other side.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.name: seated side to side neck bend on chair
exercises.description: Seated, you tilt your ear toward each shoulder. It eases side neck tightness.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your shoulders relaxed.
Slowly tilt your head so your ear moves toward one shoulder.
Return to the centre.
Tilt toward the other shoulder.
Repeat for several slow reps.

exercises.name: medicine ball sit up slam
exercises.description: Sit up while raising a medicine ball overhead and slam it down. It combines a crunch with power.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Sit up in one motion, bringing the ball forward.
Slam the ball down in front of your feet.
Catch it on the bounce or pick it up.
Lie back with control and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell full front raise catch
exercises.description: Raise a dumbbell in front of you all the way overhead and catch it with control. It trains the front shoulder.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Raise it straight up in front of you to overhead.
Control it at the top and keep your core braced.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a moderate weight and avoid arching your back.

exercises.name: lying glute stretch
exercises.description: Pull a knee toward your chest while lying down. It releases the glutes.
steps: Lie on your back.
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Pull the bottom leg toward your chest.
Keep your head and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: barbell bench press catch
exercises.description: A bench press where you lower the bar and catch it quickly before pressing. It trains chest strength and control.
steps: Lie on a bench with a spotter or safety pins set.
Unrack the bar over your chest.
Lower the bar toward your chest under control.
Stop it just above the chest and press up.
Keep your feet planted and your shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.name: kettlebell single leg deadlift pass
exercises.description: A single-leg deadlift where you pass a kettlebell from hand to hand. It trains balance and the hip hinge.
steps: Stand on one leg holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Hinge at the hips and reach the bell toward the floor.
Pass the bell to the other hand below your knee.
Stand back up using your glute and hamstring.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge high knee
exercises.description: A reverse lunge holding a kettlebell on the same side as the working leg, ending with a high knee. It trains balance and leg drive.
steps: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and stand tall.
Step back with the leg on the same side as the bell.
Lower into a lunge.
Drive up and lift that knee high as you stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: knee to box calf stretch
exercises.description: Press one knee forward toward a box with your foot flat to stretch the calf. It improves ankle flexibility.
steps: Place a foot flat a short distance from a box or step.
Keep your heel down.
Push your knee forward to touch the box.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a calf stretch.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: seated pronation supination foot
exercises.description: Seated, you roll the foot inward and outward. It mobilizes the ankle and foot.
steps: Sit on a chair with one foot lifted slightly off the floor.
Roll the sole of your foot inward.
Roll it outward as far as is comfortable.
Keep the lower leg still.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: 90 to 90 press stretch
exercises.description: Sit in a 90-degree hip position and press forward to stretch the glutes and hips. It improves hip rotation.
steps: Sit on the floor with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front, one to the side.
Sit tall.
Hinge forward over the front shin with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: half kneeling torso twist
exercises.description: From a half-kneeling stance, rotate your torso. It opens the spine and warms up the trunk.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Hold your arms crossed in front of your chest.
Rotate your upper body toward the front leg.
Return to the centre and keep your hips square.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: standing one arm chest stretch
exercises.description: Place one arm against a wall and turn away to open the chest. It eases tight pecs.
steps: Stand next to a wall or door frame.
Place your forearm or hand on the wall at shoulder height.
Slowly turn your body away from the arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms and repeat.

exercises.name: barbell lying front raise
exercises.description: Lying on a bench, you raise a barbell from your thighs to above your chest. It builds the front shoulder.
steps: Lie on a bench holding a barbell at arm's length over your thighs.
Keep your arms straight with a soft elbow.
Raise the bar in an arc until it is above your chest.
Lower it slowly back down.
Use a light weight and keep your back flat.

exercises.name: stick lying front raise
exercises.description: Lying on your back, raise a light stick from your hips to overhead. It helps shoulder mobility.
steps: Lie on your back holding a stick with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight.
Raise the stick overhead as far as is comfortable.
Return to your thighs slowly.
Keep your ribs down throughout.

exercises.name: standing quadriceps stretch
exercises.description: Pull your heel toward your glute while standing to stretch the front of the thigh. It is a classic quad stretch.
steps: Stand tall and hold something for balance if needed.
Bend one knee and grab your ankle.
Pull your heel toward your glute, knees together.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: walkout lat stretch
exercises.description: Walk your hands out and sit your hips back to stretch the lats. It opens the sides of the back.
steps: Stand and hinge forward to place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands out in front of you.
Sit your hips back and press your chest down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Walk your hands back in and stand up.

exercises.name: resistance band seated single leg hugging knee flexion
exercises.description: Seated knee flexion with a band under your foot, hugging one knee. It adds resistance to the bend.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with a band around one foot.
Hold the band ends in your hands.
Pull the knee up and bend it toward your chest.
Hold for a moment, then release slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: half kneeling hamstrings stretch
exercises.description: From half kneeling, straighten the front leg and lean forward to stretch the hamstring. It lengthens the back of the thigh.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended, heel on the floor.
Keep your toes pointing up.
Hinge forward from your hips with a flat back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: incline jack plank
exercises.description: A plank with hands on a raised surface, jumping your feet in and out like a jumping jack. It builds core and gets the heart rate up.
steps: Place your hands on a bench in an incline plank.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and the pace steady.

exercises.name: resistance band lateral hit
exercises.description: A standing band press that sweeps across the body from the side. It builds chest power and trains the trunk to resist rotation.
steps: Anchor the band at chest height beside you and hold the handle at your chest.
Stand tall in a stable stance with your core braced.
Press the handle forward and across your body in a quick controlled motion.
Return slowly to your chest without letting the band pull you around.
Keep your hips square throughout.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: medicine ball pullover catch
exercises.description: A lying throw and catch that sends a medicine ball overhead and back. It trains explosive lat and core strength.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball overhead.
Pull the ball forward over your chest to throw it up toward a partner or wall.
Catch the ball with soft elbows as it returns.
Let it travel back overhead in a controlled arc.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Repeat at a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: cable 90 degrees internal rotation catch
exercises.description: A cable drill with the upper arm at shoulder height and elbow bent to 90 degrees. It trains the rotator cuff to catch and control a quick rotation.
steps: Set the cable at shoulder height and stand sideways to it.
Raise your upper arm out to the side with the elbow bent 90 degrees.
Let the cable pull your forearm back into external rotation.
Catch it, then rotate the forearm forward and down smoothly.
Keep your upper arm still and level.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: medicine ball lying floor close press catch
exercises.description: A floor press throw with narrow hands. It builds explosive pushing power through the chest and triceps.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent, holding a medicine ball above your chest.
Press the ball up quickly with your hands close together.
Catch it as it comes down with soft elbows.
Lower it to just above your chest.
Keep your back flat and ribs down.
Repeat for controlled, crisp reps.

exercises.name: barbell hip thrust
exercises.description: A bench-supported bridge with a barbell across your hips. It is a go-to move for building strong glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell over your hips.
Plant your feet hip-width apart and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and keep your chin tucked.
Lower your hips under control.
Repeat without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: barbell one leg hip thrust
exercises.description: A single-leg version of the barbell hip thrust that demands more balance and glute strength on each side.
steps: Set your upper back on a bench with a padded barbell over your hips.
Extend one leg or hold it bent in the air.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top without twisting.
Lower under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: weighted one leg hip thrust
exercises.description: A single-leg hip thrust with weight resting on your hips. It strengthens each glute separately and fixes side-to-side gaps.
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench and place the weight on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Push through your heel to raise your hips until your torso is level.
Pause and squeeze your glute.
Lower slowly.
Complete the reps, then change legs.

exercises.name: barbell sumo squat
exercises.description: A wide-stance squat with a barbell on your back. It hits the glutes and inner thighs along with the quads.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with feet well wider than your shoulders.
Turn your toes out about 30 degrees.
Brace your core and sit down between your legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Descend to thigh level or lower, then push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall.

exercises.name: glute ham developer full sit up
exercises.description: A full-range sit-up on a glute ham developer. The extended range makes the abs and hip flexors work through a long path.
steps: Lock your feet in the machine and sit with your hips on the pad.
Lean back until your torso is in line with or just below your hips.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up until your chest reaches your thighs.
Lower back slowly with a braced core.
Avoid yanking on your neck.

exercises.name: sumo squat
exercises.description: A bodyweight squat in a wide stance with toes turned out. It targets the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands together at your chest.
Sit your hips down and back between your legs.
Keep your knees over your toes and chest upright.
Lower to thigh level.
Push through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: lever incline prone row
exercises.description: A chest-supported row on an incline lever machine. The support keeps your back steady so the upper back does the work.
steps: Lie chest-down on the incline pad and grab the handles.
Let your arms extend fully.
Pull the handles back, driving your elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your head neutral.

exercises.name: lying hip lift (on stability ball)
exercises.description: A glute bridge with your feet or upper back on a stability ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels resting on the stability ball.
Press your arms into the floor for support.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower your hips under control.
Keep the ball steady throughout.

exercises.name: resistance band explosive push up
exercises.description: A push-up with a band across your back and a fast push at the top. It trains explosive chest and triceps power.
steps: Loop the band across your upper back and hold the ends under your palms.
Set up in a push-up position with a straight body.
Lower your chest to the floor with control.
Push up hard so your hands briefly leave the floor.
Land softly with elbows slightly bent.
Keep your hips in line.

exercises.name: band standing on bosu ball single leg abduction
exercises.description: A standing hip abduction on a bosu ball against band tension. It works the outer hip and challenges your balance.
steps: Place a band around your ankles and stand on the bosu with one foot.
Hold your core tight and stay tall.
Lift your free leg out to the side against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Return slowly without leaning.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: pilates machine lying knee extension on toes
exercises.description: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet on toes. It trains the front thighs.
steps: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar, on your toes.
Bend your knees with a neutral spine.
Press the carriage away until legs straighten.
Return under control.
Keep your hips still.

exercises.name: pilates machine lying knee extension
exercises.description: Straighten your knees on a reformer with feet flat. It trains the front thighs.
steps: Lie on the carriage with feet on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out until legs are straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your lower back stable.

exercises.name: pilates machine lying knee extension on heels
exercises.description: Straighten your knees on a reformer pressing through the heels. It works the thighs.
steps: Lie on the carriage with heels on the bar.
Bend your knees.
Press out through the heels until straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.name: pilates machine lying calf raise
exercises.description: Press the carriage with just your toes on a reformer. It builds calf strength.
steps: Lie on the carriage with legs straight, balls of feet on the bar.
Press your heels down.
Rise up onto your toes.
Return slowly.
Keep your knees locked softly.

exercises.name: pilates machine hundred
exercises.description: Pump your arms against the straps while holding your legs up. It builds core endurance.
steps: Lie on the carriage holding the straps.
Lift your head and legs.
Pump your arms in small movements.
Breathe in for five counts and out for five.
Continue for 100 pumps.

exercises.name: resistance band assisted single arm pull up
exercises.description: A one-arm pull-up with a band under your foot or knee to reduce the load. It builds toward unassisted single-arm pulling.
steps: Loop a band over the bar and place your foot or knee in it.
Hang with one hand on the bar and the other holding your wrist or the band.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving the elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Switch arms after each set.

exercises.name: ring resistance band assisted single arm pull up
exercises.description: A band-assisted single-arm pull-up on gymnastic rings. The rings add instability and grip demand.
steps: Hang a band from the rings or bar and place your foot in it.
Grip one ring with one hand and hold the other ring loosely or let it go.
Pull your chest toward the ring.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Lower slowly to a full hang.
Repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: ring rocky pull up pulldown
exercises.description: A ring pull-up variation where you pull up, then press down toward the hips. It builds pulling strength and shoulder control.
steps: Hang from the rings with arms straight and shoulders engaged.
Pull your chest up toward the rings.
At the top, drive the rings down toward your hips.
Pause with your arms close to your sides.
Return to the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: ring skin the cat
exercises.description: A gymnastic move where you rotate backward through the rings. It builds shoulder mobility and control.
steps: Hang from the rings with a firm grip.
Tuck your knees and lift your hips overhead.
Rotate backward, passing your legs between your arms.
Lower your feet toward the floor until you stretch your shoulders.
Pause, then reverse the motion with control.
Move slowly and stop if you feel pinching.

exercises.name: planche press
exercises.description: An advanced gymnastics skill where you press from a lean into a planche shape. It builds shoulder strength and a strong core.
steps: Start in a deep planche lean with hands under your shoulders.
Protract your shoulders and squeeze your glutes.
Lean forward and lift your feet from the floor.
Press into the ground and hold the position.
Lower under control.
Warm up your wrists first.

exercises.name: elbow planche
exercises.description: A planche hold with your elbows tucked into your waist. It is an early step toward a full planche.
steps: Place your hands on the floor and tuck your elbows into your waist.
Lean forward over your hands.
Lift your feet off the floor one at a time.
Hold your body level with a tight core.
Keep your shoulders pressed forward.
Lower down after the hold.

exercises.name: cable kneeling single arm horizontal row
exercises.description: A one-arm cable row from a kneeling position. Kneeling removes leg drive so your back does the pulling.
steps: Set a cable at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the handle with one hand and brace your core.
Pull your elbow back along your side.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Extend the arm slowly.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: band kneeling single arm horizontal row
exercises.description: A one-arm band row from a kneeling position. It builds the lats and mid back with simple equipment.
steps: Anchor a band at chest height and kneel facing it.
Hold the band with one hand and keep your torso upright.
Pull the elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade in.
Return slowly against the tension.
Switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: lever stack seated incline chest press
exercises.description: A seated press on an incline lever machine with a weight stack. It emphasises the upper chest.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height.
Sit back with your feet flat and shoulder blades pinched.
Press the handles forward and up until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly to a stretch across your chest.
Keep your back against the pad.

exercises.name: cable straight arm pulldown v. 3
exercises.description: Pull a cable down with straight arms. It isolates the lats.
steps: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the bar.
Hinge slightly forward.
Pull the bar down to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: lever stack seated incline single arm chest press
exercises.description: A one-arm incline press on a lever machine. Working one side at a time evens out strength differences.
steps: Sit on the machine and grab one handle at upper-chest height.
Brace your core to avoid twisting.
Press the handle forward and up.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder pulled back.
Do all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lever stack seated chest press
