exercises.description: A seated machine press with a weight stack. It is a stable way to build the chest and triceps.
steps: Set the seat so the handles are level with your mid chest.
Sit back and pull your shoulder blades together.
Press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Pause without locking out.
Return slowly to a gentle chest stretch.
Keep your feet flat.

exercises.name: lever stack seated single arm chest press
exercises.description: A one-arm seated press on a lever machine. It builds the chest on each side and trains the core to resist twisting.
steps: Sit with your back against the pad and grip one handle.
Brace your core and keep your torso square.
Press the handle forward in a smooth line.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your shoulder down.
Do the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: kettlebell squat
exercises.description: A squat holding a kettlebell at your chest. The weight in front helps you stay upright and use your legs.
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

exercises.name: kettlebell back squat
exercises.description: A squat with a kettlebell held across your upper back. It loads the legs and challenges your trunk.
steps: Hold the kettlebell behind your neck on your upper back with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back.
Lower to parallel while keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows pointing down.

exercises.name: landmine squat jump
exercises.description: A squat holding a landmine bar at your chest, followed by a jump. It builds explosive leg power.
steps: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest.
Jump up explosively through your feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.name: weighted backpack walking
exercises.description: Walking with a loaded backpack to add resistance. It builds leg endurance and trunk strength.
steps: Put on a backpack and tighten the straps snug.
Stand tall with your shoulders back.
Walk at a steady pace on flat ground.
Take natural strides and breathe evenly.
Keep your core lightly braced.
Walk for 10-30 minutes depending on your fitness.

exercises.name: weighted backpack running
exercises.description: Running with a loaded backpack to raise the effort. It builds endurance and leg strength.
steps: Strap a snug backpack with a modest load on your back.
Start with an easy jog on flat ground.
Keep your torso tall and your steps light.
Maintain a pace where you can breathe steadily.
Cut back the load if your form suffers.
Run for 10-20 minutes.

exercises.name: cable kickback v. 3
exercises.description: Extend your arm back against cable resistance. It isolates the triceps.
steps: Hinge forward and hold a handle with elbow bent.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor.
Extend your arm back.
Squeeze the triceps.
Return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: cable twist v. 3
exercises.description: Rotate your torso against a cable. It works the obliques.
steps: Stand sideways to the pulley and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms extended.
Rotate your torso away from the stack.
Return slowly.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: suspender arm curl
exercises.description: Curl yourself toward the straps while leaning back. It works the biceps.
steps: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Bend your elbows to pull yourself up.
Squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: suspender bent knee inverted row
exercises.description: Row yourself up under straps with knees bent. It builds the back.
steps: Lie under the straps and grip the handles.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Lift your hips and pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: weight plate lying crunch
exercises.description: Crunch while holding a plate. It works the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Hold the plate on your chest.
Curl your shoulders up.
Pause and squeeze.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: suspender chest dip
exercises.description: Dip between straps. It works the chest and triceps.
steps: Support yourself on the straps with arms straight.
Lean slightly forward.
Lower until elbows reach 90 degrees.
Press back up.
Keep the straps steady.

exercises.name: aquabike
exercises.description: Pedal your legs in the water as if cycling. It raises your heart rate with low impact.
steps: Stand in chest-deep water, holding the pool edge.
Lift your knees alternately.
Pedal at a steady rhythm.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for several minutes.

exercises.name: suspender chest press
exercises.description: Press yourself away from the straps. It works the chest.
steps: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles at chest level.
Lean forward in a straight line.
Press your body away.
Squeeze the chest.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag romanian deadlift
exercises.description: A hip hinge with a sandbag held in front of your thighs. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Hold a sandbag in front of your thighs with a firm grip.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and slide the bag down your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Keep your back flat.

exercises.name: l sit rope climb
exercises.description: A rope climb done with your legs held out in an L shape. It is a tough test for the lats, grip and abs.
steps: Grip the rope and hang with your legs raised in front of you.
Keep your legs straight and together.
Pull with one hand over the other while staying in the L position.
Reach up and repeat.
Lower under control.
Stop if your legs drop.

exercises.name: side to side jump over stepbox
exercises.description: A lateral jump back and forth over a step box. It builds agility and leg power.
steps: Stand beside a low box with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms.
Jump sideways over the box.
Land softly on both feet.
Jump back the other way at once.
Keep the pace fast but controlled.

exercises.name: balance board single leg balance
exercises.description: A single-leg stand on a balance board. It trains ankle stability and control.
steps: Place a balance board on a flat floor next to a wall for safety.
Step on with one foot and find your centre.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold steady for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your hips level.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: balance pad single leg balance
exercises.description: A one-legged stand on a foam balance pad. It improves ankle stability and body control.
steps: Place the pad on a flat floor.
Step on with one foot and stand tall.
Lift the other foot off the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your eyes on a fixed point.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: hanging alternating knee raise
exercises.description: A hanging ab move where you lift one knee at a time. It strengthens the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Hang from a bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and lift the other knee.
Avoid swinging.
Alternate for the reps.

exercises.name: headbanger
exercises.description: A gentle bending drill that works the back and hips. The motion loosens your spine and posterior chain.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and hands behind your head.
Soften your knees.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Nod your head slightly and return to standing.
Move at a smooth pace.
Keep your neck relaxed.

exercises.name: box jump through the arms
exercises.description: A box jump with a swing-through arm action. It builds explosive power and coordination.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump onto the box, driving your arms through.
Land softly with both feet.
Stand tall at the top.
Step down and reset.

exercises.name: lying single arm triceps stretch
exercises.description: A floor stretch for the back of your upper arm. Lying down lets you relax into it.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Raise one arm and bend the elbow, hand reaching behind your head.
Use your other hand to press the elbow gently toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your ribs down.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: suspender fly
exercises.description: Open your arms wide against the straps. It stretches and works the chest.
steps: Face away from the anchor, hands at chest level.
Lean forward with arms together.
Open your arms wide.
Pull back together.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

exercises.name: stick lying single arm triceps stretch
exercises.description: A triceps stretch on the floor using a stick to deepen the stretch. It opens the back of your upper arm and shoulder.
steps: Lie on your back holding a stick in both hands.
Bend one arm and take that hand behind your head.
Use the other hand to push the stick and press that elbow down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: resistance band standing single arm triceps stretch
exercises.description: A standing triceps stretch with a band assisting. The band helps you ease into a deeper stretch.
steps: Stand tall and hold a band behind your back with one hand low.
Raise the other arm overhead and bend the elbow, holding the band.
Gently pull down with the lower hand.
Feel a stretch in the back of the upper arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: lying single arm slide from y to t
exercises.description: A prone shoulder drill where one arm slides from a Y shape to a T shape. It wakes up the mid back and shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with your arms overhead in a Y.
Lift one arm slightly off the floor.
Slide it out and down into a T position.
Hold for a moment.
Slide it back to the Y.
Switch arms after each set.

exercises.name: kneeling to box jump
exercises.description: An explosive move that goes from kneeling straight into a box jump. It trains hip drive and power.
steps: Kneel in front of a sturdy box.
Swing your arms back and drive your hips forward.
Pop up from your knees onto your feet.
Jump onto the box in one motion.
Land softly and stand tall.
Step down and reset.

exercises.name: resistance band seated single leg hamstring stretch
exercises.description: A seated hamstring stretch with a band around your foot. The band lets you control the pull.
steps: Sit tall with one leg extended and a band around that foot.
Hold the band ends in both hands.
Keep your leg straight and gently pull your toes toward you.
Hinge forward until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: seated single leg half circle
exercises.description: A seated hip mobility drill where you sweep one leg in a half circle. It warms up the hips.
steps: Sit tall on the floor with hands behind you for support.
Lift one leg slightly with the knee straight.
Draw a half circle with your foot from one side to the other.
Keep your torso steady.
Repeat for the reps.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: resistance band seated single leg knee extension
exercises.description: A seated knee extension against band tension. It isolates the quads one leg at a time.
steps: Sit on a bench and secure a band around one ankle.
Anchor the other end behind you.
Straighten your knee against the band.
Squeeze the front of your thigh at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: quick feet in out run
exercises.description: Run in place with feet moving in and out quickly. It boosts your heart rate.
steps: Stand tall with feet together.
Jog in place.
Quickly move your feet in and out.
Stay light on your toes.
Continue for the set time.

exercises.name: standing single leg front back side to side toe tap
exercises.description: Tap your toes in different directions while balancing. It works hip stability.
steps: Stand on one leg.
Tap the other toe forward.
Tap to the side, then back.
Keep your balance.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: walk leg kick
exercises.description: Walk while kicking each leg up. It warms the legs.
steps: Stand tall.
Step forward and kick the opposite leg up.
Alternate legs.
Swing your arms.
Continue for the set time.

exercises.name: suspender front raise
exercises.description: Raise your body with arms in front using straps. It works the front delts.
steps: Hold the handles and lean back with arms down.
Keep your body straight.
Raise your arms overhead.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: kneeling to stand
exercises.description: A smooth transition from kneeling to standing. It builds leg strength and control.
steps: Kneel with your torso upright.
Place one foot forward into a lunge.
Push through that foot to stand.
Bring your back foot to meet it.
Reverse the motion to return to kneeling.
Alternate the lead leg.

exercises.name: calf jump
exercises.description: Jump using only your calves. It builds explosive lower legs.
steps: Stand tall.
Keep knees nearly straight.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly.
Repeat quickly.

exercises.name: bodyweight jefferson curl
exercises.description: A slow forward bend that rolls through the spine one segment at a time. It builds back and hamstring mobility.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Tuck your chin and roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let your arms hang toward the floor.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Reverse slowly to stand.
Move with control and keep the load light.

exercises.name: resistance band seated knee raise
exercises.description: Seated knee raise against band tension. It works the hip flexors and lower abs.
steps: Sit tall on a bench or chair with a band looped around your foot and anchored low.
Hold the seat edge and brace your core.
Lift one knee toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower the foot slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg calf jump
exercises.description: Hopping on one leg using mostly the ankles. It builds calf power and springy ankles.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and arms relaxed.
Push through the ball of your foot and jump up using mainly your ankles.
Keep the knee nearly straight in the air.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot.
Rebound right away into the next hop.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg calf jump step box supported
exercises.description: A single-leg calf hop with a step box nearby for balance. It trains ankle power with extra stability.
steps: Stand beside a step box and rest a hand lightly on it for balance.
Lift one foot off the floor.
Hop up using mostly your ankle and calf.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Keep the hops small and quick.
Switch legs after your set.

exercises.name: calf forward jump
exercises.description: Small forward hops driven by the calves. They build ankle stiffness and reactive power.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Push off the balls of your feet and hop forward a short distance.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Hop back or turn around and repeat.
Stay light and quick through the whole set.

exercises.name: calf side to side jump
exercises.description: Quick lateral hops powered by the calves. They improve ankle strength and foot speed.
steps: Stand tall with feet together and knees slightly soft.
Spring off your toes and hop to one side.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop to the other side.
Keep your chest up and hips level.
Continue alternating for the set.

exercises.name: medicine ball skater hop
exercises.description: A lateral hop from leg to leg while holding a medicine ball. It trains balance and side-to-side power.
steps: Hold a medicine ball at your chest.
Hop sideways onto one leg.
Land softly with a bent knee.
Pause briefly, then push off to the other side.
Keep your chest up.
Alternate for the reps.

exercises.name: high knee walk
exercises.description: A walking warm-up where you lift each knee high. It primes the hips and legs.
steps: Stand tall with your arms relaxed.
Lift one knee toward your chest.
Step forward and lower it to the floor.
Repeat on the other side.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk 10-20 steps per leg.

exercises.name: suspension hamstring runner
exercises.description: A hamstring curl with heels in straps, alternating legs like running. It trains the hamstrings and core control.
steps: Lie on your back with both heels in the straps and lift your hips.
Press your arms into the floor for balance.
Curl one heel toward your glutes while the other leg extends.
Switch legs in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your hips high and level.
Continue for the set.

exercises.name: resistance band toe walk
exercises.description: A walk on your toes with a band around your feet. It builds calf and ankle strength.
steps: Place a band around your forefeet or ankles.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Walk forward in small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk for 20-30 steps.

exercises.name: resistance band toe side walk
exercises.description: A sideways walk on your toes against band tension. It works calves, ankles and outer hips.
steps: Place a band around your ankles.
Rise onto your toes with knees slightly bent.
Step sideways in small steps.
Keep tension on the band.
Do not let your heels drop.
Walk one way, then back.

exercises.name: toe side walk
exercises.description: A sideways walk on tiptoe. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: Stand tall and rise onto your toes.
Bend your knees slightly.
Step sideways with small controlled steps.
Stay high on your toes.
Keep your hips level.
Walk one way, then return.

exercises.name: lever seated single leg curl (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A one-leg seated hamstring curl on a plate-loaded machine. It builds each hamstring separately.
steps: Sit on the machine and set the pad above your ankle.
Hold the handles and keep your back against the seat.
Curl one leg down and back.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: sled lying single leg squat
exercises.description: A single-leg press-like squat on a sled while lying back. It builds leg strength with back support.
steps: Lie back on the sled with one foot on the platform.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Bend your knee and lower the sled toward you.
Stop before your lower back lifts.
Push through your heel to extend the leg.
Do all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: suspension hip abduction
exercises.description: Standing leg raise to the side with one foot in a strap. It works the outer hip and stability muscles.
steps: Put one foot in a strap and stand tall on the other leg, holding the anchor for balance.
Brace your core.
Sweep the strapped leg out to the side.
Pause briefly at the end.
Bring it back under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: suspension hip bridge
exercises.description: A glute bridge with heels in straps, which adds an instability challenge. It builds glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and knees bent.
Place your arms by your sides.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Lower slowly without touching down.
Repeat for reps.

exercises.name: lying neck flexion
exercises.description: Gentle chin tuck while lying on your back. It strengthens the front neck muscles.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Relax your shoulders.
Tuck your chin and lift your head slightly off the floor.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly.
Keep the motion small and smooth.

exercises.name: lying neck extension
exercises.description: Lying face down, you lift the head slightly to train the back of the neck.
steps: Lie face down with your forehead hanging near the edge of a bench or resting just off the floor.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your head a few centimeters, keeping your chin slightly tucked.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly.
Use small, controlled reps.

exercises.name: suspension hyperextension
exercises.description: Hip hinge back extension with feet in straps. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Place your feet in the straps and lie face down, hands behind your head or across your chest.
Brace your core.
Lift your chest by extending your back and hips.
Stop when your body forms a straight line.
Lower slowly.
Avoid overarching at the top.

exercises.name: suspension inverted row
exercises.description: A bodyweight row hanging under straps. It builds the upper back and biceps.
steps: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended and body straight.
Brace your abs and glutes.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower with control to full arm extension.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: suspension jackknife pike
exercises.description: From a plank with feet in straps, you pike the hips up. It hits the abs hard and challenges the shoulders.
steps: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your hips high toward the ceiling.
Roll to an inverted V shape.
Lower back to plank slowly.
Keep your arms straight throughout.

exercises.name: dumbbell wrist rotation
exercises.description: A forearm drill where you rotate a dumbbell through your palm. It builds wrist and forearm control.
steps: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh or a bench.
Hold a light dumbbell with your palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back.
Move slowly with control.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: 4 way single leg hop v. 2
exercises.description: A balance hop on one leg in four directions. It trains power, balance and ankle stability.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hop forward and land softly.
Hop back to the start, then out to the side and back.
Hop in the fourth direction.
Stick every landing.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: split stance single leg calf raise
exercises.description: A calf raise in a split stance, with most work on the front leg. It trains the calf with balance support.
steps: Stand in a split stance, front foot flat and back toes lightly touching the floor.
Keep most weight on the front leg.
Rise onto the ball of the front foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower the heel slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: suspension jackknife
exercises.description: From a plank with feet in straps, you pull the knees toward the chest. It trains the abs and core control.
steps: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps and hands under shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull your knees toward your chest by rolling your hips up.
Pause briefly.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.

exercises.name: resistance band standing balance bent leg hip abduction
exercises.description: A standing hip abduction on one leg with a band. The bent working knee changes the angle.
steps: Place a band around your ankles or knees.
Balance on one leg with a soft knee.
Bend the other knee and lift it out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: suspension leg curl
exercises.description: Hamstring curl with heels in straps while bridging. It works the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels in the straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Curl your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high.
Extend your legs slowly.
Repeat for reps.

exercises.name: suspension mountain climber
exercises.description: Mountain climbers with feet in straps, which adds instability. It trains the core and conditioning.
steps: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs in a quick running rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the set.

exercises.name: pilates machine lying frog and leg circle
exercises.description: Reformer leg work: frog press followed by circles. It trains the hips and inner thighs with control.
steps: Lie on the reformer with your feet in the straps or on the bar.
Bend your knees and open them out, heels together, in a frog shape.
Press your legs straight.
Circle them out, around and back together.
Reverse the circle direction after a few reps.
Keep your back steady on the pad.

exercises.name: pilates machine lying running
exercises.description: Reformer footwork that alternates the legs like running. It trains the calves, quads and glutes.
steps: Lie on the reformer with the balls of your feet on the bar.
Straighten both legs.
Lower one heel while bending the other knee.
Alternate smoothly.
Keep your pelvis still.
Maintain steady breathing.

exercises.name: pilates machine lying pelvic lift
exercises.description: A reformer bridge that lifts the hips. It strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet on the bar and knees bent.
Press your arms into the pad.
Lift your hips one vertebra at a time.
Hold at the top.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your ribs relaxed.

exercises.name: pilates machine side split
exercises.description: A reformer move where you open and close the legs sideways. It works the inner thighs and balance.
steps: Stand with one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Brace your core.
Slide the carriage out to widen your stance.
Pause.
Draw it back under control with your inner thighs.
Keep your hips square.

exercises.name: pilates machine russian squat
exercises.description: A reformer squat variation that builds the legs. It focuses on controlled bending and straightening.
steps: Set your feet on the carriage and platform.
Stand tall and brace your core.
Bend your knees into a squat.
Keep your chest lifted and knees over toes.
Press back up to standing.
Move with the carriage smoothly.

exercises.name: pilates machine russian split
exercises.description: A reformer split stance with the carriage sliding. It works the legs, glutes and balance.
steps: Place one foot on the carriage and one on the platform.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Slide the carriage back while lowering into a split squat.
Pause.
Press back to the start.
Switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: pilates machine long spine
exercises.description: A reformer roll-over that mobilises the spine. It stretches the back and works the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet against the shoulder rests.
Press your legs straight up.
Roll your hips off the pad.
Lift your hips over your shoulders.
Roll down slowly one vertebra at a time.
Avoid pressing on your neck.

exercises.name: pilates machine arm circle
exercises.description: A reformer arm circle holding straps. It works the shoulders and the upper back.
steps: Lie on your back holding the straps with arms up.
Bend your knees and brace your core.
Lower your arms out to the sides.
Circle them down and up in a smooth arc.
Reverse the direction after a few reps.
Keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: pilates machine chest expansion
exercises.description: A reformer move pulling the straps behind you. It opens the chest and works the upper back.
steps: Kneel facing the straps with your torso upright.
Hold the straps with straight arms.
Pull the straps back behind your body.
Turn your head gently to each side.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your chest lifted and ribs down.

exercises.name: pilates machine overhead
exercises.description: Reformer work with straps overhead. It trains the shoulders, abs and posture.
steps: Sit or kneel on the carriage holding the straps overhead.
Brace your core.
Press the straps forward and down in a controlled arc.
Return to the overhead position.
Keep your spine tall.
Move smoothly with breath.

exercises.name: barbell jefferson curl
exercises.description: A slow, loaded forward bend that rolls through the spine. Keep the barbell light and the motion smooth.
steps: Stand holding a very light barbell in front of your thighs.
Tuck your chin and roll down one segment at a time.
Let the bar hang close to your legs.
Go only as low as feels controlled.
Roll back up slowly.
Keep your knees soft.

exercises.name: dumbbell lu raise
exercises.description: A dumbbell raise that lifts the arms out and up in an L to U path. It builds shoulder strength and upper back control.
steps: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides.
Raise both arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height, elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearms upward so the dumbbells point to the ceiling.
Pause, then lower back down the same path with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid shrugging.

exercises.name: standing floor tibialis raise wall supported
exercises.description: Standing with your back against a wall, you lift your toes off the floor. It strengthens the muscles on the front of the shin.
steps: Stand with your back and hips against a wall, feet a little way out in front.
Keep your legs straight and your heels planted on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shins as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your toes slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: suspension power pull
exercises.description: A powerful pull from a long position under the straps. It builds the lats and upper back.
steps: Hold the handles with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull explosively with your arms and back.
Bring your chest toward your hands.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.name: cable side leg kick from back
exercises.description: A standing cable kick that sweeps the leg out and back. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Stand side-on to the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Kick the working leg out and slightly behind you, keeping the knee mostly straight.
Pause, then return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Keep your torso still. Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: weighted ball reverse hyperextension on ghd
exercises.description: Reverse hyper on a GHD, with a ball held between your feet. It trains glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie face down on the GHD with hips at the edge and a ball between your feet.
Hold the pad.
Lift your legs until they line up with your torso.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

exercises.name: bodyweight single leg deadlift against ball
exercises.description: A single-leg hinge with a ball against the wall for balance. It trains hamstrings and balance.
steps: Stand facing a wall with a ball between your hand and the wall.
Lift one foot slightly.
Hinge at the hip as the free leg extends back.
Keep your back flat.
Return to standing.
Switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: smith seated single arm neutral grip shoulders press
exercises.description: A one-arm seated press on the smith machine with a neutral grip. It trains the shoulder while the bar path stays guided.
steps: Set a bench under the smith bar and sit upright with your back supported.
Hold the bar with one hand in a neutral grip and unhook it.
Press the bar overhead until your arm is almost straight.
Lower it slowly to around chin height.
Keep your torso steady. Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: high box step up
exercises.description: Stepping up onto a tall box. It builds the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand facing a high box.
Place one foot fully on top.
Drive through that heel to stand up.
Bring the other foot up.
Step down with control.
Switch leading legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell single leg romanian deadlift on bench
exercises.description: A single-leg Romanian deadlift with the rear foot on a bench. It targets hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Hold dumbbells with your rear foot resting on a bench.
Keep your front knee soft.
Hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the weights along your leg.
Squeeze your glutes to stand up.
Switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: lever bent over single arm lats focused row
exercises.description: A one-arm machine row done from a bent-over stance. It targets the lats with a strong squeeze.
steps: Set the machine and lean forward from the hips with a flat back.
Grip the handle with one hand and let the arm reach forward.
Pull the elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your lat at the end of the pull.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: lever incline prone neutral grip row
exercises.description: A chest-supported machine row on an incline with a neutral grip. It builds the mid back without loading the lower back.
steps: Lie face down on the incline pad with your chest supported.
Grip the neutral handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back past your torso, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment.
Let the handles return slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: bosu ball squat
exercises.description: Squat standing on a Bosu ball. The unstable surface adds a balance challenge.
steps: Stand on the Bosu with feet shoulder width apart.
Hold your arms forward.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Keep your chest lifted.
Stand tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: bosu ball single leg squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat on a Bosu ball. It challenges the legs and balance.
steps: Stand on one foot on the Bosu.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower into a controlled squat.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Press back up.
Switch legs after the set.

exercises.name: suspension pull through
exercises.description: A hip hinge with a strap held between your legs. It trains the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Face away from the anchor, holding the handles between your legs.
Step forward to create tension.
Hinge at the hips and let your hands pass between your legs.
Drive your hips forward.
Stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your back flat.

exercises.name: resistance band glute bridge walk
exercises.description: A glute bridge held with a band while stepping sideways. It targets glutes and outer hips.
steps: Lie on your back with a band above your knees and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Step your feet out and in sideways.
Keep the band tight.
Keep your hips high.
Lower after the set.

exercises.name: weighted plate crunch (hands overhead)
exercises.description: A crunch holding a weight plate overhead. The long lever makes your abs work harder.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a plate with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders and upper back off the floor, reaching the plate upward.
Pause at the top and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly without dropping your head back.

exercises.name: dumbbell weighted crunch (hands overhead)
exercises.description: A crunch with a dumbbell held overhead. The extra load and long lever challenge your abs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold one dumbbell upright with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Curl your shoulders off the floor, driving the dumbbell toward the ceiling.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: weighted plate 45 degrees side bend
exercises.description: A side bend holding a plate, done with the body at a 45 degree angle. It works the obliques.
steps: Set up on a 45 degree bench or hyperextension frame, side-on, feet secured.
Hold a plate against your chest.
Lower your torso sideways with control.
Bend back up until your body is in a straight line.
Avoid twisting. Finish your reps and switch sides.

exercises.name: weighted plate crunch (hands overhead) v. 2
exercises.description: A second take on the overhead plate crunch. It trains the abs with a long, loaded lever.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet planted.
Hold a plate with straight arms overhead.
Crunch up, lifting your shoulder blades off the floor.
Keep your arms by your ears as you rise.
Lower back down slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: weighted dumbbell crunch (hands overhead) v. 2
exercises.description: A second version of the overhead dumbbell crunch. It builds ab strength with a loaded reach.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell at one end with both hands, arms extended overhead.
Crunch up and let the dumbbell travel in an arc toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: suspension pull up
exercises.description: A pull-up using suspension handles. It builds the lats and arms.
steps: Hang from the handles with arms extended.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up between the handles.
Lead with your elbows.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: kneeling plyo push up
exercises.description: An explosive push-up from the knees. It builds pressing power.
steps: Kneel in a push-up position with hands under shoulders.
Keep a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands leave the floor.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: elastic bed toe jump
exercises.description: Toe jumps on an elastic bed. It trains calves and ankle bounce.
steps: Stand on the elastic bed with feet together.
Rise onto your toes.
Jump using your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Stay quick and light.
Continue for the set.

exercises.name: resistance band lying abduction
exercises.description: A lying leg lift against a band that works the outer hip. Good for glute and hip stability.
steps: Loop a band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side.
Stack your hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lift the top knee or leg away from the bottom one against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch sides.

exercises.name: suspension reverse fly
exercises.description: A reverse fly using suspension handles. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Hold the handles and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.
Do not shrug.

exercises.name: dumbbell single arm shrug
exercises.description: A one-arm shrug with a dumbbell. It builds the upper traps and grip.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep your arm straight and your shoulders relaxed.
Lift your shoulder straight up toward your ear.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.name: eccentric single arm pull up
exercises.description: A slow lowering phase of a one-arm pull-up. It builds the strength needed for the full move.
steps: Get into the top position of a pull-up, with one hand on the bar and the other assisting or at rest.
Let go of any help and shift your weight onto the working arm.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can until your arm is straight.
Keep your body tight and avoid swinging.
Step back up to the top and repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.name: resistance band assisted single arm pull up v. 2
exercises.description: A one-arm pull-up where a band takes some of your body weight. It helps you work toward an unassisted rep.
steps: Hang a band from the bar and place a foot or knee in the loop.
Grip the bar with one hand and keep the other arm across your chest.
Pull your chin toward the bar, driving your elbow down.
Pause at the top.
Lower under control. Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.name: hamstring bridge v. 2
exercises.description: A bridge with heels planted that emphasises the back of the thighs. Good for the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, a bit further from your hips.
Press through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: hamstring bridge leg kick v. 2
exercises.description: A hamstring bridge with an added leg extension. It adds a balance challenge for hips and thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Straighten one leg out in front, keeping hips level.
Bring the foot back to the floor without dropping your hips.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

exercises.name: bodyweight split squat hold
exercises.description: A held split stance that opens the front of the hip and loads the front thigh.
steps: Step one foot far forward and the other back into a split stance.
Lower your hips until the front knee is bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing steadily.
Rise up and switch legs.

exercises.name: bodyweight half split squat hold
exercises.description: A half split position that stretches the back of the front leg while you sit back on the rear leg.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other leg extended in front, heel on the floor.
Sit your hips back toward the rear heel.
Keep the front leg straight and your back long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: seated single leg foot circle
exercises.description: Seated ankle circles on one leg. They loosen the ankle and warm up the lower leg.
steps: Sit tall on a chair and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Draw slow circles with your toes, as wide as is comfortable.
Do half your reps clockwise, then switch to counterclockwise.
Repeat on the other foot.

exercises.name: seated feet circle
exercises.description: Circling both feet while seated. A simple way to mobilise the ankles.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with both feet lifted off the floor.
Keep your knees still.
Circle both feet in the same direction, as wide as feels comfortable.
Reverse the direction after several turns.
Keep your breathing relaxed.

exercises.name: suspension rollout
exercises.description: A rollout using suspension handles. It challenges the abs and shoulders.
steps: Kneel holding the handles close to your chest.
Brace your core.
Push your arms forward as you lean out.
Keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start.
Do not let your hips sag.

exercises.name: seated single leg foot side to side
exercises.description: A seated ankle move that sweeps the foot from side to side. It improves ankle mobility.
steps: Sit tall and lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your lower leg still.
Turn your foot inward, then outward, in a smooth motion.
Move through a comfortable range.
Repeat for your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: seated squeezing toes
exercises.description: Curling and squeezing the toes while seated. It wakes up the small muscles of the feet.
steps: Sit on a chair with both feet flat on the floor.
Curl all your toes down as if gripping the floor.
Squeeze for a couple of seconds.
Relax and spread your toes wide.
Repeat smoothly.

exercises.name: seated single leg squeezing toes
exercises.description: A one-foot toe curl while seated. It trains the muscles under the foot.
steps: Sit on a chair and place one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and squeeze.
Hold for a second or two.
Relax and spread the toes.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: lying single leg raise
exercises.description: A lying leg raise on one leg. It strengthens the thigh and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Straighten the other leg and tighten the thigh.
Raise it to the height of your bent knee.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.name: bodyweight quarter squat
exercises.description: A shallow squat that goes only a quarter of the way down. Good for beginners and for warm-ups.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees a short way.
Keep your chest up and heels down.
Press through your feet to stand tall.
Repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.name: bodyweight single leg deadlift hold
exercises.description: A one-legged hinge held at the bottom. It builds balance and the hamstrings.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward from the hips as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold for several seconds, hips level.
Return upright and switch legs.

exercises.name: bodyweight single leg deadlift toe touch
exercises.description: A single-leg hinge where you reach to touch your toes. It trains balance and the hamstrings.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge forward as the free leg lifts behind you.
Reach your hands toward the toes of the standing foot.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Stand back up with control. Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.name: seated single leg tibialis press v. 2
exercises.description: A gentle seated press that engages the shin muscle. Useful for ankle control.
steps: Sit on a chair with one foot flat and the other crossed over it.
Press the top foot up against the resistance of the bottom foot.
Feel the front of your shin work.
Hold for a second.
Relax and repeat, then switch feet.

exercises.name: seated single leg squeezing toes v. 2
exercises.description: Another one-foot toe squeeze while seated. It strengthens the small muscles in the foot.
steps: Sit with one foot flat on the floor.
Curl your toes down and hold the squeeze.
Keep your heel planted.
Release and spread your toes.
Do all reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: seated single leg foot side to side v. 2
exercises.description: A second version of the side-to-side seated foot move for ankle mobility.
steps: Sit tall and lift one foot a little off the floor.
Keep your leg still.
Sweep the foot to the inside, then to the outside.
Keep the motion smooth and pain free.
Repeat, then switch feet.

exercises.name: seated single leg toes press
exercises.description: Pressing the toes into the floor while seated. It activates the foot and calf muscles.
steps: Sit on a chair with one foot on the floor.
Lift your heel slightly and press your toes into the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower your heel again.
Finish your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: resistance band seated single leg knee extension hold
exercises.description: A seated band-resisted knee extension that you hold at the top. It builds quad endurance.
steps: Sit on a chair with a band anchored around one ankle behind you.
Straighten that knee against the band.
Hold the leg straight for 10-20 seconds.
Keep the thigh tight and your back upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

exercises.name: standing back achilles stretch
exercises.description: A standing stretch for the back of the lower leg and the Achilles area.
steps: Stand facing a wall and step one foot back.
Keep the back heel down and the knee slightly bent.
Lean forward until you feel the stretch low in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: two to one leg jump
exercises.description: A jump taking off from two feet and landing on one. It builds power and landing control.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump up and land on one foot.
Absorb the landing with a bent knee and hold steady.
Reset and alternate landing legs.

exercises.name: standing wall slide quarter squat hold
exercises.description: A wall-supported quarter squat that you hold. It gently loads the thighs.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees bend about a quarter of the way.
Keep your back flat to the wall.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Slide back up.

exercises.name: standing forward slide press with towel
exercises.description: A towel slid forward along a wall that presses the arm out. It builds gentle shoulder control.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place a towel under your hand against it.
Keep your elbow bent and the hand at chest height.
Slide the towel forward as your arm straightens.
Slide it back slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: standing wall serratus slide with towel
exercises.description: A towel slide up the wall that works the muscle along the ribs. It supports healthy shoulder blade motion.
steps: Stand facing a wall with a towel under your forearm on the wall.
Keep your elbow bent and your body upright.
Slide your arm upward along the wall.
Reach the top without shrugging.
Slide back down slowly and switch arms.

exercises.name: standing internal rotation slide with towel
exercises.description: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder inward. It works the rotator cuff gently.
steps: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees against your side.
Slide your hand across your body along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: suspension self assisted chest dip
exercises.description: A chest dip with your feet on the floor for help. It builds the chest and triceps.
steps: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Lean your chest forward.
Lower your body by bending your elbows.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your shoulders down.

exercises.name: standing external rotation slide with towel
exercises.description: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder outward. It strengthens the back of the shoulder.
steps: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Keep your elbow at 90 degrees, tucked at your side.
Slide your hand outward along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: standing external rotation behind back with towel
exercises.description: Holding a towel behind your back to rotate the shoulder outward. It improves shoulder control.
steps: Stand tall holding a towel behind your back with both hands.
Keep the lower hand still and pull the upper hand away.
Rotate the upper shoulder outward.
Hold briefly and release.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.name: shoulder stretch behind the back with towel
exercises.description: A towel stretch behind the back that opens the shoulder.
steps: Hold a towel with one hand over your shoulder and the other behind your lower back.
Gently pull the towel upward with the lower hand.
Keep your chest open and neck relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: side lying external rotation
exercises.description: A light side-lying rotation for the back of the shoulder. Often used for shoulder stability.
steps: Lie on your side with your top elbow bent to 90 degrees against your ribs.
Hold your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward without moving your elbow.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: bodyweight side lying shoulder external rotation
exercises.description: A side-lying outward shoulder rotation with no weight. It trains rotator cuff control.
steps: Lie on your side with a small towel under the top elbow.
Bend the elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up toward the ceiling.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: stick shoulder mobilization in abduction behind back
exercises.description: Using a stick to guide the arm out and back behind you. It improves shoulder range.
steps: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back.
Hold it with one hand low and the other high.
Use the low hand to guide the top arm out and up.
Move only in a comfortable range.
Return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: stick shoulder rotation over head
exercises.description: Passing a stick overhead and around the body. It opens up the shoulders.
steps: Hold a stick with a wide grip in front of your thighs.
Raise it overhead with straight arms.
Continue the arc behind your back as far as comfortable.
Return along the same path.
Narrow your grip over time.

exercises.name: standing wall shoulder rotation
exercises.description: Rotating the shoulder against a wall. It gives gentle mobility and awareness.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your forearm against it.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm up and down against the wall.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: suspension self assisted pull up
exercises.description: A pull-up using your legs for help. It builds back and arms.
steps: Hold the handles with feet on the floor.
Lean back.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Use your legs for light help.
Lower slowly.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.name: scapular pull up swing
exercises.description: A scapular pull-up with a gentle swing. It builds shoulder blade control and grip.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulder blades down without bending your elbows.
Swing your body forward and back in a small arc.
Keep the motion controlled.
Lower to a full hang and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell straight arm bicep swing
exercises.description: Swinging the dumbbells with straight arms to load the biceps. A shoulder and arm builder.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Swing the dumbbells forward and up in a controlled arc.
Lower them back down.
Keep your torso still and avoid momentum.

exercises.name: suspension self assisted triceps dip
exercises.description: A triceps dip with your feet on the floor for help. It trains the triceps.
steps: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet on the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Bend your elbows to lower.
Use your legs for light help.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows close.

exercises.name: ring long arms push up hold
exercises.description: A push-up hold on rings with arms fully extended. It demands shoulder stability and core tension.
steps: Set the rings low and take a plank with your hands on them.
Keep your arms straight and rings close to your sides.
Squeeze your glutes and abs.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor to rest.

exercises.name: l sit leg raise
exercises.description: A raise from an L-sit position. It builds strong abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the floor with your hands on parallettes or flat beside you.
Press down to lift your hips.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Raise your legs higher and lower them back to the L position.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders down.

exercises.name: suspension shoulder external rotation
exercises.description: External rotation using straps. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
steps: Hold the handles with elbows bent at 90 degrees.
Lean back slightly.
Rotate your forearms outward and upward.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Return slowly.
Keep the motion small.

exercises.name: suspension side bend
exercises.description: A side bend using a strap. It works the obliques.
steps: Hold a handle and stand sideways to the anchor.
Brace your core.
Bend sideways away from the anchor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Do all reps, then switch sides.
Keep your hips still.

exercises.name: dumbbell hyperextension v. 2
exercises.description: Back extension holding a dumbbell. It trains the lower back and glutes.
steps: Set the pad at hip height and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Lift until you are in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly.
Do not overextend.

exercises.name: suspension side bridge
exercises.description: A side plank with your feet in the straps. It strengthens the obliques and stabilisers.
steps: Lie on your side with feet in the straps and your elbow below your shoulder.
Lift your hips.
Hold a straight line.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell jump box
exercises.description: A box jump holding dumbbells. It builds explosive leg power.
steps: Stand in front of a sturdy box holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top.
Step down carefully and reset.

exercises.name: dumbbell kneeling to jump box
exercises.description: Starting kneeling, you jump onto a box holding dumbbells. A very explosive move.
steps: Kneel in front of a box holding dumbbells at your sides.
Swing your arms and drive up to your feet.
Jump onto the box, landing softly.
Stand tall.
Step down carefully and reset to kneeling.

exercises.name: tuck planche on parallette
exercises.description: A hold on parallettes with knees tucked and hips lifted. It builds shoulder and core strength.
steps: Place your hands on parallettes and squat down.
Lean forward over your hands, arms straight.
Lift your feet with knees tucked toward the chest.
Hold for a few seconds, rounding your upper back slightly.
Lower your feet gently.

exercises.name: suspension single leg split squat (self assisted)
exercises.description: A split squat holding the handles for help. It trains the legs and balance.
steps: Hold the handles and place your back foot behind you.
Stand tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Use your arms for light help.
Press up through your front heel.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: forward and backward crab walk
exercises.description: A walk on hands and feet facing up. It works the arms, glutes and core.
steps: Sit with hands behind you and feet flat, then lift your hips.
Keep your chest open and hips high.
Walk forward with alternating hands and feet.
Then walk backward the same way.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: wall assisted handstand to tuck planche negative
exercises.description: Lowering from a wall handstand into a tuck planche. It builds advanced shoulder strength.
steps: Kick up into a handstand with your heels on the wall.
Brace your core and keep your arms straight.
Slowly lower your body forward.
Tuck your knees as you reach the planche position.
Control the descent and then reset.

exercises.name: wall facing single leg split handstand hold
exercises.description: A wall-facing handstand with one leg split off the wall. It trains balance and shoulder endurance.
steps: Kick up into a handstand facing the wall.
Keep your arms straight and push the floor away.
Lift one leg off the wall.
Hold for 10-20 seconds with control.
Return the leg and come down safely.

exercises.name: suspension single leg split squat
exercises.description: A split squat with the rear foot in a strap. It builds the front leg and balance.
steps: Put your rear foot in the strap and step forward.
Stand tall.
Lower your hips, back knee down.
Keep your front knee over your foot.
Press up.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: seated arm crossover and chest out on a chair
exercises.description: A seated stretch that crosses the arms and then opens the chest. It loosens the upper body.
steps: Sit tall on a chair.
Cross your arms in front of your chest and hug yourself.
Open your arms wide and push your chest out.
Hold the open position for 5-10 seconds.
Repeat.

exercises.name: suspension single leg squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat holding the handles for balance. It builds leg strength.
steps: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Extend the other leg forward.
Sit back and lower.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Stand up.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: hip lift low back off floor
exercises.description: A lying move where you lift the hips so the lower back leaves the floor. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs raised toward the ceiling.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips so your lower back comes off the floor.
Lower slowly with control.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: dumbbell underhand front raise
exercises.description: A front raise with palms facing up. It targets the front of the shoulders.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows slightly soft.
Raise your arms in front of you to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: scapular pull up v. 2
exercises.description: Hang from a bar and move only your shoulder blades. It builds the shoulder control you need for solid pull-ups.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, arms straight.
Let your shoulders relax up toward your ears.
Pull your shoulder blades down and together to lift your body a few centimetres.
Keep your elbows locked straight the whole time.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly back to the full hang.

exercises.name: dumbbell half kneeling single arm shoulder press
exercises.description: A one-arm overhead press from a half kneeling stance. It trains the shoulder while the position challenges your balance and core.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is extended.
Lower it under control back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell kneeling single arm shoulder press
exercises.description: A one-arm overhead press done on both knees. The kneeling position takes the legs out so your shoulder and core do the work.
steps: Kneel on both knees with your hips tall and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly back to your shoulder without leaning sideways.
Complete your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: suspension straight hip leg curl
exercises.description: A leg curl with your hips kept straight. It works the hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Lift your hips into a straight line.
Curl your heels toward you.
Keep your hips high.
Extend slowly.
Repeat.

exercises.name: suspension triceps dip
exercises.description: A dip with suspension handles. It trains the triceps.
steps: Hold the handles with arms straight.
Keep your body upright.
Lower by bending your elbows.
Keep your elbows close.
Press back up.
Stay controlled.

exercises.name: suspension triceps extension v. 2
exercises.description: A triceps extension leaning on straps. It isolates the triceps.
steps: Hold the handles and lean forward.
Keep your elbows bent and by your head.
Straighten your arms.
Keep your body straight.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows still.

exercises.name: lying abduction
exercises.description: A side-lying leg raise that targets the outer hip. It is a simple way to strengthen the muscles that keep your pelvis steady.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked.
Rest your head on your lower arm and keep your hips stacked.
Lift your top leg up and slightly back without rolling your torso.
Pause at the top, then lower with control.
Finish your reps, then roll over and do the other side.

exercises.name: seated bent knee abduction
exercises.description: Seated, you press your knees outward. It trains the outer hips.
steps: Sit tall with your knees bent and feet on the floor.
Place your hands on your outer knees.
Press your knees outward against your hands.
Hold briefly.
Release slowly.
Keep your back straight.

exercises.name: seated bent knee abduction feet floor off
exercises.description: Seated knee abduction with the feet lifted. It trains the outer hips and core.
steps: Sit tall and lift your feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees outward.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

exercises.name: suspension twist
exercises.description: From a plank with feet in straps, you twist the hips side to side. It trains the obliques.
steps: Start in a plank with your feet in the straps.
Keep your arms straight.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Return to centre.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your shoulders steady.

exercises.name: resistance band seated bent knee abduction feet floor off
exercises.description: Seated knee abduction against band resistance with feet lifted. It trains the outer hips.
steps: Sit tall with a band around your thighs and feet off the floor.
Hold the seat edge.
Open your knees against the band.
Pause.
Close slowly.
Keep your back straight.

exercises.name: cable standing high cross neutral grip triceps extension
exercises.description: A triceps pushdown with the cable set high and the handles crossed, using a neutral grip. It isolates the back of the arm.
steps: Set both pulleys high and stand in the middle, holding the handles with palms facing in.
Cross your hands in front of your chest with elbows tucked to your sides.
Press the handles down and out until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps for a moment.
Let the handles rise back slowly without moving your elbows.

exercises.name: smith staggered stance hip thrust
exercises.description: A hip thrust on the Smith machine with a staggered stance. It builds the glutes.
steps: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the bar over your hips.
Stagger your feet, one slightly ahead.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips to full extension.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

exercises.name: lever staggered stance hip thrust (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A plate-loaded machine hip thrust with a staggered stance. It targets the glutes.
steps: Sit in the machine with the pad over your hips.
Stagger your feet.
Drive through your heels.
Lift your hips fully.
Squeeze your glutes.
Lower slowly and switch the stance.

exercises.name: lever belt sumo deadlift (v bar)
exercises.description: A sumo deadlift on a belt squat style lever machine holding a V bar. It loads the legs and hips with less strain on the back.
steps: Stand wide on the platform with toes angled out and grip the V bar.
Sit your hips back, chest up, and keep your arms straight.
Push through your heels to stand fully upright.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control, letting your knees track over your toes.

exercises.name: lever seated scapular retraction (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A seated machine move where you pull your shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles between your shoulder blades.
steps: Sit with your chest against the pad and grab the handles with straight arms.
Let your shoulder blades spread forward slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together without bending your elbows.
Hold the squeeze for a second.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: cable seated scapular retraction
exercises.description: A seated cable move that trains your shoulder blades to pull back. It helps posture and builds the mid back.
steps: Sit at a low cable station, feet braced, and hold the handle with straight arms.
Sit tall and let your shoulder blades stretch forward.
Pull your shoulder blades together, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the squeeze briefly.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: dumbbell hip supported romanian deadlift
exercises.description: A Romanian deadlift with your hips supported against a surface. It teaches a clean hip hinge and loads the hamstrings.
steps: Stand with your hips lightly against the support, holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and keep your back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: resistance band kneeling leg kickback on bench
exercises.description: Kneeling on a bench, you kick one leg back against band tension to work the glutes.
steps: Anchor the band and loop it around one foot, then kneel on a bench with hands on the front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the working leg back and up until the hip is fully extended.
Squeeze the glute for a moment at the top.
Lower slowly under control without letting the band yank your leg.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: suspender twisting jackknife
exercises.description: From a plank with feet in the straps, you pull the knees toward one side of the chest, which hits the abs and obliques hard.
steps: Set your feet in the straps and get into a straight-arm plank.
Keep your shoulders stacked over your hands.
Pull both knees toward your chest, twisting them toward one elbow.
Pause briefly, then extend the legs back to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips from sagging as you return.

exercises.name: cable face pull with external rotation
exercises.description: A face pull that finishes with a rotation of the arms. It hits the rear shoulders and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.
steps: Set a rope at upper chest height and hold it with both hands, arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face with elbows high.
At the end, rotate your fists upward so your hands finish above your elbows.
Squeeze your rear shoulders for a second.
Reverse the rotation and return slowly.

exercises.name: suspender y lateral raise
exercises.description: Leaning back on the straps, you pull your arms up into a Y shape to train the shoulders and upper back.
steps: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.
Raise your arms up and out until they form a Y overhead.
Pause at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Step your feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: dumbbell over the chest lying abduction
exercises.description: A side-lying hip abduction while you hold a dumbbell over your chest. It trains the outer hips and adds a core challenge.
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked and hold a dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Raise your top leg without rotating your torso.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: suspender arm curl to ears
exercises.description: You curl your body up toward your hands with the straps at head height, a bodyweight biceps builder.
steps: Hold the handles with palms up and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and pull your hands toward your ears.
Keep elbows high and out to the sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.

exercises.name: reverse lunge arm reach twist
exercises.description: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach and a twist. It warms up the legs, hips and spine together.
steps: Stand tall with your arms by your sides.
Step one leg back into a lunge and reach both arms overhead.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Untwist, then push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs for the set.

exercises.name: split stretch spine rolling
exercises.description: A seated straddle position with a rolling spine movement. It loosens your back and inner thighs.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs spread wide in a comfortable split.
Sit tall and reach your arms forward.
Round your spine and roll down slowly, one segment at a time.
Roll back up slowly until you are upright.
Repeat for 8-10 slow reps without forcing the stretch.

exercises.name: suspender biceps clutch
exercises.description: A strap curl where you hold the contraction close to the head, great for biceps peak work and arm control.
steps: Grab the handles palms up and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body rigid.
Curl yourself up, drawing the hands in beside your head.
Hold the top position for a second and squeeze.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Walk your feet closer to make it easier.

exercises.name: negative front lever raise
exercises.description: An advanced hanging move where you lower slowly toward a front lever. It builds serious core and lat strength.
steps: Hang from a bar and pull your body up so your hips and legs are above you.
Straighten your body and keep your arms locked.
Lower slowly toward a horizontal position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Stop when you cannot hold the line, then bend your knees to come back up.
Rest and repeat for a few careful reps.

exercises.name: single arm hanging toes to bar
exercises.description: A hanging core move done from one hand. Lifting your toes to the bar trains the abs and grip.
steps: Hang from a bar with one hand and keep your shoulder active.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Lift your toes up toward the bar.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.name: landmine kneeling 180s
exercises.description: A kneeling rotational move with a landmine bar, swinging it in a wide arc side to side. It builds strong, rotating abs.
steps: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar with both hands in front of your chest.
Keep your hips squared and core tight.
Swing the bar in an arc to one side by rotating your torso.
Swing across to the other side in a controlled sweep.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.

exercises.name: barbell 2 3 deadlift
exercises.description: A deadlift variation with a two-thirds range of motion. It is a good way to drill the lower, hardest part of the lift.
steps: Stand with your feet hip width and the bar over your mid foot.
Grip the bar, brace your core, and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up.
Lower the bar back toward the floor under control.
Reset each rep and keep your back neutral.

exercises.name: sitting cat cow stretch on a chair
exercises.description: A gentle spinal stretch you can do on a chair. It moves your back through flexion and extension to ease stiffness.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with your hands on your knees and feet flat.
Inhale, arch your back and lift your chest.
Exhale, round your spine and tuck your chin.
Move slowly between the two positions.
Repeat for 8-10 breaths.

exercises.name: suspender body saw
exercises.description: From a forearm plank with feet in the straps, you rock your body back and forth like a saw to challenge the core.
steps: Place your feet in the straps and set up on your forearms.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Shift your body backward by pushing through the forearms.
Rock forward past the starting point in a short controlled motion.
Keep your hips level, do not let your lower back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

exercises.name: suspender close grip chest press
exercises.description: A narrow-hand push on the straps that shifts work toward the triceps and inner chest.
steps: Hold the handles close together and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest between the handles, elbows tucked close.
Pause when your chest is near your hands.
Press back up until the arms are straight.
Move your feet back to increase difficulty.

exercises.name: suspender crunch
exercises.description: From a plank with feet in the straps, you pull the knees in and curl the hips up, a direct ab move.
steps: Put your feet in the straps and set a straight-arm plank.
Keep shoulders over hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest while rounding your spine slightly.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Extend your legs back to plank slowly.
Avoid dropping the hips as you return.

exercises.name: suspender face pull
exercises.description: A strap row to the face with elbows high that targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Hold the handles with palms facing in and lean back.
Keep your body straight and arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your forehead, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
Do not let your hips drop.

exercises.name: suspender handstand push up
exercises.description: An advanced inverted press with hands on the straps, working the triceps and shoulders strongly.
steps: Set the straps low and place your hands in the handles in a pike position.
Kick or walk your feet up into an inverted position with a tight core.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between the handles.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body steady, using a wall or spotter if needed.
Come down carefully when finished.

exercises.name: suspender incline push up
exercises.description: A push-up with the hands in the straps and the body angled upward, a gentler version that builds the chest.
steps: Hold the handles and walk your feet back so your body is at a slant.
Keep your body straight and core tight.
Lower your chest to the handles by bending the elbows.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Walk your feet back to make it harder.

exercises.name: suspender jump squat
exercises.description: Holding the straps for balance, you squat and jump explosively to build leg power.
steps: Hold the handles with slightly bent arms and stand tall.
Lower into a squat with your chest up.
Drive through your feet and jump up.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and sink into the next squat.
Use the straps for balance only.
Keep knees tracking over toes.

exercises.name: suspender lunge back crossover
exercises.description: A rear lunge where the back leg crosses behind the front one, hitting the glutes and outer hips.
steps: Hold the handles and stand facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until the front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest tall and front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: suspender middle row
exercises.description: A strap row to mid-chest height that works the upper back and arms using your body weight.
steps: Grip the handles and lean back with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward your hands, elbows close by.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Step forward to ease the load.

exercises.name: suspender mountain climber push up
exercises.description: A hard conditioning move combining a push-up with mountain climber knee drives while the feet sit in the straps.
steps: Place your feet in the straps and set up in a high plank.
Do one push-up, keeping your body straight.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then the other.
Alternate legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat the sequence for the set.

exercises.name: suspender oblique rollout
exercises.description: Rolling out on the straps with a slight side angle, you hit the obliques and deep core.
steps: Hold the handles kneeling or standing, arms in front.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Roll forward and angle your arms toward one side.
Go only as far as you can hold a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: suspender one arm biceps curl
exercises.description: You curl yourself up with one arm holding a single strap, a tough unilateral biceps move.
steps: Hold one handle palm up and lean back at an angle.
Keep your feet planted and body straight.
Bend the elbow and pull your body toward your hand.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps and switch arms.

exercises.name: suspender one arm chest press
exercises.description: A single-arm push on one strap that trains the chest while the core fights rotation.
steps: Hold one handle, lean forward and place your feet wide for balance.
Keep your hips square.
Bend your elbow and lower your chest toward the hand.
Resist twisting at the torso.
Press back to a straight arm.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: suspender one arm leg push up
exercises.description: A push-up with feet in the straps and one hand lifted, building chest strength and total-body stability.
steps: Put your feet in the straps and set a plank with one hand on the floor.
Brace your core firmly.
Lower your chest by bending the supporting elbow.
