Keep your hips level and avoid twisting.
Press back up.
Complete your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.name: cable standing fly v. 3
exercises.description: A standing cable fly that trains your chest through a wide hugging arc. The constant cable tension keeps the muscle working.
steps: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a staggered stance and lean slightly.
With soft elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest for a moment.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: cable kneeling woodchop v. 3
exercises.description: A kneeling cable chop that works your obliques and core with a diagonal pull.
steps: Set the cable high, kneel side-on to it and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your hips square and your core tight.
Pull the handle diagonally across your body down toward the opposite hip.
Rotate through your torso, not your arms.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable overhead squat v. 3
exercises.description: A squat while holding a cable overhead. It trains the legs and challenges shoulder stability and core control.
steps: Set a cable low and hold the handle overhead with straight arms, standing tall.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Squat down by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Keep the handle over your head and chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: cable kneeling pulldown v. 3
exercises.description: A straight-arm style pulldown from a kneeling position. It targets the lats without help from your legs.
steps: Kneel facing a high pulley and hold the bar or handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Pull the handle down toward your chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the handle rise back slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: cable standing reverse fly v. 3
exercises.description: A standing cable reverse fly aimed at the rear shoulders and upper back. It helps balance all the pressing you do.
steps: Set the pulleys at shoulder height and hold the opposite handles, arms crossed.
Stand tall with soft elbows.
Pull your hands apart and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the crossed start.

exercises.name: cable lateral lunge v. 3
exercises.description: A side lunge with cable resistance. It builds strength in your hips and thighs through a sideways step.
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your chest.
Step wide to the side and sit your hips back.
Keep the other leg straight and your chest up.
Push through the bent leg to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable bench press v. 3
exercises.description: A bench press using cables. The steady tension gives your chest and triceps constant work.
steps: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand at chest level.
Plant your feet and keep your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: cable seated high row v. 3
exercises.description: A seated row with the handle pulled toward your upper chest. It targets the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Sit at a cable station with the pulley set high and grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles toward your upper chest, elbows flaring slightly.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.name: cable standing push pull v. 3
exercises.description: A standing move with one arm pressing while the other rows. It trains pushing and pulling together and tests your core.
steps: Stand in a staggered stance between two cables, one handle in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other back toward your ribs.
Reverse the roles slowly.
Alternate sides for the set.

exercises.name: cable standing hip extension v. 3
exercises.description: A standing cable kickback that targets the glutes. It teaches you to extend the hip without arching your back.
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and stand facing the machine, holding on for balance.
Keep your core tight and your torso upright.
Push your working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: suspender one leg chest press
exercises.description: A strap chest press with one foot lifted, adding a balance challenge to the pressing movement.
steps: Hold the handles, lean forward and lift one foot off the floor.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest between your hands.
Press back up without letting the hips drop.
Keep the raised leg in line with your body.
Switch legs after your set.

exercises.name: cable kneeling military press v. 3
exercises.description: A kneeling overhead press with cables. The position keeps your legs out of it, so the shoulders do the work.
steps: Kneel between two low pulleys and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press both handles straight overhead.
Lock out without leaning back.
Lower under control to your shoulders.

exercises.name: cable standing biceps curl (rope attachment) v. 3
exercises.description: A standing curl with a rope on a low cable. The rope lets you turn your hands at the top for a stronger squeeze.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and hold it with palms facing each other.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the rope up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging your body.

exercises.name: cable lying alternating bent leg jackknife v. 3
exercises.description: A lying leg-raise style core move against cable resistance, alternating legs. It hits the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet attached to a low cable and hands by your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Bring one bent knee toward your chest.
Lower it slowly and switch legs.
Keep a controlled alternating rhythm.

exercises.name: cable single arm row with rotation v. 3
exercises.description: A one-arm cable row that adds a torso rotation. It trains the back and the twisting muscles of the core.
steps: Stand facing a cable at chest height with a single handle in one hand.
Take a staggered stance and brace your core.
Row the handle to your ribs while rotating your torso slightly.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable incline bench press v. 3
exercises.description: A cable press on an incline bench. It shifts the work toward the upper chest with constant tension.
steps: Set an incline bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand.
Plant your feet and pull your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up and slightly together.
Squeeze your upper chest at the top.
Lower slowly to a comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: cable standing hip flexion v. 3
exercises.description: A standing cable knee raise that trains the hip flexors. It helps lifting your leg with control.
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley, face away from the machine, and hold on for balance.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Drive your working knee forward and up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: cable standing hip abduction v. 3
exercises.description: A standing cable leg raise to the side. It strengthens the outer hip.
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the near side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Lift your outside leg out to the side.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable standing hip adduction v. 3
exercises.description: A standing cable move where you pull your leg across your body. It works the inner thigh.
steps: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley on the far side and hold something for balance.
Stand tall with your core tight.
Sweep your working leg across in front of the other leg.
Squeeze your inner thigh.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable squat v. 3
exercises.description: A squat holding a cable at the chest. The cable adds load and encourages an upright torso.
steps: Hold a cable handle at your chest and stand with feet shoulder width.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: cable bent over single arm row v. 3
exercises.description: A bent-over one-arm row with a low cable. It builds the lats and mid back with steady tension.
steps: Face a low pulley, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the handle.
Brace your core and keep your hips back.
Row the handle toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: suspender pull up v. 2
exercises.description: A strap-based pull-up variation that builds the lats and arms, with an angled body you can adjust.
steps: Hold the handles overhead and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to full extension.
Bend your knees or lean back to make it easier.

exercises.name: cable kneeling crunch v. 3
exercises.description: A kneeling cable crunch that loads the abs. You curl your spine to bring your elbows toward your knees.
steps: Kneel under a high pulley and hold the rope beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Curl your torso down, bringing elbows toward your knees.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the upright start.

exercises.name: cable standing torso twist v. 3
exercises.description: A standing cable rotation that trains the obliques. Turn through your torso with your arms staying in front.
steps: Stand side-on to a cable set at chest height and hold the handle with both hands.
Keep your arms straight and feet planted.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable standing biceps curl to arnold press v. 3
exercises.description: A combo of a biceps curl flowing into an Arnold press with cables. It works arms and shoulders in one fluid move.
steps: Hold low cable handles, palms forward, arms down.
Curl the handles up to your shoulders.
Rotate your palms inward as you start to press.
Press overhead, turning your palms forward.
Reverse the move and lower under control.

exercises.name: cable lying fly v. 3
exercises.description: A lying cable fly that stretches and squeezes the chest. The cables keep tension on at the top.
steps: Lie on a bench between two low pulleys and hold a handle in each hand over your chest.
Keep a soft bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop at a comfortable stretch.
Bring the handles back together over your chest.

exercises.name: cable standing alternating diagonal chest press v. 3
exercises.description: A standing diagonal cable press done one arm at a time. It trains the chest and challenges your core.
steps: Stand in a staggered stance holding a high cable handle in each hand.
Brace your core.
Press one handle forward and down diagonally.
Return slowly and press with the other arm.
Alternate for the set without twisting your hips.

exercises.name: cable side plank row v. 3
exercises.description: A side plank held while you row a cable. It trains the core, shoulders and back at the same time.
steps: Set up in a side plank with a low cable handle in your top hand.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Row the handle toward your ribs.
Keep your hips high and stable.
Extend slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable prone single leg curl v. 3
exercises.description: A lying face-down leg curl on a cable. Training one leg at a time builds the hamstrings evenly.
steps: Lie face down with an ankle strap attached to a low cable.
Keep your hips pressed down.
Curl your heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze your hamstring at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: cable standing front raise v. 3
exercises.description: A front raise using a low cable. It builds the front of the shoulders with steady tension.
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle between your legs.
Keep your core tight and arm nearly straight.
Raise the handle forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable standing side bend v. 3
exercises.description: A standing side bend that loads the obliques with a cable. It trains your core to resist and control sideways motion.
steps: Stand side-on to a low pulley and hold the handle at your side.
Keep your chest tall.
Bend sideways away from the machine.
Contract your obliques to return upright.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable standing single arm overhead triceps extension v. 3
exercises.description: A one-arm overhead triceps extension with a cable. The overhead position stretches and works the long head of the triceps.
steps: Hold a handle from a low pulley overhead, elbow bent, with your upper arm close to your head.
Brace your core.
Straighten your arm overhead.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: suspender push up
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands in unstable straps, making the chest, arms and core work harder.
steps: Hold the handles and get into a plank with hands under shoulders.
Keep your body in one line.
Lower your chest between the handles.
Keep the straps steady and elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press up to straight arms.
Do not let the hips sag.

exercises.name: glute ham developer straight arms sit up
exercises.description: A sit-up on a glute ham developer with your arms extended. The longer range makes your abs work harder.
steps: Set up on the GHD with your feet secured and hips on the pad.
Extend your arms overhead and lean back.
Curl up, bringing your arms forward.
Reach your torso over your knees.
Lower slowly with control.

exercises.name: criss cross tuck jump
exercises.description: A jump where you tuck the knees and cross the feet in the air, great for conditioning and leg power.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Cross your feet in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Uncross on the next jump, alternating the crossing foot.
Keep a steady quick rhythm.

exercises.name: kettlebell single arm alternate fly
exercises.description: A lying chest fly with a kettlebell, alternating arms. It trains the chest and challenges your control.
steps: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell over your chest in one hand.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell out to the side in an arc.
Bring it back over your chest.
Switch hands and alternate.

exercises.name: resistance band lying floor chest press
exercises.description: A floor chest press using a resistance band. It trains the chest and triceps with tension that increases at the top.
steps: Lie on your back with the band under your upper back and a handle in each hand.
Start with your hands at chest level.
Press your hands straight up until your arms extend.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: kettlebell half kneeling side lunge
exercises.description: A half kneeling side lunge with a kettlebell. It opens the inner thigh and hips while loading the legs.
steps: Start in a half kneeling position holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Straighten the front leg to the side as you shift your weight back.
Feel a stretch in your inner thigh.
Return to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: kettlebell standing behind back romanian deadlift
exercises.description: A Romanian deadlift holding a kettlebell behind you. It trains the hamstrings and glutes and reinforces a straight back.
steps: Hold a kettlebell behind your back in both hands, feet hip width.
Soften your knees and brace your core.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: bodyweight standing overhead shrug
exercises.description: A shrug done with your arms overhead. It wakes up the upper traps and builds shoulder awareness.
steps: Stand tall and raise your arms straight overhead.
Keep your ribs down and core tight.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: standing ankle and hip drill
exercises.description: A standing drill that loosens the ankles and hips. It is a good warm-up for squats and lunges.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width.
Shift your weight onto one foot.
Rotate your ankle and hip through a smooth circle.
Keep your upper body steady.
Do 8-10 slow reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: suspender rear lunge
exercises.description: A reverse lunge with the hands on the straps for balance, working the thighs and glutes.
steps: Hold the handles and stand tall, facing the anchor.
Step one leg back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Press through the front heel to return.
Use the straps for balance only.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

exercises.name: suspender reverse fly wake up
exercises.description: A reverse fly on the straps that works the rear shoulders and upper back to improve posture.
steps: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight in front.
Keep your body in a line.
Open your arms wide, pulling the shoulder blades together.
Keep arms slightly bent and level with the shoulders.
Return slowly to the start.
Walk your feet forward to lighten the load.

exercises.name: smith bench squat
exercises.description: A squat on the Smith machine to a bench. The bench gives you a consistent depth and a stable path.
steps: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back.
Unrack and step your feet slightly forward.
Sit down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: lever single arm reverse grip lateral pulldown (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A one-arm pulldown on a plate-loaded machine using an underhand grip. It trains the lats and biceps one side at a time.
steps: Sit in the machine and grab one handle with an underhand grip.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Pull the handle down, driving your elbow toward your side.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: suspender side cross lunge
exercises.description: A lunge stepping out to the side and across, with straps for support, training the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step one leg out and slightly behind the other, crossing the body.
Sink back into the hip with a flat back.
Push through the working foot to return.
Keep your knee in line with your toes.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: incline close grip push up with chair against wall
exercises.description: A close grip incline push-up with your hands on a chair. It is a good way to build triceps strength.
steps: Brace a chair against a wall and place your hands close together on the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the chair, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips in line.

exercises.name: standing wall slide half squat
exercises.description: A half squat with your back sliding against a wall. It builds leg strength with support and good alignment.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet slightly forward.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall.
Press through your heels to rise.
Repeat for the set.

exercises.name: weighted plate hyperextension v. 2
exercises.description: A back extension holding a weight plate. The plate adds resistance for the lower back and glutes.
steps: Set up on a hyperextension bench with your feet secured and hold a plate against your chest.
Keep your back straight and body in a line.
Lower your torso with control.
Raise until you are back in a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without overarching.

exercises.name: suspender side lunge
exercises.description: Stepping wide to the side while holding the straps works the thighs, glutes and inner legs.
steps: Hold the handles and stand with feet together.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push your hips back, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and heel down.
Push off to return to the start.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: suspender single arm rear delt row
exercises.description: A one-arm strap row with the elbow flared, aimed at the rear shoulder.
steps: Hold one handle and lean back at an angle.
Keep your hips level and free hand on your chest or hip.
Pull the handle toward your shoulder with the elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear delt at the end.
Lower slowly to a straight arm.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: suspender single leg plank straight arm
exercises.description: A straight-arm plank with feet in the straps and one leg lifted, which challenges core stability.
steps: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lift one leg slightly higher.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower the leg and switch sides.
Breathe steadily throughout.

exercises.name: suspender single leg plank
exercises.description: A forearm plank with feet in the straps and one leg raised, fighting rotation and sag.
steps: Place your feet in the straps and rest on your forearms.
Lift one leg a bit higher than the other.
Keep your hips square and abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower and switch legs.
Do not let the lower back arch.

exercises.name: suspender single leg squat figure
exercises.description: A one-leg squat holding the straps for support, building leg strength and balance.
steps: Hold the handles and stand on one leg, other leg forward.
Sit your hips back and bend the knee.
Lower as far as you can control.
Keep your knee over your toes and chest tall.
Drive through the heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: suspender sit up
exercises.description: Lying down with your feet in the straps, you sit up to train the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and knees bent.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze the abs at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: sleepers stretch
exercises.description: A side-lying stretch that opens up the back of the shoulder. Handy for keeping internal rotation smooth.
steps: Lie on your side with the bottom arm in front of you, elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your shoulder stacked and the upper arm at chest height.
Use your top hand to gently press the bottom forearm toward the floor.
Stop where you feel a mild stretch at the back of the shoulder.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: suspender spiderman push up
exercises.description: A push-up with feet in the straps where one knee drives toward the elbow as you lower.
steps: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
As you descend, bring one knee toward the same elbow.
Press up and extend the leg back.
Alternate sides each rep.
Keep your hips low and steady.

exercises.name: wrist extensor stretch
exercises.description: Stretches the muscles on top of the forearm that lift the wrist. Good after typing, climbing or heavy gripping.
steps: Extend one arm in front of you with the elbow straight and palm facing down.
Bend the wrist so your fingers point toward the floor.
With your other hand, gently pull the back of the hand toward you.
Keep the stretch mild and your shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.name: suspender split fly
exercises.description: A fly on the straps with a split stance, opening the arms to work the shoulders and chest.
steps: Hold the handles and step into a split stance leaning forward.
Keep arms slightly bent and hands in front of you.
Open your arms out wide to the sides.
Squeeze at the end of the stretch without shrugging.
Bring the arms back together under control.
Switch the lead leg halfway through.

exercises.name: suspender sprinter
exercises.description: You hold the straps and drive the knees like a sprinter, a quick leg and cardio move.
steps: Hold the handles and lean slightly forward.
Stand on one leg with the other knee raised.
Drive one knee up as the opposite arm moves.
Switch legs with a quick hop.
Stay on the balls of your feet.
Keep your core tight and pace steady.

exercises.name: suspender squat arms overhead
exercises.description: A squat while holding the straps overhead, working the legs and mobility of the shoulders and torso.
steps: Hold the handles overhead with arms straight.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit back and down into a squat.
Keep your arms up and chest tall.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Do not let the lower back round.

exercises.name: suspender squat
exercises.description: A bodyweight squat where you hold the straps for balance and can lean back for depth.
steps: Hold the handles with arms extended.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Push through the heels to stand.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.

exercises.name: cable standing neutral grip overhead triceps extension
exercises.description: Overhead cable extension with a neutral grip that loads the long head of the triceps through a deep stretch.
steps: Attach a rope or neutral handle to a low pulley and face away from the stack.
Hold it overhead with elbows bent and pointing forward, one foot slightly ahead.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and your ribs down.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight overhead.
Lower slowly back to a deep stretch and repeat.

exercises.name: suspender standing ab rollout
exercises.description: Standing with the straps, you lean forward and roll out with straight arms, a challenging core move.
steps: Hold the handles in front of you and lean forward.
Brace your abs and tuck the pelvis.
Extend your arms overhead as your body leans out.
Stop before your lower back arches.
Pull back to the start with your abs.
Take a smaller range if you need.

exercises.name: suspender star plank
exercises.description: A plank with the feet in the straps spread wide like a star, challenging the core and hips.
steps: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Spread your legs wide.
Keep your hips level and body straight.
Brace the abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe steadily and do not sag.

exercises.name: step up (1st and 2nd stairs steps)
exercises.description: A simple stair step-up done on the first and second steps. It builds leg strength and balance using everyday stairs.
steps: Stand facing the stairs with your feet hip-width apart.
Place one foot on the first step and push through the heel to climb up.
Continue onto the second step, then step back down in control.
Keep your torso tall and your knee tracking over your toes.
Alternate the leading leg each rep or finish all reps on one side first.

exercises.name: standing wall slide half squat hold
exercises.description: A wall-supported half squat held in place to build quad endurance with low joint stress.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and feet about a step in front of you.
Slide down until your knees are bent to about 45-60 degrees.
Keep your back flat on the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Press through your whole foot and breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-45 seconds, then slide back up.

exercises.name: calves stretch v. 2
exercises.description: A standing calf stretch variation that lengthens the lower leg muscles and helps ankle mobility.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it at chest height.
Step one foot back with the heel flat on the floor and the toes pointing forward.
Bend the front knee and lean in until you feel the back calf stretch.
Keep the back leg straight and the heel down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: suspender star push up
exercises.description: A push-up with the feet spread in the straps, which adds a big core and hip challenge.
steps: Place your feet in the straps spread wide in a high plank.
Keep your core tight.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Keep elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up.
Hold the wide leg position the whole set.

exercises.name: suspender supine crunch
exercises.description: Lying on your back with your feet in the straps, you curl the hips up to work the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and legs up.
Place your arms flat on the floor.
Curl your hips up, pulling the knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.
Do not swing the legs.

exercises.name: suspender supine plank
exercises.description: A back-facing plank with the heels in the straps that strengthens the glutes, back and core.
steps: Lie on your back with heels in the straps.
Press through your heels and lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and keep abs tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: suspender triceps extension push up
exercises.description: Lowering your head toward the handles then pushing out, a strap extension that hammers the triceps.
steps: Hold the handles and lean forward with arms straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Bend your elbows and lower your forehead between the hands.
Keep elbows pointing forward.
Press back up to straight arms.
Move your feet back for more challenge.

exercises.name: suspender triceps kickback
exercises.description: Leaning forward with the straps, you straighten the elbow behind you to isolate the triceps.
steps: Hold the handles and hinge forward with elbows by your sides.
Keep your upper arms still.
Straighten your arms and push them behind you.
Squeeze the triceps at the end.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your back flat.

exercises.name: suspender twist side
exercises.description: From a side-facing plank position with the straps, you twist to hit the obliques.
steps: Place your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Twist your hips to one side, bringing the knees across.
Return to the center with control.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your shoulders square.

exercises.name: suspender twist up
exercises.description: You pull the knees up and twist across the body from a plank with the feet in the straps.
steps: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Pull your knees up and rotate them toward one elbow.
Pause and squeeze the obliques.
Extend your legs back to plank.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep your hands firmly planted.

exercises.name: lever belt single leg romanian deadlift
exercises.description: A single-leg hip hinge on a belt-loaded lever machine that trains hamstrings and glutes with extra balance support.
steps: Fasten the belt and stand on one leg on the platform with a slight knee bend.
Hinge at the hips and push them back as your torso lowers.
Let the free leg extend behind you for balance.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: suspender upper back stretch
exercises.description: Leaning back on the straps with your arms extended, you stretch the upper back and shoulders.
steps: Hold the handles and step back so your arms are straight.
Sit your hips back and lower your chest.
Round the upper back gently and push the straps away.
Feel the stretch between the shoulder blades.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and return.

exercises.name: suspender calf raise
exercises.description: Holding the straps for balance, you rise onto your toes to train the calves.
steps: Hold the handles and stand with feet hip width apart.
Keep your body upright.
Rise onto the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower the heels slowly below the start if comfortable.
Use the straps only for balance.

exercises.name: suspender single leg deadlift
exercises.description: A one-leg hip hinge with the straps for balance, training the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Hold the handles and stand on one leg.
Soften the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip as the other leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Squeeze the glute to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: suspender pendulum
exercises.description: Lying or planking with the feet in the straps, you swing the legs side to side like a pendulum to train the obliques.
steps: Put your feet in the straps and set a high plank.
Brace your core.
Swing your legs together to one side.
Swing back through the center to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled.
Keep your shoulders stable.

exercises.name: lever lying leg curl to reverse hyperextension
exercises.description: A combo move on a lever machine: curl the legs up, then lift the hips and legs to work hamstrings and glutes together.
steps: Lie face down on the machine with the pads behind your lower legs.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, then lower with control.
Move into the reverse hyperextension position with the pad behind your legs.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs until they line up with your torso.
Lower slowly and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: smith unilateral bulgarian split squat from deficit
exercises.description: A Bulgarian split squat on a Smith machine with the front foot raised, giving extra depth for quads and glutes.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand with the front foot on a low plate or step.
Place the rear foot on a bench behind you.
Lower straight down until the front thigh is about parallel or deeper.
Keep your torso upright and the front knee tracking over the toes.
Push through the front heel to stand, then switch legs.

exercises.name: resistance band standing side leg raise
exercises.description: Standing, you lift one leg out to the side against band tension, working the outer hips.
steps: Loop the band around your ankles or above the knees and stand tall.
Hold onto something for balance if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side with a straight knee.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

exercises.name: suspender hip hinge
exercises.description: Holding the straps, you hinge the hips back and forth to train the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Hold the handles with arms straight and feet hip width apart.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back with a flat back.
Lean on the straps for balance.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: resistance band standing hip extension
exercises.description: Standing, you extend one leg behind you against band tension to work the glutes.
steps: Loop the band around your ankles or secure it low, and stand tall.
Hold a support for balance.
Keep your core tight.
Kick one leg straight back without arching the back.
Squeeze the glute at the end.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: butt walking
exercises.description: Sitting on the floor with legs extended, you shuffle forward on your glutes to warm up the hips and work the glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs straight and arms crossed.
Lean back slightly.
Shift your weight to one side and swing the other hip forward.
Alternate sides to walk forward.
Keep your torso upright.
Walk back to reverse.

exercises.name: lying thoracic extensions on foam roller
exercises.description: Lying over a foam roller, you gently arch the upper back to open up the thoracic spine.
steps: Lie on your back with the roller under your upper back.
Support your head with your hands.
Keep your hips on the floor and knees bent.
Gently lean back over the roller.
Return to neutral and shift the roller up or down.
Move slowly and breathe out as you extend.

exercises.name: suspender side stretch
exercises.description: Using the straps for support, you sink into a wide side stance to stretch the inner thighs.
steps: Hold the handles and step your legs wide.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight.
Sit back into the stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: suspender abduction lunge
exercises.description: A side lunge with the straps for balance, working the outer hips and legs.
steps: Hold the handles and stand tall.
Step out wide to one side.
Bend that knee and push the hips back.
Keep your chest up and the other leg straight.
Push off to return.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: burpee
exercises.description: A full-body move: squat, kick back to a plank, push-up, jump up. It builds endurance and strength.
steps: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and placing your hands on the floor in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position.
Perform a push-up, keeping your body in a straight line.
Jump your feet back into the squat position.
Jump up explosively, reaching your arms overhead.
Land softly and immediately lower back into a squat position to begin the next repetition.

exercises.name: rowing (with rowing machine)
exercises.description: Steady rowing on an indoor machine for full-body cardio conditioning.
steps: Sit on the machine, strap in your feet and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push through your legs first, then lean back slightly.
Pull the handle to your lower ribs with elbows close.
Reverse the order: arms out, hips hinge, then knees bend to slide forward.
Keep a smooth rhythm for 10-30 minutes at a comfortable pace.

exercises.name: barbell standing military press
exercises.description: A strict standing overhead press with a barbell. It builds shoulder and triceps strength.
steps: Unrack the bar at shoulder height, hands just outside your shoulders.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head slightly back then through.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot.
Lower the bar back to your collarbone with control.

exercises.name: lying leg raise
exercises.description: A floor exercise that raises straight legs to hit the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift your legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your back from arching throughout.

exercises.name: smith calf raise v. 2
exercises.description: Calf raise under a Smith machine bar, working the calves with a fixed bar path for stable loading.
steps: Set the bar on your shoulders and stand with the balls of your feet on a step.
Keep your knees almost straight and your torso upright.
Lower your heels for a full stretch.
Rise onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top, then lower under control.

exercises.name: resistance band side lying hip abduction
exercises.description: Lying on your side, you lift the top leg against band resistance to work the outer hip.
steps: Lie on your side with the band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your legs straight and stacked.
Lift the top leg up without rolling backward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: static quadriceps contraction (isometric)
exercises.description: Seated or lying with your leg straight, you tighten the thigh muscle and hold, an easy way to activate the quads.
steps: Sit or lie with one leg straight in front.
Relax your upper body.
Tighten the front of the thigh and press the knee down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Relax fully.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: static glutes contraction (isometric)
exercises.description: Squeezing the glutes and holding without moving, a simple way to activate the hips.
steps: Lie on your back or stand with your body relaxed.
Squeeze both glute muscles together.
Keep your legs and back still.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Release fully.
Repeat for several reps.

exercises.name: single leg pogo jump
exercises.description: Small, springy hops on one leg that build calf and ankle stiffness, elasticity and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with a soft knee and your arms relaxed at your sides.
Hop straight up by pushing through the ball of your foot, keeping the knee almost straight.
Land softly on the ball of the same foot and rebound right away.
Keep your hops small and quick, with your hips level and your core tight.
Hop for the planned time or reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: floor w raise
exercises.description: A prone raise that moves the arms into a W shape to strengthen the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with arms bent and elbows out to the sides.
Rest your forehead lightly on the floor.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms and chest slightly.
Form a W shape with your arms and hold for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: bent knee calves stretch
exercises.description: A calf stretch with a bent back knee that targets the deeper soleus muscle near the Achilles tendon.
steps: Stand facing a wall with hands on it and one foot back.
Bend both knees, keeping the back heel flat on the floor.
Lean forward until you feel a stretch low in the back calf.
Keep your hips square and chest up.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: barbell standing military press (without rack)
exercises.description: A strict overhead press where you clean or lift the bar to your shoulders without a rack.
steps: Lift the barbell from the floor to your collarbone using a safe clean or deadlift and curl.
Set your feet hip-width apart with hands just outside your shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Press the bar straight overhead to full lockout.
Lower to your collarbone under control and repeat.

exercises.name: seated single leg calf raise on a chair
exercises.description: A seated one-leg calf raise that mainly hits the soleus using only your body weight.
steps: Sit on a chair with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent to 90 degrees.
Lift the other foot off the floor or tuck it behind.
Press through the ball of the working foot and raise your heel.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: seated patella mobilization
exercises.description: Gentle kneecap sliding while seated that loosens the tissue around the knee and warms up the front of the thigh.
steps: Sit tall on a chair or bench with one leg extended and the thigh muscle relaxed.
Place your fingertips or the heel of your hand on the edges of your kneecap.
Gently glide the kneecap side to side and up and down in small, slow motions.
Keep the quad relaxed and stay in a comfortable range with no sharp pain.
Move for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: sciatic nerve glide floss
exercises.description: A seated nerve glide that alternates straightening the leg and moving the head to ease the back of the leg and improve mobility.
steps: Sit tall at the edge of a chair with your hands on the seat or resting in your lap.
Slowly straighten one knee while you lower your chin toward your chest.
Bend the knee back down while you lift your head and look up.
Keep the motion smooth and gentle, never forcing into a strong stretch or tingling.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing glute squeeze
exercises.description: A simple standing contraction that wakes up the glutes and helps you feel them working before heavier lifts.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your arms relaxed.
Tighten your abs lightly so your ribs stay stacked over your hips.
Squeeze your glutes together as hard as you comfortably can.
Hold for 3-5 seconds without leaning back or tucking your hips excessively.
Relax fully, then repeat for 10-15 reps.

exercises.name: seated knee down
exercises.description: A seated hip opener that lets one knee drop to the side to loosen the hips and inner thighs.
steps: Sit tall on the floor or a bench with the soles of your feet together or one leg crossed in.
Let one knee drop slowly out to the side toward the floor.
Keep your back straight and your chest lifted as the knee lowers.
Pause briefly at the end of the comfortable range, then lift the knee back up.
Repeat for 8-12 reps per side.

exercises.name: hydrotherapy walking on spot
exercises.description: Gentle walking in place in chest-deep water, a low-impact way to move the legs and raise your heart rate.
steps: Stand in waist-to-chest-deep water with your feet hip width apart.
Lift one knee up in front of you, then lower it and lift the other.
Swing your arms naturally and keep your posture tall.
Walk at a relaxed, steady pace without leaning forward.
Continue for 2-5 minutes at an easy to moderate effort.

exercises.name: weighted plate overhead reverse lunge
exercises.description: A reverse lunge while holding a plate overhead, which trains the legs and challenges shoulder and core stability.
steps: Hold a weight plate overhead with straight arms.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Keep your ribs down and the plate stable over your head.
Push through the front foot to return, then alternate legs.

exercises.name: jump split
exercises.description: An explosive lunge jump where you switch legs in the air. It builds power and conditioning.
steps: Start in a split stance with a slight lunge dip.
Drop down and jump up powerfully.
Switch leg positions in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other leg in front.
Keep your torso upright and repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.name: dynamic chest stretch (male)
exercises.description: A dynamic chest stretch, swinging the arms out and across the chest. It loosens the chest and shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms straight out to the sides, parallel to the ground.
Slowly bring your arms forward, crossing them in front of your body.
Feel the stretch in your chest muscles.
Hold the stretch for 10-30 seconds.
Return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lying (prone) abdominal stretch
exercises.description: A face-down stretch that lengthens the abdominals, similar to a cobra position.
steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders.
Press up slowly, straightening your arms as far as is comfortable.
Keep your hips on the floor and relax your glutes.
Look forward and feel the stretch along your belly.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower down.

exercises.name: seated groin stretch
exercises.description: A seated butterfly-style stretch for the inner thighs.
steps: Sit tall on the floor and bring the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet or ankles and let your knees fall out.
Keep your back straight and chest lifted.
Lean forward slightly from the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds and breathe slowly.

exercises.name: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
exercises.description: A single-leg back extension on a 45 degree bench that trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back one side at a time.
steps: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: 45 degree twisting hyperextension
exercises.description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with a rotation at the top that adds work for the obliques and lower back.
steps: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.

exercises.name: bodyweight rope pull up
exercises.description: A pull-up done hanging from ropes, which adds a big grip challenge to the vertical pull.
steps: Hang from two ropes with arms straight and legs together.
Brace your core and pull your shoulder blades down.
Pull yourself up until your hands reach chest or chin level.
Keep your elbows pointing down and close.
Lower under control to a full hang.

exercises.name: bodyweight rope inverted row
exercises.description: A horizontal row hanging under rope handles that works the back and grip.
steps: Set ropes at about waist height and lie under them, holding the ends.
Keep your body straight from heels to head, heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: weighted stone standing power overhead press
exercises.description: A strongman-style overhead press with a heavy stone, using a small leg drive for power.
steps: Lift the stone to your chest, hugging it close.
Stand with feet hip-width apart and brace your core.
Dip slightly and drive up through your legs.
Press the stone overhead to full lockout.
Lower it back to your chest with control.

exercises.name: plyo push up v. 2
exercises.description: An explosive push-up variation where your hands leave the floor, building upper-body power.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor with control.
Explode upward so your hands leave the ground.
Land softly with slightly bent elbows.
Reset your body line and repeat.

exercises.name: lever incline chest supported reverse delt fly (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A chest-supported reverse fly on a plate-loaded lever machine that isolates the rear delts.
steps: Sit with your chest against the incline pad and grab the handles.
Start with arms forward and slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly without letting the weight crash.

exercises.name: assisted weighted push up
exercises.description: A push-up with extra load and assistance so you can adjust difficulty while keeping good form.
steps: Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up until your elbows are straight.
Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.

exercises.name: barbell incline wide reverse grip bench press
exercises.description: An incline bench press with a wide underhand grip that emphasizes the upper chest.
steps: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar wide with palms facing you.
Unrack and hold the bar over your upper chest.
Lower it to the upper chest with elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up to lockout.
Use a spotter, as this grip is less stable.

exercises.name: diamond push up (on knees)
exercises.description: An easier knee version of the diamond push-up that targets the triceps with hands close together.
steps: Kneel on the floor and place your hands under your chest, thumbs and fingers forming a diamond.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward your hands, elbows close.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

exercises.name: dumbbell forward leaning lunge
exercises.description: A lunge with a forward torso lean that shifts more of the load onto the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall with your feet hip width apart.
Step forward with one foot and lean your chest slightly forward with a flat back.
Lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Push through the front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or finish all reps on one side before switching.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline front raise
exercises.description: A front raise performed lying on an incline bench to reduce swinging and isolate the front delts.
steps: Lie face down or back on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Start with your arms hanging or in front of you.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height with straight arms.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: smith bent over row (chest supported)
exercises.description: A chest-supported row on the Smith machine that takes stress off the lower back.
steps: Set an incline bench under the bar and lie chest down on it.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: cable seated incline curl
exercises.description: A curl on an incline seat with cable resistance for a deep, constant-tension biceps stretch.
steps: Set a bench to incline and place a low pulley behind you.
Sit back with your arms hanging and grab the handles.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders, keeping elbows back.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: cable standing single arm supinated grip chest press
exercises.description: A standing one-arm press with a palm-up grip that works the chest and tests core stability.
steps: Set a cable at chest height and hold the handle with a palm-up grip.
Stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Press the handle forward until your arm is straight.
Keep your torso still and resist twisting.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying hammer press v. 2
exercises.description: A bench press with dumbbells held in a neutral grip that is easier on the shoulders.
steps: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Start with the weights above your chest.
Lower them to the sides of your chest, elbows slightly tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing single leg calf raise
exercises.description: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for a challenging calf workout.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on one foot on a step.
Hold a wall or rail with your other hand for balance.
Lower your heel to a full stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: jump step box
exercises.description: An explosive jump onto a low step box that builds power in the legs and trains soft, controlled landings.
steps: Stand facing a step box with your feet hip width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms back.
Jump explosively up onto the box, landing softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on top, then step back down one foot at a time.
Reset and repeat, staying quick but controlled.

exercises.name: lateral jump
exercises.description: A side-to-side jump that develops lateral power, balance and leg stability.
steps: Stand on both feet with your knees slightly bent and your arms ready.
Push off and jump sideways, covering a comfortable distance.
Land softly on both feet with your knees tracking over your toes.
Immediately jump back to the starting side.
Keep your chest up and repeat for the planned reps or time.

exercises.name: explosive fingers
exercises.description: A quick open-and-close finger drill that warms up the hands and forearms.
steps: Hold your hands out in front of you.
Close both hands into tight fists.
Open them fast, spreading your fingers as wide as possible.
Repeat quickly for 20-30 reps.
Keep your wrists relaxed.

exercises.name: explosive hang squat
exercises.description: A squat jump while hanging from a bar that lets you focus on explosive leg drive.
steps: Hang from a bar with arms straight and knees slightly bent.
Lower into a deep squat position.
Explode upward through your legs.
Absorb the movement softly and return to the start.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

exercises.name: internal rotation shoulders mobilization
exercises.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill that trains internal rotation.
steps: Stand or sit tall with one elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm across your belly.
Move slowly through a comfortable range.
Return to the start and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: seated radial nerve mobilization
exercises.description: A gentle seated nerve glide that moves the radial nerve along the arm.
steps: Sit tall with one arm down at your side, palm facing back.
Lower your shoulder slightly and rotate your arm inward.
Bend your wrist gently and tilt your head away.
Move slowly and stop at a mild pull, never pain.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

exercises.name: seated median nerve mobilization
exercises.description: A gentle seated nerve glide for the median nerve running down the arm to the hand.
steps: Sit tall and lift one arm out to the side, palm up.
Extend your wrist and fingers backward.
Tilt your head slightly away from that arm.
Return slowly and repeat 8-10 times.
Stay within a mild stretch, then switch arms.

exercises.name: seated ulnar nerve mobilization
exercises.description: A gentle seated nerve glide for the ulnar nerve on the inner side of the arm.
steps: Sit tall with one arm out to the side.
Bend your elbow and bring your hand toward your face like a mask.
Tilt your head slightly away.
Straighten the arm back out, keeping it gentle.
Repeat 8-10 times, then switch arms.

exercises.name: barbell staggered stance stiff legged deadlift
exercises.description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a staggered stance that loads the hamstrings and glutes while shifting weight to the front leg.
steps: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs and place one foot slightly behind the other, mostly on the ball of the back foot.
Keep most of your weight on the front leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips, sliding the bar down your legs with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward to stand.
Finish all reps, then switch the stance.

exercises.name: flutter kicks v. 2
exercises.description: Small alternating leg kicks that burn the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, quick alternating moves.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Continue for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.name: balance 3 point toe tap
exercises.description: A balance drill where you stand on one leg and tap the other foot to three points, training hip control and stability.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend and your hands on your hips.
Tap the free foot out in front of you, then lightly out to the side.
Tap it behind you, keeping your torso upright.
Return to center and repeat the sequence under control.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single arm fingers press with ball
exercises.description: A hand-strengthening drill pressing the fingers into a ball.
steps: Hold a small ball in one palm.
Press down on it with your fingers.
Spread and squeeze with control, keeping your wrist neutral.
Hold the press for 2-3 seconds.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

exercises.name: kneeling isometric biceps hold
exercises.description: A static curl hold that builds biceps endurance.
steps: Kneel upright with your elbows bent at about 90 degrees.
Hold your hands in front of you with palms up.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Squeeze your biceps and hold the position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

exercises.name: external press shoulders mobilization
exercises.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill pressing outward to warm up the joint.
steps: Stand tall with your elbow bent at your side.
Press your forearm outward away from your body.
Hold for a moment at the end of your comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: single arm fingers press with ball v. 2
exercises.description: A second version of the fingers-on-ball drill for forearm and hand strength.
steps: Place a ball under one hand on a table or hold it in your palm.
Spread your fingers over the ball.
Press down and hold for 2-3 seconds.
Release with control.
Repeat for reps, then switch hands.

exercises.name: backward press shoulders mobilization
exercises.description: A shoulder mobility drill moving the arm backward to open the front of the shoulder.
steps: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Press one arm backward, keeping the elbow straight.
Move through a comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: external rotation shoulders mobilization
exercises.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill for external rotation.
steps: Stand tall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: forward press shoulders mobilization
exercises.description: A shoulder mobility drill pressing the arm forward to warm up the joint.
steps: Stand tall with your elbows bent in front of you.
Press your arm forward until it is straight.
Keep your shoulder relaxed.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: bent over back to side to front arms raise
exercises.description: A flowing bent-over arm sweep from back to side to front that warms up and strengthens the rear and side shoulders.
steps: Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and let your arms hang down.
Sweep both arms back behind your hips.
Swing them out wide to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue the arc forward until your arms point ahead of you, then reverse the path.
Keep your neck neutral and move smoothly for the planned reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell bent over back to side to front arms raise
exercises.description: A bent-over sweeping raise with light dumbbells that targets the rear and side delts through a long arc.
steps: Hold light dumbbells and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Start with your arms back by your hips.
Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Continue forward in an arc, then reverse the path with control.
Use light weights and avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.name: lying simultaneous alternating straight leg raise
exercises.description: A floor core move where both legs work together in an alternating pattern, challenging the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips or at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor and brace your abs.
Raise one leg while the other lowers toward the floor, keeping both straight.
Switch legs in a smooth scissor pattern without letting your back arch.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying single straight arm press on floor
exercises.description: A one-arm press from the floor with a straight arm that trains the chest and shoulder stabilisers.
steps: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent and one dumbbell held above your chest.
Keep the other arm resting on the floor beside you.
Press the dumbbell up until your arm is straight and the shoulder reaches forward.
Lower it back with control until your upper arm touches the floor.
Complete the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lying single leg quadriceps mobilization
exercises.description: A lying quad mobilization that gently bends the knee to loosen the front of the thigh.
steps: Lie on your side or stomach with your legs extended.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle if needed.
Move the knee in and out of the bend in a slow, controlled rhythm.
Keep your hips level and stay within a comfortable range.
Repeat for 10-15 reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lying straight leg raise v. 2
exercises.description: A lying leg raise that targets the lower abs and hip flexors while you keep your legs long.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your hands under your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your core braced and your back from arching.

exercises.name: push up (on knees)
exercises.description: An easier push-up variation from the knees that builds chest, shoulder and arm strength.
steps: Kneel on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder width.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor by bending your elbows.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight and your hips from sagging.

exercises.name: smith kneeling rear kick
exercises.description: A glute kickback done kneeling with one foot pressing against a smith machine bar, a focused move for the glutes.
steps: Set the bar at a low height and kneel on all fours facing it, with the sole of one foot under the bar.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Press your foot up and back against the bar until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: weighted inverted row
exercises.description: An inverted row with extra weight placed on your body for added back challenge.
steps: Set a bar at waist height and lie under it with extra weight on your torso.
Grip the bar just wider than shoulders.
Keep your body straight from heels to head.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: alternate straight leg raise (on bosu ball)
exercises.description: A lying leg raise on a bosu ball that adds an unstable surface to challenge the lower abs and balance.
steps: Lie back on a bosu ball with your lower back supported and your hands holding it lightly.
Brace your abs and extend both legs.
Raise one leg while keeping it straight.
Lower it and switch to the other leg.
Keep your torso steady and move with control.

exercises.name: dumbbell single arm curl with isometric hold
exercises.description: A one-arm curl that pauses at the halfway point to increase biceps tension.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell at your side, palm forward.
Curl the weight up until your elbow is bent to 90 degrees.
Hold that position for 2-3 seconds.
Finish the curl, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

exercises.name: kettlebell sit up
exercises.description: A sit-up holding a kettlebell for extra resistance on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hold a kettlebell at your chest.
Brace your core.
Curl up until your torso is upright.
Keep the kettlebell close to you.
Lower slowly back down.

exercises.name: hanging l sit
exercises.description: A hanging hold with legs straight out in front that challenges the abs and grip.
steps: Hang from a bar with straight arms.
Lift your legs straight in front until they are parallel to the floor.
Keep your toes pointed and your knees locked.
Avoid swinging.
Hold for 10-20 seconds, then lower.

exercises.name: stall bar leg raise
exercises.description: A hanging leg raise performed on stall bars.
steps: Hang on a stall bar with arms straight.
Brace your core and keep your body still.
Raise your legs up in front of you.
Lift as high as you can without swinging.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: smith step up
exercises.description: A step-up with a Smith machine bar across your back for loaded leg work.
steps: Set the bar across your upper back and stand in front of a bench.
Place one foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up fully.
Step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: weighted twisting crunch (on bench)
exercises.description: A weighted crunch with a rotation done on a bench that trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie back on a bench with your knees bent and a weight held on your chest.
Brace your abs and curl your upper body up.
Rotate your torso so one elbow moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower back down slowly without letting go of tension.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: lever t bar close grip row (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A plate-loaded T-bar row with a close grip for thick back work.
steps: Stand on the platform with your chest supported.
Grab the close-grip handle with straight arms.
Pull the handle toward your torso, elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to full extension.

exercises.name: weighted v crunch (on bosu ball)
exercises.description: A V-shaped crunch on a bosu ball with added weight, which challenges the abs and balance together.
steps: Sit on a bosu ball and lean back slightly, holding a weight in front of you.
Lift your feet off the floor with your legs bent or straight.
Bring your chest and knees toward each other in a V shape.
Lower back with control, keeping your spine long.
Stay stable on the ball throughout.

exercises.name: incline twisting sit up v. 2
exercises.description: An incline sit-up with a twist to work the obliques as well as the abs.
steps: Lie on an incline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up while rotating your torso to one side.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: standing hip flexors stretch
exercises.description: A standing stretch for the front of the hip and thigh, useful after long periods of sitting.
steps: Stand tall and hold a wall or support for balance.
Bend one knee and bring your heel toward your glute, holding the ankle.
Tuck your pelvis slightly and push your hips gently forward.
Keep your knees close together and your chest upright.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing half kneeling hip flexors stretch
exercises.description: A half-kneeling position that opens the front of the hip and the quad of the back leg.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and a pad under your knee.
Keep your torso upright and tuck your pelvis under.
Shift your weight forward until you feel a stretch at the front of the back hip.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your core engaged.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: triceps press (head below bench)
exercises.description: A triceps extension lying with your head off the bench edge for an extra stretch.
steps: Lie on a bench with your head just past the end, holding a weight overhead.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the weight toward your head.
Extend your arms to straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.

exercises.name: iron cross plank
exercises.description: A plank variation with arms and legs spread wide to challenge the core.
steps: Start in a plank position with hands under your shoulders.
Spread your arms and legs wide in an X shape.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.name: lever lying t bar row
exercises.description: A chest-supported T-bar row lying on the machine pad.
steps: Lie chest-down on the pad and grab the handles.
Start with your arms straight.
Pull the handles toward your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: lever incline hammer chest press
exercises.description: Pressing on an incline chest machine with neutral hammer handles. It builds the upper chest and is gentle on the shoulders.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades pinned to the pad and grip the neutral handles.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost straight.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.
Keep your wrists straight and your back against the pad.

exercises.name: lying pretzel stretch
exercises.description: A lying twist that pulls one leg across and bends the other back, stretching the glutes, hips and thighs.
steps: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and your bottom leg bent in front.
Bend the top knee and bring that foot back toward your glutes, holding it with your hand.
Gently roll your top knee back and open your chest toward the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell alternate biceps curl v. 2
exercises.description: Curling one dumbbell at a time while standing. A classic way to build the biceps with a steady rhythm.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbow by your side, curl one dumbbell up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.
Avoid swinging your torso to lift the weight.

exercises.name: squat
exercises.description: The basic bodyweight squat. It trains the thighs and glutes and teaches solid lower body mechanics.
steps: Stand with your feet about shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can while keeping your heels down and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: jumping pull up
exercises.description: A pull-up that uses a small jump to help you up, then a slow lowering phase. Good for building pulling strength.
steps: Stand under a pull-up bar and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Bend your knees and jump up, pulling your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
Reset on the floor and repeat.

exercises.name: sumo deadlift high pull
exercises.description: A wide-stance deadlift finished with an upright row. It works the thighs, glutes and shoulders in one smooth motion.
steps: Stand with a wide stance and grip the barbell between your legs with hands close together.
Keep your back flat and drive through your legs to stand up.
As the bar passes your hips, pull it up to chest height with your elbows high.
Lower the bar back along the same path.
Keep the bar close to your body throughout.

exercises.name: push press
exercises.description: An overhead press helped by a quick leg dip and drive. It lets you handle heavier loads for the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Hold the barbell at your upper chest with your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up through your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out with the bar over your mid foot, then lower it back to your chest.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: dumbbell burpee
exercises.description: A burpee with dumbbells that finishes with an overhead press. It builds strength and endurance.
steps: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower your body into a squat position, placing the dumbbells on the ground in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Perform a push-up, bending your elbows and lowering your chest towards the ground.
Jump your feet back towards your hands, landing in a squat position.
Stand up explosively, lifting the dumbbells off the ground and bringing them to your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and repeat the entire sequence for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kettlebell standing slingshots (advanced)
exercises.description: Passing a kettlebell around your torso in quick circles. It challenges the core, grip and coordination.
steps: Stand with your feet hip width apart holding a kettlebell by the handle.
Pass it around your waist from one hand to the other behind your back.
Continue the circle to the front, keeping the movement smooth.
Keep your core tight and your hips still.
After several reps, reverse the direction.

exercises.name: cable horizontal pallof press
exercises.description: Pressing a cable straight out from your chest while resisting the pull to rotate. It trains anti-rotation core strength.
steps: Set a cable at chest height and stand sideways to the stack.
Hold the handle at your chest with both hands and brace your core.
Press the handle straight out until your arms are extended.
Hold for a second without letting your torso twist.
Bring it back to your chest and finish the set, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable one arm inner biceps curl
exercises.description: A single-arm cable curl with the elbow pointing slightly out to emphasise the inner biceps.
steps: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the stack.
Hold the handle with one hand, palm up, and turn your elbow slightly out.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable one arm lat pulldown
exercises.description: A single-arm pulldown on a high cable. It lets each side of the lats work on its own.
steps: Attach a handle to a high pulley and sit facing the stack.
Grab the handle with one hand and sit tall.
Pull the handle down to the side of your chest, driving your elbow toward your hip.
Pause, then let your arm rise slowly.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

exercises.name: cable one arm twisting seated row
exercises.description: A seated one-arm cable row with a rotation of the torso. It trains the back and gives the core a twist.
steps: Sit at a low cable with your feet braced and grab the handle with one hand.
Start with your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Row the handle to your side while rotating your torso open.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back, then return slowly.
Do all reps, then change arms.

exercises.name: cable pull through
exercises.description: A hip hinge facing away from a low cable. It builds the glutes and hamstrings and teaches a good hinge.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the stack, holding the rope between your legs.
Step forward until the cable is taut and bend your knees slightly.
Push your hips back, letting the rope travel behind you.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to stand tall.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: cable twist (down up)
exercises.description: A diagonal cable rotation from low to high that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.
steps: Set the cable pulley low and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle near your lower hip, arms mostly straight.
Rotate your torso and pull the handle diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and keep your hips stable.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable twist (up down) v. 2
exercises.description: A diagonal cable rotation from high to low that trains the obliques and builds rotational strength.
steps: Set the cable pulley high and stand sideways to the machine, holding the handle with both hands.
Start with the handle above your shoulder, arms mostly straight.
