Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: stability ball rollout
exercises.description: Rolling a ball forward with your forearms to challenge the abs and core stability.
steps: Kneel in front of a stability ball and place your forearms on it.
Brace your abs and keep your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Roll the ball forward by extending your arms and body.
Stop when you feel your core working hard without your back sagging.
Pull the ball back by squeezing your abs.
Repeat slowly.

exercises.name: stability ball crunch (full range hands behind head)
exercises.description: A full-range crunch on a stability ball with hands behind your head. Works the abs through a longer range.
steps: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: inverted row on bench
exercises.description: A bodyweight row hanging beneath a bench or bar, pulling your chest up. Trains the upper back and biceps.
steps: Set up a bench at a height that allows your body to hang freely underneath it.
Lie face up on the ground with your head towards the bench.
Reach up and grab the bench with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your arms are fully extended.
Engage your core and squeeze your shoulder blades together as you pull your chest up towards the bench.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: inverted row bent knees
exercises.description: A bodyweight row beneath a bar with knees bent to make it easier. Builds the upper back and biceps.
steps: Set up a bar at waist height and lie underneath it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Position your body so that your heels are on the ground and your body is straight.
Pull your chest up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: rear leg hook kick
exercises.description: A martial arts kick with the back leg that swings in an arc to strike with the heel, training hip mobility and control.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Shift your weight onto the lead foot.
Lift the rear knee and extend the leg across the target.
Hook the heel around in an arc.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: front leg hook kick
exercises.description: A hooking kick with the lead leg that swings the heel across the target, building balance and hip control.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the lead knee and point it forward.
Extend the leg and hook the heel across the target.
Keep your supporting foot grounded and your core tight.
Bring the leg back under control.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: front groin kick
exercises.description: A straight forward kick aimed low with the toes or the instep, practising speed and hip flexor power.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Snap the lower leg forward and low.
Keep your torso upright and balanced.
Pull the leg back quickly.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: rear axe kick
exercises.description: A kick with the back leg that rises high and then drops down like an axe, training flexibility and control.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Swing your rear leg straight up in front of you.
Reach the top with the leg extended.
Bring the heel sharply down.
Keep your supporting leg slightly bent and balanced.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: front snap kick
exercises.description: A quick forward kick that snaps out from the knee, building leg speed and balance.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Snap your lower leg forward to the target.
Pull the leg back quickly along the same line.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: spin hook kick
exercises.description: A spinning kick where you turn your body and sweep the heel in a hook around the target. Great for balance and coordination.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Spin on the ball of your supporting foot.
Swing your kicking leg around and hook the heel across the target.
Land in a balanced stance.
Repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side kick
exercises.description: A kick that thrusts the heel out to the side, using hip strength and balance.
steps: Stand sideways in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift your knee toward your chest.
Extend the leg sideways and push the heel to the target.
Keep your supporting foot turned slightly away.
Pull the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: roundhouse kick
exercises.description: A kick that swings in an arc to hit with the shin or instep, powered by a hip turn.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Pivot on your supporting foot and turn the hip over.
Lift the knee and swing the leg in an arc across the target.
Extend the lower leg at the end.
Pull the leg back and return to stance.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: heel push kick
exercises.description: A pushing front kick that drives the heel forward to create distance, working hips and quads.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Lift the knee and point the toes up.
Push your heel straight forward, leaning back slightly.
Keep your supporting foot grounded.
Bring the leg back and set it down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: spin back kick
exercises.description: A kick where you turn your back to the target and thrust the heel straight back, building rotation and balance.
steps: Stand in a fighting stance with your hands up.
Turn your head and shoulders to look behind you.
Pivot on your supporting foot.
Kick your leg straight back with the heel leading.
Keep your torso leaning slightly forward for balance.
Return to stance and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: walking on stepmill
exercises.description: Stepping on a stepmill at a steady pace. A tough, low-impact cardio workout for legs and glutes.
steps: Adjust the stepmill machine to a comfortable level.
Step onto the machine and place your hands on the handrails for support.
Start walking by placing one foot on a step and then the other, alternating between legs.
Maintain an upright posture and engage your core muscles.
Continue walking for the desired duration or distance.
Gradually increase the intensity or speed as you become more comfortable with the exercise.
Remember to cool down and stretch after completing the exercise.

exercises.name: lying elbow to knee
exercises.description: A floor crunch that brings elbow to opposite knee. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight out and lift it off the ground.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time bringing your left elbow towards your right knee and extending your left leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever lying crunch v. 2
exercises.description: A machine crunch performed lying back, targeting the abdominal muscles with adjustable resistance.
steps: Lie back on the machine and set your feet or hands as the machine requires.
Grip the handles lightly and set your lower back against the pad.
Curl your ribs toward your hips to crunch up.
Exhale and squeeze your abs at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weight stack rest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: lever rotary calf
exercises.description: A seated rotary calf raise on a machine. Builds the calf muscles.
steps: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated bent arm lateral raise
exercises.description: A seated lateral raise with bent elbows. Targets the side delts with a shorter lever.
steps: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body and your arms bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keeping your elbows bent, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever shoulder press v. 3
exercises.description: A machine shoulder press, pushing the handles overhead. Builds shoulder and triceps strength.
steps: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing inner biceps curl v. 2
exercises.description: A standing biceps curl with the palms turning to face forward as you lift. Works the biceps and brachialis.
steps: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
While holding your upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbells sumo squat
exercises.description: A wide stance squat holding dumbbells that emphasises the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes pointing out.
Hold one or two dumbbells with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: cable straight legs pull through (with rope)
exercises.description: A cable hinge with straight legs that trains the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the stack.
Reach through your legs and grab the rope, then step forward to add tension.
Keep your legs nearly straight and hinge forward at the hips.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall while the rope passes between your legs.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hinge back with control and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell pronated to neutral grip row
exercises.description: A dumbbell row that begins with an overhand grip and turns to a neutral grip, working the back and arms.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells with an overhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight below your shoulders.
Row the weights toward your hips while rotating your palms to face each other.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower the dumbbells slowly while turning your palms back down.
Keep your torso still.

exercises.name: dumbbell pronated grip row
exercises.description: A bent-over row with an overhand grip, building the muscles of the mid and upper back.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang with palms facing your legs.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs.
Keep your elbows close to your body and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Avoid jerking with your torso.

exercises.name: dumbbell reverse grip row (female)
exercises.description: A bent-over dumbbell row using an underhand grip. Trains the upper back and biceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let your arms hang straight down, fully extended, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: narrow push-up on exercise ball
exercises.description: A close-hand push-up with hands on a stability ball. Hits the triceps and chest while the ball challenges your balance.
steps: Place the stability ball on the ground and position yourself in a push-up position with your hands on the ball, slightly narrower than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Lower your chest towards the ball by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: spine twist
exercises.description: A seated torso rotation, twisting side to side. Loosens the spine and works the obliques.
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground, hip-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to the right, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist to the left side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable lat pulldown full range of motion
exercises.description: A cable lat pulldown using the full range of motion. Builds the lats and upper back.
steps: Sit on the lat pulldown machine with your knees positioned under the pads.
Grasp the cable bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lean back slightly and keep your chest up, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the bar down towards your upper chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cycle cross trainer
exercises.description: Pedalling a cycle cross trainer with arms and legs moving together. Steady, low-impact cardio.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the cycle cross trainer.
Place your feet on the pedals and grip the handlebars.
Start pedaling in a smooth and controlled motion.
Maintain a steady pace and increase the resistance if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your cardio workout.

exercises.name: arm slingers hanging straight legs
exercises.description: A hanging straight-leg raise. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors and challenges your grip.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your legs straight down.
Engage your core and lift your legs up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: sled lying calf press
exercises.description: A calf press on a sled machine while lying back. Builds the calf muscles.
steps: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Sit on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Push the platform away from you by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Continue pushing until your calves are fully contracted.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever seated calf press
exercises.description: A seated machine calf press. Builds the calf muscles.
steps: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lower portion of the platform and position your knees under the lever pad.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Press the lever pad down by extending your ankles, lifting your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell chest bench press forearms (form check)
exercises.description: A bench press form check that shows how the forearms should line up under the bar for a safe and strong press.
steps: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your forearms vertical when the bar is at your chest.
Lower the bar with control to the mid-chest.
Press it up to straight arms without flaring the elbows.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell chest fly arms (form check)
exercises.description: A chest fly form check that shows how to keep a soft elbow bend and a wide, smooth arc through the movement.
steps: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc.
Stop when you feel a gentle stretch across the chest.
Bring the dumbbells back together above your chest.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: chest bench press butt (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for keeping your butt on the bench during a chest press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Lie on the bench with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips stay planted on the pad and never lift off.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: chest bench press grip width (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for choosing the right grip width on the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Lie on the bench and grip the bar at a moderate width.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your forearms are vertical at the bottom, with hands just wider than the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: chest bench press shoulders (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for shoulder position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Lie on the bench and pinch your shoulder blades together before unracking.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your shoulder blades stay pulled back and down against the bench.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: chest bench press arms (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for arm path during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Lie on the bench and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your arms move in a controlled line and the bar tracks over the lower chest.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: chest bench press elbows (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for elbow position during the bench press, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Lie on the bench with the bar unracked above your chest.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows sit at roughly 45 degrees from the torso instead of flaring wide.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: bent over row back (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a bent over row, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Hold the bar and hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your spine stays long and flat, not rounded.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: crunch back (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a crunch, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands by your head.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your lower back stays gently on the floor while only the upper back curls up.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: sled hack squat legs (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for leg position on the hack squat sled, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Set your back and shoulders against the pads and place your feet on the platform.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees track over your toes and your feet sit flat on the platform.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: bench dip back arms (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for back and arm position in bench dips, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench, grip it beside your hips and slide your butt off.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays close to the bench and your elbows point straight behind you.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: front plank butt (form check)
exercises.description: A front plank form check that compares a raised butt with a straight body line.
steps: Place your forearms on the floor with elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your toes on the floor.
Lift your body into a straight line from head to heels.
Avoid pushing your butt up or letting your hips sag.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to keep the line.
Hold for 20-40 seconds and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: preacher curl wrists (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for wrist position during a preacher curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Sit at the preacher bench with your upper arms flat on the pad.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your wrists stay neutral and straight rather than bending back or curling in.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: side plank butt (form check)
exercises.description: A side plank form check that compares a piked butt with a straight body line.
steps: Lie on your side with your forearm on the floor and elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Make a straight line from your head to your feet.
Avoid letting your butt stick out or your hips drop.
Squeeze your abs and glutes to stay level.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: push up start position (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for the starting position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Set your hands on the floor under your shoulders and extend your legs back.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your body forms one straight line from head to heels with hands under the shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: push up end position (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for the bottom position of a push-up, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Start in a high plank and lower yourself under control.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your chest nearly touches the floor, elbows angled back, and hips stay in line.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: biceps curl arms body (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for arm and body position during a biceps curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Stand tall holding dumbbells at your sides with palms forward.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your elbows stay pinned at your sides and your torso does not swing.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: concentration curl arms (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for arm position during a concentration curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Sit on a bench, lean forward and brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your upper arm rests against the inner thigh and only the forearm moves.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: deadlift back (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot, hinge down and grip it just outside your legs.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays neutral and braced from the floor to lockout.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: arm slingers hanging bent knee legs
exercises.description: A hanging knee raise bringing knees toward your elbows. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, bringing them as close to your elbows as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: deadlift hips (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a deadlift, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and set your hips at a mid height before gripping.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips start above the knees and rise together with your shoulders.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: plank butt (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for hip position in a plank, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Set your forearms on the floor with elbows under the shoulders and legs extended.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your butt stays level with your shoulders, not piked up or sagging down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: barbell squat knees end position (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for knee position at the bottom of a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and descend into a full squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees push out over your toes and do not cave inward.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: squat knees middle position (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for knee position midway through a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and begin to squat.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your knees keep tracking in line with your toes on the way up and down.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: barbell squat hips (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for hip position during a barbell squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and squat down to depth.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your hips and chest rise together, without the hips shooting up first.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: squat back (form check)
exercises.description: A side-by-side form check for back position during a squat, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back, brace your core and squat down.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your back stays flat and braced without rounding at the bottom.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

exercises.name: wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars
exercises.description: A wide-grip dip on high parallel bars, leaning forward. Targets the chest and shoulders.
steps: Position yourself on the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Lean forward slightly and lower your body by bending your elbows until your chest is just above the bars.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: assisted wide-grip chest dip (kneeling)
exercises.description: A machine-assisted wide-grip dip with your knees on a pad. Lets you train the chest with less bodyweight.
steps: Adjust the machine to your desired height and secure your knees on the pad.
Grasp the handles with a wide grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbells straight arm pullover v. 2
exercises.description: A pullover with straight arms that stretches and works the lats and chest.
steps: Lie on a bench with your upper back supported and hold a dumbbell over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a slight bend in the elbows.
Lower the dumbbell in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips stable.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest using your lats.
Repeat with control.

exercises.name: dumbbell rear lunge from step
exercises.description: A reverse lunge from a raised step that works the legs and glutes with a deeper range.
steps: Stand on a low step with a dumbbell in each hand.
Step one foot back and off the step.
Lower your back knee toward the floor while keeping your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: split squats
exercises.description: A bodyweight split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.

exercises.name: weighted russian twist v. 2
exercises.description: A weighted russian twist, rotating a weight side to side while leaning back. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold the weight with both hands in front of your chest.
Lean back slightly to engage your core muscles.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: single leg squat with support
exercises.description: A one-leg squat using a support for balance, building strength in each leg.
steps: Stand next to a sturdy support and hold it lightly with one hand.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor in front of you.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Push through your heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm shoulder press v. 3
exercises.description: A one-arm overhead press that builds the shoulders and challenges your core.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at shoulder height with your palm facing forward.
Stand or sit tall and brace your core.
Press the dumbbell overhead until your arm is straight.
Avoid leaning to the side.
Lower the dumbbell slowly back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm bent over row
exercises.description: A one-arm row in a bent-over position that works the back and arm.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, one hand on a bench or knee for support.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging straight.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your elbow close.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine.
Lower slowly until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: floor hyperextension
exercises.description: A floor-based back extension that strengthens the glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended or by your head.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral and look at the floor.
Pause at the top for a second.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without forcing a big arch.

exercises.name: air bike v. 2
exercises.description: A bicycle crunch variation that trains the abs and obliques through alternating twists.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee while extending the other leg.
Switch sides in a smooth pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

exercises.name: cable lying biceps curl v. 2
exercises.description: Lying on your back with a cable pulling from the floor, you curl the handle toward your shoulders to isolate the biceps under steady tension.
steps: Lie on your back on the floor facing the cable stack and hold the bar or handle with palms up.
Keep your upper arms still and pinned to the floor.
Curl the handle toward your shoulders, squeezing the biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.
Keep your back flat and avoid lifting your shoulders as you curl.

exercises.name: dumbbell scott press
exercises.description: A seated dumbbell press from shoulder height. Builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: close-grip push-up (on knees)
exercises.description: A close-grip push-up done on your knees. An easier way to train the triceps and chest.
steps: Start by getting on your hands and knees, with your hands shoulder-width apart and your knees hip-width apart.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable seated twist
exercises.description: A seated cable twist, rotating the torso against resistance. Works the obliques and core.
steps: Sit on a cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly rotate your torso to one side, pulling the cable across your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the range of motion, then slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
exercises.description: A bodyweight inverse leg curl using a pull-up cable machine setup. Targets the hamstrings.
steps: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle straps are at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs extended and the ankle straps attached to your feet.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Bend your knees and curl your legs towards your glutes, squeezing your hamstrings.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell biceps curl (with arm blaster)
exercises.description: A standing dumbbell curl with an arm blaster to keep your upper arms still. Isolates the biceps.
steps: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell hammer curls (with arm blaster)
exercises.description: A standing hammer curl with an arm blaster to prevent swinging. Targets the biceps and brachialis.
steps: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
This will be your starting position.
Now, while holding your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell alternate biceps curl (with arm blaster)
exercises.description: An alternating dumbbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your upper arms fixed so the biceps do the work.
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Place the arm blaster on your upper arms, ensuring a secure fit.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with the opposite arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: ez-bar biceps curl (with arm blaster)
exercises.description: An EZ bar curl with an arm blaster. Isolates the biceps with a comfortable wrist angle.
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping them stationary throughout the exercise.
Keeping your elbows close to your body, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable triceps pushdown (v-bar) (with arm blaster)
exercises.description: A cable pushdown with a v-bar and an arm blaster. Isolates the triceps.
steps: Attach a v-bar attachment to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and exhale as you push the v-bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
Inhale as you slowly return the v-bar to the starting position, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable reverse grip triceps pushdown (sz-bar) (with arm blaster)
exercises.description: A reverse grip cable pushdown with an arm blaster. Targets the triceps with a different hand angle.
steps: Attach a straight bar to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and slowly push the bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell biceps curl (with arm blaster)
exercises.description: A barbell curl with an arm blaster. Keeps your elbows still so the biceps do the work.
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Place your upper arms against the arm blaster, keeping your elbows close to your torso.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the bar is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted lying neck extension (with head harness)
exercises.description: Lying face down with a harness on your head, you lift against added weight to strengthen the muscles at the back of the neck.
steps: Lie face down on a bench with your head past the edge and the weighted harness fitted.
Start with your chin tucked toward your chest.
Raise your head slowly until your face looks forward.
Pause, then lower back under control.
Use a light weight and smooth reps, never jerking the neck.

exercises.name: weighted lying neck flexion (with head harness)
exercises.description: Lying on your back with a weighted head harness, you lift your chin toward your chest to train the neck flexors.
steps: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and the harness fitted.
Let your head hang back slightly in a comfortable range.
Curl your chin toward your chest slowly.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and keep the weight light with smooth reps.

exercises.name: weighted standing neck extension (with head harness)
exercises.description: Standing and bent forward with a weighted harness, you raise your head against the load to build the back of the neck.
steps: Fit the head harness with a light weight hanging in front.
Stand and hinge forward, resting your hands on your thighs.
Let your chin drop toward your chest.
Lift your head until your gaze is forward.
Lower slowly and keep the movement small and controlled.

exercises.name: cable seated neck extension (with head harness)
exercises.description: Seated with a harness attached to a cable, you pull your head back against steady resistance to train the neck extensors.
steps: Fit the head harness and sit facing the cable with it attached at head height.
Start with your head tipped slightly forward.
Pull your head back until it is upright.
Pause, then return slowly against the cable.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: cable seated neck flexion (with head harness)
exercises.description: Seated with a harness attached to a cable behind you, you tuck your chin forward to train the neck flexors.
steps: Fit the head harness and sit facing away from the cable, attached at head height.
Start with your head tilted slightly back.
Bring your chin toward your chest.
Pause, then return slowly in control.
Keep the load light and your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: barbell wide grip drag curl
exercises.description: A curl where the bar drags up your torso with a wide grip, targeting the biceps.
steps: Stand holding a barbell with a wide underhand grip.
Keep your elbows pointing back and the bar close to your body.
Drag the bar up your torso by pulling your elbows behind you.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly along the same path.
Keep your torso upright.

exercises.name: barbell standing concentration curl
exercises.description: A one-arm barbell curl while standing, with the other hand resting on your thigh. Isolates the biceps.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your opposite hand on your thigh for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight up towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the weight back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell single arm leaning lateral raise
exercises.description: A lateral raise done while leaning away from a support for a greater range on the side delt.
steps: Hold a support with one hand and lean your body away.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand by your side.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Lower slowly to the start.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: resistance band duck walk
exercises.description: A low squat walk with a band around the legs that fires up the glutes and hips.
steps: Place a loop band around your thighs or knees.
Lower into a half squat with your chest up.
Step sideways or forward with a wide stride.
Keep tension on the band and your knees out.
Bring your other foot in, staying low.
Walk for the planned distance, then return.

exercises.name: resistance band bent leg side kick (kneeling)
exercises.description: A kneeling side kick with a band that targets the glutes and outer hips.
steps: Kneel on all fours with a band around your thighs.
Keep your core braced and your back flat.
Lift one bent leg out to the side against the band.
Pause when your thigh is about hip height.
Lower slowly without twisting your torso.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: resistance band leg lift
exercises.description: A leg lift against band tension that trains the glutes and hips.
steps: Place a loop band around your ankles or thighs.
Get on all fours or stand with support.
Lift one leg back or out against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without arching your back.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: resistance band air bike
exercises.description: A bicycle crunch with a band adding resistance to the leg movement.
steps: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet.
Hold the ends with your hands or place them by your head.
Lift your shoulders and bring your knees up.
Pedal your legs while twisting your elbow toward the opposite knee.
Keep your lower back flat.
Continue for the planned reps.

exercises.name: resistance band floor hyperextension
exercises.description: A floor back extension with band resistance for the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down and anchor a band under your hands or around your upper back.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your chest slightly off the floor.
Keep your neck neutral.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Repeat without overarching.

exercises.name: resistance band lunge
exercises.description: A lunge with band resistance that works the legs and glutes.
steps: Stand on the middle of a band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and your torso tall.
Push through your front heel to return.
Alternate legs for the planned reps.

exercises.name: resistance band calf raise
exercises.description: A calf raise with a band that builds lower leg strength.
steps: Sit or stand with the band under the balls of your feet.
Hold the ends firmly.
Press up onto your toes against the band.
Pause at the top and squeeze your calves.
Lower your heels slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: frog crunch
exercises.description: A crunch that curls your upper body up with your knees bent. Works the abs.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell sumo squat off benches
exercises.description: A wide squat with feet on benches that extends the range of motion for the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Place a bench under each foot with a wide stance.
Hold a dumbbell in front of you with both hands.
Sit your hips down between the benches.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch in your hips.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up throughout.

exercises.name: ez-bar close-grip bench press
exercises.description: A close-grip bench press with an EZ bar. Targets the triceps with less wrist strain.
steps: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the ez barbell with a close grip, hands shoulder-width apart, palms facing forward.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell touches your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable seated twist on floor
exercises.description: A seated rotation with a cable that trains the obliques and core.
steps: Sit on the floor facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Lean back slightly and lift your feet if you can.
Rotate your torso from side to side.
Keep your arms steady and your core tight.
Move slowly without jerking.
Continue for the planned reps.

exercises.name: wall ball
exercises.description: A squat-to-throw movement with a medicine ball that conditions the whole body.
steps: Stand facing a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up powerfully and throw the ball to a target on the wall.
Catch the ball as it returns.
Flow straight into the next squat.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: tire flip
exercises.description: Flipping a heavy tire end over end by driving through your legs. Builds full-body power, especially glutes and legs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing the tire.
Bend your knees and hinge at the hips, lowering into a squat position.
Reach down and grab the bottom edge of the tire with both hands, fingers facing towards you.
Engage your glutes and leg muscles, and explosively drive through your legs to lift the tire off the ground.
As the tire flips over, use your upper body strength to guide it and maintain control.
Once the tire is fully flipped, quickly step back and reset your stance.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: side lying clam
exercises.description: Lying on your side with knees bent, you open the top knee like a clam to strengthen the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet stacked, head on your arm.
Keep your hips stacked and your core lightly braced.
Lift the top knee while keeping your feet together.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: chest dip on straight bar
exercises.description: A chest dip on a bar, leaning forward and crossing your ankles. Targets the chest and triceps.
steps: Grab the parallel bars with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your arms until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: resistance band toe touch
exercises.description: A crunch variation where you reach up to your toes with band tension.
steps: Lie on your back with a band around your feet.
Lift your legs toward the ceiling.
Hold the band ends and reach toward your toes.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: cable thibaudeau kayak row
exercises.description: A one-arm cable row with a rotating kayak-style pull. Trains the lats and upper back.
steps: Attach a cable handle to a low pulley and sit facing the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handle with your right hand and extend your arm fully, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight and your abs engaged.
Pull the handle towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blade and bending your elbow, keeping your arm close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the top of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform with your left arm.

exercises.name: resistance band jumping jack
exercises.description: A jumping jack with a band that raises your heart rate and adds a challenge to the hips and shoulders.
steps: Stand with a loop band around your thighs or ankles.
Keep your knees soft and your core tight.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Push against the band as you land.
Jump back to the start with your arms down.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: bridge - mountain climber (cross body)
exercises.description: A plank-position mountain climber driving knee across the body. Works the abs and obliques, and raises your heart rate.
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Engage your core and lift your right foot off the ground, bringing your right knee towards your left elbow.
Return your right foot to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left foot towards your right elbow.
Continue alternating sides, moving at a controlled pace.
Keep your hips level and avoid lifting your hips too high or sagging them too low.
Maintain a steady breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell lateral step up
exercises.description: A side-on step up with dumbbells that builds the legs and glutes.
steps: Stand beside a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place your near foot on the bench.
Drive through that heel to step up onto the bench.
Bring your other foot up to balance.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: exercise ball frog crunch
exercises.description: A crunch on a stability ball with the legs in a frog position to hit the lower abs.
steps: Lie back on a stability ball with your lower back supported.
Place the soles of your feet together with your knees out.
Place your hands lightly by your head.
Crunch up while pulling your knees toward your chest.
Squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying on floor rear delt raise
exercises.description: A rear delt raise performed lying face down on the floor. Targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Lie face down on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Engaging your shoulder muscles, lift your arms up and out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: glute bridge two legs on floor
exercises.description: A floor bridge with both feet down that strengthens the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through your heels to lift your hips.
Make a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: glute bridge one leg on bench
exercises.description: A single-leg bridge with a foot on a bench that targets the glutes harder.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot on a bench and the other leg extended.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: glute bridge one leg on floor (straight leg)
exercises.description: A single-leg bridge with the free leg straight, working the glutes and core.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight up.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Push through your planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your hips level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: glute bridge one leg on floor (bent knee)
exercises.description: A single-leg bridge with the free knee bent toward your chest.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot on the floor and the other knee pulled up.
Place your arms by your sides.
Push through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Keep your pelvis level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell hammer curl v. 3
exercises.description: A curl with a neutral grip that works the biceps and forearms.
steps: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows close to your torso.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Keep your wrists straight.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell rear delt fly
exercises.description: A bent-over fly that targets the rear of the shoulders.
steps: Hinge forward with a flat back, holding dumbbells below your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly to the start.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline rear fly
exercises.description: A chest-supported rear fly on an incline bench that isolates the rear shoulders.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise the dumbbells out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest on the pad.

exercises.name: barbell reverse grip incline row
exercises.description: A chest-supported row with an underhand grip that works the lats and upper back.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.

exercises.name: dumbbell reverse grip incline row
exercises.description: A chest-supported dumbbell row with an underhand grip for the lats and upper back.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding dumbbells with an underhand grip.
Let your arms hang straight.
Row the dumbbells toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad.

exercises.name: cable front raise v. 2
exercises.description: A cable raise to the front that works the front of the shoulders.
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Avoid leaning back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: decline twisting sit up
exercises.description: A sit up on a decline bench with a twist to work the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Sit up while rotating your torso to one side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: vibrate plate standing
exercises.description: A standing hold on a vibrating platform that engages the legs and core.
steps: Step onto the vibrating plate with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Hold your posture tall and your core braced.
Keep your weight balanced over your feet.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.
Step off carefully.

exercises.name: vibrate plate plank
exercises.description: A plank held on a vibrating platform that adds challenge to your core.
steps: Place your forearms or hands on the vibrating plate.
Extend your legs behind you.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Come down carefully.

exercises.name: vibrate plate lunge
exercises.description: A lunge with the front foot on a vibrating plate for added stability work.
steps: Place one foot on the vibrating plate and step the other back.
Lower into a lunge with your torso upright.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Hold the bottom briefly.
Push up to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: cable wide grip rear pulldown behind neck v. 2
exercises.description: A wide pulldown to the back of the neck that works the lats and upper back.
steps: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs secured.
Grab the bar with a wide overhand grip.
Lean forward slightly and pull the bar down behind your head to the base of your neck.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Control the bar back up.
Move gently and keep your neck neutral.

exercises.name: resistance band glute bridge v. 2
exercises.description: A glute bridge with a band around the thighs that adds hip activation.
steps: Lie on your back with a loop band around your thighs.
Bend your knees with feet flat.
Push your knees out against the band.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: bench full squat
exercises.description: A deep squat down to a bench that builds the legs and hips.
steps: Stand in front of a bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and lower until you touch the bench.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Push through your heels to stand.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: side up jump top bench
exercises.description: A side-on jump onto a bench that builds explosive leg power.
steps: Stand beside a sturdy bench.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up and sideways onto the bench.
Land softly with your knees bent.
Step down carefully.
Repeat, alternating sides.

exercises.name: side jump step up
exercises.description: A side-on step with a jump that trains power in the legs.
steps: Stand beside a low step.
Place your near foot on the step.
Drive up with a small jump.
Land softly on the step.
Step down with control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: power sled pull row
exercises.description: A row performed while pulling a loaded sled for back and grip strength.
steps: Attach a rope or handles to a loaded sled.
Hold the rope with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the sled toward you with a rowing motion.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Keep your back flat.
Repeat for the planned distance.

exercises.name: jack plank on medicine ball
exercises.description: A plank with jumping jack feet on a medicine ball, challenging core stability.
steps: Place your hands on a medicine ball in a plank.
Brace your abs and keep your body straight.
Jump your feet wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level.
Continue for the planned reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell bent arm pullover with knees bent
exercises.description: A lying pullover with a bent elbow that stretches and works the chest, with help from the lats and triceps.
steps: Lie back on a bench or the floor with knees bent and feet flat, holding one dumbbell over your chest.
Bend your elbows slightly and lock that angle.
Lower the dumbbell back over your head in a slow arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pull the weight back over your chest along the same arc.
Keep your ribs down and your lower back from arching.

exercises.name: seated piriformis stretch
exercises.description: A seated stretch for the piriformis and glute muscles. Helps loosen tight hips.
steps: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left knee.
Place your left elbow on the outside of your right knee and gently twist your torso to the right.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: cossack squats
exercises.description: A wide side-to-side squat where you sink onto one leg while the other stays straight. It builds leg strength and hip mobility.
steps: Stand with your feet much wider than shoulder width and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee, sitting your hips down and back.
Keep the other leg straight with the heel down and toes up.
Push through the bent leg to slide back to the centre.
Repeat on the other side and keep your chest tall.

exercises.name: bent leg circle kick (kneeling)
exercises.description: A kneeling Pilates move where one bent leg draws circles in the air. It works the glutes and hips while the core keeps you steady.
steps: Start on hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side with the knee bent.
Draw slow circles in the air with your knee.
Keep your hips level and your spine still.
Switch direction, then repeat on the other leg.

exercises.name: rocking frog stretch
exercises.description: A rocking frog stretch that opens the hips and inner thighs. Helps loosen the glutes and groin.
steps: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart.
Place your hands on the ground in front of you for support.
Slowly lean forward, shifting your weight onto your hands and extending your legs behind you.
Keep your back straight and engage your glutes as you push your hips back and up towards the ceiling.
Hold this position for a few seconds, feeling a stretch in your glutes.
Slowly return to the starting position by bending your knees and lowering your hips back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: roll overs into v sits
exercises.description: You roll back over your shoulders and then roll forward into a V sit, working the abs and building control.
steps: Sit with knees bent and arms reaching forward.
Roll back, lifting your legs up and over toward your head.
Roll forward with control and extend your legs.
Land in a balanced V sit, with arms reaching toward your feet.
Move smoothly and use your abs to drive the motion.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying triceps extension v. 2
exercises.description: A classic lying extension that isolates the triceps by bending only at the elbows.
steps: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest, palms facing in.
Keep your upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the triceps.
Straighten your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows pointing at the ceiling.

exercises.name: lever horizontal one leg press
exercises.description: A horizontal machine leg press done one leg at a time. Builds the glutes and quads.
steps: Adjust the seat of the machine so that your knees are at a 90-degree angle when your feet are on the footplate.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push the footplate away from your body by extending your leg, keeping your back against the backrest.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly bend your leg to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.

exercises.name: jump rope
exercises.description: Skipping over a rope at a steady pace. Classic cardio that builds endurance and coordination.
steps: Hold the handles of the jump rope with your hands, palms facing inward.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing the rope over your head and jump over it as it comes towards your feet.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and repeat the jump as the rope comes around again.
Continue jumping for the desired duration or number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable lateral pulldown with v-bar
exercises.description: A lat pulldown with a v-bar attachment. Builds the lats and upper back.
steps: Sit down on the cable pulldown machine and grab the v-bar attachment with an overhand grip.
Adjust the knee pad so that your thighs are secured under it.
Keep your back straight and lean back slightly.
Pull the v-bar down towards your upper chest while keeping your elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back muscles at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return the v-bar to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable one arm biceps curl v. 2
exercises.description: A one-arm curl using a cable for constant tension, great for working each biceps on its own.
steps: Stand facing the cable with the handle at low height and grip it with one hand, palm up.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder and squeeze the biceps.
Lower slowly until the arm is nearly straight.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: elliptical machine skiing
exercises.description: A ski-style stride on the elliptical that keeps your heart rate up and works the whole body.
steps: Step onto the elliptical and hold the handles.
Start striding in a smooth, ski-like rhythm, swinging your arms with your legs.
Stay upright and keep your core engaged.
Hold a steady pace for your chosen time.
Slow down gradually to finish.

exercises.name: lever incline chest press (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A plate-loaded machine press on an incline that targets the upper chest and the front of the shoulders.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles are level with your upper chest.
Sit back and grip the handles with feet flat on the floor.
Press forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Squeeze the chest, then return slowly.
Keep your back against the pad and your shoulders down.

exercises.name: lever preacher curl (plate loaded) v. 2
exercises.description: A plate-loaded preacher machine curl that isolates the biceps with your upper arms supported.
steps: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad.
Grip the handles with palms up.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.
Do not lift your elbows off the pad or let the weight drop.

exercises.name: cable seated row with v bar
exercises.description: A seated cable row with a V-shaped grip that trains the mid back and lats.
steps: Sit at the cable row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grip the V bar and sit tall with arms extended.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest up and avoid rocking.

exercises.name: lever high row (plate loaded) v. 2
exercises.description: A plate-loaded high row machine that pulls from above to train the lats and upper back.
steps: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.

exercises.name: lever high row (plate loaded) v. 3
exercises.description: A plate-loaded high row machine that pulls from above to train the lats and upper back.
steps: Adjust the seat and chest pad so you can grip the handles with arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest on the pad.
Pull the handles down and back, driving the elbows toward your hips.
Squeeze the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and keep your shoulders down.

exercises.name: lever seated row (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A plate-loaded seated row machine with a chest pad that builds the mid back and lats.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your mid chest.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Keep your torso tight against the pad.

exercises.name: lever lateral wide pulldown
exercises.description: A machine pulldown with a wide grip that targets the lats for a broad back.
steps: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grip the wide handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, leading with the elbows.
Squeeze the lats, then let the handles rise slowly.
Avoid leaning far back or using momentum.

exercises.name: lever seated calf raise (plate loaded) v. 2
