exercises.description: A seated plate-loaded calf raise that focuses on the soleus under the calf.
steps: Sit with the balls of your feet on the platform and the pad over your thighs.
Release the safety and lower your heels for a stretch.
Press up through the balls of your feet as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze the calves.
Lower slowly to full stretch.

exercises.name: smith narrow row v. 2
exercises.description: A bent-over row on the smith machine with a narrow grip, working the lats and mid back.
steps: Set the bar at knee height and grip it with hands close together.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower the bar under control to full arm extension.

exercises.name: barbell reverse wrist curl v. 2
exercises.description: A wrist curl with an overhand grip that builds the muscles on top of the forearm.
steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs or a bench, palms down, holding a barbell.
Let your wrists drop so the bar hangs down.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your forearms still.

exercises.name: cable one arm front raise
exercises.description: A single-arm front raise with constant cable tension, training the front of the shoulder.
steps: Stand facing away from a low cable pulley with the handle in one hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and raise it forward to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm lateral raise v. 2
exercises.description: A one-sided raise out to the side that builds the middle part of the shoulder.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Do all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying pronation on floor
exercises.description: A lying dumbbell forearm pronation on the floor. Works the forearm muscles.
steps: Lie flat on the floor with your face down and your arms extended straight out in front of you, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms so they are facing down towards the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, lift the dumbbells off the floor by contracting your forearms.
Continue lifting until your forearms are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying supination on floor
exercises.description: A lying dumbbell forearm supination on the floor. Works the forearm muscles.
steps: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your legs extended and your arms by your sides, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Rotate your palms to face up, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Slowly curl the dumbbells towards your shoulders, squeezing your forearms.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: strongman log lift
exercises.description: Lifting a heavy log from the ground to overhead, building full-body strength and power.
steps: Stand over the log with feet shoulder width apart and grip it with a firm hold.
Lift it to your lap with a flat back and drive the hips forward.
Rack it on your chest with elbows high.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the log overhead.
Lock out, then lower with control.
Start light and keep your core braced.

exercises.name: strongman mas wrestling
exercises.description: A grip and pull contest with a stick, building grip strength and total body tension.
steps: Sit facing a partner with feet against theirs and both hands on a stick.
Brace your core.
Pull the stick toward you with a strong grip.
Resist your partner while keeping your back straight.
Keep the effort steady and control the end of each pull.

exercises.name: strongman arm over arm
exercises.description: A heavy rope pull where you move hand over hand, training pulling strength and grip.
steps: Face the load with the rope in both hands and feet set wide.
Lean back slightly with a braced core.
Pull the rope with one arm and then the other.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Reach and pull smoothly while keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: strongman truck pull
exercises.description: Pulling a heavy truck with a rope over a distance, building leg drive and grip.
steps: Stand facing away from the truck with the rope held across your body.
Lean forward and dig your feet in.
Take short, powerful steps driving through the legs.
Keep your core braced and the rope close.
Pull the full distance, then rest.

exercises.name: strongman duck walk
exercises.description: A low squat-walk holding a load, building leg endurance and hip strength.
steps: Hold the weight in front of you and lower into a deep squat.
Keep your chest up.
Take small steps while staying low.
Keep your core braced and your knees tracking over your toes.
Walk the full distance, then stand and rest.

exercises.name: strongman sandbag walk
exercises.description: Carrying a heavy sandbag over a set distance to train grip, back and core.
steps: Lift the sandbag off the floor and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward at a steady pace with short steps.
Keep your posture upright and do not lean back.
Set the bag down under control at the end.

exercises.name: strongman iron block press
exercises.description: An overhead press using a heavy iron block, building shoulder and arm strength.
steps: Lift the block to your shoulders and set your feet hip width apart.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the block overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause at the top.
Lower it back to your shoulders under control.

exercises.name: strongman iceland cross
exercises.description: A hold with a heavy weight in each hand, arms held out to the sides, building shoulder and grip endurance.
steps: Pick up a weight in each hand and stand tall.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Hold them there with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid shrugging.
Hold as long as you can, then lower under control.

exercises.name: strongman timber carry
exercises.description: Carrying a heavy timber on your shoulder, training full-body strength and stability.
steps: Lift the timber onto your shoulder and balance it.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk with short, steady steps.
Keep the load balanced and avoid leaning to one side.
Set it down under control, then switch shoulders.

exercises.name: strongman circle of conan
exercises.description: A heavy walk in a circle holding a load, building grip, back and leg strength.
steps: Pick up the load and hold it against your body.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Walk in a circle with steady steps.
Stay balanced and avoid leaning away.
Set the load down under control when you finish.

exercises.name: strongman crucifix hold
exercises.description: Holding weights out to your sides at shoulder height, building shoulder endurance.
steps: Pick up a weight in each hand and stand tall.
Raise your arms out to the sides until level with your shoulders.
Hold the position with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and wrists straight.
Hold as long as you can, then lower with control.

exercises.name: strongman front hold
exercises.description: Holding a load out in front of your body, building shoulder and core endurance.
steps: Pick up the weights and stand tall.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height.
Hold with a braced core.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning back.
Hold as long as you can, then lower with control.

exercises.name: strongman viking press
exercises.description: An overhead press with a heavy viking-press frame, building shoulders and triceps.
steps: Stand inside the frame and grab the handles.
Lift the handles to shoulder height and set your feet.
Brace your core and press overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower back to shoulder height under control.

exercises.name: strongman squats with platform
exercises.description: A squat while holding a heavy platform, building leg strength and trunk stability.
steps: Stand with the platform loaded on your shoulders and feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core.
Squat down with your chest up and knees tracking over toes.
Drive back up through your heels.
Stand tall and lock out at the top.

exercises.name: strongman loading
exercises.description: Lifting heavy objects onto a platform in sequence, building full-body strength.
steps: Stand over the first object with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge at the hips and grip it with a flat back.
Lift it by driving through the hips.
Carry it to the platform and load it.
Return, repeat with the next object, and keep your core braced.

exercises.name: strongman hood stones
exercises.description: Lifting a heavy stone to a platform, building power through the hips and back.
steps: Straddle the stone and squat down to hug it.
Lift it to your lap by driving the hips forward.
Roll the stone up your chest.
Extend your hips to land it on the platform.
Lower the stone under control and reset.

exercises.name: strongman wheelbarrow
exercises.description: Pushing a loaded wheelbarrow over a distance, building leg drive and grip.
steps: Grip the wheelbarrow handles and lift them with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Push forward with strong steps.
Keep your arms straight and your body in line.
Set it down under control at the end.

exercises.name: strongman atlas stones
exercises.description: Lifting heavy round stones onto a platform, a classic test of full-body strength.
steps: Straddle the stone and squat down to wrap your arms around it.
Lift it to your lap by driving the hips forward.
Roll the stone up your chest.
Extend your hips to load it on the platform.
Lower it back to the floor under control and reset.

exercises.name: strongman power stairs
exercises.description: Carrying a heavy load up a flight of stairs, building leg power and grip.
steps: Pick up the load and hold it against your chest.
Brace your core and stand tall.
Climb the stairs one step at a time.
Push through your whole foot and keep your chest up.
Set the load down under control at the top.

exercises.name: strongman hercules hold
exercises.description: Holding two heavy weights, arms out, for time to build grip and shoulder endurance.
steps: Pick up the weights and stand tall.
Hold your arms out to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders down.
Hold the position as long as you can.
Lower under control when done.

exercises.name: strongman shield carry
exercises.description: Carrying a heavy shield-like load over a distance, training core and back strength.
steps: Lift the shield and hold it in front of you.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward at a steady pace.
Keep your posture upright.
Set it down under control when you finish.

exercises.name: strongman front chest squat
exercises.description: A front squat with a heavy load hugged to the chest, building quads and trunk strength.
steps: Hold the load tight against your chest with your elbows up.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down keeping your chest tall.
Drive up through your heels.
Lock out the hips at the top.

exercises.name: strongman deadlift
exercises.description: A heavy deadlift in strongman style, pulling a loaded bar from the floor to a full stand. Builds total posterior chain and grip strength.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over mid foot.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your knees, chest up and back flat.
Brace your core and push the floor away, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Stand tall by driving your hips forward, then lower the bar under control.

exercises.name: strongman tire flip
exercises.description: Flipping a large tire end over end by driving up from a deep hinge. A full body power move that hits legs, back and chest.
steps: Stand close to the tire and squat down, getting your fingers under its edge.
Press your chest against the tire with a flat back and hips low.
Explode up with your legs and hips, lifting the tire as you rise.
Shove the tire over with your hands and shoulders, then step in and reset for the next flip.

exercises.name: strongman weight for height
exercises.description: Throwing a heavy weight up and over a high bar. It is an explosive power move that trains hips, back and shoulders together.
steps: Hold the weight with both hands low in front of you, feet shoulder width apart.
Swing it back between your legs while hinging at the hips.
Drive your hips and legs up hard and swing the weight up and overhead.
Release it over the bar, then step back and reset for the next throw.

exercises.name: strongman dumbbell one arm clean and jerk
exercises.description: A one arm dumbbell clean followed by a jerk overhead. Trains explosive power from the legs through the shoulder.
steps: Stand over a dumbbell with feet shoulder width apart and grab it with one hand.
Pull it explosively to your shoulder with a hip drive, dipping slightly under it.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the dumbbell overhead to a locked arm.
Lower it back to the shoulder and then the floor with control, then switch arms.

exercises.name: strongman apollons axle
exercises.description: Lifting a thick axle bar from the floor to overhead. The fat grip makes it a brutal test for hands, forearms and shoulders.
steps: Stand over the thick axle with feet shoulder width apart and grip it firmly.
Pull it up the thighs with a flat back and clean it to your chest.
Dip and drive with your legs, pressing the axle overhead until your arms lock.
Bring it back down to your chest and then the floor with control.

exercises.name: strongman barbell farmers walk
exercises.description: Walking while carrying a heavy loaded bar at your sides. Builds grip strength, upper back and trunk stability.
steps: Stand inside the loaded bar and grip the handle, then lift it to hang at your sides.
Keep your chest tall, shoulders back and core braced.
Walk forward with short, quick steps for a set distance.
Stop, lower the weights to the floor with a flat back, and rest.

exercises.name: strongman yoke walk
exercises.description: Carrying a heavy yoke frame across your upper back and walking with it. Strengthens the legs, trunk and traps.
steps: Step under the yoke so it rests across your upper back and grip the frame.
Brace your core and stand up to lift it off the supports.
Walk forward in quick, controlled steps, keeping your torso upright.
At the end, lower the yoke back onto the supports with care.

exercises.name: lever reverse grip lateral pulldown
exercises.description: A reverse grip lat pulldown on a machine. Builds the lats and biceps.
steps: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your knees under the pads and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Sit upright with your chest out and shoulders back, maintaining a slight arch in your lower back.
Pull the handles down towards your chest, leading with your elbows and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: standing hip extension (straight leg)
exercises.description: A standing kickback with a straight leg that targets the glutes.
steps: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Keep your standing knee slightly soft.
Lift one straight leg back behind you without arching your lower back.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying triceps extension on floor
exercises.description: A floor version of the lying triceps extension, where the floor limits how far you lower the weight.
steps: Lie on the floor with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand over your chest.
Keep upper arms still and bend your elbows to lower the weights toward your head.
Stop just before the weights touch the floor.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your elbows pointing up.

exercises.name: wide push up (wall)
exercises.description: A beginner-friendly standing push-up against a wall with a wide hand position to emphasise the chest.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it, wider than your shoulders.
Step your feet back so your body leans in a straight line.
Bend your elbows to bring your chest toward the wall.
Push back to the start.
Keep your hips in line with your shoulders.

exercises.name: ez-barbell standing wide grip biceps curl
exercises.description: A standing EZ bar curl with a wide grip. Emphasises the biceps.
steps: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lever hip thrust (with stepbox) v. 2
exercises.description: A machine hip thrust with the feet raised on a step box, for a deeper glute contraction.
steps: Sit in the machine with your feet on the step box and the pad across your hips.
Brace your core and drive through your heels.
Lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

exercises.name: lever hip thrust v. 2
exercises.description: A machine hip thrust that loads the glutes in a controlled path.
steps: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat.
Secure the hip pad over your lap.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control without letting the weight crash.

exercises.name: cable standing hip thrust
exercises.description: A standing hip thrust against cable resistance, training hip extension and the glutes.
steps: Attach a belt or strap to a low cable and stand facing away from the stack.
Hold the cable at your hips with feet shoulder width apart.
Hinge slightly, then thrust your hips forward.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Return slowly and keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: smith reverse hyperextension
exercises.description: A reverse hyperextension on the smith machine that works the glutes and hamstrings with support from the lower back.
steps: Lie face down over a bench with your hips at the edge and legs hanging.
Hook your heels under the smith bar if it is set low.
Lift your legs by extending the hips until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: lever abduction squat
exercises.description: A machine squat that adds an outward leg push to work the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Set the machine and step in with the pads on your shoulders.
Squat down with control, keeping your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Push your knees slightly outward as you rise.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: lever adduction thrust
exercises.description: A machine hip thrust that squeezes the legs inward, training the inner thighs and glutes.
steps: Sit in the machine with the pads between or around your legs as set.
Brace your core.
Thrust your hips up while squeezing your legs inward.
Hold the squeeze briefly at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: lever kneeling reverse hyperextension
exercises.description: A kneeling machine kickback that extends the hip and works the glutes.
steps: Kneel on the machine pad and hold the handles.
Place the back of your working leg against the lever pad.
Press the leg back and up until your hip is fully extended.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly and switch legs.

exercises.name: lever assisted leg press
exercises.description: A machine leg press with assistance, building the thighs and glutes with a controlled path.
steps: Sit in the machine and place your feet on the platform about shoulder width apart.
Release the safety handles.
Lower the platform by bending your knees until they reach about 90 degrees.
Push through your heels to extend the legs.
Do not lock your knees fully.

exercises.name: dumbbell single leg deadlift with wall support
exercises.description: A one-legged deadlift where a wall helps you balance while the hamstrings and glutes do the work.
steps: Stand near a wall, holding a dumbbell and resting one hand on it for balance.
Lift one leg behind you.
Hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbell down your standing leg.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kettlebell dumbbell sumo squat off stepbox
exercises.description: A sumo squat from a raised step box, adding range of motion for deeper work on the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand on a step box in a wide stance with toes out.
Hold a kettlebell or dumbbell in front of you.
Sit down between your legs, keeping your chest up.
Lower as far as comfortable.
Push through your feet to stand.

exercises.name: split squat v. 2
exercises.description: A static lunge-style squat that trains the legs one at a time with balance and control.
steps: Stand in a long stride with one foot forward and one back.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front heel to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kettlebell resistance band full squat from deficit
exercises.description: A deep squat from a raised platform with a band for added resistance, training the legs and glutes.
steps: Stand on a low platform, band under your feet and a kettlebell at your chest.
Sit down into the deepest squat you can control.
Keep your heels flat and chest up.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep tension in the band all the way up.

exercises.name: weighted hip thrusts
exercises.description: A hip thrust with added weight for building strong glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and the weight across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and bend your knees.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable hip abduction (toe out)
exercises.description: A cable leg raise to the side with the toes turned out, targeting the outer hip.
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: cable hip abduction (toe in)
exercises.description: A cable leg raise to the side with the toes turned in, shifting the work toward the outer glute.
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold a support for balance.
Turn your toes inward slightly.
Lift the working leg out to the side.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: frog hip thrust
exercises.description: A hip thrust with the soles of the feet together and knees out, which shifts work to the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your heels near your hips.
Drive through the feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable stand up
exercises.description: Rising from a low squat against cable tension to train the glutes and legs.
steps: Hold the cable handle at your chest and sit back into a deep squat.
Keep your chest tall.
Push through your heels to stand fully.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: resistance band hip thrust
exercises.description: A hip thrust with a resistance band over the hips, adding load that increases toward the top.
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band over your hips, anchored at both sides.
Plant your feet flat.
Drive your hips up against the band.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: ankle dorsal flexion
exercises.description: Pulling the toes up toward the shin, working the front of the lower leg. A simple way to keep the ankle moving well.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your heel resting on the floor.
Pull your toes and the top of your foot toward your shin as far as is comfortable.
Pause briefly, then lower the foot back down slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: ankle plantar flexion
exercises.description: Pointing the foot away from the shin, engaging the calf. Good for warming up and mobilising the ankle.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit with one leg out and your foot relaxed.
Point your toes down and away from you, as if pressing a gas pedal.
Pause briefly at the end, then return to the neutral position.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: elbow extension
exercises.description: Straightening the elbow from a bent position, which works the back of the upper arm and keeps the joint moving.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your upper arm still with the elbow bent.
Straighten the arm slowly until it is almost fully extended.
Pause briefly, keeping the shoulder relaxed and the upper arm fixed.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: elbow flexion
exercises.description: Bending the elbow to bring the hand toward the shoulder, working the front of the upper arm.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Start with your arm straight down at your side, palm forward.
Bend the elbow to bring your hand up toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly, then lower back down slowly without swinging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: forearm pronation
exercises.description: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns down. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing up.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns down to face the floor.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: forearm supination
exercises.description: Rotating the forearm so the palm turns up. Helps forearm control and wrist mobility.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Hold your elbow close to your side bent at 90 degrees, palm facing down.
Rotate your forearm so your palm turns up to face the ceiling.
Keep the elbow still and pause briefly at the end.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: hip abduction
exercises.description: Lifting the leg out to the side away from the body, working the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg straight out to the side, toes pointing forward.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without leaning your torso.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: hip adduction
exercises.description: Bringing the leg inward across the body, working the inner thigh.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other leg slightly out to the side.
Bring it back in and across the front of the standing leg, then pause.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: hip extension
exercises.description: Moving the leg back behind the body, which works the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Swing the other leg straight back, keeping your knee mostly straight.
Squeeze the glute at the top, avoiding any arching of your lower back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: hip flexion
exercises.description: Lifting the thigh forward and up, working the hip flexors and front of the thigh.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Lift the other knee up in front of you toward hip height.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly without rounding your back.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: hip lateral rotation (external rotation)
exercises.description: Rotating the thigh outward at the hip, working the deep hip rotators and glutes.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg inward, which rotates the hip outward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: hip medial rotation (internal rotation)
exercises.description: Rotating the thigh inward at the hip, working the muscles that turn the leg in.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg outward, which rotates the hip inward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: knee extension
exercises.description: Straightening the knee, which works the front of the thigh.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair with your feet off the floor.
Straighten one knee until the leg is almost fully extended.
Squeeze your thigh at the top, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: knee flexion
exercises.description: Bending the knee to bring the heel toward the glutes, working the back of the thigh.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall holding a support, with your weight on one leg.
Bend the other knee to bring your heel up toward your glutes.
Keep your thighs side by side, pause, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder abduction
exercises.description: Raising the arm out to the side, working the side of the shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Raise one arm out to the side up to about shoulder height.
Lower slowly without shrugging.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder adduction
exercises.description: Bringing the arm down toward the body from the side, working the lats and chest.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm raised out to the side at shoulder height.
Pull the arm down toward your side with control.
Keep your torso still and finish with the arm next to your body.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder extension
exercises.description: Moving the arm back behind the body, working the lats and rear shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm straight down at your side.
Swing the arm back behind you, keeping it straight.
Avoid leaning forward, pause, then return to the start.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder flexion
exercises.description: Raising the arm forward and up in front of the body, working the front of the shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arms at your sides, palms facing in.
Raise one arm forward and up to about shoulder height or higher.
Keep your ribs down, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder lateral rotation (external rotation)
exercises.description: Rotating the upper arm outward, which works the rotator cuff muscles at the back of the shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm outward, keeping the elbow tucked against your side.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder medial rotation (internal rotation)
exercises.description: Rotating the upper arm inward, working the muscles that turn the shoulder in.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with your elbow at your side bent at 90 degrees, forearm pointing forward.
Rotate your forearm inward across your stomach, keeping the elbow tucked in.
Pause briefly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder transverse abduction
exercises.description: Moving the arm backward in a horizontal arc, working the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out in front at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm out and back in a horizontal arc as far as is comfortable.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder transverse adduction
exercises.description: Moving the arm forward and across the body in a horizontal arc, working the chest.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with one arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Sweep the arm forward and across your body in a horizontal arc.
Keep the arm at shoulder height, pause, then return.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder transverse extension
exercises.description: Drawing the arm back in a horizontal plane, working the rear shoulder and upper back.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held in front at shoulder height.
Pull the arm back and out to the side, keeping it level.
Squeeze your shoulder blade lightly, then return slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: shoulder transverse flexion
exercises.description: Bringing the arm forward in a horizontal plane, working the chest and front shoulder.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand tall with your arm held out to the side at shoulder height.
Bring the arm forward in front of your chest, keeping it level.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to the side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: spine (lumbar) extension
exercises.description: Gently arching the lower back backward, working the muscles along the spine.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Lean back gently, arching your lower back within a comfortable range.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: spine (lumbar) flexion
exercises.description: Curling the lower back forward, working the abs and mobilising the lumbar spine.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and knees slightly soft.
Round your lower back forward and tuck your chin and pelvis in.
Pause briefly, then return upright.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: spine (lumbar) lateral flexion
exercises.description: Bending the trunk sideways, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms at your sides.
Slide one hand down the outside of your leg as you bend sideways.
Keep your hips level, return to upright, then bend to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: spine (lumbar) rotation
exercises.description: Twisting the trunk to each side, working the obliques and mobilising the spine.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Stand with feet hip width apart and your arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping the hips facing forward.
Return to center, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: wrist adduction
exercises.description: Tilting the wrist toward the little finger side, working the forearm muscles that guide the wrist.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, thumb up.
Tilt your hand down toward the little finger side.
Pause briefly, then return to neutral under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: wrist extension
exercises.description: Lifting the back of the hand up, working the top of the forearm.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm down.
Raise your hand upward by bending the wrist back.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: wrist flexion
exercises.description: Curling the hand toward the forearm, working the underside of the forearm.
steps: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Rest your forearm on a table with your hand hanging off the edge, palm up.
Curl your hand upward by bending the wrist toward your forearm.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

exercises.name: plank jump
exercises.description: A jumping plank drill that raises your heart rate and challenges the core.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and core tight.
Move at a steady pace.

exercises.name: plank walk up
exercises.description: Moving between a forearm and a high plank, building core and arm endurance.
steps: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand and then the other on the floor to rise to a high plank.
Lower one forearm and then the other back down.
Keep your hips steady.
Alternate the leading arm each rep.

exercises.name: dumbbell step up lunge
exercises.description: A step up that flows into a lunge while holding dumbbells. Builds single leg strength and balance.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Step one foot onto the box and drive up until you stand on it.
Step the same foot back down behind you into a lunge.
Push back up to the start, keeping your torso upright.
Finish all reps on one leg, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell step-up lunge
exercises.description: A dumbbell step-up that finishes with a lunge motion. Builds the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is on the surface.
Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the step, bringing your left foot up as well.
Once both feet are on the step, lower your left foot back down to the starting position, keeping your right foot on the step.
Repeat the movement, alternating which foot you step up with each time.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell squat jump step rear lunge v. 2
exercises.description: A barbell squat, a small jump and a step back into a rear lunge. A demanding combo for leg strength and power.
steps: Rest the barbell across your upper back and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down, then jump up lightly and land softly.
Step one foot back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep, keeping your chest tall.

exercises.name: barbell squat jump step rear lunge
exercises.description: A barbell squat jump followed by a rear lunge. Builds explosive leg power.
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Lower your body into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Explode upwards, jumping off the ground as high as you can.
Land softly on your feet and immediately step back with one leg into a reverse lunge.
Lower your body down until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, keeping your back straight.
Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat the jump and lunge sequence on the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell sitted alternate leg raise
exercises.description: A seated alternate leg raise holding a barbell across the thighs. Works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs.
Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping the other leg on the ground.
Lower the raised leg back down and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell sitted alternate leg raise (female)
exercises.description: A seated alternate leg raise with a barbell across the thighs and hands on the bench. Works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on a bench with your back straight and hold a barbell across your thighs.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Keeping your legs straight, lift one leg up as high as possible while keeping it parallel to the ground.
Lower the leg back down and repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: twisted leg raise (female)
exercises.description: A lying leg raise with a hip twist. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, bringing them towards your chest.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your knees towards your opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: twisted leg raise
exercises.description: A lying leg raise with a hip twist and hands under the glutes. Works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Place your hands under your glutes for support.
Engage your abs and lift both legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your legs towards your opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell supported squat
exercises.description: A dumbbell squat done with a support for balance. Builds the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: dumbbell supported squat v. 2
exercises.description: A dumbbell squat with a hand on a support for balance. Lets you focus on a deep, steady squat pattern.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and rest the other hand on a stable support.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and toes slightly out.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up.
Switch the dumbbell hand halfway through if needed.

exercises.name: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support
exercises.description: A single leg dumbbell deadlift with the rear foot supported on a step box. Works the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Place your left foot on a stepbox or elevated surface behind you.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, hinge forward at the hips, lowering the dumbbell towards the ground.
As you lower the dumbbell, simultaneously lift your left leg behind you, maintaining a straight line from head to heel.
Lower the dumbbell until you feel a stretch in your right hamstring, then return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell single leg deadlift with stepbox support v. 2
exercises.description: A one leg deadlift with the rear foot resting on a step box for balance. Works hamstrings and glutes with less wobble.
steps: Hold a dumbbell and rest the toes of one foot on a step box behind you.
Soften the front knee and hinge at the hips, lowering the dumbbell along your leg.
Keep your back flat and go as far as your hamstring allows.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell sumo pull through v. 2
exercises.description: A wide stance hinge where a dumbbell swings between the legs. Trains glutes, inner thighs and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell back between your legs.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive your hips forward and stand tall, swinging the dumbbell to hip height.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: dumbbell sumo pull through
exercises.description: A sumo-stance dumbbell pull through between the legs. Trains the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width apart, toes pointed outwards.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands in front of your body, arms extended.
Bend your knees and lower your hips down into a squat position, keeping your back straight.
Lower the dumbbell down between your legs, keeping your arms straight.
Drive through your heels and extend your hips forward, pulling the dumbbell up and in front of your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top of the movement, then lower the dumbbell back down between your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell split squat v. 3
exercises.description: A split squat with a barbell on your back, a second variation. Builds single leg strength and balance.
steps: Rest the barbell across your upper back and step into a split stance.
Keep your torso upright and core braced.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Press through your front foot to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: barbell split squat v. 2
exercises.description: A barbell split squat with a long stance. Builds the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell across your upper back.
Take a large step forward with your right foot, keeping your torso upright.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips until your right thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg forward for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell leg twist press
exercises.description: A combined move where a leg rotation pairs with an overhead press with a barbell. Trains legs, trunk and shoulders together.
steps: Hold a barbell at your shoulders with feet shoulder width apart.
Step one foot out and rotate your hips and torso with it, bending into a rotated lunge.
Drive back up and press the bar overhead as you stand.
Lower the bar to your shoulders.
Alternate sides on each rep.

exercises.name: dumbbell step-up split squat
exercises.description: A dumbbell step-up combined with a knee drive. Builds the quads and glutes.
steps: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the bench or step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Step up onto the bench or step with your right foot, pushing through your heel to lift your body up.
As you step up, simultaneously lift your left knee towards your chest.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your left foot back to the ground while keeping your right foot on the bench or step.
Repeat the movement with your left foot on the bench or step.
Continue alternating between your right and left foot for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: one arm twisted clean and press
exercises.description: A one arm clean with a body twist followed by a press overhead. Builds power and coordination from hips to shoulder.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart, holding a weight in one hand low in front of you.
Pull it up to your shoulder with a hip drive and a slight turn of the body.
Turn your feet and hips back to face forward as you dip your knees.
Press the weight overhead until your arm locks.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: v up down (with stability ball)
exercises.description: A V up where you pass a stability ball between hands and feet. Works the abs and builds control.
steps: Lie on your back holding the stability ball overhead with straight arms.
Lift your arms and legs up together, curling into a V.
Pass the ball from your hands to your feet.
Lower back down slowly, holding the ball between your feet.
Repeat, passing the ball back to your hands.

exercises.name: battling ropes side raise
exercises.description: Raising battling ropes out to the side with a fast, wave-making motion. Boosts shoulder endurance and heart rate.
steps: Stand in a slight squat holding a rope end in each hand.
Keep your core braced and elbows soft.
Raise both arms out to the sides to about shoulder height in a quick, controlled motion.
Lower and repeat at a steady fast pace.
Work in intervals of 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: power sled rear lunge
exercises.description: A rear lunge while pushing or holding a power sled. Builds leg strength with extra resistance.
steps: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with your feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.name: pike push up (on bench)
exercises.description: A pike push up with your feet raised on a bench, shifting more load to the shoulders. A bodyweight alternative to the overhead press.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips raised in an inverted V.
Keep your legs straight and your core braced.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees to your body.

exercises.name: suspender weighted inverted row
exercises.description: An inverted row on suspension straps with added weight on your body. Builds the back and biceps.
steps: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with your body in a straight line, with weight on your torso.
Keep your arms straight and heels on the floor.
Pull your chest up toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.name: cable narrow chair stand up
exercises.description: A weighted sit-to-stand with a narrow stance and cable resistance.
steps: Sit on a chair holding the cable handle at your chest.
Keep your feet close together.
Lean forward slightly.
Push through your heels to stand.
Lower back under control.

exercises.name: cable stiff leg deadlift from stepbox
exercises.description: A straight-leg hinge from a raised box for a longer range on the hamstrings.
steps: Stand on a step box facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Hinge at the hips and lower the handle.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

exercises.name: cable rear lunge from stepbox
exercises.description: A reverse lunge from a step box with cable tension, training the glutes and legs.
steps: Stand on a step box facing a cable and hold the handle.
Step one leg back and down to lunge.
Lower the back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to return.
Switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: bicycle
exercises.description: A pedalling leg movement lying on your back that works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your legs and curl your shoulders up.
Extend one leg while bringing the opposite elbow toward the other knee.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.name: chest lift with rotation
exercises.description: A curl up with a twist that trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and lower.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: control balance
exercises.description: A challenging Pilates move where you balance on your shoulders while switching legs, building control and core strength.
steps: Lie on your back and roll your legs overhead.
Hold one ankle with both hands.
Extend the other leg out above you.
Switch legs with control.
Roll down slowly.

exercises.name: corkscrew
exercises.description: A Pilates move where the legs trace circles overhead, training the obliques and lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides and legs raised up.
Lift your hips slightly and swing your legs across to one side.
Circle them down and around.
Bring them back up to the start.
Reverse the direction.

exercises.name: crab
exercises.description: A rolling Pilates move in a seated crab shape that works the core and spine mobility.
steps: Sit with your legs crossed and hold your feet.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Cross your legs the other way.
Roll back up.
Keep your movement smooth.

exercises.name: double leg stretch
exercises.description: A core-driven move where arms and legs stretch out together and then draw back in.
steps: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders up.
Hug your knees to your chest.
Reach your arms overhead while extending your legs.
Circle your arms and draw your knees back in.
Keep your lower back down.

exercises.name: floor hyperextension v. 2
exercises.description: A face-down back lift that strengthens the spine and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lengthen your neck.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: hip twist supported arms
exercises.description: A seated twist with the legs lifted, working the obliques and core.
steps: Sit with your hands behind you and legs lifted.
Keep your chest open.
Rotate your hips to one side.
Circle your legs back to the centre.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: hundred
exercises.description: The classic Pilates warm-up where you pump your arms while holding your legs up, building abdominal endurance.
steps: Lie on your back and lift your head and shoulders.
Raise your legs to a tabletop or extend them.
Pump your arms up and down in small beats.
Breathe in for five beats and out for five.
Aim for one hundred beats.

exercises.name: leg pull side
exercises.description: A side-plank style Pilates move where one leg lifts, challenging the obliques and shoulders.
steps: Start in a side plank on one hand.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lift your top leg.
Hold briefly.
Lower and switch sides.

exercises.name: leg pull
exercises.description: A plank-based Pilates move where you lift one leg at a time, training core stability.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Brace your core.
Lift one leg a few inches.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.name: leg raise (bent knee)
exercises.description: A lying leg raise with bent knees that makes it easier to focus on the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Bend your knees.
Raise your legs until your thighs are vertical.
Lower slowly without arching.
Keep your lower back on the floor.

exercises.name: lying double leg kick
exercises.description: A face-down Pilates move that opens the chest and strengthens the back.
steps: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your back.
Kick both heels toward your glutes.
Lift your chest and extend your arms back.
Lower down.
Repeat smoothly.

exercises.name: lying leg lift side
exercises.description: A side-lying leg lift that works the outer hip.
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked.
Support your head with your arm.
Lift your top leg.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lying neck pull
exercises.description: A roll up from lying with your hands behind your head, training the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with hands behind your head.
Curl your head and shoulders up.
Roll up to sit.
Reach forward.
Roll down with control.

exercises.name: lying single leg circle
exercises.description: A hip mobility move where one leg draws circles in the air.
steps: Lie on your back with one leg extended up.
Keep your pelvis still.
Draw small circles with that leg.
Reverse direction.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: lying single leg kick
exercises.description: A face-down move kicking one heel toward the glute while the chest stays lifted.
steps: Lie face down and prop yourself on your forearms.
Keep your chest lifted.
Kick one heel toward your glute twice.
Lower and switch legs.
Keep your hips down.

exercises.name: rocker with open legs
exercises.description: A balance and rolling move with the legs open in a V shape.
steps: Sit and hold your ankles with your legs in a V.
Balance on your tailbone.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll up to balance again.
Keep your back rounded.

exercises.name: rocking
exercises.description: A rocking move on the stomach that stretches the front and strengthens the back.
steps: Lie face down and reach back to hold your ankles.
Lift your chest and legs.
Rock forward and back.
Keep your movement smooth.
Lower down to finish.

exercises.name: roll up v. 2
exercises.description: A slow roll up from lying to sitting, training abdominal control and spine flexibility.
steps: Lie on your back with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and curl your head and chest up.
Roll up one vertebra at a time.
Reach over your legs.
Roll back down slowly.

exercises.name: rolling back
exercises.description: A rolling move that massages the spine and trains abdominal control.
steps: Sit with your knees tucked and hold your shins.
Round your back.
Roll back onto your shoulders.
Roll back up to balance.
Keep your chin tucked.

exercises.name: rollover
exercises.description: A controlled move where the legs travel overhead and back, challenging the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs raised.
Roll your legs overhead.
Open them to hip width.
Roll down slowly.
Keep your arms pressing down.

exercises.name: saw
exercises.description: A seated twist that reaches toward the opposite foot, training the obliques and stretching the back of the legs.
steps: Sit with legs wide and arms out.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Reach your hand past your opposite foot.
Return to centre.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: scissors
exercises.description: A leg-switching move lying on your back, building lower abdominal strength.
steps: Lie on your back with your hips lifted and hands supporting them.
Raise your legs up.
Lower one leg while the other stays up.
Switch legs.
Keep the movement steady.

exercises.name: shoulder bridge
exercises.description: A bridge that lifts the hips and adds a leg raise, working the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Extend one leg up.
Lower it and switch legs.
Roll down slowly.

exercises.name: side bend
exercises.description: A Pilates side bend from a seated or side-supported position that works the obliques and the sides of the trunk.
steps: Sit tall on your side with your bottom hand pressed into the mat and your legs stacked.
Lift your hips so your body forms a long diagonal line.
Reach your top arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting arm.
Lift back up to the long line while keeping your hips high.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side twist
exercises.description: A Pilates twist from a side-supported position that trains the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Set up in a side support with one hand on the mat and your feet stacked.
Lift your hips and reach your top arm to the ceiling.
Thread the top arm under your body as you rotate your torso.
Open back up and reach to the ceiling again.
Keep your hips lifted throughout, then switch sides.

exercises.name: spine twist v. 2
exercises.description: A seated Pilates twist that mobilises the spine and strengthens the obliques.
steps: Sit tall with your legs extended and arms reaching out to the sides.
Flex your feet and grow tall through the crown of your head.
Twist your torso to one side, pulsing gently for a small extra turn.
Return to center without sagging in the chest.
Twist to the other side and repeat.

exercises.name: swan dive
exercises.description: A rocking Pilates move on your belly that builds back extensor strength and control.
steps: Lie face down with your hands under your shoulders and legs together.
Press up into a swan, lifting your chest off the mat.
Let your arms float forward as you rock your chest and legs up.
Rock back and forth in a smooth, controlled rhythm.
Keep your neck long and your abs gently drawn in.

exercises.name: swimming
exercises.description: A prone Pilates exercise with alternating arm and leg flutters that trains the back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended overhead and legs long.
Lift your arms, chest and legs slightly off the mat.
Flutter opposite arm and leg up and down in a quick, small rhythm.
Keep your abs drawn in and your neck long.
Continue for 20-30 seconds, then rest.

exercises.name: teaser
exercises.description: A classic Pilates V-sit that challenges abdominal strength and balance.
steps: Lie on your back with legs extended and arms overhead.
Roll up while lifting your legs to form a V shape.
Reach your arms parallel to your legs and balance on your sit bones.
Hold briefly with a flat, strong back.
Roll down slowly with control and repeat.

exercises.name: single leg stretch (bent knee) v. 2
exercises.description: A Pilates ab move with alternating knee pulls that builds core endurance and coordination.
steps: Lie on your back and curl your head and shoulders off the mat.
Pull one knee toward your chest, with hands on that shin.
Extend the other leg long at a low angle.
Switch legs in a steady rhythm.
Keep your lower back anchored to the mat.

exercises.name: spine stretch forward v. 2
exercises.description: A seated Pilates stretch that rounds the spine forward to lengthen the back and hamstrings.
steps: Sit tall with legs extended hip-width apart and arms reaching forward.
Draw your belly in and flex your feet.
Curl forward one vertebra at a time, reaching over an imaginary ball.
Hold for a breath at the bottom.
Roll back up to tall sitting and repeat.

exercises.name: leg pull front supported
exercises.description: A Pilates plank variation with a leg lift that builds core and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels.
Lift one leg a few inches without shifting your hips.
Lower it and repeat on the other leg.
Keep your abs tight and your neck long.

exercises.name: side kick kneeling
exercises.description: A kneeling Pilates side kick that works the outer hip and core stability.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the opposite leg extended to the side.
Place your bottom hand on the mat and keep the top hand light behind your head.
Kick the top leg forward, then sweep it back with control.
Keep your torso steady and tall.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: boomerang
exercises.description: An advanced Pilates sequence of rolling and balancing that tests core control.
steps: Sit tall with legs extended and crossed at the ankles.
Roll back and lift your legs overhead, then switch the cross.
Roll up to a teaser with your legs lifted.
Hold your hands behind you and then reach forward over your legs.
Move smoothly, using your abs to control each roll.

exercises.name: seal
exercises.description: A rolling Pilates exercise that massages the spine and builds ab control.
steps: Sit balanced on your tailbone with knees open and hands inside your ankles.
Tuck your chin and round your back into a ball.
Roll back to your shoulders and clap your feet together.
Roll up to the balance position and clap again.
Keep the roll smooth and avoid rolling onto your neck.

exercises.name: prone press swan
exercises.description: A Pilates back extension on your belly that lifts the chest and strengthens the spine.
steps: Lie face down with hands beside your chest and legs together.
Press your pubic bone into the mat and engage your glutes.
Press through your hands to lift your chest.
Keep your neck long and shoulders away from your ears.
Lower slowly with control and repeat.

exercises.name: mermaid
exercises.description: A seated Pilates side stretch that opens the sides of the torso and ribs.
steps: Sit with your legs folded to one side in a comfortable position.
Place one hand on the mat beside you.
Reach the other arm overhead and bend sideways over the supporting hand.
Hold for a breath, feeling the side stretch.
Return to tall sitting and switch sides.

exercises.name: swimming all fours
exercises.description: A quadruped Pilates move with opposite arm and leg lifts for back stability.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Flutter them in small, quick pulses.
Keep your spine neutral and your hips level.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: cable hanging leg raise
exercises.description: A hanging leg raise with cable resistance at your feet. Strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with the cable attached to your ankles.
Keep your arms straight and your body steady.
Raise your legs up in front of you toward hip height or higher.
Curl your pelvis slightly at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: starfish crunch (advanced)
exercises.description: A wide-limb crunch that works the abs while your arms and legs open and close like a starfish.
steps: Lie on your back with arms and legs spread wide.
Brace your core and press your lower back into the floor.
Crunch up, bringing your arms and legs toward the center.
Slowly open back out to the starfish shape.
Keep your movements controlled and repeat.

exercises.name: front plank to push up
exercises.description: A move that moves from forearm plank to full push-up position, training the chest, arms and core.
steps: Start in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Place one hand on the floor and press up, then the other.
Reach a high plank with straight arms.
Lower back to your forearms one arm at a time.
Alternate the leading arm each rep and keep your hips level.

exercises.name: flutter kicks (hands under hips head up)
exercises.description: Fast alternating leg lifts with your head raised that fire up the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with hands tucked under your hips.
Lift your head and shoulders slightly off the floor.
Raise both legs a few inches above the ground.
Kick your legs up and down in small alternating pulses.
Keep your lower back pressed down and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: scissors (beginner)
exercises.description: A beginner floor exercise crossing the legs like scissors to train the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor.
Open them wide, then cross one over the other.
Alternate which leg is on top with each rep.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

exercises.name: front plank with arm lift
exercises.description: A plank where one arm lifts at a time, challenging core stability and anti-rotation.
steps: Set up in a forearm plank with elbows under shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and keep a straight line from head to heels.
Lift one arm forward without letting your hips twist.
Return it and lift the other arm.
Alternate in a slow, controlled rhythm.

exercises.name: front plank with arm lift (push up position)
exercises.description: A high plank where you lift one arm at a time, training anti-rotation core strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Set your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and reach it forward without twisting your hips.
Place it down and switch arms.
Keep your core braced throughout.

exercises.name: front plank with arm and leg lift (push up position)
exercises.description: A high plank holding the opposite arm and leg in the air, which tests balance and core strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold them in line with your body for a moment.
Lower them back to the floor with control.
Switch to the other arm and leg and repeat.

exercises.name: side plank (beginner)
exercises.description: A bent-knee side plank that builds oblique and hip strength for beginners.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Press into your forearm to lift your hips off the floor.
Hold a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: ez barbell standing preacher curl
exercises.description: A preacher style curl performed standing at an angled pad. Isolates the biceps with strict form.
steps: Stand facing a preacher pad and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with the arms extended.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.

exercises.name: power sled biceps curl
exercises.description: A biceps curl using a power sled as the resistance. Adds a unique load for arm strength.
steps: Stand facing the sled and grip the handle or strap with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows tucked at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders, moving the sled.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and keep your torso still.

exercises.name: power sled rear lunge row
exercises.description: A rear lunge combined with a row using a power sled. Works legs and back together.
steps: Hold the sled handles with arms extended and feet together.
Step back into a rear lunge, lowering your back knee.
As you rise, row the handles toward your ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return to standing and extend your arms.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.name: power sled rear lunge v. 2
exercises.description: A rear lunge using a power sled for resistance. Builds glute and thigh strength.
steps: Hold the sled handles and stand tall with feet together.
Step one foot back into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs on each rep.

exercises.name: power sled rear batwing
exercises.description: A movement with a power sled where you pull the handles out and back like wings. Works the hamstrings, back and rear shoulders.
steps: Hold the sled handles and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep your back flat and knees soft.
Pull the handles back and out to the sides like wings.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: power sled rear fly
exercises.description: A rear fly done with a power sled for resistance. Works the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Hold the sled handles with arms out in front and hinge slightly at the hips.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: power sled rear drag
exercises.description: Walking backward while dragging a power sled. Great for quads and conditioning with low joint stress.
steps: Face the sled, holding its handles or straps with a slight lean back.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Walk backward in steady steps, pulling the sled with you.
Keep your knees soft and drive through your legs.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

exercises.name: power sled backward push
exercises.description: Pushing a power sled while walking backward. Builds quad strength and conditioning.
steps: Stand behind the sled with your back to it and grip the handles.
Brace your core and lean slightly into the load.
Walk forward in powerful steps, pushing the sled.
Keep your stride steady and breathing controlled.
Cover a set distance, then rest.

exercises.name: power sled anti rotation forward walk
exercises.description: Walking a loaded sled forward while resisting twist from a side-on pull or hold. It builds hip and trunk stability under load.
steps: Set a light load and stand side-on to the pull, gripping the handle at chest height.
Brace your abs and keep your hips and shoulders square.
Walk forward in controlled steps without letting the torso twist.
Walk the set distance, then reset and repeat.
Switch sides and do the same distance.

exercises.name: power sled high pull
exercises.description: A pull from low to chest height on a sled, using hip drive. It trains the shoulders and upper back with a bit of power.
steps: Stand facing the sled and hold the handles or rope with arms long.
Hinge slightly at the hips with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and pull the handles up toward your chest, elbows high.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell suitcase carry
exercises.description: Carrying one heavy dumbbell at your side like a suitcase. It challenges your grip and forces your trunk to resist leaning.
steps: Pick up one dumbbell with a tall, braced posture and hold it at your side.
Keep your shoulders level and your ribs stacked over your hips.
Walk with steady steps without leaning toward the weight.
Cover the set distance, then put the weight down safely.
Switch hands and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell high low carry
exercises.description: A walking carry with one dumbbell overhead and one at your side. The mismatch trains shoulder stability and trunk control.
steps: Hold one dumbbell overhead with a locked, stable arm and the other at your side.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps and keep the top arm stacked over your shoulder.
Walk the set distance, then lower the weights carefully.
Swap positions and repeat.

exercises.name: trap bar farmers carry
exercises.description: Carrying a loaded trap bar at your sides while walking. It works grip, traps and the whole trunk together.
steps: Stand inside the trap bar and hinge down to grip the handles.
Stand up with a flat back, shoulders back and chest tall.
Walk with short, quick steps, keeping the bar still.
Cover the set distance without leaning or shrugging.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.

exercises.name: dumbbell overhead carry
exercises.description: Walking with a dumbbell held overhead. It builds shoulder stability and a strong, braced trunk.
steps: Press a dumbbell overhead and lock out your elbow with the biceps near your ear.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Walk with steady steps without letting the arm drift forward.
Cover the set distance, then lower the weight with control.
Switch arms and repeat.

exercises.name: barbell overhead carry
exercises.description: Walking while holding a barbell locked out overhead. It trains shoulder stability and whole-body bracing.
steps: Press the barbell overhead with a grip just outside shoulder width.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Walk with small, steady steps, keeping the bar over your mid-foot.
Cover the set distance without arching your back.
Lower the bar to your shoulders and set it down safely.

exercises.name: barbell zercher carry
exercises.description: Carrying a barbell in the crooks of your elbows. It loads the legs, upper back and trunk in a tough front-loaded position.
steps: Set the bar in your elbow crooks, hugging it tight to your chest.
Stand tall with your chest up and your abs braced.
Walk with controlled steps while keeping the bar close.
Cover the set distance without rounding forward.
Lower the bar to the rack or floor carefully.

exercises.name: kettlebell goblet carry
exercises.description: Walking while hugging a kettlebell at chest height. It trains posture, the trunk and the upper back.
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the horns close to your chest, elbows tucked.
Stand tall with your ribs down and abs braced.
Walk with steady steps without leaning back.
Cover the set distance, keeping the bell high and still.
