Bend at the waist to the right, reaching your right hand towards your right foot while keeping your left hand extended to the side.
Return to the starting position and then bend at the waist to the left, reaching your left hand towards your left foot while keeping your right hand extended to the side.
Repeat the side-to-side bending motion for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: arms apart circular toe touch (male)
exercises.description: A standing toe touch with a circular path and a leg lifting behind you. It loosens the hamstrings and challenges balance.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended to the sides.
Keeping your legs straight, bend forward at the waist and reach down towards your toes with your right hand.
As you reach down, simultaneously lift your left leg straight up behind you, maintaining balance.
Return to the starting position and repeat the movement with your left hand reaching towards your toes and your right leg lifting up behind you.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: hands reversed clasped circular toe touch (male)
exercises.description: A toe touch with the hands clasped in reverse and moved in a circle. It opens the hamstrings and back while warming up the hips.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down with your hands and clasp them together behind your legs.
Slowly raise your hands up and over your head in a circular motion, keeping your legs straight.
Continue the circular motion until your hands touch your toes.
Reverse the motion and bring your hands back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: chest tap push-up (male)
exercises.description: A push-up where one hand taps the chest at the bottom of each rep, alternating sides. It adds a stability challenge to the chest and triceps.
steps: Start in a high plank position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, tap your chest with your right hand.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time tapping your chest with your left hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: modified hindu push-up (male)
exercises.description: A modified hindu push-up that flows from a pike through a low dive to a lifted chest. It trains the chest, shoulders and triceps while opening up the spine.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and your feet hip-width apart.
Lower your body towards the ground, bending your elbows and keeping your core engaged.
As you lower your body, shift your weight back and lift your hips up towards the ceiling, creating an inverted V shape with your body.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground, then reverse the movement, pushing your hips back down and extending your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: hands clasped circular toe touch (male)
exercises.description: A standing toe touch with the hands clasped and moved in a circular path. It stretches the hamstrings and warms up the hips and back.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your hands clasped together in front of your chest.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Lower your hands towards your toes in a circular motion, reaching as far as you can without straining.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: scissor jumps (male)
exercises.description: A quick jumping drill where the legs cross in front of each other in the air. It raises your heart rate and builds light, springy legs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump off the ground and simultaneously cross your right leg in front of your left leg.
As you land, quickly switch legs, crossing your left leg in front of your right leg.
Continue alternating legs and jumping as quickly as possible.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: astride jumps (male)
exercises.description: A jump from a squat that ends with the legs spread wide, like a jumping jack with a squat start. It raises the heart rate and trains the legs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively upwards, extending your legs and arms.
While in the air, spread your legs apart and bring your arms out to the sides.
Land softly with your feet shoulder-width apart, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: half knee bends (male)
exercises.description: A shallow squat that bends the knees only partway. It is a gentle leg exercise good for warming up or high rep sets.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body down as if you were sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your weight in your heels.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: semi squat jump (male)
exercises.description: A shallow squat followed by a jump, with the arms swinging for momentum. It trains the leg power and gets the heart rate up.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively, extending your hips and knees while swinging your arms for momentum.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and immediately go into the next repetition.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: star jump (male)
exercises.description: A jump where arms and legs spread wide like a star at the top. It is a full-body cardio move that raises your pulse fast.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees slightly and jump up explosively.
As you jump, spread your legs and extend your arms out to the sides, forming a star shape with your body.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with your knees slightly bent.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: jack jump (male)
exercises.description: A jumping jack, hopping the feet apart while the arms go overhead and back again. A classic warm-up and cardio move.
steps: Stand with your feet together and your arms by your sides.
Jump up, spreading your feet apart and raising your arms above your head.
As you land, quickly jump back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: floor t raise
exercises.description: Lying face down, you lift your arms out to the sides into a T. It strengthens the mid and upper back.
steps: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor.
Turn your thumbs up toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and lift your arms.
Pause for a second.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: prone cobra palms under thighs
exercises.description: A face-down hold where you lift your chest with your palms tucked under your thighs. It builds lower back and upper back endurance.
steps: Lie face down with your palms under your thighs.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the ground using your back muscles.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

exercises.name: swimmer kicks
exercises.description: Lying face down, you flutter your legs like a swimmer. It works the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and legs slightly off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in small, fast alternations.
Keep your neck long.
Breathe steadily.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: lying back extension
exercises.description: A face-down lift of your chest off the floor. It strengthens the lower back muscles.
steps: Lie face down with your hands beside your head.
Keep your legs straight and your feet on the floor.
Lift your chest using your lower back.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly.
Keep your neck in line with your spine.

exercises.name: lying back extension with press
exercises.description: A lying back extension where you also press your arms forward at the top. It adds shoulder work to a back extension.
steps: Lie face down with your hands near your shoulders.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Press your arms forward in front of you.
Pull them back to your shoulders.
Lower your chest slowly.
Keep your neck long throughout.

exercises.name: prone cobra hands interlocked
exercises.description: A face-down hold with your hands clasped behind you. It trains the back extensors and opens the chest.
steps: Lie face down with your hands clasped behind your lower back.
Keep your neck long and look at the floor.
Lift your chest off the floor.
Reach your hands toward your feet.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

exercises.name: two toe touch (male)
exercises.description: A standing forward bend reaching both hands toward the toes. It loosens the hamstrings and lower back.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended out to the sides.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Reach down towards your toes with both hands, keeping your legs straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable standing rear delt horizontal row (with rope)
exercises.description: A standing cable row with a rope that pulls the elbows wide. It targets the rear delts.
steps: Attach a rope to a cable at chest height.
Hold the ends and step back.
Stand with your knees slightly bent.
Pull the rope toward your face with your elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your rear shoulders.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: cable seated supine grip row
exercises.description: A seated cable row with an underhand grip that brings the biceps and lats into play.
steps: Sit at a cable row with your feet braced.
Grip the handle with your palms facing up.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly without rounding your back.

exercises.name: hyght dumbbell fly
exercises.description: A flat-bench dumbbell fly done with a wide arc and a stretch across the chest. It isolates the pecs.
steps: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable assisted inverse leg curl
exercises.description: A cable-resisted leg curl from a face-down position. It isolates the hamstrings with smooth, constant tension.
steps: Adjust the cable machine so that the ankle attachment is at the lowest setting.
Lie face down on the bench with your legs straight and the ankle attachment secured to your ankles.
Hold onto the handles of the bench for stability.
Keeping your upper body stationary, exhale and curl your legs up towards your glutes by flexing your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your hamstrings.
Inhale and slowly lower your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: resistance band hip thrusts on knees (female)
exercises.description: A kneeling hip thrust against a resistance band around the thighs. It trains the glutes with a hip extension.
steps: Start by kneeling on the ground with your knees hip-width apart and your feet flexed.
Wrap the resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees.
Place your hands on your hips or extend them out in front of you for balance.
Engage your glutes and core muscles.
Push your hips forward and squeeze your glutes as you lift your knees off the ground, extending your hips until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your knees back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: landmine lateral raise
exercises.description: A raise done with a barbell anchored in a landmine setup, lifting out and up to shoulder height. It works the shoulders with a smooth arc.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, resting it on the front of your shoulders.
Keeping your core engaged and back straight, lift the barbell up and away from your body, raising it to shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: kneeling plank
exercises.description: A plank held on the knees. It's an easier version that builds core strength.
steps: Kneel and place your forearms on the floor under your shoulders.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line from your knees to your head.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your neck neutral.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Lower and rest.

exercises.name: kneeling plank tap shoulder (male)
exercises.description: A kneeling plank where you tap the opposite shoulder with one hand at a time. It trains the abs and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a kneeling position with your hands on the ground, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on your toes, and lift your body into a plank position.
Keeping your core engaged and your hips stable, lift one hand off the ground and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return the hand to the ground and repeat with the other hand.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between knees)
exercises.description: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the knees. It trains the calves and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and place an exercise ball between your lower back and the wall.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly in front of you.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your knees.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: exercise ball on the wall calf raise (tennis ball between ankles)
exercises.description: A standing calf raise with your back on an exercise ball against a wall, dumbbells in hand, and a ball squeezed between the ankles. It trains the calves.
steps: Stand facing a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Place an exercise ball between the wall and your lower back.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your arms extended by your sides.
Place a tennis ball between your ankles.
Raise your heels off the ground, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lying lower back stretch (bent knee)
exercises.description: A gentle lying stretch that draws the knee toward your chest to ease the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Pull one knee toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your lower back relaxed on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: lying lower back stretch
exercises.description: A lying stretch hugging both knees toward your chest to release the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back.
Pull both knees toward your chest.
Wrap your arms around your shins.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

exercises.name: abdominal stretch
exercises.description: A stretch lengthening the front of the trunk and the abs.
steps: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press up, lifting your chest.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Look straight ahead and relax.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: feet and ankles side to side stretch
exercises.description: A seated stretch moving the feet side to side to loosen the ankles.
steps: Sit with your legs extended.
Keep your heels on the floor.
Roll your feet slowly to the outside.
Then roll them inward.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: front toe touching
exercises.description: A standing movement reaching down to touch your toes for a warm-up of the hamstrings and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward and reach toward your toes.
Let your head hang relaxed.
Rise slowly.
Repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.name: two front toe touching
exercises.description: A wider standing toe touch that reaches down with both hands to warm up the legs and back.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart.
Hinge forward with both arms reaching down.
Touch the floor or your toes.
Rise slowly.
Repeat for the set.

exercises.name: side toe touching
exercises.description: A standing toe touch with a sideways reach to warm up the obliques and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with your feet wide apart.
Reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Keep your other arm extended behind you.
Rise and switch sides.
Alternate at an easy pace.

exercises.name: side two front toe touching
exercises.description: A wide-stance toe touch reaching both hands toward one side to loosen the trunk and legs.
steps: Stand with feet wide apart.
Turn your torso slightly to one side.
Reach both hands to the foot on that side.
Rise, then turn to the other side.
Repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.name: standing side bend
exercises.description: A standing side bend that loosens the trunk and works the obliques.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead.
Bend sideways, reaching over to the other side.
Return to upright.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: standing two side bend
exercises.description: A standing side bend with both arms overhead for a longer reach through the trunk.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Clasp your hands overhead.
Bend to one side, keeping your hips still.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

exercises.name: standing two side bend (bent arm)
exercises.description: A standing side bend with your elbows bent that loosens the sides of the trunk.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Place your hands behind your head with elbows out.
Bend to one side without twisting.
Return to the center.
Bend to the other side and repeat.

exercises.name: standing one arm circling
exercises.description: One-arm circles to warm up the shoulder joint.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm out to the side.
Make slow circles, gradually larger.
Reverse the direction.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: standing arms circling
exercises.description: Big arm circles with both arms to warm up the shoulders.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart.
Extend both arms out to the sides.
Make slow circles forward.
Then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: standing alternate arms circling
exercises.description: Big alternating arm circles that warm up the shoulder joints and loosen the upper back before pressing or pulling work.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms hanging at your sides.
Swing one arm forward, up and back in a large smooth circle.
As that arm finishes, start the same circle with the other arm.
Keep your ribs down and your neck relaxed.
Continue alternating for 20-30 seconds, then reverse the direction.

exercises.name: standing arms flinging
exercises.description: Open and close your arms in a relaxed fling to loosen the chest and shoulders. Handy as a quick warm-up.
steps: Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and arms out in front at chest height.
Fling both arms wide open to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Swing them back across your body, letting one arm cross over the other.
Keep the motion loose and controlled, without arching your back.
Repeat for 15-20 swings.

exercises.name: lying full leg raise
exercises.description: Raise both straight legs from the floor to work the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands under your hips or by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point at the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping just above the floor.
Keep your legs straight and do not let your back arch.

exercises.name: side plank leg raise
exercises.description: Hold a side plank and lift the top leg to work the outer hips and the side of your trunk.
steps: Lie on your side and prop yourself up on one forearm with elbow under the shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your top leg to about hip height, toes pointing forward.
Lower it a little without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: kneeling push up to child pose
exercises.description: A knee push-up that ends by sitting your hips back into child pose, building the chest and giving the back a stretch.
steps: Start on your hands and knees with hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to the start.
Push your hips back onto your heels and reach your arms forward into child pose.
Return to the start and repeat.

exercises.name: elbow push up
exercises.description: Move between a forearm plank and a high plank, one arm at a time, to train the core and shoulders.
steps: Start in a forearm plank with body in a straight line.
Press up onto one hand, then the other, into a high plank.
Lower back down to your forearms one arm at a time.
Keep your hips steady and avoid rocking side to side.
Alternate which arm leads each rep.

exercises.name: lying leg raise to side
exercises.description: Lower your legs to the side from a raised position to hit the lower abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides and legs raised straight up.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Lower both legs toward one side, stopping just above the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: run and hop
exercises.description: Run in place and add a hop to lift the heart rate and wake up the legs.
steps: Stand tall with feet under your hips.
Run on the spot at a steady pace, pumping your arms.
Every few steps, hop off one foot and land softly.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds at a pace you can hold.

exercises.name: run and jack jump
exercises.description: Run in place and throw in a jumping jack every few steps for a full-body cardio burst.
steps: Stand tall and start jogging on the spot.
After a few steps, jump your feet wide while raising your arms overhead.
Jump your feet back together and lower the arms.
Resume running and repeat the pattern.
Keep your landings soft and keep going for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: run and half knee bend
exercises.description: Alternate running in place with a shallow knee bend to keep the heart rate up while the legs work.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Jog on the spot for a few steps.
Pause into a shallow knee bend, hips back and chest up.
Stand tall and go straight back into running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: run and semi squat jump
exercises.description: Combine running in place with a half squat jump for a cardio drill that also trains the legs.
steps: Stand tall and run on the spot for a few steps.
Drop into a half squat with your chest up.
Jump up, swinging your arms.
Land softly with bent knees and go back to running.
Repeat for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: floor crunch feet on bench
exercises.description: A crunch with the calves resting on a bench, which keeps the hips bent and focuses the work on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a bench, knees bent at about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by squeezing your abs.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: floor twisting crunch feet on bench
exercises.description: A crunch with a rotation, with the legs on a bench, to train the abs and the obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl up and rotate so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

exercises.name: smith full squat
exercises.description: A full-depth back squat on the smith machine, where the fixed bar path gives extra stability. It trains the glutes, quads and thighs.
steps: Set up the smith machine with the barbell at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly turned out.
Step under the bar and position it across your upper back, resting on your traps.
Grip the bar with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the bar and take a step back, maintaining a stable stance.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, initiate the squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as your flexibility allows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted floor crunch feet on bench
exercises.description: A loaded crunch with the calves on a bench, for stronger abs once bodyweight crunches feel easy.
steps: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: weighted floor twisting crunch feet on bench
exercises.description: A loaded twisting crunch with the legs on a bench, building the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a light weight against your chest with both hands.
Curl up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: weighted muscle up
exercises.description: A muscle up with added weight, pulling from a hang up and over the bar into a dip position. It is an advanced move for lats, chest and triceps.
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, leading with your chest.
As you reach the top of the movement, transition your grip so that your palms are facing towards you.
Continue pulling yourself up until your chest reaches the bar, then pause for a moment.
Slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: elbow dips
exercises.description: A bench dip variation that bends the elbows to lower the hips. It trains the triceps and the front of the shoulders.
steps: Sit on the edge of a bench or chair with your hands gripping the edge next to your hips.
Slide your hips forward off the bench and straighten your legs, keeping your heels on the ground.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back close to the bench.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: korean dips
exercises.description: A deep dip variation performed on parallel bars with a different hand and body position. It trains the chest and triceps.
steps: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms extended and supporting your body weight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: impossible dips
exercises.description: An advanced dip on parallel bars with the legs crossed or lifted. It trains the triceps and chest through a tough range.
steps: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Bend your knees and cross your ankles.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted one hand pull up
exercises.description: An advanced one arm pull-up with added weight. It builds the lats and biceps and needs great pulling strength.
steps: Grab the pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arm fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar by bending your elbow and squeezing your back muscles.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Lower your body back down to the starting position with control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: stalder press
exercises.description: A gymnastics press where you shift your weight over the hands and lift the body up with straight arms. It trains the triceps and shoulders.
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended overhead.
Bend your knees slightly and engage your core.
Lower your body down into a squat position while keeping your arms extended overhead.
As you squat down, press your arms down towards the ground, engaging your triceps.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the squat, then push through your heels to stand back up while simultaneously raising your arms back overhead.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: elevator
exercises.description: A bodyweight hinge forward and back up again with the hands on the hips. It works the upper back and the muscles along the spine.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or cross them in front of your chest.
Keeping your back straight, slowly bend forward at the waist, lowering your upper body towards the ground.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly raise your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: archer pull up
exercises.description: A wide pull-up where you pull toward one hand while the other arm stays straight. It builds lat strength on the way to the one arm pull-up.
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
As you pull yourself up, bend one arm and bring your elbow towards your side, while keeping the other arm straight.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar and your bent arm is fully flexed.
Lower yourself back down with control, straightening the bent arm and repeating the movement on the other side.
Alternate sides with each repetition.

exercises.name: archer push up
exercises.description: A wide push-up that shifts the weight to one arm while the other arm stays straight. It trains the chest and triceps on the way to one arm push-ups.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend one arm straight out to the side, parallel to the ground.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, extending the opposite arm out to the side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: front lever reps
exercises.description: A rep-based version of the front lever, pulling the body in a horizontal line from a bar. It trains the lats, upper back and core.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Keeping your body straight, lift your legs up until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for 10-20 seconds.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: front lever
exercises.description: A gymnastics hold with the body straight and parallel to the ground while hanging from a bar. It trains the abs, lats and upper back.
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Simultaneously, lift your legs up and extend them straight out in front of you, keeping your body parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, aiming for a full front lever position.
To release, slowly lower your legs back down and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: back lever
exercises.description: A gymnastics hold hanging from a bar with the body horizontal and facing down. It trains the upper back, shoulders and core.
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your knees and tuck them towards your chest.
Slowly lift your legs up, keeping them straight, until your body is parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: straddle planche
exercises.description: A planche hold with the legs spread wide, which makes the lever shorter. It trains the shoulders, chest and core.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet spread wide apart.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders over your hands.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your hands to straighten your arms and lift your body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: full planche
exercises.description: A gymnastics hold where the body is parallel to the floor and balanced on the hands. It builds extreme strength in the shoulders, chest and core.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your fingers pointing forward.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, lifting your feet off the ground.
Continue shifting your weight forward until your body is parallel to the ground, balancing on your hands.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your feet back to the ground and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: lean planche
exercises.description: A leaning plank where the shoulders move forward past the hands. It trains the shoulders, wrists and core on the way to the planche.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your body straight.
Engage your core and slowly shift your weight forward, bringing your shoulders past your hands.
Keep your elbows slightly bent and your body straight as you lean forward.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: frog planche
exercises.description: A planche hold with the knees tucked in toward the arms. It builds shoulder, chest and wrist strength as a stepping stone to the full planche.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands shoulder-width apart and your feet together.
Bend your elbows and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your back straight.
As you lower your body, lift your feet off the ground and bring your knees towards your chest.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then extend your legs back out and push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: handstand
exercises.description: A balance hold on the hands with the body upside down, usually against a wall to start. It trains the shoulders, triceps and core.
steps: Find an open space with enough room to perform a handstand.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart, fingers pointing forward.
Kick your legs up towards the wall, using your core and shoulders to maintain balance.
Once in a handstand position, engage your triceps to support your body weight.
Hold the handstand for as long as you can maintain balance.
To come down, slowly lower your legs back to the ground.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: flag
exercises.description: A gymnastics hold where you grip a vertical pole and hold your body out to the side. It trains the obliques, shoulders and lats.
steps: Start by gripping a vertical pole with both hands, palms facing each other, and arms fully extended.
Engage your core and lift your legs off the ground, keeping them straight.
Using your core and upper body strength, raise your legs until they are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for as long as you can, maintaining a straight body line.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: skin the cat
exercises.description: A ring or bar move where you tuck up, pass the legs through the arms and then roll over the bar. It trains the back and shoulder mobility.
steps: Start by hanging from a bar with your arms fully extended and your body relaxed.
Engage your core and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
Continue to lift your legs up and over your head, allowing your body to pass through the arms.
Once your legs are fully extended over your head, begin to lower them back down towards the starting position.
As you lower your legs, allow your body to pass back through the arms until you are hanging with your arms fully extended again.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell thruster
exercises.description: A front squat followed by an overhead press in one fluid movement with a barbell. It trains the legs, shoulders and heart rate.
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back.
As you reach the bottom of the squat, explosively drive through your heels to stand up, simultaneously pressing the barbell overhead.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height as you lower back into the squat position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: strongman fingal's fingers
exercises.description: A strongman grip challenge based on the legend of Fingal's fingers. It tests hand and forearm strength.
steps: Set up the implement in front of you.
Grip it firmly with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Lift it using your legs and hips.
Hold it steady for a moment.
Lower it under control.

exercises.name: strongman keg toss
exercises.description: An explosive strongman lift where you heave a heavy keg up and over a bar behind you. It builds hip power and total body drive.
steps: Stand with feet wide and the keg between your legs, gripping it low with both hands.
Hinge at the hips, keep your chest up and your back flat.
Drive your hips forward hard and pull the keg up your body.
Extend fully and throw the keg up and back over the bar.
Reset, step back to the start and repeat with control.

exercises.name: barbell weighted deadlift
exercises.description: A classic deadlift lifting a loaded barbell from the floor to hip height. It trains the whole posterior chain and your grip.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart and the bar over your mid foot.
Hinge down, grip the bar just outside your legs and brace your core.
Push the floor away and keep the bar close as you stand up.
Lock out with hips and knees extended and shoulders back.
Lower the bar along your legs with a flat back to the floor.

exercises.name: barbell weighted front chest squat
exercises.description: A squat with the barbell racked across the front of your shoulders. The front load keeps you upright and hits the quads hard.
steps: Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high and hands steadying it.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart and brace your core.
Sit down between your hips, keeping your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your whole foot and keep your elbows up the whole way.

exercises.name: barbell weighted bench press
exercises.description: The standard flat bench press with a loaded barbell, the staple lift for chest size and pressing strength.
steps: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it over your chest.
Lower the bar under control to your mid chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet planted throughout.

exercises.name: barbell front squat (from blocks)
exercises.description: A front squat started from a rack or blocks height, so you begin the rep with the bar already set. It builds quad and trunk strength.
steps: Set the bar on the blocks or rack at front shoulder height.
Step in, rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Lift it off and stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with a tall chest until your thighs pass parallel.
Stand back up by driving through your feet, then re-rack the bar.

exercises.name: weighted muscle up (on bar)
exercises.description: A weighted muscle up performed with the added load on a bar. An advanced pull and dip that trains the lats, chest and triceps.
steps: Start by hanging from a pull-up bar with your palms facing away from you and your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Bend your elbows and pull your chest towards the bar, keeping your body straight.
Once your chest reaches the bar, push down with your hands and drive your elbows back, lifting your body above the bar.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: weighted straight bar dip
exercises.description: A weighted dip on a straight bar or parallel bars. It builds the chest, triceps and shoulders with added resistance.
steps: Position yourself between parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: straddle maltese
exercises.description: A ring hold with the arms out and the legs straddled. It builds the chest and shoulders and is a stepping stone toward the full maltese.
steps: Start by hanging from a pair of rings with your arms fully extended and your body in a straight line.
Spread your legs wide apart, forming a straddle position.
Engage your core and slowly lower your body until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Hold this position for a few seconds, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: full maltese
exercises.description: An advanced gymnastics hold on rings with the arms out wide and the body straight. It demands huge strength in the chest, shoulders and core.
steps: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart and your arms extended straight out to the sides.
Slowly lean forward, keeping your arms straight, until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and hold this position for a few seconds.
Return to the starting position by pushing through your feet and standing back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell weightlifting complex
exercises.description: A flowing series of barbell lifts done back to back without putting the bar down. It works your whole body and your conditioning.
steps: Load a light to moderate barbell and stand over it with feet hip width apart.
Perform the first lift of your chosen sequence, such as a deadlift.
Move straight into the next lift without setting the bar down.
Keep each rep crisp with a braced core and a flat back.
Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.

exercises.name: strongman car flip
exercises.description: A strongman event where you lift one side of a heavy vehicle and flip it over. It takes full body strength and leg drive.
steps: Squat low at the edge of the vehicle with a flat back and hands underneath.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Drive hard through your legs and lift the edge to hip height.
Shift your hands and push up and over with your legs and arms.
Let it roll over fully, then step back and reset for the next flip.

exercises.name: swing 360
exercises.description: A rotating movement that swings the arms and torso in a full circle. It gets the heart rate up and loosens the trunk.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold your arms straight out in front of you, parallel to the ground.
Engage your core and swing your arms in a circular motion, rotating your torso as you do so.
Continue the circular motion, swinging your arms and rotating your torso for the desired number of repetitions.
Remember to breathe throughout the exercise.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying on floor hammer press
exercises.description: A floor press with palms facing each other, which is kind to your shoulders. It trains the chest and triceps through a short range.
steps: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell hammer grip incline bench two arm row
exercises.description: A chest supported row on an incline bench with a neutral grip. It targets the mid back with little strain on your lower back.
steps: Set a bench to a low incline and lie chest down on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, leading with your elbows.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension and repeat.

exercises.name: resistance band rear fly
exercises.description: A band version of the reverse fly that works the back of your shoulders and upper back, handy for posture.
steps: Hold the band in both hands in front of you with arms straight.
Stand tall with a soft knee bend and your core tight.
Pull your hands apart and out to the sides at shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap back.

exercises.name: kettlebell deadlift
exercises.description: A beginner friendly deadlift with a kettlebell between your feet. It teaches the hip hinge and builds glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart and the kettlebell between your feet.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to grab the handle with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet and stand tall, squeezing your glutes.
Hinge back down to set the kettlebell on the floor and repeat.

exercises.name: kettlebell half turkish get up
exercises.description: The first half of a turkish get up, moving from lying to a seated position with the kettlebell overhead. It builds shoulder stability and core strength.
steps: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the bell and your arm vertical.
Roll onto the opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Come up to a tall seated position with your arm still locked overhead.
Reverse the steps slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band alternate incline chest press with twist
exercises.description: An alternating band press angled upward, with a torso twist added to bring in your core. It works the upper chest and trunk together.
steps: Anchor a band low behind you and hold the handles at chest height.
Stand in a split stance with your core braced.
Press one hand up and forward while rotating your torso slightly.
Return under control and press with the other arm.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides for the full set.

exercises.name: band alternate low row with twist
exercises.description: An alternating band row with a rotation, training your back and the muscles that twist your trunk.
steps: Anchor a band in front of you at low height and hold both handles.
Stand in a staggered stance with arms extended.
Pull one handle back toward your hip while rotating your torso.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: band alternate lat pulldown with twist
exercises.description: A standing band pulldown done one arm at a time with a trunk twist. It trains your lats and adds core work.
steps: Anchor a band high in front of you and hold both handles with arms overhead.
Stand tall in a staggered stance.
Pull one handle down toward your ribs while rotating your torso.
Keep your elbow tucked and shoulder down.
Return slowly and switch to the other arm.

exercises.name: full planche push-up
exercises.description: A push-up from the planche position with the feet off the ground. It is an elite bodyweight move for the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Engage your core and lower your body down towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
As you lower yourself, lean your body forward and lift your feet off the ground, balancing on your hands.
Continue to lower your body until your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to lift your body back up to the starting position.
Maintain a straight line from your head to your heels throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: barbell complex stiff leg deadlift clean step
exercises.description: A barbell complex that links a stiff leg deadlift into a clean and then a step. It builds posterior chain power and rhythm.
steps: Stand holding a light barbell with an overhand grip at thigh height.
Lower the bar down your legs with soft knees and a flat back.
Stand up, then pull the bar explosively and catch it on your shoulders.
Take a controlled step forward with the bar racked.
Step back, lower the bar and begin the next round.

exercises.name: roman chair sit up
exercises.description: A sit up on a roman chair that gives you a big range of motion for your abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the roman chair with your feet locked under the pads.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back slightly.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your thighs.
Pause at the top and keep your neck relaxed.
Lower back slowly under control and repeat.

exercises.name: oblique crunches with bent knee leg lift
exercises.description: A side crunch combined with a bent knee lift. It trains the obliques and lower abs together.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your head and knees bent.
Lift your shoulders and knees at the same time.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.
Alternate sides through the set.

exercises.name: oblique crunches with straight leg lift
exercises.description: A twisting crunch with your legs lifted straight, making your core work harder through the lever.
steps: Lie on your back with legs raised straight and hands by your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Rotate to bring one elbow toward the opposite hip.
Keep your legs steady and low back pressed down.
Return slowly and alternate sides.

exercises.name: weighted stability ball crunch (full range)
exercises.description: A crunch over a stability ball while holding a weight, using the ball for a longer range of motion in your abs.
steps: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your back is supported.
Hold a weight against your chest.
Let your torso drape back over the ball for a full stretch.
Curl up until your upper back clears the ball.
Lower slowly back into the stretch and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm wide grip bench press
exercises.description: A one arm dumbbell bench press with a wide elbow path, stressing the chest while your core resists rotation.
steps: Lie on a bench with one dumbbell held over your chest.
Place your free arm on your stomach or out to the side.
Lower the dumbbell with elbow flared out until you feel a chest stretch.
Press it back up over your chest.
Keep your torso square, then switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm floor fly
exercises.description: A one arm fly lying on the floor, a safe way to stretch and load the chest with a limited range.
steps: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in one hand over your chest.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Open your arm out to the side until your upper arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the dumbbell back above you.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell glute bridge
exercises.description: A loaded hip bridge that targets your glutes. Resting a dumbbell on your hips adds resistance.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips toward the ceiling.
Squeeze your glutes hard at the top.
Lower your hips slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell v up
exercises.description: A v up while holding a dumbbell, raising your arms and legs together to challenge the abs.
steps: Lie flat with legs straight and a dumbbell held in both hands overhead.
Brace your core.
Lift your arms and legs together, forming a V shape.
Touch the dumbbell near your shins.
Lower back down slowly without dropping your legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell side bridge
exercises.description: A side plank with a dumbbell held on your hip or raised overhead. It trains the obliques and lateral stability.
steps: Lie on one side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Hold a dumbbell on your top hip.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds without sagging.
Lower, then repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: dumbbell single stiff leg deadlift
exercises.description: A single leg hinge holding a dumbbell, which trains your hamstrings, glutes and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with a dumbbell in the opposite hand or both hands.
Keep a soft bend in your standing knee.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower the dumbbell toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand back up, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm lunge
exercises.description: A lunge holding a dumbbell in one hand. The uneven load makes your core work to keep you balanced.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Alternate legs and switch the dumbbell hand halfway.

exercises.name: dumbbell stiff leg deadlift v. 2
exercises.description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs holding dumbbells. It stretches and strengthens the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Stand with feet hip width apart holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees slightly bent and back flat.
Push your hips back and slide the dumbbells down your legs.
Stop when you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: dumbbell lunge v. 2
exercises.description: A dumbbell lunge variation for leg strength and balance, working quads and glutes.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and torso upright.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

exercises.name: cable y raise
exercises.description: A cable raise that moves your arms into a Y shape, building the shoulders and the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
steps: Set the pulleys low and hold a handle in each hand, arms crossed in front.
Stand tall with a slight lean forward.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y shape.
Keep your thumbs pointing up and shoulders down.
Lower slowly to the start.

exercises.name: lever lateral raise v. 2
exercises.description: A machine lateral raise that isolates the side delts with smooth, guided resistance.
steps: Adjust the seat so your shoulders line up with the machine pivots.
Sit tall and place your arms against the pads.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the weights rest.

exercises.name: lever crossovers
exercises.description: A machine crossover that brings your arms together across the body, isolating the chest.
steps: Set the seat height and grip the handles with a slight elbow bend.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Sweep your arms together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest at the center.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: hand spring wrist curl
exercises.description: A wrist curl using a hand grip spring, strengthening your forearms and grip.
steps: Sit with a forearm resting on your thigh or a bench, palm up.
Hold the hand spring in that hand.
Squeeze the handles together by curling your wrist and fingers.
Hold briefly at full squeeze.
Release slowly, finish your reps, then switch hands.

exercises.name: dumbbell curl to press
exercises.description: Curl the dumbbells and keep going into an overhead press, training the arms and shoulders in one smooth rep.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height without swinging.
Rotate your wrists slightly and press the weights overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then back down to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: incline shoulder tap
exercises.description: A plank on an incline where you tap each shoulder, building core and shoulder stability.
steps: Place your hands on a bench or box and extend into a plank position.
Spread your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips level and body in a straight line.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

exercises.name: cable front squat
exercises.description: A squat with a cable held at your chest, keeping you upright while the quads and glutes work.
steps: Set the cable low and hold the handle at your chest.
Step back to create tension and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down and back into a squat with your chest tall.
Descend until your thighs are parallel.
Drive up through your heels.

exercises.name: cable lateral lunge
exercises.description: A sideways lunge against cable tension, training glutes, inner thighs and side to side strength.
steps: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand sideways to the stack.
Step wide to one side and sit back into that hip.
Keep the other leg straight and feet flat.
Push off your bent leg to return to center.
Complete the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable lunge
exercises.description: A lunge with cable resistance, building leg strength with a constant load.
steps: Hold a cable handle at chest height and step away from the stack.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front heel down.
Push back to standing and alternate legs.

exercises.name: cable kneeling pull through
exercises.description: A kneeling hip hinge with a cable pulled between your legs. It teaches the hinge and trains glutes with little spinal load.
steps: Kneel facing away from a low cable with a rope held between your legs.
Sit your hips back with a flat back.
Let the rope pull your hands back between your knees.
Drive your hips forward to a tall kneeling position.
Squeeze your glutes at the top and repeat.

exercises.name: cable one arm high pulley overhead tricep extension
exercises.description: A single arm overhead extension on a high pulley that stretches and loads the long head of the triceps.
steps: Face away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with one hand.
Stand in a split stance with your elbow pointing up.
Extend your arm forward and up until it is straight.
Keep your upper arm still.
Return slowly and switch arms after the set.

exercises.name: cable front squat v. 2
exercises.description: A second take on the cable front squat, holding the handle at your chest to stay upright and hit the quads.
steps: Set the cable low and hold the handle against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a deep squat, chest tall.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Press through your heels back to standing.

exercises.name: cable lateral lunge v. 2
exercises.description: A second variation of the cable side lunge for the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Hold a cable handle at chest height, standing sideways to the stack.
Step wide to the side and bend that knee.
Push your hips back and keep your chest up.
Push off the bent leg to return.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable forward lunge
exercises.description: A forward stepping lunge with cable tension, working quads and glutes.
steps: Hold a low cable handle at your chest and stand facing away from the stack.
Take a big step forward.
Drop your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee stable over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

exercises.name: cable seated on floor row with rope
exercises.description: A floor seated cable row using a rope, which lets you pull the hands apart and squeeze the mid back.
steps: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with legs extended and the rope in your hands.
Sit tall with a straight back.
Pull the rope toward your lower chest, spreading your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable parallel grip lat pulldown on floor
exercises.description: A lat pulldown done from the floor with a neutral grip, focusing on the lats.
steps: Kneel or sit on the floor under a high cable with a parallel grip handle.
Sit tall and lean back slightly.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest.
Drive your elbows down and back.
Return slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.name: cable standing chest press
exercises.description: A standing press with cables that trains the chest while your core keeps you steady.
steps: Set the cables at chest height and hold a handle in each hand.
Step forward into a split stance.
Press the handles forward until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
Return slowly with control.

exercises.name: bear crawl
exercises.description: A crawl on hands and feet with the knees hovering off the floor. It works the shoulders, core and legs together.
steps: Start on all fours with your hands directly under your shoulders and your knees directly under your hips.
Lift your knees slightly off the ground, keeping your back flat and your core engaged.
Move your right hand and left foot forward simultaneously, followed by your left hand and right foot.
Continue crawling forward, alternating your hand and foot movements.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core tight throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired distance or time.

exercises.name: skater hops
exercises.description: A side-to-side hop that mimics a speed skater, landing on one foot at a time. It builds leg power and balance.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees slightly and jump to the right, landing on your right foot.
As you land, swing your left leg behind your right leg and tap the ground with your left toes.
Immediately jump to the left, landing on your left foot.
As you land, swing your right leg behind your left leg and tap the ground with your right toes.
Continue alternating sides, jumping and tapping the ground with each leg.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

exercises.name: cable lying close press
exercises.description: A close grip press lying down with a cable, putting emphasis on the triceps.
steps: Lie on a bench with the cable behind your head and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Start with arms bent over your chest.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows close to your body.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable standing close press
exercises.description: A standing close grip cable press that focuses on the triceps.
steps: Set the cable at chest height and hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Stand in a split stance, core tight.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your elbows tucked in.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: cable seating close press
exercises.description: A seated close grip cable press for the triceps with a stable base.
steps: Sit on a bench facing away from a cable at chest height.
Hold the handle with a narrow grip.
Press forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your back against the pad.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: hawaiian squat
exercises.description: A deep bodyweight squat variation that builds leg strength and hip mobility.
steps: Stand with feet slightly wider than your shoulders and toes turned out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips down and back into a deep squat.
Pause at the bottom without rounding your back.
Drive through your feet to stand up.

exercises.name: shrimp squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat with the back foot held behind you, demanding strong quads and good balance.
steps: Stand on one leg and bend the other knee, holding that foot behind you.
Reach your free arm forward for balance.
Lower slowly until the back knee lightly touches the floor.
Drive through the front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: skater squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat with the free leg swept behind, like a speed skater, for leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other knee bent and the foot lifted behind you.
Swing your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower on the standing leg.
Lightly tap the back knee near the floor.
Stand up through the front foot, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell swing
exercises.description: A hip driven swing using a dumbbell, building power in your glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand with feet wider than hips and hold one dumbbell in both hands.
Hinge at the hips and swing the dumbbell between your legs.
Snap your hips forward to swing it to chest height.
Let your arms stay relaxed.
Guide it back down and hinge into the next rep.

exercises.name: battling ropes alternate arms squat
exercises.description: Squatting while whipping the battle ropes with alternating arms. It raises your heart rate and works legs and shoulders.
steps: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Sit into a squat position.
Whip the ropes up and down with alternating arms.
Keep your chest tall and your knees stable.
Continue for a set time at a steady pace.

exercises.name: battling ropes alternate arms jump squat
exercises.description: A high energy move combining a jump squat with alternating rope waves. It builds power and conditioning.
steps: Hold the rope ends and stand in a squat position.
Start waving the ropes with alternating arms.
Jump up explosively and land softly.
Go straight into the next squat.
Keep going for a set time and rest when needed.

exercises.name: battling ropes side to side arms
exercises.description: Swinging the ropes from side to side to condition your shoulders and trunk.
steps: Hold the rope ends in an athletic stance with knees bent.
Swing both ropes to one side.
Swing them across to the other side in a flowing motion.
Rotate through your torso a little.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set time.

exercises.name: battling ropes alternate arms side lunge
exercises.description: Side lunges while whipping the ropes alternately, working legs, shoulders and heart.
steps: Hold the rope ends and stand with feet together.
Step wide to one side and sit into a side lunge.
Whip the ropes alternately with your arms.
Push back to the middle.
Alternate sides and keep the waves going.

exercises.name: battling ropes inside circle
exercises.description: Drawing circles with the ropes toward each other. It builds shoulder endurance.
steps: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn inward.
Keep the circles even and large.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Continue for a set time then rest.

exercises.name: battling ropes outside circle
exercises.description: Drawing outward circles with the ropes, training shoulders and conditioning.
steps: Stand with knees bent and a rope end in each hand.
Move your arms in circles that turn outward.
Keep the movement smooth and even.
Keep your core tight.
Continue for a set time.

exercises.name: battling ropes fly
exercises.description: Sweeping the ropes out and in like a fly, hitting the shoulders and upper body.
steps: Stand with knees bent, a rope end in each hand and arms in front.
Sweep your arms out wide and slightly up.
Bring them back together in front of you.
Keep a steady rhythm.
Continue for a set time.

exercises.name: battling ropes jumping jack
exercises.description: A jumping jack with rope waves added, so arms and legs both work hard.
steps: Hold the rope ends with feet together.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms and making waves.
Jump back to the start.
Keep your landings soft.
Keep a steady pace for the set time.

exercises.name: battling ropes russian twist
exercises.description: A seated twist where you swing the ropes side to side. It trains the obliques and conditioning.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the rope ends in front of you.
Twist your torso to one side and swing the ropes.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted and continue for the set time.

exercises.name: battling ropes split jump
exercises.description: Jumping lunges while waving the ropes, a demanding mix of power and cardio.
steps: Hold the rope ends and stand in a split stance.
Start making waves with your arms.
Jump and switch legs in mid air.
Land softly in a lunge.
Keep switching for the set time.

exercises.name: battling ropes high waves
exercises.description: Big overhead wave style rope slams that fire up the shoulders and heart.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and a rope end in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly.
Raise both arms overhead and slam the ropes down.
Repeat quickly to make big waves.
Keep your core braced for the set time.

exercises.name: battling ropes low waves
exercises.description: Alternating or double low waves with heavy ropes that spike your heart rate and work the shoulders, arms and core.
steps: Hold one rope end in each hand and stand in a quarter squat.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Whip the ropes down and up so waves travel low along the floor.
Keep the waves even and your hips stable.
Work for 20-30 seconds at a hard pace.
Rest, then repeat for several rounds.

exercises.name: inverted row under table
exercises.description: Pull your chest up to the underside of a sturdy table to train the back and arms using your own weight.
steps: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Extend your legs with heels on the floor and body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower with control until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

exercises.name: inverted row bent knee under table
exercises.description: An easier inverted row with bent knees, pulling up to a sturdy table to build back strength.
steps: Lie under a sturdy table and grip the edge with both hands.
Bend your knees and plant your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line from knees to shoulders.
Pull your chest to the table edge, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: pike push up (on bench) v. 2
exercises.description: A pike push-up with your feet on a bench, loading the shoulders more than a flat push-up does.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and your hands on the floor, hips piked high.
Walk your hands back until your body forms an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and lower your head toward the floor.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your core tight throughout.

exercises.name: battling ropes power slam
exercises.description: An explosive overhead rope slam that builds conditioning and power through the whole body.
steps: Hold a rope end in each hand and stand in an athletic stance.
Raise both ropes overhead while rising onto your toes.
Slam them down hard while dropping into a squat.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Reset and repeat at a steady, powerful pace.
Work in bursts of 15-30 seconds.

exercises.name: lever seated leg press v. 2
exercises.description: A seated machine press that loads the thighs and glutes with a stable path.
steps: Sit on the machine and set your back firmly against the pad.
Place your feet on the platform about shoulder-width apart.
Release the safety and lower the weight until your knees bend to about 90 degrees.
Press through your whole foot to extend your legs.
Stop just short of locking your knees.
Lower under control and repeat.

exercises.name: lever seated leg extension v. 2
exercises.description: A machine isolation move for the front of the thighs.
steps: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad.
Hook your lower shins under the roller and align your knees with the pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Avoid swinging or lifting your hips.

exercises.name: dips between chairs
exercises.description: Bodyweight dips using two sturdy chairs, working the triceps and chest.
steps: Place two sturdy chairs facing each other and brace them against a wall.
Grip the seats, lift your body and straighten your arms.
Lower yourself by bending your elbows until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your elbows pointing back and your chest up.
Press up to straight arms.
Make sure the chairs cannot slide.

exercises.name: inverted row between chairs
exercises.description: A bodyweight row under a sturdy support between two chairs for the upper back and arms.
steps: Set a sturdy bar or table edge between two stable chairs and lie under it.
Grip the support with straight arms and your body in a plank line.
Pull your chest toward the support.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

exercises.name: sit up with chair assisted
exercises.description: A sit-up with your feet or legs supported on a chair to focus on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back and rest your lower legs on a chair seat, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Do not pull on your neck.

exercises.name: calf raise from deficit with chair supported
exercises.description: A calf raise from a raised step with a chair for balance, giving a deeper stretch and fuller range.
steps: Stand with the balls of your feet on a step edge, holding a chair for balance.
Let your heels drop below the step to stretch your calves.
Rise as high onto your toes as you can.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower slowly into the deep stretch.
Keep your knees almost straight.

exercises.name: bent over twist
exercises.description: A standing bent-over rotation that mobilizes the spine and works the obliques.
steps: Stand with feet wide and hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Extend your arms out to the sides.
Rotate your torso and reach one hand toward the opposite foot.
Return through the middle and twist to the other side.
Move with control and keep your hips square.
Do 10-12 reps per side.

exercises.name: narrow squat from deficit
exercises.description: A close-stance squat with your heels raised on a small step to emphasize the quads.
steps: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your feet close together.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down, keeping your knees over your toes.
Go as deep as comfortable with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet.
Stand tall without locking out hard.

exercises.name: lying leg hip raise on floor
exercises.description: A floor leg raise that lifts the hips off the ground for a stronger lower-abs contraction.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or holding something behind your head.
Raise your legs to vertical.
Lift your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Lower your legs without arching your back.
Keep movements smooth, not swinging.

exercises.name: glute march
exercises.description: A hip-bridge hold with alternating knee lifts that trains glutes and pelvic stability.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Raise one knee toward your chest without letting your hips drop.
Place that foot down and lift the other.
Keep squeezing your glutes the whole time.
Continue alternating for 10-20 marches.

exercises.name: sliding leg curl on floor with towel
exercises.description: A hamstring curl where your heels slide on a towel over a smooth floor.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your heels away until your legs are nearly straight.
Pull your heels back toward your hips.
Keep your hips high throughout.
Move slowly to stay in control.

exercises.name: flexion and extension hip stretch
