Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral throughout.

exercises.name: cable bent over row
exercises.description: A hinged row on the cable stack that trains the mid back and lats with steady tension all the way through.
steps: Attach a handle or bar to a low pulley and grab it.
Step back and hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Start with your arms extended toward the pulley.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

exercises.name: weighted plate bent over row
exercises.description: A rowing movement holding a weight plate, good for the mid back and for grip strength.
steps: Hold a weight plate firmly with both hands at its edges.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Let the plate hang below your chest with arms extended.
Pull the plate toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
Keep your hips still and your neck neutral.

exercises.name: stability ball body saw
exercises.description: A plank with your forearms on a stability ball, rocking back and forth to challenge deep core control.
steps: Place your forearms on a stability ball and extend your legs into a plank.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body forms a straight line.
Slowly push your elbows forward a few inches by shifting your body weight.
Pull back to the start without letting your hips sag.
Keep the movement small and controlled.
Repeat for time or reps.

exercises.name: resistance band long jump
exercises.description: An explosive forward jump against band resistance that builds power in the legs and hips.
steps: Anchor a band behind you and loop it around your hips.
Stand tall with feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump forward as far as you can against the band.
Land softly on both feet with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.name: bulgarian jump squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat jump with the rear foot elevated, building explosive power and balance in each leg.
steps: Stand facing away from a bench and rest the top of one foot on it.
Lower into a split squat until your front thigh is about parallel.
Drive up explosively through your front foot so it leaves the floor.
Land softly and sink straight back into the next rep.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee stable.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kettlebell burpee
exercises.description: A burpee that adds a kettlebell for extra load, giving you a hard full-body conditioning move.
steps: Stand with a kettlebell on the floor between your feet.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor beside it, or on the handle if you prefer.
Jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest, push up, then jump your feet back in.
Grab the kettlebell and stand, then press or swing it overhead if you like.
Return it to the floor and repeat.

exercises.name: sprinter crunch
exercises.description: A running-style crunch where opposite elbow and knee drive together to work the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands lightly behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor and bring one knee toward the opposite elbow.
Extend the other leg out low above the floor.
Switch sides in a smooth running rhythm.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set.

exercises.name: resistance band anti rotation dead bug
exercises.description: A dead bug with a band pulling you sideways, so your core works hard to keep your torso from twisting.
steps: Anchor a band at the side and lie on your back, holding the band above your chest with both hands.
Raise your knees to a tabletop position.
Brace your core so the band does not pull you sideways.
Slowly extend one leg and the opposite arm back.
Return and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat on the floor.

exercises.name: duck walk
exercises.description: A walk in a deep squat that challenges the quads, hips and balance.
steps: Lower into a deep squat with your chest up.
Place your hands on your hips or in front of you for balance.
Step forward with one foot, keeping the squat low.
Step with the other foot and continue walking.
Keep your heels down and your back straight.
Walk for a set distance or time.

exercises.name: cable fly with chest supported
exercises.description: A cable fly with your chest against a bench, which isolates the pecs with steady tension.
steps: Set the pulleys at about shoulder height and position an incline bench facing the stack, chest against the pad.
Hold a handle in each hand with arms out to the sides.
With a slight bend in your elbows, sweep your arms forward in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as the handles meet.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch across the chest.

exercises.name: cable seated chest fly
exercises.description: A seated fly on the cable machine that isolates the chest with constant tension.
steps: Sit on a bench between two cable stacks with the pulleys at chest height.
Grab a handle in each hand and hold your arms out with soft elbows.
Press your back firmly into the bench.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest in a wide arc.
Squeeze, then open your arms slowly.
Stop when you feel a good stretch.

exercises.name: frog reverse hyperextension (on a bench)
exercises.description: A reverse hyperextension with the legs in a frog position, aimed at the glutes and lower back.
steps: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge and hold the bench for support.
Let your legs hang and bring the soles of your feet together, knees out.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your legs up behind you.
Pause when your thighs are in line with your torso.
Lower slowly and repeat.
Avoid arching your lower back too far.

exercises.name: barbell front chest squat with resistance band
exercises.description: A front squat with a band adding resistance, building strong quads and a tall, braced torso.
steps: Set up a band under your feet or anchored to the floor and attach it to the bar.
Rest the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and brace your core.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels against the band tension.
Keep your chest tall throughout.

exercises.name: heel drops
exercises.description: A controlled drop of the heels off a step that stretches and strengthens the calves and ankles.
steps: Stand on the edge of a step with the balls of your feet on it.
Hold a rail for balance.
Rise onto your toes.
Slowly lower your heels below the step level.
Pause and feel the stretch in your calves.
Raise up and repeat.

exercises.name: barbell hip thrust with resistance band
exercises.description: A barbell hip thrust with a band adding extra tension at the top, focused on the glutes.
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the loaded bar across your hips.
Set a band over your hips or around your thighs as the setup allows.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level with the floor.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: smith kneeling hip thrust
exercises.description: A kneeling hip thrust on the Smith machine that trains hip extension and the glutes.
steps: Set the bar on the Smith machine at a low height and kneel facing away from it.
Place the bar across your hips with a pad for comfort.
Keep your torso upright and your core braced.
Thrust your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Slowly return to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: resistance band 45 degrees hyperextension
exercises.description: A hyperextension on an angled bench with a band adding load for the lower back and glutes.
steps: Set up on a 45 degree hyperextension bench with your hips just over the pad.
Loop a band across your upper back and under your feet or the base.
Cross your arms over your chest or hold them lightly.
Lower your torso with a straight back.
Raise your torso until your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch at the top.

exercises.name: weighted squat jump with plate
exercises.description: A jump squat holding a plate at your chest, building leg power.
steps: Hold a weight plate close to your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are near parallel.
Jump up explosively, extending your hips, knees and ankles.
Land softly and go straight into the next rep.
Keep your chest up throughout.

exercises.name: medicine ball squat jump
exercises.description: A squat jump while holding a medicine ball, building explosive power in the legs.
steps: Hold a medicine ball at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sink into a squat with your chest up.
Jump up as high as you can.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.name: resistance band jump squat
exercises.description: A jump squat with a band adding resistance for a more powerful leg drive.
steps: Stand on a band with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the other end at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel.
Jump up explosively against the band.
Land softly through your toes and heels.
Sink immediately into the next squat.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: dumbbell poliquin lateral raise
exercises.description: A lateral raise variation with a slight forward lean that hits the side delts with extra range.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, standing with a slight forward lean.
Start with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing in.
Raise your arms out and up in a slight arc until about shoulder height.
Lead with your elbows and keep your wrists neutral.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly.
Avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.name: cable leaning lateral raise
exercises.description: A one-arm lateral raise leaning away from a cable stack, giving constant tension on the side delt.
steps: Stand sideways to a low pulley and hold the handle with the far hand.
Hold the upright support with the other hand and lean away from the machine.
Start with your working arm across your body.
Raise it out to shoulder height with a soft elbow.
Lower slowly under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lever seated full crunch
exercises.description: A seated machine crunch that works the full abdominal wall with adjustable resistance.
steps: Adjust the seat and sit with the pads in position.
Hold the handles and keep your feet planted.
Exhale and curl your torso forward, bringing your ribs toward your hips.
Squeeze your abs at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your hips on the seat.

exercises.name: lever seated left side crunch
exercises.description: A seated machine crunch to the left side that trains the obliques.
steps: Sit in the machine with the pads positioned for a left side crunch.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Exhale and crunch your torso toward the left.
Squeeze your side at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Avoid using momentum.

exercises.name: lever seated right side crunch
exercises.description: A seated machine crunch to the right side that trains the obliques.
steps: Sit in the machine with the pads positioned for a right side crunch.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Exhale and crunch your torso toward the right.
Squeeze your side at the bottom.
Return slowly to the start.
Avoid using momentum.

exercises.name: double under jump rope
exercises.description: A skipping move where the rope passes twice under your feet for each jump, great for conditioning and coordination.
steps: Hold the rope handles at your hips with your elbows close.
Stand tall and start with a few normal jumps.
Jump a little higher and spin the rope faster with your wrists.
Let the rope pass twice under your feet before landing.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your jumps small and your body upright.

exercises.name: dumbbell complex push up row clean and press
exercises.description: A flowing combo of push-up, row, clean and press that works the whole body with a pair of dumbbells.
steps: Start in a push-up position with your hands on two dumbbells.
Do a push-up, then row one dumbbell to your ribs and switch sides.
Jump or step your feet toward your hands and stand up, cleaning the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Press them overhead.
Lower to the floor and return to the push-up position.
Move smoothly and keep your core tight.

exercises.name: jump box over
exercises.description: A jump onto and over a box that builds explosive leg power and coordination.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and load your hips.
Jump onto the box and land softly with bent knees.
Step or hop down on the other side.
Turn around and repeat in the other direction.
Reset your balance between reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm snatch
exercises.description: A one-armed dumbbell snatch, pulling the weight from the floor to overhead in one explosive movement. It trains the hips, legs and shoulders.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Lower the dumbbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body.
Explosively extend your hips, knees, and ankles, driving the dumbbell upwards in a straight line.
As the dumbbell reaches shoulder height, quickly rotate your hand and punch it overhead, fully extending your arm.
Catch the dumbbell overhead with a slight bend in your knees and hips.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.

exercises.name: frog sit up
exercises.description: A sit-up with the legs in a frog position that works the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Place your hands behind your head or reach forward.
Curl up and sit all the way up.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: hanging knees to elbows
exercises.description: A hanging leg raise where the knees travel up to the elbows, working the abs and hip flexors hard.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Brace your core and tuck your knees.
Raise your knees up toward your elbows.
Curl your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Repeat for the desired reps.

exercises.name: hanging toes to bar
exercises.description: A tough hanging core move that brings the toes all the way up to the bar.
steps: Hang from a bar with a firm grip.
Engage your lats and brace your core.
Raise your straight legs up until your toes touch the bar.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs with control.
Avoid excessive swinging.

exercises.name: jump on fit box
exercises.description: A box jump that builds explosive power in the legs and hips.
steps: Stand facing a plyo box with feet shoulder-width apart.
Swing your arms back and bend your knees.
Jump up and land softly on top of the box with both feet.
Stand fully upright at the top.
Step down carefully.
Reset and repeat.

exercises.name: assault bike run
exercises.description: A hard-effort ride on an air bike that gets your heart rate up and trains the legs and arms.
steps: Adjust the seat height and sit on the bike.
Grip the handles and push and pull with your arms.
Pedal at a steady, strong pace.
Increase the effort for intervals.
Keep your breathing controlled.
Ride for a set time or distance.

exercises.name: dumbbell stiff leg deadlift v. 3
exercises.description: A hip hinge with nearly straight legs that stretches and strengthens the hamstrings.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees almost straight.
Hinge at the hips and slide the weights down your legs.
Stop when you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand, keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: band seated row
exercises.description: A seated row with a band that works the mid back and lats.
steps: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and loop a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms extended.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Slowly extend your arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: band bent over row
exercises.description: A bent-over row with a band that strengthens the mid back and lats.
steps: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the ends.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower slowly.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.name: resistance band one leg kickback (bent position)
exercises.description: A standing glute kickback with a band while leaning forward, isolating one hip at a time.
steps: Loop a resistance band around your ankle and anchor the other end low in front of you.
Hold a support and lean forward slightly.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Kick your leg back and up against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: pike press (between benches)
exercises.description: A pike push-up with the hands on two benches so you can lower deeper, building the shoulders.
steps: Place your hands on two benches shoulder-width apart and your feet on the floor.
Lift your hips into a pike shape.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Keep your hips high throughout.

exercises.name: arm circles
exercises.description: A simple warm-up that loosens the shoulder joints by moving the arms in circles.
steps: Stand tall with your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Make small circles forward.
Gradually make the circles larger.
Do 10 to 15 circles, then reverse direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Breathe normally.

exercises.name: bodyweight kneeling push up row
exercises.description: A kneeling push-up combined with a row that works the chest and back together.
steps: Start in a kneeling push-up position with your hands on the floor, or on light dumbbells.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push back up.
Pull one elbow toward your ribs.
Return that hand to the floor and alternate sides.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.name: bodyweight windmill
exercises.description: A standing side bend and twist that loosens the hips and trains the obliques.
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulder-width and one arm overhead.
Turn your feet slightly outward.
Hinge at the hips and rotate your torso toward the floor.
Reach your free hand toward the opposite foot.
Return to standing with control.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: weighted push up with vest
exercises.description: A push-up wearing a weighted vest for extra load on the chest and triceps.
steps: Put on a weighted vest and start in a plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and glutes.
Lower your chest to the floor with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Repeat for the set.

exercises.name: dumbbell low fly
exercises.description: A dumbbell fly with a low path that emphasizes the lower chest.
steps: Lie on a flat bench or stand and hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Move the dumbbells in a wide arc.
Bring them together in front of your lower chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: cable bent over one arm lateral raise
exercises.description: A bent-over one-arm cable raise that hits the rear delts.
steps: Stand next to a low pulley and bend forward at the hips with a flat back.
Grab the handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side with a soft elbow.
Lift to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm front raise
exercises.description: A one-arm raise in front of you that trains the front delts.
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in one hand in front of your thigh.
Keep your core braced.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: cable rear delt row
exercises.description: A row with wide elbows on the cable machine that targets the rear delts.
steps: Set a cable at chest height with a handle or rope.
Hold it with your arms extended.
Step back and lean slightly.
Pull the handle toward your upper chest with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your rear delts.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: decline pike press (between benches)
exercises.description: A harder pike push-up with the feet raised, hands on benches, loading the shoulders strongly.
steps: Place your hands on two benches and your feet on a higher surface behind you.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Bend your elbows and lower your head between the benches.
Press up to straight arms.
Keep your core tight.
Control the descent.

exercises.name: handstand shoulder press with wall (between benches)
exercises.description: A wall-supported handstand press between two benches for strong shoulders and triceps.
steps: Place your hands on two benches and kick up into a handstand with your heels against the wall.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Lower your head between the benches by bending your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep the movement controlled.
Come down carefully when done.

exercises.name: barbell reverse grip floor press
exercises.description: A floor press with a reverse grip, which shifts more work to the triceps and upper chest.
steps: Lie on the floor with a barbell above your chest, hands in an underhand grip.
Plant your feet and brace your core.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press the bar back up.
Keep your wrists straight.

exercises.name: landmine single leg landmine rdl
exercises.description: A single-leg Romanian deadlift holding a landmine bar, challenging balance and the hamstrings.
steps: Hold the end of a landmine bar with both hands.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and extend the other leg behind you.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute to stand.
Switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: landmine rear lunge
exercises.description: A reverse lunge holding a landmine bar at the chest, working the quads and glutes.
steps: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

exercises.name: cable triceps pushdown on floor
exercises.description: A triceps pushdown performed while sitting or lying on the floor with the cable set low.
steps: Set a cable at a low or mid position and sit on the floor facing it.
Hold the handle with elbows tucked at your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your upper arms still.

exercises.name: landmine kneeling squeeze press
exercises.description: A kneeling landmine press with the hands squeezed together, working the chest and core.
steps: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the bar end close to your chest with both hands pressed together.
Brace your core.
Press the bar forward and up.
Squeeze your hands together as you press.
Lower it slowly.
Keep your torso upright.

exercises.name: side push up with towel
exercises.description: A push-up variation where one hand slides on a towel, shifting load to one side of the chest.
steps: Start in a push-up position with one hand on a towel on the floor.
Slide that hand out to the side.
Lower your chest toward the other hand.
Push back up.
Slide the towel hand back in.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: landmine floor one arm chest fly
exercises.description: A one-arm fly on the floor with a landmine bar, training the chest and stability.
steps: Lie on the floor holding the landmine bar end with one hand.
Extend the arm above your chest.
Lower the bar out to the side in an arc.
Stop when your arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the bar back up.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: floor fly with towels
exercises.description: A floor fly sliding hands on towels for a bodyweight chest isolation move.
steps: Kneel or get into a plank with your hands on towels.
Slide your hands out wide to the sides.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Squeeze your chest to slide your hands back together.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

exercises.name: cable seated floor one arm concentration curl
exercises.description: A seated one-arm cable curl with your elbow braced against the thigh, isolating the biceps.
steps: Sit on the floor facing a low cable with a handle in one hand.
Brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: side lying leg circle
exercises.description: A slow side-lying leg circle that works the outer hip and mobilizes the hip joint.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked.
Lift the top leg slightly.
Draw small circles in the air.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.
Keep your pelvis still.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: squat tip toe
exercises.description: A squat performed on your tiptoes that challenges balance, the quads and the calves.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and rise onto your toes.
Hold your arms in front for balance.
Squat down while staying up on your toes.
Pause at the bottom.
Stand back up.
Keep your chest tall.

exercises.name: bodyweight single leg deadlift
exercises.description: Hinge forward on one leg while the other reaches back. It builds hamstring and glute strength and trains balance.
steps: Stand on one foot with a soft knee and your arms hanging in front.
Hinge at the hips and extend the free leg straight behind you.
Lower your torso until it is nearly parallel to the floor, back flat.
Squeeze your glute to stand tall again.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing side leg raise
exercises.description: Lift one leg out to the side while standing. It works the outer hip and helps with balance.
steps: Stand tall, hands on your hips or on a support.
Keep your toes pointing forward and lift one leg out to the side.
Raise it as high as you can without leaning your torso.
Lower with control and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: plank jack
exercises.description: A plank where your feet jump apart and together like a jumping jack. It trains the core and raises your heart rate.
steps: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Jump both feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hips level and your abs tight throughout.
Continue for the planned reps or time.

exercises.name: decline push up (kneeling)
exercises.description: A push-up from your knees with the lower body elevated, shifting the work to the upper chest and shoulders.
steps: Kneel with your knees on a bench or step and hands on the floor.
Keep a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your core tight and your elbows at about 45 degrees.

exercises.name: band overhead triceps extension
exercises.description: Press a band overhead from behind your head to straighten the elbows. It isolates the triceps.
steps: Anchor the band low or stand on it and hold the other end behind your head.
Keep your elbows pointing up and close to your ears.
Straighten your arms overhead.
Bend the elbows slowly to return.
Keep your upper arms still and your ribs down.

exercises.name: romanian chair sit up v. 2
exercises.description: A sit up done with your legs supported on a chair, which keeps the movement strict. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit on the floor and rest your lower legs on a chair or bench, knees bent.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl your torso up until your chest nears your knees.
Lower slowly back to the floor.
Do not pull on your neck.

exercises.name: cable seated rear delt fly with chest support
exercises.description: A reverse fly on a chest-supported seat using cables. It targets the rear delts with little help from momentum.
steps: Sit facing the stack with your chest against the pad and hold the handles.
Start with your arms forward and elbows slightly bent.
Sweep your arms out and back to shoulder height.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

exercises.name: seated alternate crunch
exercises.description: A seated crunch where you bring one knee and the opposite elbow together, then switch sides. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and lift your feet.
Place your hands behind your head.
Bring one knee in while rotating your torso toward it.
Return and repeat on the other side.
Keep your chest open and move with control.

exercises.name: smith single arm bent over row
exercises.description: A one-arm row against the Smith bar for a stable path. It builds the lats and upper back, one side at a time.
steps: Set the bar at a low height and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Grip the bar with one hand and brace the other on your thigh.
Pull the bar toward your lower ribs.
Lower it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated upright alternate squeeze press
exercises.description: Press two dumbbells held together, one arm at a time, while seated upright. It trains the chest with a strong inner squeeze.
steps: Sit upright with a dumbbell in each hand, pressed together in front of your chest.
Keep the two dumbbells touching.
Press one dumbbell forward until the arm is straight.
Bring it back and press with the other arm.
Keep squeezing the weights together.

exercises.name: hands release push up
exercises.description: A push-up where you lift your hands at the bottom, removing momentum and building chest strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your whole body to the floor.
Lift your hands off the floor briefly.
Place them back and press up.
Keep your body in a straight line.

exercises.name: air squat
exercises.description: A basic bodyweight squat that builds leg strength and mobility.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand.

exercises.name: crawl to crab
exercises.description: Move from a crawl position into a crab position to work the whole body.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Lift your knees slightly into a low crawl.
Rotate your body and sit back into a crab position, face up.
Lift your hips.
Rotate back into the crawl and repeat.

exercises.name: cross twisting sit up
exercises.description: A sit-up with a twist to bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and hands behind your head.
Curl up and twist toward one knee.
Lower slowly.
Alternate sides.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: high knees lunge
exercises.description: Step into a lunge and drive the knee high to raise the heart rate.
steps: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Push off and drive the back knee up high.
Step back and repeat on the other side.
Keep your pace steady for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: front to side plank
exercises.description: Rotate from a front plank into a side plank to train the core.
steps: Start in a front plank on your forearms or hands.
Rotate your body to one side, lifting one arm up.
Hold briefly in a side plank.
Return to the front plank.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: twist step stretch
exercises.description: Step into a lunge with a twist to open the hips and loosen the trunk.
steps: Stand tall.
Step forward into a lunge.
Twist your torso toward the front leg.
Return to centre and step back.
Alternate sides for 8-10 reps each.

exercises.name: side step front plank
exercises.description: Walk your hands and feet sideways in a front plank to train the core and shoulders.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand and foot out to the side.
Bring the other hand and foot to meet them.
Keep your hips level.
Repeat in one direction, then reverse.

exercises.name: forward step front plank
exercises.description: Walk forward in a front plank, stepping hands and feet to challenge the core and shoulders.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Step one hand forward, then the other.
Follow with your feet.
Keep your hips level.
Walk forward a few steps, then back.

exercises.name: pike to cobra
exercises.description: A flowing bodyweight move that goes from a pike with hips high to a cobra with chest lifted. It warms up the shoulders, spine and hamstrings.
steps: Start on hands and toes with your hips high in an inverted V.
Bend your elbows and glide your chest forward and down between your hands.
Sweep forward and up, straightening your arms and lifting your chest into a cobra.
Keep your legs active and look slightly forward.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up into the pike, and repeat smoothly.

exercises.name: forward to side to rear lunge
exercises.description: A lunge sequence that steps forward, to the side and then back with the same leg. It trains the legs and hips from three directions and challenges your balance.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and hands on your hips.
Step one foot forward into a lunge, then push back to standing.
Step the same foot out to the side, sit back into the hip, then return to center.
Step the same foot backward into a lunge and push back to standing.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes, then switch legs after your set.

exercises.name: seated flutter kick
exercises.description: Small alternating leg kicks while seated and leaning back. It trains the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit with your hands behind you and lean back slightly.
Lift both legs off the floor.
Kick your legs up and down in short alternating moves.
Keep your core tight and your back from rounding.
Continue for time.

exercises.name: dumbbell single spider curl with chest support
exercises.description: A one-arm curl done lying chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps with no swinging.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench with one arm hanging, dumbbell in hand.
Keep your upper arm vertical.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze, then lower fully.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: twist push up
exercises.description: A push up with a rotation at the top. It trains the chest and arms and adds core work.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Push up and rotate one arm toward the ceiling.
Return the hand to the floor.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: side bear crawl
exercises.description: A bear crawl moving sideways on hands and toes. It builds shoulder stability, core control and leg endurance.
steps: Get on hands and toes with knees just off the floor.
Keep your back flat.
Step the hand and foot on one side out, then bring the other pair along.
Move several steps one way, then return.
Stay low and keep your hips steady.

exercises.name: static lunge kick
exercises.description: A lunge held in place that ends with a kick from the back leg. It works the legs and balance.
steps: Step into a lunge with your front knee over your ankle.
Lower down until both knees are bent.
Drive up through the front foot.
Swing the back leg forward in a kick.
Return to the lunge and repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline around the world
exercises.description: Swing dumbbells in a wide arc over your head while lying on an incline bench. It trains the shoulders and chest.
steps: Lie back on an incline bench holding dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out to the sides in a wide arc.
Continue down to your hips.
Reverse the arc to return.

exercises.name: dumbbell flat around the world
exercises.description: Sweep dumbbells from your hips to overhead in a wide arc on a flat bench. It works the shoulders and chest through a long range.
steps: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells over your chest.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Lower them out and back in a wide arc.
Take them down toward your hips.
Reverse the arc with control.

exercises.name: tuck up
exercises.description: Seated or reclined, you pull knees and chest together and then extend out again. It works the abs and hip flexors, especially the lower abs.
steps: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and hold the floor or your sides for support.
Extend your legs out in front, hovering just above the floor.
Pull your knees toward your chest while curling your torso forward.
Pause briefly at the top with your abs tight.
Extend back out under control without letting your feet touch down, and repeat.

exercises.name: jack burpee with push up
exercises.description: A burpee that adds a jumping jack finish and a push-up on the floor. It spikes your heart rate while working the chest, arms and legs.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up and press back up.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Explode up into a jumping jack, landing softly, then flow into the next rep.

exercises.name: band bent over rear lateral raise
exercises.description: A band raise to the sides while bent forward. It targets the rear delts.
steps: Stand on the band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends with arms hanging.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

exercises.name: dumbbell alternate shoulder press
exercises.description: Press dumbbells overhead one arm at a time. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Stand or sit with dumbbells at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell overhead until the arm is straight.
Lower it back to your shoulder.
Press with the other arm.
Brace your core and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: dumbbell single leg calf raise v. 2
exercises.description: A one-leg calf raise holding a dumbbell for extra load. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the ball of the opposite foot, ideally on a step.
Rest your free hand on a wall or rail for balance.
Lift your heel as high as you can, squeezing the calf.
Pause for a moment at the top.
Lower your heel slowly below the step level, then repeat and switch legs.

exercises.name: push up toe touch
exercises.description: A push up followed by a hand reaching to the opposite toe. It adds core and mobility work to the chest drill.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower your chest and push back up.
Lift your hips and reach one hand to the opposite foot.
Return to plank.
Alternate hands each rep.

exercises.name: seated side to side leg raise crunch on floor
exercises.description: Seated crunch with the legs swinging to one side and then the other. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit and lean back on your hands, legs lifted.
Swing both knees to one side while crunching in.
Return through the middle.
Swing to the other side.
Keep the motion smooth and controlled.

exercises.name: cross body push up
exercises.description: A push up where one hand crosses over toward the other side. It adds an uneven challenge for the chest and core.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Push up and cross one hand over toward the other side.
Place it down and repeat.
Alternate the crossing hand.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline front raise with chest support
exercises.description: A front raise done chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the front delts without momentum.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise the weights forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep your chest against the pad.

exercises.name: finger push up
exercises.description: A push up supported on your fingertips. It challenges the hands and forearms as well as the chest.
steps: Get into a high plank on your fingertips.
Keep your body straight.
Lower your chest to the floor.
Press up.
Reduce the range if your fingers tire.

exercises.name: leg lift to chest front plank
exercises.description: From a front plank, drive one knee to the chest and alternate. It trains the core and hip flexors.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Draw one knee toward your chest.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate legs.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.name: one arm front plank
exercises.description: A front plank held with one arm lifted. It tests anti-rotation core strength.
steps: Start in a high plank with feet wide.
Lift one hand off the floor.
Hold your hips steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: push up pike toe touch
exercises.description: A push up followed by a pike with a reach to the toes. It trains the chest, shoulders and core.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Do a push up.
Lift your hips into a pike.
Reach one hand to the opposite toe.
Return to plank and alternate.

exercises.name: push up hand by hand
exercises.description: A push up where your hands shift one at a time to walk in and out. It adds shoulder stability to the chest drill.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up.
Step one hand wider, then the other.
Do another push up.
Step your hands back in.

exercises.name: ez bar front twist raise
exercises.description: Raise an EZ bar forward while rotating it. It trains the front delts with a twist.
steps: Stand holding an EZ bar at thigh height.
Raise it forward to chest height.
Rotate your wrists as you lift.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: barbell incline wrist curl with chest support
exercises.description: A wrist curl performed chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the forearm flexors.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench with the barbell in hands, palms up.
Let your wrists extend gently.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: barbell incline reverse grip spider curl with chest support
exercises.description: A reverse grip curl done chest down on an incline bench. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell overhand.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Curl the bar up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower fully with control.

exercises.name: ez bar incline front raise
exercises.description: A front raise with an EZ bar on an incline bench. It isolates the front delts.
steps: Sit on an incline bench with the EZ bar at thighs.
Keep arms straight with a slight bend.
Raise the bar to eye level.
Lower under control.
Keep your back on the pad.

exercises.name: ez bar seated close grip shoulder press
exercises.description: A seated overhead press with a narrow grip on the EZ bar. It builds the shoulders and triceps.
steps: Sit upright holding the EZ bar with a close grip at your chest.
Brace your core.
Press the bar overhead.
Lower it back to chest height.
Keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: barbell bent over wide alternate row plus
exercises.description: A wide grip bent over row done with alternating pulls. It builds the upper back and lats.
steps: Hinge forward holding the barbell with a wide grip.
Keep your back flat.
Pull one side toward your ribs.
Lower and pull the other side.
Keep your hips still.

exercises.name: barbell bent over wide row plus
exercises.description: A wide grip bent over row aimed at the upper back. It builds the lats and rear shoulders.
steps: Hinge forward with a wide overhand grip.
Keep a flat back.
Row the bar toward your upper abdomen.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: dumbbell push up front raise
exercises.description: A push up on dumbbells followed by a front raise. It trains the chest, arms and core.
steps: Start in a high plank gripping two dumbbells.
Do a push up.
Lift one dumbbell forward to shoulder height.
Return it to the floor.
Alternate arms.

exercises.name: neck circle stretch
exercises.description: Gentle circles of the head to loosen the neck. It eases stiffness in the neck muscles.
steps: Stand or sit tall with relaxed shoulders.
Drop your chin toward your chest.
Slowly roll your head to one side.
Continue in a smooth circle.
Do 5 circles, then reverse.

exercises.name: back slaps wrap around stretch
exercises.description: Swing your arms across your body, wrapping them around the trunk. It loosens the upper back and shoulders.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Swing your arms wide.
Wrap them around your body so the hands slap your upper back.
Open them wide again.
Keep it loose and rhythmic.

exercises.name: circles arm
exercises.description: Draw circles with straight arms to warm up the shoulders. It loosens the shoulder joints.
steps: Stand tall with arms out to the sides.
Make small circles forward.
Increase to larger circles.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: standing side bend (bent arm)
exercises.description: Bend sideways with one arm overhead and bent. It stretches the side of the trunk.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Bend one arm overhead.
Lean to the opposite side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: standing air bike
exercises.description: A standing cycling crunch bringing the elbow to the opposite knee. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Stand with hands behind your head.
Lift one knee while rotating your torso.
Touch your elbow to the knee.
Switch sides in a pedaling rhythm.
Stay upright.

exercises.name: static lunge
exercises.description: A lunge held in one place with no stepping. It builds the legs and balance.
steps: Step one foot forward and stay in a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your front knee above the ankle.
Push through the front heel.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: alternate leg raise with head up
exercises.description: Raise one leg at a time while lying with your head lifted. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your head slightly lifted.
Raise one leg to vertical.
Lower it without touching the floor.
Raise the other leg.
Keep your lower back pressed down.

exercises.name: v up double crunch
exercises.description: A V up where you crunch your arms and legs together twice. It hits the whole abdominal wall.
steps: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Crunch in again.
Lower with control.
Keep your legs straight.

exercises.name: v up with clap
exercises.description: A V up finishing with a clap above the legs. It trains the core and coordination.
steps: Lie flat with arms overhead.
Lift your arms and legs into a V.
Clap above your shins.
Lower with control.
Repeat smoothly.

exercises.name: place jog
exercises.description: Jogging on the spot as a warm-up or light cardio. It raises your heart rate without equipment.
steps: Stand tall with your arms bent.
Jog in place, lifting your knees.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady pace.
Continue for 1-5 minutes.

exercises.name: backward abdominal stretch
exercises.description: Arch back to stretch the front of the trunk. It lengthens the abs.
steps: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders.
Press your chest up.
Keep your hips on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: 90 degree heel touch
exercises.description: Lie with legs raised and reach toward your heels. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie with your legs up and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Lift your shoulders.
Reach one hand toward the heel.
Switch sides.
Keep your legs still.

exercises.name: straight leg sit up
exercises.description: A sit up with straight legs. It trains the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Curl up to sitting.
Lower with control.
Do not pull on your neck.

exercises.name: long arm crunch
exercises.description: A crunch with the arms extended overhead, which lengthens the lever and makes it harder. It focuses on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with arms straight overhead.
Bend your knees.
Crunch up reaching forward.
Lower slowly.
Keep your arms by your ears.

exercises.name: cable kneeling shoulder press
exercises.description: An overhead cable press from a kneeling position. It builds the shoulders and demands core stability.
steps: Kneel in front of a low cable and hold the handles at shoulder height.
Brace your abs.
Press the handles overhead.
Lower under control.
Keep your hips tall.

exercises.name: cable bent over row with bar
exercises.description: A bent over row with a cable and straight bar. It builds the lats and mid-back.
steps: Face the low pulley and hinge forward holding the bar.
Keep a flat back.
Pull the bar toward your waist.
Squeeze your back.
Extend your arms slowly.

exercises.name: cable incline cross rear fly
exercises.description: A rear fly using crossed cables on an incline bench. It targets the rear delts.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cables, holding opposite handles.
Keep elbows slightly bent.
Pull your arms out and back.
Pause.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: cable lying cross lateral raise
exercises.description: A lateral raise performed lying down using a crossing cable. It isolates the side delts.
steps: Lie on a bench with a cable running across your body.
Hold the handle with the far hand.
Raise the arm out to the side.
Lower with control.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable standing front raise variation
exercises.description: A standing cable front raise. It targets the front delts with steady tension.
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley.
Hold the handle with a slight elbow bend.
Raise the arm to eye level.
Lower slowly.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline close grip press variation
exercises.description: A close grip dumbbell press on an incline. It targets the triceps and upper chest.
steps: Lie on an incline bench with dumbbells together over your chest.
Keep your elbows tucked.
Lower to your chest.
Press up.
Keep the dumbbells touching.

exercises.name: barbell seated shrug
exercises.description: A shrug with a barbell while seated. It builds the upper traps.
steps: Sit upright holding the barbell at thigh level.
Keep your arms straight.
Lift your shoulders to your ears.
Pause.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing single spider curl
exercises.description: A standing one-arm spider curl bent forward. It isolates the biceps.
steps: Stand and hinge forward, bracing against a support.
Let one arm hang with a dumbbell.
Curl up.
Squeeze.
Lower and switch arms.

exercises.name: lying leg hip raise on floor v. 2
exercises.description: Lift your hips off the floor with your legs raised. It focuses on the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs raised.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Lower with control.
Avoid swinging.

exercises.name: reverse crunch v. 2
exercises.description: Curl the knees and hips up toward the chest. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift your legs.
Curl hips off the floor.
Lower slowly.
Do not swing.

exercises.name: criss cross leg raises
exercises.description: Lying leg raises with legs crossing over each other. It targets the lower abs and inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and raised.
Lower them slightly.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch the cross.
Keep your lower back down.

exercises.name: seated 8 leg crunch
exercises.description: Seated crunch where the legs trace a figure eight in the air. It works the lower abs and hip flexors while you balance on your seat.
steps: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly and support yourself with your hands behind you.
Lift both feet off the floor and brace your core.
Draw a figure eight in the air with your legs, slow and controlled.
Keep your chest lifted and your lower back from collapsing.
Lower your feet and rest, then repeat.

exercises.name: front plank to toe tap
exercises.description: A forearm or high plank where you reach a foot out to tap the floor. It trains core stability and hip control.
steps: Start in a front plank with your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one foot and tap the toes out to the side without twisting your hips.
Bring the foot back to the start.
Repeat on the other leg and keep alternating.

exercises.name: resistance band standing overhead warming up
exercises.description: A light band warm-up that presses the arms overhead to wake up the shoulders before training.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold the band with both hands at chest height.
Keep a slight tension in the band.
Raise your arms overhead in a smooth arc.
Lower back to chest height slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps without shrugging.

exercises.name: resistance band standing down warming up
exercises.description: A gentle band warm-up that pulls the arms down from overhead to prepare the shoulders and upper back.
steps: Stand tall and hold the band overhead with both hands, a little wider than shoulder width.
Keep your ribs down and core braced.
Pull your hands down in front of you toward your chest.
Return slowly overhead keeping tension.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps.

exercises.name: resistance band standing front warming up
exercises.description: A band warm-up with the arms moving in front of the body, loosening the shoulders and chest before a workout.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold the band in front of you at shoulder height.
Keep your arms mostly straight.
Move your hands apart, stretching the band across your chest.
Bring your hands back together slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps.

exercises.name: resistance band standing back warming up
exercises.description: A band warm-up that pulls the arms behind the body to activate the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Stand tall holding the band with both hands in front of you.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the band apart and back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly then return slowly.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: resistance band squatting front warming up
exercises.description: A warm-up from a low squat position, moving a band in front of you to loosen the shoulders and hips together.
steps: Hold the band in front of you and sink into a comfortable deep squat.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Move your hands apart, stretching the band at shoulder height.
Bring your hands back together under control.
Repeat for 10 to 15 easy reps, then stand up.

exercises.name: band hip adduction
exercises.description: Standing leg movement against a band that squeezes the thigh inward. It strengthens the inner thigh.
steps: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle nearest the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Pull the working leg across in front of the other leg.
Pause for a moment and return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell bar grip sumo squat
exercises.description: Wide stance squat holding one dumbbell by its bar between the legs. It hits the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out.
Hold the dumbbell vertically by its bar with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down while keeping your chest up.
Push your knees out over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: band hip abduction
exercises.description: Standing leg raise to the side against a band. It targets the outer hip and glute muscles.
steps: Anchor the band low and loop it around the ankle farthest from the anchor.
Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift the working leg out to the side without leaning.
Pause, then lower slowly against the band.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band standing leg curl
exercises.description: Standing leg curl using a band around the ankle. It isolates the hamstrings.
steps: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Stand tall facing the anchor and hold a support.
Bend your knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Keep your thighs together and hips still.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band standing hip extension
exercises.description: Standing kick-back against a band that works the glutes and the back of the thigh.
steps: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Stand facing the anchor, holding a support and keeping your torso upright.
Press the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band bent over hip extension
exercises.description: A bent over kick-back against a band. The hinged torso gives the glutes and hamstrings a deeper stretch and squeeze.
steps: Anchor the band low and loop it around one ankle.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back, hands on a support.
Extend the working leg back and up against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: resistance band leg curl
exercises.description: Leg curl with a tube band around the ankle, building the hamstrings.
steps: Attach the band to a low anchor and loop the handle around one ankle.
Face the anchor and hold a support for balance.
Curl your heel toward your glute.
Keep your knees close and your hips steady.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: landmine one arm bent over row
exercises.description: One arm row with the end of a landmine bar. It builds the lats and mid back with a smooth arc.
steps: Load the landmine bar and stand over it with a hip hinge, knees soft.
Grip the bar end with one hand and keep your back flat.
Pull the bar toward your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade back.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: landmine one arm bent over bench row
exercises.description: A supported one arm landmine row with your free hand and knee on a bench. It keeps the lower back relaxed while you pull.
steps: Set the landmine bar next to a bench and place one hand and knee on the bench.
Grip the bar end with your free hand and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbow up toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your shoulder blade.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: landmine rear lunge v. 2
exercises.description: Reverse lunge holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The bar adds load and encourages an upright torso.
steps: Hold the bar end against your chest with both hands.
Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower until both knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your front heel down and your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell russian twist (on stability ball)
exercises.description: Rotating a dumbbell side to side while balanced on a stability ball. It challenges the obliques and balance.
steps: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it, hips lifted.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Rotate your torso and arms to one side.
Rotate smoothly to the other side.
Keep your hips high and move with control.

exercises.name: cable seated cross arm twist
exercises.description: Seated trunk rotation pulling a cable across the body. It works the obliques and deep core.
steps: Sit next to a cable machine set at chest height and grab the handle with both hands.
Start with your arms extended in front of you.
Rotate your torso away from the stack, pulling the handle across your body.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your hips still, finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: inverted shrug (on parallel bars)
exercises.description: Hanging from parallel bars, you shrug your shoulder blades up and down. It builds the traps and shoulder control.
steps: Grip the parallel bars and hang in an inverted position with arms straight.
Keep your body stable and your elbows locked.
Draw your shoulder blades down and together, pulling your body up a little.
Lower back to a full hang under control.
Repeat for controlled reps.

exercises.name: single leg glute bridge with knee to chest
exercises.description: One leg glute bridge where the free knee is hugged toward the chest. It strengthens the glutes and challenges hip stability.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the foot flat, the other knee pulled toward your chest.
Brace your core.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kettlebell lateral lunge
exercises.description: Side lunge holding a kettlebell at the chest. It trains the thighs, glutes and inner thighs in the frontal plane.
steps: Hold the kettlebell at your chest with both hands and stand tall.
Take a big step to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee while the other leg stays straight.
Keep your chest up and both feet flat.
Push back to the start and alternate sides.

exercises.name: kettlebell sumo deadlift
exercises.description: Deadlift from a wide stance with a kettlebell between your feet. It trains the glutes, thighs and back.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes angled out, the kettlebell between your feet.
Hinge and bend your knees to grip the handle with both hands.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand tall and squeeze your glutes.
Lower the kettlebell under control.

exercises.name: kettlebell dead bug
exercises.description: Dead bug with a kettlebell held above the chest. The weight adds challenge to the core while the limbs move.
steps: Lie on your back and hold a kettlebell by the horns above your chest.
Lift your knees to a tabletop position.
Slowly extend one leg while pressing your lower back into the floor.
Bring the leg back and switch.
Keep the kettlebell steady and breathe.

exercises.name: dumbbell ipsilateral split squat
exercises.description: Split squat with the dumbbell held on the same side as the working front leg. It tests balance and leg strength.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and step into a split stance, the dumbbell on the same side as your front leg.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front foot to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: inverted shrug
exercises.description: Hanging inverted, you move your shoulder blades to lift the body slightly. It builds the traps and scapular control.
steps: Set up under a bar or rings and hang with straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back to rise a little.
Hold briefly, then lower to a full hang.
Repeat for controlled reps.

exercises.name: resistance band hip thrusts
exercises.description: Hip thrust with a band across the hips for resistance. It is a direct glute builder.
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench and the band across your hips, anchored to each side.
Plant your feet flat, knees bent.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: side lying leg raise
exercises.description: Lying on your side, you lift the top leg. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head supported.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Lift the top leg up with the toes pointing forward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: battling ropes half kneeling
exercises.description: Rope waves from a half kneeling stance. It raises the heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a rope end in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Make fast alternating waves with your arms.
Keep the rhythm steady for a set time.
Switch the front leg for the next set.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated gittleson shrug
exercises.description: Seated shrug variation with a dumbbell in each hand that builds the upper traps.
steps: Sit upright on a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat without rolling your shoulders.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm triceps extension on stability ball
exercises.description: Overhead triceps extension with one dumbbell while seated on a stability ball. The ball adds a core challenge.
steps: Sit tall on a stability ball and hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Bend your elbow and lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Extend your arm back up.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated lateral raise on stability ball
exercises.description: Seated side raise performed on a stability ball. It trains the side delts and trunk balance.
steps: Sit upright on a stability ball with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: dead bug with stability ball
exercises.description: Dead bug holding a stability ball between hands and knees. It builds deep core control.
steps: Lie on your back and hold the ball above your chest with your knees raised.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend your opposite arm and leg away, holding the ball with the rest.
Return to the center.
Alternate sides slowly.

exercises.name: kettlebell turkish get up to hand
exercises.description: The first part of a Turkish get up, rising from the floor to a seated position on your hand while holding a kettlebell overhead.
steps: Lie on your back with a kettlebell pressed up in one hand and the same-side knee bent.
Keep your eyes on the kettlebell.
Roll up onto your opposite elbow, then onto your hand.
Hold the seated position with your arm vertical.
Reverse the steps to lie back down, then switch sides.

exercises.name: leg raise dragon flag
exercises.description: Advanced core move where the body stays straight while you raise and lower the legs from a bench. It strongly trains the abs.
steps: Lie on a bench and grip it behind your head.
Lift your hips and legs so your body is straight from shoulders to toes.
Keep your body rigid and lower slowly without sitting.
Raise your legs back up under control.
Stop before your lower back arches.

exercises.name: kettlebell split squat
exercises.description: Split squat holding a kettlebell, working the thighs and glutes one leg at a time.
steps: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and take a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through the front heel to stand.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: bird dog push up
exercises.description: A push up combined with extending an opposite arm and leg. It builds the chest while testing core balance.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push up with elbows about 45 degrees from your body.
Press back up.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg and hold briefly.
Return and alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: barbell banded bench squat
exercises.description: Squat to a bench with bands adding tension. It teaches depth control and builds the glutes and thighs.
steps: Set a bench behind you and place the bar on your upper back with bands attached.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit back and down until you touch the bench.
Keep your chest up and knees pushing out.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: lever lying banded t bar row
exercises.description: Chest-supported T bar row on a lever machine with bands for extra resistance as you pull.
steps: Lie chest down on the support and grip the handles.
Keep your head neutral.
Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.

exercises.name: band biceps curl
exercises.description: Standing curl using a band under your feet. It builds the biceps with rising tension.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms forward.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: barbell squat with chains
exercises.description: Back squat with chains hanging from the bar, so the load grows as you stand. It builds leg strength through the whole range.
steps: Set chains on the bar and unrack it onto your upper back.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest up until your thighs are at least parallel.
Drive up through your feet.
Keep your core braced throughout.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing alternate arnold press
exercises.description: Rotating press with dumbbells, done one arm at a time while standing. It works all parts of the shoulder.
steps: Stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Brace your core.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower while rotating back.
Alternate arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated bent over alternate rear delt fly
exercises.description: Seated bent over fly done one arm at a time to hit the rear delts.
steps: Sit at the edge of a bench and lean forward with dumbbells hanging below your knees.
Keep your back flat and elbows slightly bent.
Raise one arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell alternate arnold press
exercises.description: Seated Arnold press alternating arms. The twist works the front and side delts.
steps: Sit upright holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing you.
Press one dumbbell overhead while rotating your palm forward.
Lower it while rotating back.
Alternate arms.
Keep your back against the pad and avoid arching.

exercises.name: barbell bench press with 3 board
exercises.description: Bench press with three boards on the chest limiting the range. It overloads the lockout phase.
steps: Lie on a bench with three boards stacked on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.name: barbell bench press with 2 board
exercises.description: Bench press with two boards on the chest, giving a slightly longer range than the three board press.
steps: Lie on a bench with two boards stacked on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the boards.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.name: barbell bench press with 1 board
exercises.description: Bench press with a single board, shortening the range just a little. It builds pressing power near lockout.
steps: Lie on a bench with a single board on your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Lower the bar until it touches the board.
Press back up to full extension.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline one arm front raise with chest support
exercises.description: Front raise with your chest supported on an incline bench to reduce swinging. It isolates the front delts.
steps: Set an incline bench and lie chest down on it.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand hanging straight down.
Raise the dumbbell forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: bodyweight single leg wall squat
exercises.description: One leg squat with your back against a wall for balance. It builds single leg strength.
steps: Lean your back on a wall and lift one foot off the floor.
Place your standing foot forward.
Slide down into a squat as far as you can control.
Press through your heel to rise.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: band low chest fly
exercises.description: Chest fly with the band anchored low, so you sweep your arms up and together. It focuses on the upper chest.
steps: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Sweep your hands up and together in front of your chest.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: band low chest press
exercises.description: Pressing a band upward from a low anchor. It trains the upper chest and triceps.
steps: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends at chest level.
Step forward into a staggered stance.
Press your hands up and forward.
Pause, then return slowly.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: band chest fly
exercises.description: Standing band fly bringing the hands together in front of the chest. It trains the pecs.
steps: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Start with arms out to the sides and slightly bent.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Return slowly under control.

exercises.name: band cross body one arm chest press
exercises.description: Single arm band press that travels across the body, working the chest and core.
steps: Anchor the band behind you and hold the end in one hand.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press your hand forward and across your body.
Return slowly while resisting rotation.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: band low alternate chest press
exercises.description: Alternating band presses from a low anchor. It trains the upper chest.
steps: Anchor the band low behind you and hold both ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press one hand up and forward.
Return, then press the other hand.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: band alternate low chest fly
exercises.description: Alternating single arm chest fly from a low anchor.
steps: Anchor the band low behind you and hold the ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Sweep one arm up and across in front of your chest.
Return slowly.
Alternate arms.

exercises.name: band standing alternate chest press
exercises.description: Standing band press, one arm at a time, hitting the chest and triceps.
steps: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold both ends.
Stand in a staggered stance.
Press one hand straight forward.
Return and press the other hand.
Keep your torso steady.

exercises.name: band kneeling crunch
exercises.description: Kneeling crunch against a band anchored overhead. It trains the abs with steady resistance.
steps: Anchor the band high and kneel facing it, holding the ends beside your head.
Keep your hips still.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: band reverse crunch
exercises.description: Lying reverse crunch with a band for added resistance, focusing on the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with the band anchored overhead and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and lift your feet.
Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: band overhead side bend
exercises.description: Standing side bend with a band stretched overhead, training the obliques.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends overhead.
Keep your core braced.
Bend sideways at your waist.
Return to upright.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band upper crunch
exercises.description: Crunch lifting just the upper torso against a band for resistance.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band anchored overhead, ends in hand.
Hold the band near your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: band horizontal biceps curl
exercises.description: A band curl done with the band pulling horizontally, which keeps constant tension on your biceps through the whole range.
steps: Anchor the band at chest height and face away from the anchor, holding the ends.
Step out until the band is taut and raise your arms out to the sides at shoulder height.
Bend your elbows to bring your hands toward your head.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your arms again.
Keep your elbows level with your shoulders the whole time.

exercises.name: band kneeling preacher curl
exercises.description: A curl performed kneeling with your upper arms braced on a bench or pad, so the biceps do the work without momentum.
steps: Anchor the band low and kneel facing it with your upper arms resting on a bench or pad.
Hold the band ends with palms up and arms extended.
Curl your hands toward your shoulders.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.
Keep your upper arms pressed down on the pad.

exercises.name: band standard biceps curl
exercises.description: The classic standing curl with a band underfoot. It builds the biceps with smooth, rising resistance.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band with your feet hip-width apart and grip the ends.
Keep your elbows at your sides and your chest tall.
Curl your hands up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Pause briefly, then lower slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your wrists neutral throughout.

exercises.name: band 45 degrees biceps curl
exercises.description: A band curl with your arms angled about 45 degrees behind your body, which stretches the biceps and works the long head.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends, then set your arms about 45 degrees behind your torso.
Keep your chest up and shoulders back.
Curl your hands up while your upper arms stay in that angled position.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.
Avoid leaning back to finish the rep.

exercises.name: band cross chest biceps curl
exercises.description: A hammer-style curl that crosses the band toward the opposite shoulder, hitting the biceps and brachialis.
steps: Stand on the band and hold the ends with palms facing in.
Keep your elbows near your sides.
Curl one hand across your chest toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower under control, then repeat on the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: kettlebell sumo squat
exercises.description: A wide stance squat holding a kettlebell between your legs, working your glutes, inner thighs and quads.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than shoulders and toes turned out, holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of you.
Brace your core and keep your chest tall.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: landmine sumo squat
exercises.description: A wide stance squat holding the end of a landmine barbell at your chest, which trains glutes and legs with an upright torso.
steps: Stand facing the landmine anchor with a wide stance and hold the bar end against your chest.
Brace your core and keep your elbows tucked in.
Sit down between your legs, knees tracking over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your heels to stand tall.

exercises.name: twist superman
