steps: Lie on your back and place your hands under your head.
Lift your legs a few inches off the floor.
Kick up and down alternately in small, quick motions.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for the set time.

exercises.name: seated chin up (low bar position)
exercises.description: A seated chin-up using a low bar with an underhand grip. It lets you train the lats and biceps with a reduced load.
steps: Set a bar at a low height and sit under it.
Grab it with an underhand grip, arms extended.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: seated chin up
exercises.description: A seated chin-up where your legs help a little while you pull up with an underhand grip. It builds back and arm strength.
steps: Sit under a bar with an underhand grip, shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chin toward the bar.
Squeeze your back and biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: seated commando pull up
exercises.description: A seated pull-up with a staggered grip, pulling your head to alternating sides of the bar. It trains the lats and grip.
steps: Sit under a bar and grab it with one hand in front of the other.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your body up and bring your head to one side.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep or each set.

exercises.name: seated pull up (legs elevated)
exercises.description: A seated pull-up with your feet raised on a bench, which increases the load. It builds the back and arms.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and sit under a bar.
Grab it with an overhand grip, arms extended.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly to straight arms.

exercises.name: seated pull up (low bar position)
exercises.description: A seated pull-up on a low bar. It reduces the load compared with a full pull-up, which is good for building strength.
steps: Set a bar low and sit beneath it.
Grab it with an overhand grip, a little wider than your shoulders.
Extend your legs in front with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest to the bar.
Lower under control.

exercises.name: seated pull up
exercises.description: A pull-up from a seated position with your legs assisting. It builds lats and arms while reducing the load.
steps: Sit under a bar and grab it with an overhand grip.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: side bench squat
exercises.description: A side squat toward a bench with body weight only. It works the thighs and glutes one side at a time.
steps: Stand sideways to a bench with feet wide.
Shift your weight to the leg nearest the bench.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the other leg straight.
Drive up through your heel and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side crunch with hands on chest
exercises.description: A side-lying crunch with the arms crossed over the chest. It works the obliques along the side of the trunk.
steps: Lie on your side with knees slightly bent and arms crossed over your chest.
Brace your core and lift your shoulders and legs toward each other.
Crunch sideways, squeezing the side of your waist.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled, without pulling on your neck.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side split squat
exercises.description: A wide side-to-side squat on one leg at a time. It builds the thighs and mobilises the hips.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Lower until your thigh is parallel.
Push back to the middle and alternate sides.

exercises.name: side squat
exercises.description: A side squat in a wide stance, bending one leg while the other stays straight. It works the thighs, glutes and inner legs.
steps: Stand with feet wide and your arms in front for balance.
Shift your weight to one leg and sit back and down.
Keep the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the middle and switch sides.

exercises.name: single leg bench squat
exercises.description: A one-legged squat down to a bench behind you. It builds leg strength and balance while the bench keeps the depth safe.
steps: Stand in front of a bench with your back to it and lift one foot off the floor.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and lower until you lightly touch the bench.
Keep the working knee in line with your toes.
Drive through the heel to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg glute bridge (arms on chest)
exercises.description: A one-legged glute bridge with arms crossed on the chest. It focuses the work on the glutes and tests hip stability.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent, foot flat, and the other leg extended or raised.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Push through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top so your body forms a straight line.
Lower your hips slowly without touching the floor fully.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg hip thrust v. 2
exercises.description: A one-legged hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, a second variation. It hits the glutes hard without any equipment.
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat on the floor.
Lift the other leg off the floor, knee bent or straight.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top until your torso is level.
Lower your hips under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg hip thrust jump
exercises.description: An explosive one-leg hip thrust where you jump your hips off the floor. It trains glute power.
steps: Sit with your upper back on a bench and one foot planted.
Lift the other leg.
Drive up through your heel and thrust your hips explosively.
Let your hips leave the floor briefly.
Land softly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg jumping glute bridge
exercises.description: An explosive one-leg glute bridge where you pop your hips off the floor. It builds glute power and balance.
steps: Lie on your back with one foot planted and the other leg lifted.
Drive through the planted heel and thrust your hips up.
Push hard enough that your hips leave the floor.
Land softly back in the bridge.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg step up on bench
exercises.description: A step-up onto a bench using one leg at a time. It builds strength in the thighs and glutes and helps balance.
steps: Stand facing a sturdy bench and place one foot fully on top.
Lean slightly forward and press through that heel.
Step up until the leg is straight and you stand tall.
Lower yourself slowly back down with control.
Avoid pushing off the trailing foot.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing single leg calf raise balance
exercises.description: A one-leg calf raise that also challenges balance. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: Stand tall on one foot with the other lifted.
Keep your hands on your hips or lightly on a wall.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Hold briefly at the top, steady.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: supported squat
exercises.description: A squat where you hold onto something for balance. It is a friendly way to practise depth and build leg strength.
steps: Stand holding a stable support at about chest height, feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Sit your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go as deep as you can with your heels down.
Push through your feet to stand back up.
Use the support for balance, not to pull yourself up.

exercises.name: suspender alternate superman
exercises.description: A superman variation with the feet in suspension straps, lifting opposite arm and leg in turn. It trains the lower back and core.
steps: Place your feet in the suspension straps and get into a plank face down.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm forward while keeping your body steady.
Return it, then lift the other arm.
Move slowly and avoid sagging your lower back.
Alternate sides for the full set.

exercises.name: suspender rollout v. 2
exercises.description: A rollout using suspension handles, a second variation. It challenges the abs as you extend your body forward and pull back.
steps: Kneel facing the anchor and hold the suspension handles under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Roll your arms forward as your body leans out in a straight line.
Go only as far as you can keep your back flat.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Keep your ribs down throughout.

exercises.name: table top bridge
exercises.description: Face-up bridge on hands and feet that lifts the hips into a table shape. It builds the glutes, hamstrings and shoulder stability.
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet flat, hands behind you with fingers pointing toward your feet.
Press through your hands and heels to lift your hips.
Raise until your torso and thighs are level like a tabletop.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your head in line with your spine.
Hold briefly, then lower your hips back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: table top bridge rotation
exercises.description: A table top bridge with an arm sweep and trunk rotation. It trains the glutes while opening the chest and challenging balance.
steps: Set up in a table top bridge with hips lifted and hands under your shoulders.
Shift your weight onto one hand and both feet.
Lift the free arm and reach it up and over your body as you rotate your chest.
Keep your hips high and level throughout.
Return the arm to the floor and repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: toe walk
exercises.description: Walking on the balls of your feet with heels lifted. It works the calves and the small stabilisers of the feet and ankles.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Keep your heels lifted as high as you comfortably can.
Walk forward with small, controlled steps.
Keep your core tight and your gaze forward.
Walk for 20-30 steps, rest, and repeat.

exercises.name: triceps press (high bar position)
exercises.description: Lying or seated barbell press where the bar travels from a high position over the head, isolating the triceps through a long range.
steps: Set up with a barbell held at arm's length above your head, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms still and pointing up.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead or just behind your head.
Keep your elbows from flaring out.
Extend your arms to press the bar back to the start.

exercises.name: triceps press (low bar position)
exercises.description: A barbell triceps press where the bar travels lower, closer to your face or chest. It hits the triceps hard through the bottom of the movement.
steps: Hold a barbell at arm's length over your chest, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your elbows tucked.
Bend only at the elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Pause briefly when the bar is low.
Extend your arms to return the bar to the start.

exercises.name: wide air squat
exercises.description: A bodyweight squat with a wide stance and toes turned out. It puts extra work on the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet well wider than your shoulders and toes angled out.
Raise your arms in front for balance.
Sit your hips down and back, pushing your knees out over your toes.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

exercises.name: wide seated pull up
exercises.description: A wide-grip pull from a seated start position. It trains the lats and upper back with a lower starting load than a full pull-up.
steps: Sit under a pull-up bar and take a wide overhand grip.
Hang with arms extended and your chest lifted.
Pull your elbows down and toward your ribs to bring your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower yourself slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.name: wide to narrow push up
exercises.description: A push-up where the hands move from a wide to a narrow position between reps. It shifts the load from chest to triceps.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands wider than your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor with your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the top.
Walk your hands in to a narrow, close position.
Repeat a push-up, then step your hands back out wide.

exercises.name: lying leg raise v. 2
exercises.description: Raising your legs while lying on your back. It works the lower abs and the hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe steadily through each rep.

exercises.name: standing side bend v. 2
exercises.description: A standing bend to the side, a second variation. It works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and one arm overhead.
Brace your core lightly.
Bend sideways at the waist, reaching over with the raised arm.
Pause when you feel the side muscles work.
Return to upright with control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: side plank v. 3
exercises.description: A side plank hold, a second variation. It strengthens the obliques and the muscles that keep your trunk stable.
steps: Lie on your side and prop yourself on your forearm under your shoulder.
Stack or stagger your feet.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Keep your neck neutral and your core tight.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Lower down and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: side crunch v. 3
exercises.description: A side crunch, a second variation, aimed at the obliques. It shortens the side of the waist with a small controlled movement.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and one hand behind your head.
Rest the other hand on the floor for balance.
Lift your shoulders and knees toward each other.
Squeeze the side of your waist at the top.
Lower slowly without relaxing fully.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell goblet 2 sec hold squat
exercises.description: A goblet squat with a two-second pause in the bottom. The pause builds leg strength and control out of the hole.
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and toes slightly out.
Squat down with your chest tall until your thighs are at least parallel.
Hold the bottom position for two seconds.
Drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: kettlebell good morning
exercises.description: A hip hinge with a kettlebell held at the chest. It strengthens the hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
steps: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and hinge forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes to stand tall again.

exercises.name: ring elevated row
exercises.description: A ring row with the feet raised, making the bodyweight pull harder. It builds the upper back and biceps.
steps: Set the rings at about chest height and rest your heels on a bench.
Grab the rings and hang with arms extended and body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower with control without letting your hips sag.

exercises.name: ring leg curl
exercises.description: Lying on your back with heels in the rings, you bridge up and curl your feet in. It hits the hamstrings hard.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels in the ring straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Bend your knees to pull your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high the whole time.
Extend your legs slowly to return.

exercises.name: ring reverse ab rollout
exercises.description: A hanging or reclined rollout that drives the knees in under the rings. It strongly trains the lower abs and core.
steps: Set up in a push-up position with your feet in the ring straps.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders over your hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis.
Pause with your hips lifted and abs tight.
Extend your legs back to a straight plank slowly.

exercises.name: dumbbell single leg step up on bench
exercises.description: A single-leg step-up onto a bench with dumbbells at your sides. It builds leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand facing a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Press through that heel to stand up on the bench.
Lower your other foot back down slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell rdl to jump shrug
exercises.description: A Romanian deadlift that finishes with an explosive jump and shrug. It trains power through the hips and traps.
steps: Stand holding dumbbells in front of your thighs.
Hinge your hips back and lower the weights along your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward and jump as you shrug your shoulders.
Land softly with bent knees.
Reset into the hinge and repeat.

exercises.name: diagonal punch
exercises.description: A fast, rotating punch that travels across the body. It raises your heart rate and trains shoulders, core and rotation.
steps: Stand in an athletic stance with your fists up.
Rotate your hips and torso as you throw a punch across your body.
Extend your arm fully and pivot your back foot.
Pull the arm back quickly.
Alternate sides at a brisk, controlled pace.

exercises.name: superman chest stretch
exercises.description: A face-down stretch with arms reaching out, opening the chest and front of the shoulders.
steps: Lie face down on the floor with your arms extended out wide.
Gently lift your chest off the floor.
Draw your shoulder blades together and back.
Keep your neck in a neutral position.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then relax.

exercises.name: alternate leg raise
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you raise one leg at a time. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and arms at your sides.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise one leg up toward the ceiling.
Lower it slowly while lifting the other leg.
Keep alternating without arching your back.

exercises.name: jump skip rope
exercises.description: Skipping rope with a jump on each turn. It builds stamina, coordination and calf strength.
steps: Hold the rope handles at hip height with elbows near your sides.
Swing the rope over your head using your wrists.
Jump just high enough to clear the rope.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds, rest, and repeat.

exercises.name: push up in child pose
exercises.description: A push-up performed from a kneeling child's pose position. It trains the chest and triceps with a gentle range.
steps: Kneel and sit back on your heels with your arms stretched forward.
Place your hands on the floor at chest height.
Shift forward and lower your chest between your hands.
Push the floor away to rise.
Sit back to the starting pose and repeat.

exercises.name: sliding floor pulldown on towel v. 2
exercises.description: A floor pulldown where you slide your hands on a towel from overhead to your sides. It works the lats without any equipment.
steps: Kneel with your hands on a towel placed on a smooth floor, arms stretched forward.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Pull your elbows down and back as your hands slide toward you.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Slide back out slowly to the start.

exercises.name: lying rear lateral raise
exercises.description: Lying face down, you raise light dumbbells out to the sides. It targets the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Lie face down on a bench holding a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang down with a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing single arm arnold press
exercises.description: A one-arm Arnold press with a rotating grip. It works all heads of the shoulder while challenging core stability.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at shoulder height, palm facing you.
Brace your core and keep your other arm at your side.
Press the dumbbell up while rotating your palm to face forward.
Fully extend your arm overhead.
Lower while rotating back, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell alternate chest press on stability ball
exercises.description: Alternating dumbbell presses while resting on a stability ball. It builds the chest and trains core balance.
steps: Sit on a stability ball holding dumbbells and walk out until your upper back rests on it.
Lift your hips so your body forms a bridge.
Press one dumbbell up over your chest.
Lower it slowly while keeping your hips steady.
Alternate arms for each rep.

exercises.name: dumbbell rotational grip bench press
exercises.description: A dumbbell bench press where your grip rotates during the press. It adds a smooth, shoulder-friendly path for the chest.
steps: Lie on a bench holding dumbbells at chest level with palms facing each other.
Press the weights up while turning your palms to face forward.
Reach full arm extension over your chest.
Lower the weights while rotating back to a neutral grip.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades tight.

exercises.name: dumbbell reverse grip squeeze bench press
exercises.description: A dumbbell press with a reverse grip and the weights squeezed together. It emphasises the triceps and inner chest.
steps: Lie on a bench holding two dumbbells together over your chest with a reverse (palms toward you) grip.
Squeeze the dumbbells together firmly.
Lower them to your chest with elbows close to your body.
Press back up, keeping the squeeze.
Keep your wrists straight throughout.

exercises.name: dumbbell single arm bent over row
exercises.description: A one-arm row in a hinged position. It builds the lats and upper back, one side at a time.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Pull the dumbbell toward your hip, leading with your elbow.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly and switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: cable unilateral bicep curl
exercises.description: A one-arm cable curl that keeps constant tension on the biceps. Train each arm on its own to even out strength.
steps: Attach a handle to a low cable and stand facing the machine.
Hold the handle with one hand, elbow at your side.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms.

exercises.name: banded lower body dead bug
exercises.description: A dead bug with a band around the feet that adds resistance for the legs. It trains the lower abs and anti-extension control.
steps: Lie on your back with a band around your feet and legs bent over your hips.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Extend one leg away against the band.
Return it and switch legs.
Keep your ribs down and your core braced.

exercises.name: straight leg dead bug
exercises.description: A dead bug with straight legs lowering alternately. It is a tougher core challenge with a long lever.
steps: Lie on your back with arms and legs straight up toward the ceiling.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start and switch sides.
Keep your lower back flat the whole time.

exercises.name: barbell band assisted deadlift
exercises.description: A barbell deadlift with a band that assists off the floor. It lets you train heavy lockout work and hip drive.
steps: Attach a band to the barbell and anchor it overhead or to a rack.
Stand with the bar over midfoot and grip just outside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away to lift.
Stand tall and lock out your hips.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: trap bar banded deadlift
exercises.description: A trap bar deadlift with bands adding resistance toward the top. It builds hip and leg power.
steps: Attach bands to the trap bar and stand inside the bar.
Grip the handles with a flat back and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand up.
Lock your hips out at the top against the band.
Lower slowly back to the floor.

exercises.name: depth jump to broad jump
exercises.description: A drop off a box into an immediate broad jump. It trains reactive leg power.
steps: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Immediately explode forward into a broad jump.
Swing your arms for momentum.
Land softly with bent knees and reset.

exercises.name: depth jump
exercises.description: A drop from a box followed by a quick vertical jump. It develops reactive power.
steps: Stand at the edge of a low box.
Step off and land on both feet.
Rebound immediately into a maximum vertical jump.
Spend as little time on the ground as you can.
Land softly and reset for the next rep.

exercises.name: kettlebell lying on floor chest press
exercises.description: A floor press with kettlebells. The floor limits range and keeps the focus on the chest and triceps.
steps: Lie on the floor holding a kettlebell in each hand at chest level.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Press the kettlebells up until your arms are straight.
Lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press again.

exercises.name: kettlebell lying on floor single arm bottoms up chest press
exercises.description: A one-arm floor press with the kettlebell upside down. It demands stability in the wrist and shoulder.
steps: Lie on the floor and hold a kettlebell upside down in one hand.
Keep your wrist straight and the bell steady.
Press it up to full extension.
Lower slowly until your upper arm touches the floor.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: weighted plate standing high front raise
exercises.description: Raising a weight plate in front of you to above eye level. It trains the front shoulders and upper chest.
steps: Stand holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Keep your arms nearly straight.
Raise the plate up and overhead.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: barbell pin front squat
exercises.description: A front squat starting from pins in a rack, removing the stretch reflex. It builds strength out of the bottom.
steps: Set pins at the bottom depth and place the bar on them.
Get under the bar in a front rack position.
Brace and drive up to stand.
Lower back to the pins under control.
Pause and reset between reps.

exercises.name: banded glute ham raise v. 2
exercises.description: A glute-ham raise with a band assisting the movement. It strengthens the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Set up on a glute-ham bench or anchor your feet with a band assisting you.
Start with your torso down and hips locked.
Curl up using your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: barbell single leg good morning
exercises.description: A single-leg barbell hip hinge. It trains the hamstrings and balance.
steps: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand on one leg.
Keep your standing knee slightly bent.
Hinge forward while your free leg extends behind you.
Lower until your torso is near parallel.
Return and switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: barbell pin good morning
exercises.description: A good morning starting from pins in a rack. It builds hamstring and lower back strength.
steps: Set the pins to a hip-hinge height and set the bar on them.
Get under the bar, brace and unrack.
Hinge forward with a flat back.
Return the bar to the pins.
Stand tall and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell alternate lateral raise
exercises.description: Raising dumbbells out to the sides one arm at a time. It builds the side delts.
steps: Stand holding light dumbbells at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly.
Switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell lateral lunge
exercises.description: A sideways lunge with dumbbells. It trains the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest or sides.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee.
Keep your other leg straight.
Push off to return and switch sides.

exercises.name: barbell sitting on floor oblique twist
exercises.description: A seated twist with a barbell across your shoulders. It trains the obliques and core rotation.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs bent and a bar across your shoulders.
Lean back slightly and brace.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center.
Rotate to the other side.

exercises.name: bodyweight standing oblique twist
exercises.description: A standing trunk rotation without load. It warms up the obliques and spine.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and arms at chest height.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to center.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips facing forward.

exercises.name: barbell pin close grip bench press
exercises.description: A close-grip bench press from pins. It builds triceps strength off the dead stop.
steps: Set the bar on pins at chest height.
Lie on the bench and grip the bar shoulder-width.
Press the bar up.
Lock out your elbows.
Lower back to the pins.

exercises.name: barbell behind the back push press
exercises.description: A push press with the bar behind the neck. It builds overhead power.
steps: Hold a barbell on your upper back with a wide grip.
Dip your knees slightly.
Drive up explosively and press overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders.

exercises.name: lateral walk push up
exercises.description: A push-up combined with side steps. It trains the chest and shoulders with extra coordination.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Do one push-up.
Step your hands and feet to the side.
Do another push-up.
Alternate direction after a set.

exercises.name: push up to side plank v. 2
exercises.description: A push-up that finishes by rotating into a side plank. It trains the chest and trunk.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
Push up and rotate into a side plank, raising one arm.
Return to plank.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: push up with knee drive
exercises.description: A push-up followed by a knee drive toward the chest. It combines upper-body strength with core work.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Lower into a push-up.
Push back up.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Return and alternate legs.

exercises.name: kettlebell romanian deadlift
exercises.description: A hip hinge with a kettlebell. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Hold a kettlebell in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees.
Push your hips back and lower the bell along your legs.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

exercises.name: barbell standing snatch grip shrug
exercises.description: A shrug with a wide snatch grip. It trains the traps and grip.
steps: Hold a barbell with a wide snatch grip at your thighs.
Stand tall with your chest up.
Shrug your shoulders straight up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: side plank leg lift
exercises.description: A side plank with the top leg lifted. It trains the obliques and hip stabilisers.
steps: Lie on your side and prop up on your forearm.
Lift your hips into a side plank.
Raise your top leg.
Lower it slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: barbell sumo deadlift from deficit
exercises.description: A sumo deadlift standing on a low platform. It increases range of motion off the floor.
steps: Stand on a low platform with a wide stance and toes out.
Grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace and push the floor away.
Lock your hips out.
Lower the bar under control.

exercises.name: dumbbell overhead walking lunge
exercises.description: Walking lunges with dumbbells held overhead. It trains the legs and shoulder stability.
steps: Hold dumbbells overhead with locked arms.
Step forward into a lunge.
Lower your back knee near the floor.
Push through your front foot.
Step through into the next lunge.

exercises.name: barbell z press
exercises.description: A seated floor overhead press with legs straight. It builds shoulders and core.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs straight and the bar at your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Press the bar overhead.
Lock out your arms.
Lower to the shoulders.

exercises.name: butterfly yoga flaps
exercises.description: Seated butterfly pose with gentle knee flapping. It loosens the inner thighs and hips.
steps: Sit with the soles of your feet together.
Hold your feet.
Gently flap your knees up and down.
Keep your spine tall.
Continue for 30 seconds.

exercises.name: hip clam shell
exercises.description: A side-lying clamshell opening of the knees. It strengthens the outer hips.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and feet together.
Keep your feet touching.
Lift your top knee.
Lower slowly.
Switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell 6 ways raise
exercises.description: A series of six dumbbell raises in different directions. It thoroughly trains the shoulders.
steps: Hold light dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them to the side and lower.
Raise them to the front and lower.
Then bend forward and raise them out to the rear.
Complete all six variations as one rep.

exercises.name: bodyweight standing back stretch
exercises.description: A standing stretch that opens up the back. It is a gentle way to loosen tight muscles along the spine.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of you and press your arms forward.
Round your upper back and tuck your chin slightly.
Feel the stretch between your shoulder blades and along the spine.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly and stand tall.

exercises.name: prayer push
exercises.description: Pressing your palms together in front of your chest. It activates the chest and shoulders without any equipment.
steps: Stand or sit tall and press your palms together at chest height.
Point your fingers up and keep your elbows out.
Push your palms firmly into each other.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and shake out your arms.
Repeat for several rounds.

exercises.name: lying criss cross legs
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you cross your legs back and forth. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with legs raised slightly off the floor.
Press your lower back down.
Cross one leg over the other.
Switch and cross the other way.
Continue smoothly.

exercises.name: bridge hip abduction
exercises.description: A glute bridge where you press the knees apart at the top. It fires up the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Drive through your heels and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping the hips high, open both knees out to the sides.
Bring the knees back together without dropping the hips.
Lower slowly to the floor and repeat.
Keep your ribs down so your lower back does not arch.

exercises.name: side lying scissors
exercises.description: Lying on your side, you open and close the legs like scissors. Good for the outer hips and the glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with your body in a straight line and head supported.
Stack your legs and lift the top leg slightly.
Raise the top leg up while the bottom leg lifts toward it.
Bring them back together in a smooth scissor motion.
Keep your hips stacked and still.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lying air cycles
exercises.description: A floor cycling move that keeps the core working while the legs pedal in the air. It builds abdominal endurance.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your head or at your sides.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pedal your legs as if riding a bicycle.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Breathe steadily and keep a smooth rhythm.
Lower your legs and rest when your form slips.

exercises.name: side lying outward knee kick
exercises.description: From a side lying position you swing the top knee out and kick the leg outward. It works the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and bottom leg bent.
Bend the top knee and bring it toward your chest.
Kick the top leg straight out to the side.
Pull the knee back in under control.
Keep your torso still the whole time.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lying incline hip raise
exercises.description: A hip raise done lying on an incline. It trains the lower abs by curling your pelvis toward your ribs.
steps: Lie back on an incline surface and hold the top with your hands.
Bring your legs up with knees slightly bent.
Curl your pelvis and lift your hips off the surface.
Pause with your feet pointing toward the ceiling.
Lower your hips slowly.
Avoid swinging your legs.

exercises.name: lying flat hip raise
exercises.description: A hip raise done lying flat on the floor. It works the lower abs by lifting your hips with a controlled curl.
steps: Lie on your back with arms by your sides or under your hips.
Raise your legs so they point to the ceiling.
Tighten your abs and lift your hips a few centimetres.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower your hips slowly to the floor.
Keep the motion small and controlled.

exercises.name: dumbbells glute bridge v. 2
exercises.description: A glute bridge with dumbbells resting on your hips, a second variation. The added weight makes the glutes work harder.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Rest a dumbbell on each hip and hold them in place.
Push through your heels and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top in a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Lower your hips slowly.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing high windmill
exercises.description: A windmill with the weight held high overhead while you hinge sideways. It trains the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Stand with feet wide and press a dumbbell overhead with one arm.
Turn your feet slightly away from the weighted side.
Push your hips toward the weighted side and hinge forward.
Slide your free hand down your leg while your eyes stay on the dumbbell.
Reverse the movement to stand tall again.
Keep the arm locked and stacked over your shoulder, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell power clean
exercises.description: An explosive pull that takes a pair of dumbbells from the floor to your shoulders. It builds power through the hips.
steps: Stand over the dumbbells with feet hip width and grab them with a flat back.
Push through the floor and extend your hips and knees fast.
Shrug and pull the dumbbells up close to your body.
Drop under them and catch them on your shoulders in a quarter squat.
Stand tall, then lower with control to the floor.
Keep your back flat and the weights close throughout.

exercises.name: glute ham raise with extended arms
exercises.description: A glute ham raise performed with the arms stretched out in front, making the lift harder. It strongly trains the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Set up on the glute ham bench with your ankles locked in and thighs supported.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a straight body.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Move slowly and avoid arching your lower back.

exercises.name: hanging half windmill
exercises.description: From a hang you lift the legs and sweep them to one side in a half circle. It builds oblique strength and grip.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm overhand grip.
Raise both legs together toward one side of the bar.
Sweep them across the front in a half circle.
Lower the legs on the other side under control.
Keep the swing small and your shoulders active.
Repeat, alternating the direction.

exercises.name: elevated single leg squat
exercises.description: A one legged squat with the working foot raised on a step. It builds leg strength and balance.
steps: Stand on a bench or box on one leg with the other leg hanging off the edge.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Sit your hips back and bend the standing knee to lower.
Go as deep as you can while the knee tracks over your toes.
Push through the foot to stand back up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kneeling half triceps extension
exercises.description: A kneeling cable triceps extension done in a short range at the lockout. It isolates the triceps.
steps: Kneel facing the cable stack and hold the attachment with elbows bent.
Tuck your elbows close to your sides.
Press the handle down until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps at the bottom.
Let the hands rise only halfway, keeping tension.
Keep your upper arms still throughout.

exercises.name: staggered leg side bridge
exercises.description: A side plank with the feet placed one in front of the other for a different base. It trains the obliques and hips.
steps: Lie on your side with your forearm under your shoulder.
Stagger your feet, top foot in front of the bottom one.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Keep the hips high and avoid rolling forward.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: standing calf raise circle
exercises.description: A calf raise that finishes with a small circle of the heels. It works the calves and the ankle control.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width apart and hold a support if needed.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Trace a small circle with your heels while staying high.
Lower your heels slowly to the floor.
Reverse the circle direction on the next rep.
Keep your knees straight and your balance steady.

exercises.name: kneeling straight leg side kick
exercises.description: A kneeling side kick with a straight leg. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Extend one leg out to the side with the knee straight.
Lift the leg to about hip height.
Keep your hips and back steady.
Lower with control without touching down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: reverse sliding leg curl on floor with towel
exercises.description: A hamstring curl on a towel where you slide the heels away and pull them back. It is a challenging bodyweight hamstring move.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels on a towel on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Slide your feet away from you by extending the knees.
Pull the heels back toward your hips with your hamstrings.
Keep your hips high the whole set.
Lower to the floor when you finish.

exercises.name: kick side jump
exercises.description: A lively jump that ends with a kick out to the side. It lifts your heart rate and trains leg power.
steps: Stand tall with your knees slightly bent.
Jump up off both feet.
Kick one leg out to the side at the top.
Land softly on both feet with soft knees.
Repeat, alternating the kicking leg.
Keep a controlled, bouncy rhythm.

exercises.name: lever bent over wide row (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A plate loaded machine row with a wide grip while bent over. It builds the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Load the machine and set your chest against the support.
Grab the wide handles with arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your lower chest, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.
Keep your chest on the pad throughout.

exercises.name: elevated seated calf raise
exercises.description: A seated calf raise with the balls of the feet on a raised surface for a deeper stretch. It targets the lower calf muscle.
steps: Sit on a bench with the balls of your feet on a raised step.
Rest weight or your hands on your thighs.
Lower your heels as far as you comfortably can.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing windmill
exercises.description: A standing windmill with a dumbbell held overhead as you hinge to the side. It trains the obliques, hips and shoulder stability.
steps: Press a dumbbell overhead with one hand and stand with feet wide.
Turn your toes slightly away from the weight.
Push your hips out and hinge sideways.
Slide your free hand down your leg toward the floor.
Reverse the motion and stand tall.
Keep your eyes on the weight, then switch sides.

exercises.name: elevated single leg hip thrust
exercises.description: A one-legged hip thrust with the foot or upper back raised on a platform. It increases the range for the glutes.
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench and put one foot on the floor or a raised step.
Lift the other leg off the ground.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower slowly under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: resistance band seated leg curl
exercises.description: A seated hamstring curl using a resistance band anchored in front of you. It isolates the back of the thigh.
steps: Anchor the band at foot height and sit facing it.
Loop the band around your heels.
Extend your legs straight in front of you.
Curl your heels back under the seat against the tension.
Squeeze the hamstrings at the end.
Return slowly without letting the band snap.

exercises.name: toe jump
exercises.description: Quick small hops on the balls of your feet. It trains the calves and ankles and builds a springy stride.
steps: Stand tall with feet close together and knees slightly bent.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hop up quickly using mainly your ankles.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep your hops small and rhythmic.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: banded glute ham raise v. 3
exercises.description: A glute ham raise with a band for assistance, a third variation. It builds the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Set up on a glute ham bench with your ankles locked and a band for support.
Cross your arms or hold the band in front of you.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a straight body.
Squeeze your hamstrings and glutes to pull yourself back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Move slowly and avoid jerking.

exercises.name: long lever decline sit up
exercises.description: A decline sit-up with the arms extended overhead. The long lever makes it a tougher core exercise.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, raising your arms with it.
Sit up until your chest is over your thighs.
Lower slowly back down.
Keep your arms reaching forward the whole time.

exercises.name: side plank with raised leg v. 2
exercises.description: A side plank with the top leg lifted, a second variation. It adds hip work to the oblique hold.
steps: Set up in a side plank on your forearm with your body in a line.
Lift your top leg to hip height.
Keep your hips high and your core tight.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without dropping.
Lower down gently.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: dumbbell over bench reverse wrist curl with mat
exercises.description: A reverse wrist curl with your forearms resting on a padded bench. It builds the muscles on top of the forearm.
steps: Kneel by a bench with forearms on it, palms down, wrists over the edge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your wrists lower gently.
Curl the weights up by extending your wrists.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep your forearms still on the bench.

exercises.name: side to wide squat
exercises.description: A squat that starts with feet together and steps out to a wide stance. It trains the glutes and legs.
steps: Stand with your feet together and arms in front.
Step one foot out to the side into a wide stance.
Sit down into a squat with your chest up.
Stand up and bring your feet back together.
Alternate the stepping side.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: dumbbell bent arm iso hold
exercises.description: A static hold with the elbows bent and the dumbbells held in place. It builds endurance in the arms.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand.
Curl the weights until your elbows are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.
Hold the position without letting the weights drop.
Breathe steadily during the hold.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then lower under control.

exercises.name: inverted wide to narrow row
exercises.description: An inverted row where you start with a wide grip and finish narrow. It trains the whole back and the arms.
steps: Set a bar or straps at waist height and lie underneath.
Grab it with a wide grip and straighten your body.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Bring your hands closer on the way up or between reps.
Lower yourself with control.
Keep your body in a straight line.

exercises.name: ring leg curl v. 2
exercises.description: A hamstring curl with the heels in rings, second variation. It builds hamstrings and glutes with an unstable setup.
steps: Lie on your back with your heels in the rings.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Pull the rings toward your glutes by bending the knees.
Pause and squeeze the hamstrings.
Extend your legs slowly back out.
Keep your hips high throughout.

exercises.name: narrow top half pull up
exercises.description: A partial pull-up with a narrow grip, done in the top half of the range. It focuses on the upper phase of the pull.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar with a narrow grip and pull up to the top position.
Lower yourself to about halfway.
Pull back up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your chest up and your elbows close.
Avoid swinging.
Repeat for your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell deadlift (neutral grip)
exercises.description: A deadlift with dumbbells held with palms facing in. It trains the glutes, hamstrings and back.
steps: Stand with feet hip width and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and lower the weights.
Keep the dumbbells close to your legs.
Push through your heels to stand tall.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Do not round your lower back.

exercises.name: reverse leg extension
exercises.description: A prone or quadruped move where you extend the leg backward. It focuses on the glutes.
steps: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Extend one leg back and up.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower the leg without touching the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: high bar inverted row
exercises.description: An inverted row on a high bar, which makes the pull more upright and easier. It builds the back and arms.
steps: Set a bar at about chest height and grab it overhand.
Walk your feet forward until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.

exercises.name: alternate high hop
exercises.description: Springy hops from one foot to the other with a high knee. It raises your heart rate and trains leg power.
steps: Stand tall with your arms ready to swing.
Hop off one foot and drive the opposite knee up.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Switch legs on the next hop.
Swing your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Keep a quick, bouncy pace.

exercises.name: kneeling assisted sliding chin up
exercises.description: A kneeling, assisted chin up where you slide on the floor to reduce the load. It helps you build toward full chin ups.
steps: Kneel below a bar and grab it with an underhand grip.
Place a towel or slider under your knees.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Use your legs lightly to help.
Lower slowly to straight arms.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: leg assisted ring pull up
exercises.description: A ring pull up where your feet on the floor help you up. It is a good step toward full pull ups.
steps: Hold the rings with a firm grip and stand with a bend in the knees.
Place your feet on the floor for light help.
Pull your elbows down and your chest between the rings.
Use your legs only as much as you need.
Lower with control.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.name: ring high row
exercises.description: A row with the rings pulled toward your face, higher than a normal row. It builds the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Hold the rings and lean back with a straight body.
Pull the rings toward your forehead.
Flare your elbows out and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower until your arms are straight.
Keep your hips up the whole time.

exercises.name: ring chest fly
exercises.description: A fly in the rings from a push up position. It stretches and works the chest with a lot of core control.
steps: Set the rings low and hold them in a plank position.
Keep your arms nearly straight with a small bend in the elbows.
Open your arms out to the sides, lowering your chest.
Pull the rings back together with your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Go only as wide as you can control.

exercises.name: ring reverse fly
exercises.description: A reverse fly using rings while leaning back. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back.
steps: Hold the rings with arms straight and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your elbows only slightly bent.

exercises.name: long lever lying back extension
exercises.description: A prone back extension with the arms stretched long overhead. It strengthens the lower back and glutes.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Squeeze your glutes to stabilize.
Lift your chest and arms off the floor.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control.
Keep your neck neutral by looking down.

exercises.name: seated calf stretch v. 2
exercises.description: A seated stretch for the calves, a second variation. It helps loosen tight lower legs.
steps: Sit with one leg straight in front of you.
Loop your hands or a strap around the ball of your foot.
Gently pull your toes toward you.
Feel the stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: lying calf stretch
exercises.description: A calf stretch done lying on your back. It stretches the lower leg with little effort from the rest of your body.
steps: Lie on your back and lift one leg toward the ceiling.
Hold behind the thigh or use a strap on your foot.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Keep the knee as straight as you comfortably can.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: lunge stretch
exercises.description: A low lunge held to stretch the front of the hip and thigh. It opens up the hips.
steps: Step one foot forward into a lunge, back knee down on a mat.
Keep your torso upright.
Push your hips gently forward.
Feel the stretch in the front of the back hip and thigh.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: single leg calf stretch
exercises.description: A calf stretch done on one leg at a time. It lengthens the lower leg muscles.
steps: Stand facing a wall with one foot back and heel on the floor.
Place your hands on the wall.
Lean forward with a straight back leg.
Feel the stretch in the calf.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: lying bent knee figure 8
exercises.description: A lying hip mobility move where you draw a figure eight with the bent knee. It loosens the hips.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent.
Lift one knee above the hip.
Trace a slow figure eight in the air with your knee.
Keep the movement smooth and controlled.
Keep your pelvis steady on the floor.
Switch legs after a set.

exercises.name: standing leg circle
exercises.description: Circles with a straight leg while standing. It loosens the hips and warms up the glutes.
steps: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw a smooth circle with the leg.
Keep your torso still.
Reverse the direction after several reps.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: reverse plank v. 2
exercises.description: A plank done face up, with a slightly different arm setup. It strengthens the back of the body and the core.
steps: Sit with your legs straight and your hands behind you.
Press into your hands and lift your hips.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Keep your chin neutral.
Squeeze your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: around the world superman
exercises.description: A superman hold where the arms sweep in a circle. It works the lower back, glutes and shoulders.
steps: Lie face down with your arms extended overhead.
Lift your chest, arms and legs off the floor.
Sweep your arms out to the sides toward your hips.
Return them overhead in a wide arc.
Keep your legs lifted.
Lower to the floor to rest.

exercises.name: sumo air squat
exercises.description: A bodyweight squat with a wide stance and toes turned out. It trains the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes turned out.
Hold your hands in front of your chest.
Sit down between your legs.
Keep your chest up and knees over the toes.
Push through your heels to stand.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: 45 degree hip extension glute focused
exercises.description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a rounded upper back. This shifts the focus onto the glutes.
steps: Set up on a 45 degree bench with your ankles locked.
Cross your arms over your chest and round your upper back slightly.
Lower your torso by hinging at the hips.
Squeeze the glutes to raise back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Avoid overarching your lower back.

exercises.name: wrist abduction
exercises.description: A gentle wrist movement that tilts the hand toward the thumb side. It improves wrist mobility.
steps: Rest your forearm on a table with your hand off the edge.
Keep your palm facing in.
Tilt your hand up toward the thumb side.
Return to neutral slowly.
Keep your forearm still.
Do equal reps on both wrists.

exercises.name: superman row
exercises.description: A prone superman with a rowing motion of the arms. It targets the upper back and the muscles along the spine.
steps: Lie face down with arms extended in front.
Lift your chest and arms slightly off the floor.
Pull your elbows back toward your ribs as if rowing.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Extend your arms forward again.
Keep your neck neutral.

exercises.name: stationary arms throw
exercises.description: An arm swing from a stationary stance. It warms up the shoulders and upper back.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and arms at your sides.
Swing your arms up and back in a throwing motion.
Rotate through your torso slightly.
Keep the movement smooth and rhythmic.
Switch arms or alternate.
Continue for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: standing bent knee figure 8
exercises.description: A standing hip mobility move where you draw a figure eight with the bent knee. It loosens the hips.
steps: Stand tall and hold a support if needed.
Lift one knee in front of you.
Trace a slow figure eight with your knee.
Keep your standing leg steady.
Keep your torso upright.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: chest out hands behind (hold)
exercises.description: A standing chest stretch with the hands clasped behind your back. It opens the front of the chest.
steps: Stand tall and clasp your hands behind your back.
Straighten your arms.
Lift your chest and gently raise your hands.
Feel the stretch across the chest and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release slowly.

exercises.name: cable kneeling one arm lat pulldown
exercises.description: A one arm lat pulldown from a kneeling position. It builds the lats and tests your core control.
steps: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle down toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Let the arm rise back up slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: bodyweight forward lunge (hinge at hips)
exercises.description: A forward lunge with a forward hinge at the hips. It shifts more work to the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Hinge your torso forward at the hips.
Lower until both knees are bent.
Push off the front foot to return.
Alternate legs.

exercises.name: bodyweight forward lunge (smaller stance upright torso)
exercises.description: A forward lunge with a shorter step and an upright torso. It emphasizes the quads.
steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a short step forward.
Lower straight down, keeping your torso upright.
Keep the front knee over the ankle.
Push through the front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

exercises.name: lever pendulum squat (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A squat on a pendulum machine that swings along an arc. It loads the quads heavily.
steps: Load the machine and step onto the platform.
Place your shoulders under the pads.
Unlock the machine and lower in a controlled squat.
Go as deep as comfortable.
Push through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up and heels down.

exercises.name: lying lat pulldown
exercises.description: A lat pulldown done lying down. It trains the lats with a different angle.
steps: Lie on a bench under a high pulley.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull the bar down toward your chest.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly with straight arms.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: cable overhead single arm triceps extension (rope attachment)
exercises.description: A one arm overhead triceps extension with a rope. It isolates the triceps.
steps: Hold a rope with one hand overhead and face away from the stack.
Keep your upper arm close to your head.
Extend your elbow until the arm is straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lunge thighs (form check)
exercises.description: A form check drawing for the lunge, showing correct and incorrect positions. It reminds you how to train the thighs safely.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip width.
Step forward into a lunge.
Keep your front knee over your ankle.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up to the start.
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

exercises.name: cable high triceps extension
exercises.description: A triceps extension performed from a high cable position. It builds the triceps.
steps: Set the cable high and face it.
Hold the attachment with elbows bent.
Press down by extending your elbows.
Squeeze at the bottom.
Return slowly.
Keep your elbows near your sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell prone triceps kickback
exercises.description: A triceps kickback performed lying face down on an incline bench. It isolates the triceps.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench holding dumbbells.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees and keep your upper arms close.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight.
Squeeze the triceps.
Lower slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.

exercises.name: barbell box squat
exercises.description: A squat to a box behind you. It trains the hips and legs while teaching depth control.
steps: Place a box behind you and a barbell on your upper back.
Push your hips back and sit onto the box.
Pause briefly without relaxing.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

exercises.name: kettlebell box squat
exercises.description: A squat to a box holding a kettlebell at your chest. It trains the hips and legs.
steps: Stand in front of a box holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Push your hips back and sit onto the box.
Pause briefly.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Keep your chest up.
Keep your elbows close.

exercises.name: jump shrug
exercises.description: An explosive jump with a shrug at the top. It builds hip power for the Olympic lifts.
steps: Stand holding a barbell at hip height.
Dip slightly with your knees.
Jump explosively and extend fully.
Shrug your shoulders at the top.
Land softly with bent knees.
Keep the bar close to your body.

exercises.name: jump box v. 2
exercises.description: A box jump that builds explosive leg power. It trains the whole lower body.
steps: Stand facing a box with feet shoulder width.
Dip and swing your arms back.
Jump onto the box with both feet.
Land softly with bent knees.
Stand tall on the box.
Step down carefully.

exercises.name: press under
exercises.description: An Olympic style drill where you press yourself down under a barbell overhead. It builds shoulder stability and speed.
steps: Hold a barbell overhead with a wide grip.
Press up so your arms lock out.
Drop into a squat while keeping the bar overhead.
Keep your arms locked.
Stand up tall.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: lateral raise arms (form check)
exercises.description: A form check drawing for the lateral raise, showing correct and incorrect technique. It reminds you how to train the side delts safely.
steps: Stand tall with dumbbells at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides.
Stop at shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Compare with the incorrect position to correct your form.

exercises.name: quadruped leg curl
exercises.description: A hamstring curl from hands and knees position. It works the back of the thigh.
steps: Get on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your core.
Curl one heel toward your glutes.
Squeeze the hamstring.
Lower slowly.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: assisted chin up (squat position)
exercises.description: A chin up where you use your legs in a squat position to assist. It helps you build toward full chin ups.
steps: Grab a bar with an underhand grip.
Bend your knees into a squat position.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Use your legs only as much as you need.
Lower slowly.
Keep your shoulders down.

exercises.name: bodyweight single leg rdl
exercises.description: A single leg Romanian deadlift without weight. It trains the hamstrings and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee.
Hinge forward as the other leg lifts behind you.
Keep your back flat.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.
Finish reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: decline sit up and russian twist
exercises.description: A decline sit up followed by a Russian twist at the top. It trains the abs and obliques.
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured.
Sit up toward your knees.
Twist your torso to one side at the top.
Twist to the other side.
Lower slowly to the bench.
Keep your movements controlled.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline biceps curl (70 degrees)
exercises.description: A biceps curl seated on a bench set to 70 degrees. The slight lean keeps the arms hanging for a good stretch.
steps: Set a bench to 70 degrees and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang by your sides, palms forward.
Curl the weights up without moving your elbows.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
Keep your back against the bench.

exercises.name: inverted row slide on floor
exercises.description: An inverted row where you pull your body along the floor on sliders. It trains the back with core demand.
steps: Lie under a bar or lower support with sliders under your heels.
Grab the bar overhand.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Keep your body straight.
Lower slowly.
Keep your hips up.

exercises.name: lying leg raise v. 3
exercises.description: Raising your legs while lying on your back. It works the lower abs and the hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight and arms by your sides.
Press your lower back gently into the floor.
Lift both legs together until they point to the ceiling.
Lower them slowly, stopping before your back arches.
Keep your legs as straight as you comfortably can.
Breathe steadily through each rep.

exercises.name: mountain climber jump
exercises.description: A mountain climber with a jump between the feet. It raises your heart rate and works the core.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Drive one knee toward your chest.
Switch legs with a small jump.
Keep your hips low.
Maintain a fast, steady pace.
Rest when your form slips.

exercises.name: ring alternate superman
exercises.description: A superman variation with your feet in rings, lifting opposite arm and leg in turn. It builds the lower back and core.
steps: Put your feet in the rings and get into a face-down plank.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm forward while holding steady.
Return it and switch to the other arm.
Avoid letting your lower back sag.
Alternate sides for the full set.

exercises.name: ring kneeling ab rollout
exercises.description: Kneeling ab rollout on gymnastic rings. The unstable rings make your core work hard to keep the body straight as you extend.
steps: Kneel and hold the rings at about knee height with a firm grip.
Brace your abs and keep a straight line from head to knees.
Roll the rings forward by extending your arms until you are long but still in control.
Pull the rings back toward your knees by contracting your abs.
Do not let your lower back sag at any point.

exercises.name: ring rollout
exercises.description: A rollout using gymnastic rings. The unstable rings make your core work hard.
steps: Kneel holding rings under your shoulders.
Brace your core and tuck your pelvis.
Roll your arms forward, extending your body.
Go as far as you can with a flat back.
Pull back to the start using your abs.
Keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: reverse flutter kick on floor (hand under head) v. 2
exercises.description: Alternating small leg kicks while lying on your back with hands under your head. It works the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands under your head and legs extended.
Lift both heels a few inches off the floor and press your lower back down.
Kick one leg up higher while the other goes down, then switch in a steady rhythm.
Keep your legs fairly straight and your core tight.
Stop the set when your lower back starts to arch.

exercises.name: barbell close grip biceps curl
exercises.description: Barbell curl with hands placed close together. This grip puts extra emphasis on the outer part of the biceps.
steps: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands closer than shoulder width.
Keep your elbows tucked against your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Squeeze your biceps at the top for a moment.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: negative dragon flag
exercises.description: The lowering half of the dragon flag. You control a straight body down toward the bench, which builds serious core strength.
steps: Lie on a bench and grip the edge behind your head.
Raise your body into a straight vertical line on your upper back.
Lower your body slowly as one stiff plank, keeping hips from bending.
Stop just above the bench with your core tight.
Bend your knees to return to the start, then repeat.

exercises.name: top pull up hold
exercises.description: Holding the top of a pull-up with your chin above the bar. It builds strength and grip in the finish position.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar and pull yourself up.
Bring your chin above the bar.
Squeeze your shoulder blades down and back.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower yourself slowly.
Keep your body still.

exercises.name: kneeling modified hindu push up
exercises.description: An easier knee-supported version of the hindu push up. The flowing dip and sweep trains the chest, shoulders and triceps and opens the spine.
steps: Start on your knees and hands with hips high, like a pike.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest down and forward close to the floor.
Push through your arms to glide your chest up and forward, arching slightly.
Reverse the path, pushing your hips back up to the start.
Move smoothly and keep your core engaged.

exercises.name: band assisted floor glute ham raise
exercises.description: Floor glute ham raise where a band helps you come back up. It builds the hamstrings and glutes with a manageable load.
steps: Anchor a band at head height and loop it around your chest or hold it to your chest.
Kneel with your feet held firmly under a stable object.
Lower your torso forward slowly with a straight line from knees to head.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings and glutes, using the band to help.
Keep your hips extended throughout.

exercises.name: dumbbell step up v. 2
exercises.description: Step up onto a bench or box holding dumbbells. It trains your legs and glutes one side at a time.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a sturdy bench.
Place one foot fully on the bench.
Drive through that heel to stand up tall on the bench.
Lower your trailing foot back down under control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lying leg figure eight
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you trace a figure eight in the air with your legs. It keeps the lower abs and hip flexors under tension.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips and legs lifted.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Trace a figure eight in the air with your feet, slowly and in control.
Keep your legs close together.
Change direction halfway through the set.

exercises.name: inverse leg curl with bench pads
exercises.description: A bodyweight hamstring curl where you lower your torso against the pads. It is very demanding for the back of the thighs.
steps: Anchor your ankles under the bench pads and kneel upright.
Cross your arms or hold them in front of you.
Lean forward slowly from the knees, keeping hips and torso in a straight line.
Lower as far as you can control.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings.

exercises.name: v sit cross punch
exercises.description: Hold a V sit and punch across your body. You train the abs and obliques while balancing.
steps: Sit with knees bent and lean back, lifting your feet off the floor.
Raise your fists in front of your chest.
Punch one arm across your body while twisting your torso.
Return to center and punch with the other arm.
Keep your chest tall and your balance steady.

exercises.name: knee tuck oblique crunch
exercises.description: Drive a knee toward the opposite elbow to crunch the side of your waist. It trains the obliques and lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head.
Lift your shoulders off the floor.
Tuck one knee in while rotating your opposite elbow toward it.
Return and repeat to the other side.
Move with control instead of pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: side plank rotation
exercises.description: A side plank with an arm rotation under the body. It builds the obliques and shoulder stability.
steps: Set up in a side plank on one forearm or hand with your top arm raised.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Thread your top arm under your torso, rotating your chest toward the floor.
Rotate back and reach the arm up to the ceiling.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: opposite crunch
exercises.description: Crunch where opposite arm and leg move toward each other. It hits the abs and obliques together.
steps: Lie on your back with hands lightly behind your head.
Lift one leg bent while curling your torso up.
Bring the opposite elbow toward the raised knee.
Lower slowly with control.
Alternate sides on each rep.

exercises.name: lying leg cross
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you cross straight legs over each other. It works the lower abs and inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides.
Lift both legs a little off the floor with your lower back pressed down.
Open them wide, then cross one leg over the other.
Open again and cross with the other leg on top.
Keep your core tight throughout.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated external shoulder rotation
exercises.description: Seated rotation with a light dumbbell that trains the muscles on the back of the shoulder. It supports healthy shoulders.
steps: Sit holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your side.
Rest your arm on your thigh or a pad for support.
Rotate your forearm upward and outward, keeping the elbow in place.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell one arm y elevation
exercises.description: A light dumbbell raise along a Y-shaped path. It trains the shoulders and the muscles of the upper back.
steps: Hold a light dumbbell in one hand and hinge slightly or lie chest down on an incline bench.
Start with your arm hanging down.
Raise your arm diagonally overhead to form a Y with your thumb up.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, and switch sides.

exercises.name: standing single leg calf raise (on a staircase)
exercises.description: One-legged calf raise from a stair step for a deep stretch. It builds calf strength and ankle stability.
steps: Stand on the edge of a stair on one foot, holding the rail for balance.
Let your heel drop below the step.
Rise up onto your toes as high as you can.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch legs after your set.

exercises.name: suspension sumo squat
exercises.description: A wide-stance squat holding suspension handles for support. It trains the inner thighs and glutes.
steps: Stand facing the anchor holding the handles with a wide stance.
Turn your toes out slightly.
Sit your hips down, keeping knees over toes.
Use the straps lightly for balance.
Push through your heels to stand.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: band seated underhand grip row
exercises.description: Seated row using a band and an underhand grip. This grip adds extra work for the lats and biceps.
steps: Sit with your legs extended and the band looped around your feet.
Hold the band ends with an underhand grip, arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: suspension underhand grip inverted row
exercises.description: An inverted row on suspension straps with an underhand grip. It builds the back and biceps.
steps: Hold the handles palms up and lean back with a straight body.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly.
Walk your feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: suspension hammer curl
exercises.description: A hammer curl using suspension straps with palms facing each other. It works the biceps and the muscles beside them.
steps: Hold the handles with palms facing each other and lean back.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Curl your hands toward your head.
Keep your elbows high and still.
Lower slowly until arms are straight.
Keep your core tight.

exercises.name: suspension chin up
exercises.description: A chin-up on suspension straps. It builds the lats and arms with a natural hand path.
steps: Hold the handles palms facing you and lean back.
Brace your core and keep your body straight.
Pull your chest toward the handles.
Squeeze your elbows close to your sides.
Lower under control.
Adjust your foot position to change difficulty.

exercises.name: elevated standing calf raise v. 2
