Push your hips back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.

exercises.name: peacock pose mayurasana
exercises.description: An advanced arm balance with your torso held horizontally on your elbows. It builds core and wrist strength.
steps: Kneel and place your hands on the floor with fingers pointing back toward your feet.
Bring your elbows together under your belly.
Lean forward and rest your torso on your upper arms.
Extend your legs back and lift them.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower.

exercises.name: half frog pose ardha bhekasana
exercises.description: A prone backbend with one foot pulled toward your hip. It stretches the quads and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your belly, propped on your forearms.
Bend one knee and reach back to hold that foot.
Gently press the foot toward your hip.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: sage marichi i pose marichyasana
exercises.description: A seated forward fold with a twist and a bent knee. It stretches the back, hips and hamstrings.
steps: Sit with one leg straight and the other knee bent, foot flat beside the straight leg.
Wrap your opposite arm around the bent knee.
Sit tall, then twist toward the bent knee.
Keep your spine long.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: bird of paradise pose svarga dvijasana
exercises.description: A standing bind pose that straightens one leg upward. It demands balance and flexibility in the hamstrings.
steps: Stand and bind one arm behind your back around your bent knee.
Grab your hand with the other arm.
Step in and stand tall on the grounded leg.
Slowly straighten the lifted leg.
Hold for a few breaths, then switch.

exercises.name: wheel pose urdhva dhanurasana
exercises.description: A deep backbend pressing up from the floor. It opens the chest and shoulders and strengthens the back and legs.
steps: Lie on your back, knees bent, hands beside your head with fingers toward your feet.
Press into hands and feet and lift your hips.
Straighten your arms as you lift the crown of your head off the floor.
Press your chest toward the wall behind.
Hold for a few breaths, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: one legged upward bow pose eka pada urdhva dhanurasana
exercises.description: A wheel pose with one leg lifted into the air. It adds balance and strength demand to the backbend.
steps: Come into wheel pose with hands and feet pressing down.
Shift weight onto one foot.
Lift the other leg toward the ceiling.
Keep your hips high and level.
Hold briefly, lower, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dragonfly pose maksikanagasana
exercises.description: A seated wide-leg arm balance with legs extended out to the sides. It needs hip flexibility and core strength.
steps: Squat with hands on the floor in front of you.
Place your knees high on your upper arms.
Lean forward and lift your feet off the floor.
Extend your legs wide to the sides.
Hold for a few breaths, then release.

exercises.name: half boat pose ardha navasana
exercises.description: A V-shaped balance on your sit bones. It strengthens the abs and hip flexors.
steps: Sit with knees bent and lean back a little.
Lift your feet so your shins are parallel to the floor.
Extend your arms forward.
Keep your chest open and spine long.
Hold for 15-30 seconds.

exercises.name: eagle pose garudasana
exercises.description: A balancing pose with legs and arms wrapped. It stretches the hips and shoulders and trains balance.
steps: Stand and bend your knees slightly.
Cross one thigh over the other, hooking the foot behind the calf if you can.
Wrap your arms, one under the other, palms together.
Sit your hips low and lift your elbows.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.

exercises.name: two legged inverted staff pose dwi pada viparita dandasana
exercises.description: A supported deep backbend resting on your forearms. It stretches the chest and spine.
steps: Start in a headstand or lie on your back with elbows on the floor.
Arch your back and bring your feet toward the floor.
Keep your forearms firm.
Stay in the backbend, breathing steadily.
Hold briefly, then come out carefully.

exercises.name: camel pose ustrasana
exercises.description: A kneeling backbend with hands on your heels. It opens the chest and stretches the thighs and hips.
steps: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward.
Lean back and reach for your heels.
Lift your chest and let your head drop gently if comfortable.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then rise.

exercises.name: dancer pose natarajasana
exercises.description: A standing balance with a back-held leg and a forward reach. It stretches the quads and opens the chest.
steps: Stand tall and bend one knee, holding that foot behind you.
Kick your foot back into your hand.
Reach your free arm forward.
Tilt your torso forward as the leg lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch.

exercises.name: basic to cross donkey kick
exercises.description: A quadruped kick that goes up behind you, then crosses over. It hits the glutes from two angles.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Lift one leg back with a bent knee, sole toward the ceiling.
Lower it, then kick it across behind your other leg.
Alternate basic and cross kicks.
Keep your hips level, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single curtsy lunge
exercises.description: A lunge stepping one leg back and across behind you. It targets the glutes and outer hips.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower your hips.
Keep your chest up and front knee over your toes.
Push up and return, then switch sides.

exercises.name: bodyweight low split squat
exercises.description: A split squat with a deep, low range that challenges your front thigh and glutes while building balance and hip mobility.
steps: Step one foot forward into a long split stance.
Keep your torso upright and your hands on your hips.
Lower your back knee toward the floor as far as you can control.
Drive through your front foot to stand back up.
Finish all reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell low split squat
exercises.description: A deep split squat holding dumbbells at your sides, great for loading the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a long split stance.
Keep your chest up and your front foot flat.
Lower your back knee toward the floor in a controlled way.
Push through your front heel to rise.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: barbell low split squat
exercises.description: A deep split squat with a barbell on your upper back that builds strong quads and glutes and tests your balance.
steps: Rest a barbell across your upper back and step into a long split stance.
Brace your core and keep your torso tall.
Lower your back knee toward the floor under control.
Press through your front foot to stand up.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: side kick through
exercises.description: A floor move where you sweep one leg under your body from a side-facing support, working your obliques, shoulders and coordination.
steps: Start in a high plank, then rotate onto one hand with your chest turned to the side.
Lift your hips and keep your core tight.
Sweep your top leg under your body and through the gap.
Return the leg to the start with control.
Repeat, then switch sides.

exercises.name: bodyweight slow to explosive squats
exercises.description: A squat that goes down slowly and then jumps up fast, training control, leg strength and power together.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat over about three seconds.
Pause briefly at the bottom with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next rep.

exercises.name: humble warrior pose
exercises.description: A lunge with a forward fold and clasped hands behind you. It stretches the hips, hamstrings and shoulders.
steps: Step into a wide lunge with the front knee bent.
Clasp your hands behind your back.
Fold your torso inside your front thigh.
Let your arms float overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: holding squat
exercises.description: A static squat hold that builds endurance in your thighs and glutes and teaches a solid bottom position.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down into a squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Hold the position while breathing steadily.
Hold for 20-40 seconds, then stand up.

exercises.name: lying prone y raise
exercises.description: Lying face down, you lift your arms into a Y shape to strengthen the muscles that stabilise your shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with your arms stretched overhead in a Y shape.
Keep your forehead near the floor and your neck long.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Pause for a second at the top.
Lower your arms slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: lever outdoor seated leg press
exercises.description: Seated leg press on an outdoor lever machine, pushing the pads away with your legs to train thighs and glutes.
steps: Sit on the seat with your back against the pad.
Place your feet on the footplates, shoulder-width apart.
Push the plates away until your legs are nearly straight.
Do not lock your knees at the top.
Bend your knees to return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: lever outdoor seated chest press
exercises.description: A seated chest press on an outdoor lever machine that works your chest, front shoulders and triceps.
steps: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles at chest height.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Let the handles come back slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: lever outdoor seated lat pulldown
exercises.description: Pulling the handles down from overhead on an outdoor lever machine to build your lats and upper back.
steps: Sit down and grab the handles overhead.
Lean back very slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let your arms rise slowly until fully stretched, then repeat.

exercises.name: ez barbell standing wrist curl
exercises.description: Wrist curls with an EZ bar held in front of you, targeting the muscles on the underside of your forearms.
steps: Stand holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still and close to your body.
Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar a short distance.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower the bar slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing wrist curl
exercises.description: A standing wrist curl with dumbbells that builds forearm strength and grip.
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your arms still at your sides.
Curl your wrists up, bringing the dumbbells toward your forearms.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable standing wrist curl
exercises.description: Wrist curls using a low cable for steady tension through the whole range, working the inside of your forearms.
steps: Face a low cable pulley and grab the handle with an underhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows tucked.
Curl your wrists upward against the cable.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: ez barbell standing wrist reverse curl
exercises.description: Reverse wrist curls with an EZ bar, an overhand movement that trains the top of your forearms.
steps: Stand holding an EZ bar with an overhand grip, arms hanging in front.
Keep your elbows still at your sides.
Extend your wrists to raise the bar upward.
Hold briefly at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing wrist reverse curl
exercises.description: Standing reverse wrist curls with dumbbells to strengthen the extensor muscles on top of your forearms.
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Keep your upper arms still.
Lift the backs of your hands up by extending your wrists.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable standing wrist reverse curl
exercises.description: An overhand wrist curl on a low cable that works the top of your forearms with constant tension.
steps: Face a low cable and grab the handle with an overhand grip.
Step back and let your arms hang with elbows close to your sides.
Extend your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Hold for a second.
Lower under control and repeat.

exercises.name: ez barbell seated wrist reverse curl
exercises.description: Seated reverse wrist curl with your forearms supported on your thighs, isolating the top of your forearms.
steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, holding an EZ bar overhand.
Let your wrists hang past your knees.
Extend your wrists to lift the bar.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: ez barbell standing back wrist curl
exercises.description: A wrist curl with the EZ bar held behind your back, training your forearms and grip.
steps: Stand holding an EZ bar behind your back with an underhand grip.
Keep your elbows still and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to raise the bar slightly.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing back wrist curl
exercises.description: Holding dumbbells behind your body, you curl your wrists to train your forearms and grip.
steps: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand behind your back, palms facing back.
Keep your arms still and your chest tall.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable standing back wrist curl v. 2
exercises.description: A standing wrist curl with a low cable behind you, giving steady tension on your forearm flexors.
steps: Stand with your back to a low cable and hold the handle behind you.
Keep your elbows tucked and your chest up.
Curl your wrists to pull the handle upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: cable lateral pulldown with mag grip
exercises.description: A lat pulldown using a magnetic grip handle that builds the wide muscles of your back.
steps: Sit at the pulldown station and grab the grip overhead.
Lean back slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the grip down to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Let the bar rise slowly to a full stretch and repeat.

exercises.name: ez barbell preacher curl
exercises.description: Curling an EZ bar over a preacher pad, which keeps your upper arms still so your biceps do the work.
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad.
Hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight and repeat.

exercises.name: resistance band reverse crunch
exercises.description: A reverse crunch with a band for added resistance, curling your hips up to hit the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with a band anchored and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and bring them over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, drawing your knees toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without letting your lower back arch.

exercises.name: resistance band reverse crunch v. 2
exercises.description: A variation of the band reverse crunch that uses a different setup to challenge your lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back and hold the band firmly with both hands.
Lift your bent knees over your hips.
Curl your pelvis upward, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: bodyweight triceps extension from plank position
exercises.description: From a plank, you bend and straighten your elbows to hinge forward and press back, a tough bodyweight move for the triceps.
steps: Start in a forearm-height plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lean forward and bend your elbows to lower your head toward your hands.
Press back up by straightening your arms.
Keep your core tight and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell good morning
exercises.description: A hip hinge holding a dumbbell at your chest, training hamstrings, glutes and lower back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding one dumbbell against your chest.
Soften your knees slightly.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

exercises.name: kettlebell good morning v. 2
exercises.description: Holding a kettlebell at your chest, you hinge at the hips to train hamstrings, glutes and your lower back.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding a kettlebell at your chest.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Push your hips back and tip your torso forward, back flat.
Lower until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return upright.

exercises.name: 90 degree heel touch v. 2
exercises.description: Lying on your back with your knees bent, you reach side to side to tap your heels, working your obliques.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your shoulders slightly off the floor.
Reach your right hand toward your right heel.
Switch and reach your left hand to your left heel.
Keep your core tight and continue alternating.

exercises.name: heel glute bridge
exercises.description: A bridge with heels pushed into the floor and toes lifted. It biases the glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and heels on the floor, toes lifted.
Keep your arms by your sides.
Press through your heels and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: resistance band shoulder adduction
exercises.description: A band pulldown pulling the arm from out to your side down to your body. It trains the lats and shoulder control.
steps: Anchor a band overhead and hold the handle with your arm raised.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your arm down toward your side.
Keep your elbow straight or slightly bent.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: bent over shoulder pendulum
exercises.description: A gentle pendulum swing for the shoulder joint. It loosens the shoulder and warms it up without any load.
steps: Stand beside a bench and rest one hand on it, hinging forward at the hips.
Let the other arm hang straight down, relaxed.
Swing the arm gently forward and back in a small arc using your body's motion.
Then swing it side to side and in small circles.
Keep the shoulder loose and the movement easy.
Do equal time on both sides.

exercises.name: resistance band standing single arm shoulder flexion
exercises.description: Raising one arm forward against band tension. It trains the front of the shoulder with smooth control.
steps: Stand on the band with one foot and hold the handle at your thigh, palm down.
Brace your core and keep your torso upright.
Raise the arm forward to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly against the band tension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: resistance band standing single arm lateral shoulder extension
exercises.description: A one-arm band move that pulls the arm out and back to the side. It works the shoulder and the muscles behind it.
steps: Anchor the band at about waist height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, arm across your body.
Keep your chest tall and core braced.
Sweep the arm out and slightly back to the side with a soft elbow.
Return slowly to the start without letting the band snap.
Complete all reps, then turn around and switch arms.

exercises.name: resistance band standing external rotation
exercises.description: Rotating the forearm outward against a band, elbow at your side. It strengthens the small rotator cuff muscles that steady the shoulder.
steps: Anchor the band at elbow height and stand sideways to it.
Hold the handle with the far hand, elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Rotate the forearm outward, keeping the elbow pinned.
Pause when your hand points forward or slightly out.
Return slowly under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: bear plank kickback
exercises.description: From a hovering bear plank position, you kick one leg back to fire up your glutes while your core stays steady.
steps: Start on hands and knees, then lift your knees a few centimetres off the floor.
Keep your back flat and core braced.
Extend one leg back and up, squeezing your glute.
Bring the knee back in without touching down.
Repeat, then switch legs.

exercises.name: half seated leg circle
exercises.description: Seated leg circles that loosen up your hips and gently work the muscles around them.
steps: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly on your hands.
Lift one leg a little off the floor.
Draw slow circles in the air with that foot.
Keep your core engaged and your torso steady.
Switch directions, then switch legs.

exercises.name: yoga vajrasana thunderbolt diamond pose
exercises.description: Sitting back on your heels in a kneeling pose that stretches your thighs, shins and ankles while keeping your spine tall.
steps: Kneel on the floor with your knees together.
Point your toes back and sit on your heels.
Rest your hands on your thighs.
Lengthen your spine and breathe slowly.
Hold for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: bodyweight frog hip thrust
exercises.description: A glute bridge with the soles of your feet together and knees open, which shifts the focus onto your glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Keep your feet close to your hips.
Push through your feet to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: smith frog hip thrust
exercises.description: A loaded hip thrust on a Smith machine with the soles of your feet together, strongly targeting the glutes.
steps: Sit with your upper back on a bench and the Smith bar over your hips.
Put the soles of your feet together, knees open.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower under control and repeat.

exercises.name: side plank bent leg lift
exercises.description: A side plank with a bent top leg that you lift, challenging your obliques and outer hips.
steps: Lie on one side and prop yourself on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a line.
Bend your top knee and lift it upward.
Lower it without dropping your hips.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: weighted plate standing lateral raise
exercises.description: Holding a weight plate in each hand, you raise your arms out to the sides to build the middle shoulders.
steps: Stand tall holding a plate in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: band bent over rear lateral raise v. 2
exercises.description: Bent over with a band, you raise your arms out wide to work the back of your shoulders and upper back.
steps: Stand on a band and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold the band ends in each hand.
Raise your arms out to the sides up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable single arm high row
exercises.description: A one-arm row from a high cable, pulling toward your torso to train the upper back and lats.
steps: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Brace your core and stand or kneel tall.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable single arm high scapular row
exercises.description: A high cable row focused on moving your shoulder blade, building control in your upper back.
steps: Set a cable high and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Pull your shoulder blade back and down, bending the elbow slightly.
Squeeze at the end.
Release slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable single arm low scapular row
exercises.description: A low cable row that emphasises the shoulder blade, training the muscles between and around it.
steps: Set a cable low and hold the handle with one hand.
Hinge slightly forward with a flat back.
Pull your shoulder blade back toward your spine.
Squeeze for a second.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lever bent over row (with chest support)
exercises.description: A chest-supported lever row that lets you pull heavy while your lower back stays out of the way.
steps: Lean your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handles toward your body, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: lever bent over neutral grip row (with chest support)
exercises.description: A chest-supported row with palms facing each other, building your mid-back and lats.
steps: Lean your chest on the pad and take a neutral grip on the handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: lever bent over single arm neutral grip row (with chest support)
exercises.description: A one-arm chest-supported row with a neutral grip, letting you focus on each side of your back.
steps: Lean your chest against the pad and grip one handle, palm in.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back, driving your elbow past your torso.
Squeeze your back at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lever bent over wide grip row (with chest support)
exercises.description: A chest-supported row with a wide grip that shifts more work to the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Lean your chest on the pad and take the wide handles.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the handles back with your elbows flared out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: lever bent over single arm wide grip row (with chest support)
exercises.description: A one-arm chest-supported row on a wide handle, hitting the upper back and rear shoulder on one side.
steps: Lean your chest on the pad and grip one wide handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle back with your elbow flaring out.
Squeeze at the end.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lever linear hack squat
exercises.description: A hack squat on a linear lever machine that loads your thighs and glutes along a fixed path.
steps: Stand on the platform with your back against the pad and shoulders under the supports.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart.
Lower into a squat until your thighs are about parallel.
Press through your feet to stand.
Keep your back against the pad throughout.

exercises.name: push up pull
exercises.description: A push-up combined with a pulling motion, adding upper-back work to a classic chest exercise.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest to the floor in a push-up.
Press back up to the top.
Drag one hand across the floor as if pulling yourself forward.
Alternate sides and keep your core tight.

exercises.name: armless prayer stretch
exercises.description: A kneeling stretch that opens up your shoulders and lats as you sink your chest toward the floor.
steps: Kneel on the floor and sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest.
Let your forehead rest near the floor.
Relax your shoulders and breathe deeply.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: big turn back stretch
exercises.description: A standing or seated rotation that opens the back and the side of the trunk. Good for easing stiffness through the spine.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and arms out in front.
Slowly rotate your upper body to one side, leading with the arms.
Keep your hips facing forward as much as you can.
Turn until you feel a comfortable stretch through the back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to center and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: bodyweight bench squat
exercises.description: A squat down to a bench and back up. The bench gives you a depth target and builds leg strength with control.
steps: Stand in front of a bench with feet shoulder-width apart.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower.
Lightly touch the bench with your glutes without dropping onto it.
Keep your chest up and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: cable kneeling high to low fly
exercises.description: A kneeling cable fly pulling from high to low across your body, working the lower chest.
steps: Set the cables high and kneel between them, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Sweep your arms down and together in front of your hips.
Squeeze your chest at the bottom.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: cable front raise (rope attachment)
exercises.description: A front raise using a rope on a low cable. The cable keeps tension on the front shoulder through the whole lift.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope ends and let your arms hang with the cable between your legs.
Raise your arms forward to shoulder height with soft elbows.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly without letting the stack rest.
Keep your torso still, no swinging.

exercises.name: cable goblet squat
exercises.description: A squat holding a low cable at your chest. The front load helps you stay upright and drives the thighs and glutes.
steps: Attach a handle or rope to a low pulley and hold it against your chest.
Step back until there is tension and set your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your feet to stand up.
Keep your elbows pointing down throughout.

exercises.name: handstand hold on wall
exercises.description: A wall-supported handstand held in place, building shoulder strength, balance and body control.
steps: Place your hands on the floor a short distance from a wall.
Kick up carefully until your heels rest on the wall.
Push the floor away and keep your arms straight.
Tighten your core and glutes.
Hold for 15-30 seconds, then come down with control.

exercises.name: landmine single leg hip thrust
exercises.description: A one-leg hip thrust with a landmine bar across the hips. It hits each glute separately and challenges balance.
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench with a padded landmine bar across your hips.
Plant one foot on the floor and extend the other leg or hold it up.
Drive through the planted heel and lift your hips.
Squeeze the glute at the top with your torso level.
Lower with control.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: hanging hollow hold
exercises.description: A hold hanging from a bar with the body in a slight hollow curve. It builds deep abdominal tension and grip.
steps: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Lift your legs forward a little so your body forms a gentle hollow shape.
Keep your shoulders active and avoid swinging.
Hold the position for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down under control.

exercises.name: decline knee raise
exercises.description: Knee raises on a decline bench. The slope adds difficulty and focuses on the lower abs.
steps: Lie on a decline bench and grip the top behind your head.
Extend your legs with a slight knee bend.
Pull your knees up toward your chest, curling the pelvis off the bench.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without letting the hips drop hard.
Keep the movement smooth, not jerky.

exercises.name: weighted plate standing around the world
exercises.description: Passing a plate in a circle around the body while standing. It works the shoulders and trunk through many angles.
steps: Stand tall and hold a weight plate with both hands at your waist.
Brace your core and keep your feet planted.
Raise the plate up and over to one side in a wide circle, then around your head.
Bring it back down on the other side.
Keep your hips still as the plate travels.
Do half the reps in each direction.

exercises.name: incline push up on a smith bar
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands on a Smith bar, making it easier than a floor push-up while still training your chest.
steps: Set the Smith bar at about waist height and rack it securely.
Place your hands on the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest to the bar.
Push back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: bodyweight reverse lunge with overhead reach
exercises.description: A reverse lunge with an overhead reach that works your legs and stretches your torso.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step one foot back and lower into a lunge.
Reach both arms overhead as you lower.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Alternate legs.

exercises.name: cable romanian deadlift
exercises.description: A hip hinge using a low cable. It trains the hamstrings and glutes with steady tension.
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and face the machine.
Hold the bar, step back and stand tall with soft knees.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down your thighs.
Keep your back flat and shoulders pulled back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand up.

exercises.name: landmine single leg romanian deadlift
exercises.description: A one-leg hip hinge holding a landmine bar. It builds hamstring and glute strength along with balance.
steps: Hold the end of a landmine bar at your chest and stand on one leg.
Keep a soft bend in the standing knee.
Hinge at the hip and send the free leg back for balance.
Lower the bar toward the floor with a flat back.
Squeeze your glute and return to standing.
Complete the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: glute ham sit up
exercises.description: A sit-up on a glute ham bench. The extra range of motion works the abs and hip flexors hard.
steps: Set your feet under the pads of a glute ham bench, hips on the support.
Cross your arms over your chest and lean back to a comfortable depth.
Brace your abs and curl up until your torso is upright.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly under control.
Keep your lower back from over-arching at the bottom.

exercises.name: ab mat sit up
exercises.description: A sit-up on a shaped ab mat that supports the lower back and allows a fuller range of motion.
steps: Lie back on an ab mat with knees bent and feet flat.
Cross your arms over your chest or place your hands by your ears.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting tall.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

exercises.name: dumbbell banded wall sit
exercises.description: A wall sit with a band around the knees and a dumbbell held in your lap, adding glute work to the hold.
steps: Put a band around your thighs and stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Hold a dumbbell in both hands in front of you.
Push your knees out against the band.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.

exercises.name: weighted plate tibialis anterior curl
exercises.description: Lifting your toes up against the weight of a plate to strengthen the muscle on the front of your shin.
steps: Sit on a bench and rest a plate on your forefoot.
Keep your heel on the floor.
Pull your toes up toward your shin.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: 90 to 90 stretch
exercises.description: A seated hip stretch with both legs bent at right angles. It loosens the hip rotators and the glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with one leg bent in front and the other bent out to the side, both at about 90 degrees.
Sit tall with your hands on the floor.
Hinge forward over the front shin until you feel a stretch in the hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Come back up slowly.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: lever ab swing
exercises.description: A rotating ab machine movement where you swing your legs and trunk to work the abs.
steps: Sit in the machine and secure yourself with the pads.
Hold the handles and brace your core.
Swing your legs to one side using your abs.
Return to the centre with control.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: glute bridge walk
exercises.description: A glute bridge held high while stepping the feet out and back. It adds a dynamic challenge for glutes and hamstrings.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Lift your hips into a glute bridge.
Keep the hips high and walk your feet out a few small steps.
Then walk them back in toward your body.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Lower with control when finished.

exercises.name: barbell feet flat bench press
exercises.description: A bench press with your feet flat on the bench or surface instead of the floor, limiting leg drive and focusing on the chest.
steps: Lie on a bench and place your feet flat on it, knees bent.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat and your core tight.

exercises.name: bear crawl low hip
exercises.description: A low bear crawl with your hips kept down, which challenges your shoulders, legs and core.
steps: Start on hands and feet with your knees slightly off the floor.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.
Crawl forward with opposite hand and foot.
Stay controlled and quiet.
Crawl for 20-30 seconds.

exercises.name: bodyweight supported squat
exercises.description: A squat where you hold on to a support to stay balanced, ideal for learning depth and form.
steps: Hold on to a sturdy support at chest height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat.
Keep your chest up and your heels down.
Stand back up by pushing through your feet.

exercises.name: lever glute press
exercises.description: A glute press on a lever machine that targets your glutes by pushing your hips and legs back against resistance.
steps: Position yourself on the machine and set your feet on the platform.
Brace your core.
Press the platform away by driving through your heels.
Squeeze your glutes at the end.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: smith curtsey lunge
exercises.description: A curtsey lunge on the smith machine that steps one leg behind and across the other. It hits the glutes and outer hips with a stable bar path.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it, feet hip-width apart.
Step one leg back and diagonally behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel, chest tall.
Press through the front heel to return to standing.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: band lateral walk
exercises.description: Side stepping with a loop band around the legs. It fires up the hip abductors and glutes.
steps: Put a loop band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Stand in a quarter squat with feet hip-width apart.
Step sideways with the lead foot, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Walk several steps one way, then return the other way.

exercises.name: low lunge yoga pose anjaneyasana i
exercises.description: A yoga low lunge with the back knee down and arms overhead. It opens the hips and stretches the front of the thigh.
steps: Start in a lunge with the front knee over the ankle.
Lower the back knee to the floor and untuck the toes.
Sink your hips forward and down.
Raise both arms overhead and lift your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Step back and switch legs.

exercises.name: diagonal reach on chair
exercises.description: A seated reach across the body toward the opposite foot. It loosens the trunk and works the obliques gently.
steps: Sit tall on the front edge of a chair with feet flat.
Extend your arms out in front of you.
Reach one hand diagonally down toward the opposite foot, rotating your torso.
Return to upright with control.
Reach to the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: cable high pull with rope attachment
exercises.description: A rope pull toward the face from a high pulley. It builds the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and grip an end in each hand.
Step back until the cable is taut, with a slight lean back.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring high.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let the rope return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: barbell deadlift (side pov)
exercises.description: The classic barbell deadlift shown from the side to check form. It trains the whole posterior chain.
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace your core, flatten your back and pull the slack out of the bar.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out the hips without leaning back.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bar under control.

exercises.name: cable kneeling side crunch
exercises.description: A kneeling crunch to the side against a high cable. It targets the obliques with steady resistance.
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel beside the stack.
Hold the rope at the side of your head.
Crunch sideways, bringing your elbow toward your hip.
Pause and squeeze your side.
Return slowly, then switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: weight plate standing biceps curl
exercises.description: A standing curl holding a single plate. The plate grip also challenges your hands and forearms.
steps: Stand tall holding a plate at its sides with both hands, arms down.
Keep your elbows tucked against your ribs.
Curl the plate up toward your chest.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower the plate slowly to full arm extension.

exercises.name: supine windshield wipers
exercises.description: Lying on your back, you swing the legs side to side like wipers. It strengthens the obliques and trunk control.
steps: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: lever good morning on the hack squat machine
exercises.description: A good morning done on a hack squat machine. The machine supports your back while you hinge at the hips.
steps: Set up under the shoulder pads with feet shoulder-width apart.
Unlock the machine and stand tall.
Push your hips back and lean your torso forward with a flat back.
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Keep your knees slightly bent throughout.

exercises.name: sled angled single leg press
exercises.description: A one-leg press on an angled sled. It loads each leg separately for strength and balance.
steps: Sit in the angled sled and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled by bending the knee.
Go as deep as you can with your back against the pad.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking out.
Keep your hips flat on the seat.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell banded hip thrust
exercises.description: A hip thrust with a dumbbell on the hips and a band around the thighs. The band keeps the glutes working to hold the knees out.
steps: Put a band around your thighs and rest your upper back on a bench.
Place a dumbbell across your hips and hold it steady.
Plant your feet and push your knees out against the band.
Drive your hips up until your torso is level.
Squeeze the glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: resistance band side plank glute raise
exercises.description: A side plank with a band around the legs while raising the top leg. It works the outer hip and the side of the trunk.
steps: Put a band around your thighs or ankles and get into a side plank on your forearm.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise the top leg up against the band.
Pause briefly.
Lower the leg with control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band reverse hyper with stability ball on flat bench
exercises.description: A reverse hyper with your torso on a stability ball and a band adding resistance. It trains glutes and hamstrings while sparing the spine.
steps: Lie face down with your hips over a stability ball on a flat bench.
Loop a band around your feet and anchor it low in front.
Hold the bench for stability.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly against the band.

exercises.name: cable kneeling hip abduction
exercises.description: A kneeling cable move that lifts the leg out to the side. It targets the outer hip muscles.
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Kneel on all fours with the cuffed leg on the outside.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Lift the knee out to the side against the cable.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: resistance band kneeling leg half circle on bench
exercises.description: A kneeling band move on a bench, sweeping the leg in a half circle. It works the glutes from several angles.
steps: Place a band around your thighs or ankles and kneel on a bench with hands on its edge.
Keep your back flat and hips level.
Lift one leg out behind you.
Sweep it in a half circle out to the side.
Return along the same path under control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: cable donkey diagonal kickback
exercises.description: A donkey kickback on a cable that sends the leg back and slightly out. It focuses on the glutes.
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Get on all fours facing the machine.
Keep your core braced and back flat.
Kick the leg back and slightly out on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly, then switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: resistance band side walk squat
exercises.description: A squat position with side steps against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and thighs.
steps: Put a band around your thighs or just above the knees.
Drop into a quarter squat with chest up.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the feet touch.
Take several steps one way, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.

exercises.name: cable seated foot eversion
exercises.description: A seated ankle move turning the foot outward against a cable. It strengthens the outer ankle and lower leg.
steps: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot inward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot outward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.

exercises.name: cable seated foot inversion
exercises.description: A seated ankle move turning the foot inward against a cable. It strengthens the inner ankle and lower leg.
steps: Sit with your leg extended and a cable cuff on your foot.
Position the cable so it pulls the foot outward.
Keep your leg still.
Turn the sole of your foot inward against the cable.
Pause, then return slowly.
Finish the reps and switch feet.

exercises.name: kneeling glute press
exercises.description: A kneeling move pressing one leg back to fire the glute. Great for learning to feel the glutes work.
steps: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Press one foot back and up, leading with the heel.
Squeeze the glute at the top without arching your back.
Lower with control.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: kneeling single hamstring curl
exercises.description: A hamstring curl done from a kneeling position, one leg at a time. It works the back of the thigh.
steps: Get on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Keep your back flat and core tight.
Bend one knee and curl your heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the hamstring at the top.
Lower the foot slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: seated hip external rotation
exercises.description: A seated rotation turning the thigh outward. It improves hip mobility and activates the deep rotators.
steps: Sit tall on a bench or chair with feet flat.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Keep your knee still and rotate the lower leg inward so the thigh turns outward.
Pause when you feel the hip working.
Return slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: standing balance hip rotation
exercises.description: A one-leg balance with controlled hip rotation. It works hip mobility and stability together.
steps: Stand tall on one leg with a soft knee, holding a wall if needed.
Lift the other knee to hip height.
Rotate the lifted knee out to the side, then back to the front.
Keep your torso steady.
Move slowly and smoothly.
Finish the reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: side lying diagonal backward leg raise
exercises.description: A side-lying leg lift that goes back on a diagonal. It focuses on the glutes and outer hip.
steps: Lie on your side with legs stacked and your bottom arm supporting your head.
Brace your core and keep your hips stacked.
Lift the top leg up and slightly back on a diagonal.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lying rectus abdominis activation crunch
exercises.description: A small, focused crunch from lying down. It helps you feel the front abdominal muscle working.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Place your hands lightly on your abs or behind your head.
Exhale and curl your shoulders off the floor.
Feel the abs tighten at the top.
Lower back slowly.
Keep your neck relaxed.

exercises.name: lying scalene muscles activation
exercises.description: A gentle lying exercise that wakes up the scalene muscles at the side of the neck. It supports neck control.
steps: Lie on your back with your head resting on the floor.
Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Gently tilt your head to one side without lifting your shoulder.
Feel a light engagement along the side of your neck.
Return to the middle slowly.
Alternate sides for several reps.

exercises.name: bodyweight lying shoulder external rotation
exercises.description: A side-lying rotation that turns the forearm upward. It strengthens the rotator cuff without weights.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your waist.
Rest your forearm across your stomach.
Rotate your forearm upward, keeping the elbow in.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable kneeling shoulder external rotation
exercises.description: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm outward. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
steps: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the far hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: cable kneeling shoulder internal rotation
exercises.description: A light rotation drill with a cable that turns the arm inward. It builds rotator cuff strength and shoulder stability.
steps: Kneel side-on to a low cable and hold the handle with the near hand.
Tuck your elbow at your side, bent to 90 degrees.
Rotate your forearm inward across your belly.
Pause briefly at the end.
Return slowly and switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing single arm biceps curl
exercises.description: A one-arm standing curl. It builds the biceps and lets you focus on each arm separately.
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell at your side, palm facing forward.
Keep your elbow tucked at your side.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arm is straight.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell over the bench supination
exercises.description: A forearm rotation holding a dumbbell with the arm over the end of a bench. It trains the muscles that turn the palm up.
steps: Sit by a bench and rest your forearm on it with your hand past the edge.
Hold a dumbbell with a hammer grip.
Keep your forearm still.
Rotate your palm up as far as you can.
Return slowly to the start.
Finish the reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: seated tibialis anterior press
exercises.description: A seated press with the front of the foot to train the shin muscle. It helps balance the lower leg.
steps: Sit tall with your heels on the floor.
Lift the toes of one foot as high as you can.
Press them up against light resistance such as the other foot.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish the reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: cable kneeling twist
exercises.description: A kneeling trunk rotation on a cable. It trains the obliques while the base stays stable.
steps: Set a cable at chest height and kneel sideways to it.
Hold the handle with both hands in front of your chest.
Brace your abs and keep your hips square.
Rotate your torso away from the machine.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: half pigeon hip stretch
exercises.description: A floor stretch with one shin folded in front. It opens the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Start on all fours and bring one knee forward behind your wrist.
Slide the other leg straight back.
Square your hips to the floor.
Fold forward gently over the front leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: diagonal bend hold
exercises.description: A standing diagonal bend held for a stretch through the back and side of the body.
steps: Stand with feet wider than your hips.
Reach one arm overhead and toward the opposite foot.
Bend diagonally, keeping your hips facing forward.
Reach only as far as is comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Return to standing and switch sides.

exercises.name: seated forearms stretch
exercises.description: A seated stretch for the muscles of the forearm. It eases tight wrists after typing or gripping.
steps: Sit tall and extend one arm in front of you, palm up.
With the other hand, gently pull the fingers back toward you.
Keep the elbow straight and shoulders relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Turn the palm down to stretch the other side, then switch arms.

exercises.name: forward bend back stretch
exercises.description: A standing forward fold that lengthens the back and the backs of the legs.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart.
Hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Let your arms and head hang down.
Relax your neck and shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Roll up slowly to stand.

exercises.name: neck stretch with hand assisted
exercises.description: A neck stretch where your hand adds gentle pressure. It eases the side and back of the neck.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Place one hand on the side of your head.
Gently tilt your head toward the shoulder, using light pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder down.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Release slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: roll ball posterior tibialis (single leg) side lying on floor
exercises.description: Rolling a ball under the inner lower leg while lying on your side. It releases the deep calf muscle that supports the arch.
steps: Lie on your side with a small ball under the inside of your lower leg.
Support yourself with your hands and the other leg.
Slowly roll the leg along the ball from calf toward ankle.
Pause on tender spots with light pressure.
Breathe and relax the leg.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: roll ball side lying scalene muscles activation
exercises.description: Lying on your side with a ball at the neck to ease the scalene muscles. Use light pressure.
steps: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head with a pillow or your hand.
Relax your shoulder.
Gently press or nod to roll over the ball.
Keep the pressure light.
Do 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: roll ball side lying scalene muscles activation (side pov)
exercises.description: The same side-lying scalene release as seen from the side. A ball at the neck eases the muscles with light pressure.
steps: Lie on your side with a small ball under the side of your neck.
Support your head so your neck stays neutral.
Relax your shoulder.
Gently move your head to roll over the ball.
Keep the pressure light.
Do 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.

exercises.name: roll ball lying semispinalis capitis muscle activation
exercises.description: Lying on your back with a ball under the base of the skull. It releases the deep muscles at the back of the neck.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and a small ball under the base of your skull.
Relax your head onto the ball.
Make small nods or turns to roll over the muscle.
Keep the pressure gentle.
Breathe slowly.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: kneeling sartorius stretch
exercises.description: A kneeling stretch for the long strap muscle across the front of the thigh and hip.
steps: Kneel on one knee in a half-kneeling position.
Tuck your pelvis and squeeze the glute of the back leg.
Shift your hips forward slightly.
Lean slightly to the side of the back leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: kneeling iliopsoas stretch
exercises.description: A kneeling lunge stretch for the deep hip flexor. It helps loosen the front of the hip.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward.
Tuck your pelvis and brace your abs.
Shift your weight forward until you feel the stretch at the front of the hip.
Raise the arm on the kneeling side overhead.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: standing peroneus muscles stretch
exercises.description: A standing stretch for the muscles on the outside of the lower leg. It helps ankle mobility.
steps: Stand near a wall for balance.
Cross one foot behind and turn the sole so the outer edge presses into the floor.
Gently shift your weight onto that foot.
Feel the stretch along the outside of the lower leg.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.

exercises.name: standing tibialis anterior stretch
exercises.description: A standing stretch for the muscle at the front of the shin. Useful after running or lots of walking.
steps: Stand near a wall for balance.
Place the top of one foot on the floor behind you with toes curled under.
Gently bend the standing knee to press forward.
Feel the stretch along the shin.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch feet.

exercises.name: seated rhomboid stretch
exercises.description: A seated stretch that opens the space between the shoulder blades. It relieves tightness in the upper back.
steps: Sit tall and clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Push your arms forward and round your upper back.
Tuck your chin slightly and spread the shoulder blades apart.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: standing foot muscles activation
exercises.description: A standing drill that wakes up the small muscles of the feet. It builds foot control and balance.
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Spread your toes wide and press all of them into the floor.
Lift your toes while keeping the ball of the foot down.
Lower them one by one.
Keep your arch lifted.
Repeat for 10-15 slow reps.

exercises.name: cable standing single delt row
exercises.description: A one-arm cable row with a high elbow. It focuses on the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Set a cable at chest height and grab the handle with one hand.
Stand with feet staggered and your torso slightly braced.
Pull the handle toward you with your elbow flared out.
Squeeze the rear shoulder at the end.
Extend slowly, then switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: band seated hip abduction v. 2
exercises.description: A seated move pushing the knees outward against a band. It strengthens the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Sit tall on a bench with a band around your thighs above the knees.
Keep your feet flat and planted.
Press your knees apart against the band.
Hold for a second at the widest point.
Bring the knees back together slowly.

exercises.name: faber test
exercises.description: A gentle hip check where the ankle rests on the opposite knee and the knee drops out. It shows how mobile the hip is.
steps: Lie on your back with legs straight.
Place one foot on the opposite knee.
Let the bent knee drop out to the side.
Relax and notice how far it goes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without forcing it.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: hip external rotation test
exercises.description: A simple check of how far the hip turns outward. You do it gently to see your range.
steps: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg inward so the hip rotates outward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.

exercises.name: hip internal rotation test
exercises.description: A simple check of how far the hip turns inward. You do it gently to see your range.
steps: Sit or lie with the knee bent 90 degrees.
Keep the thigh still.
Swing the lower leg outward so the hip rotates inward.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other leg.

exercises.name: leg length test
exercises.description: A lying check comparing the length of both legs. It is done gently and with a relaxed body.
steps: Lie flat on your back with legs straight and feet together.
Relax your hips and arms.
Compare the position of your heels or ankles.
Bend your knees and lift your hips, then lower and straighten again.
Check again for any difference.
Stay relaxed throughout.

exercises.name: shoulder external rotation test
exercises.description: A simple check of how far the shoulder turns outward. Move slowly and stay in a pain-free range.
steps: Stand or lie with your elbow bent 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your elbow against your body.
Rotate your forearm outward slowly.
Stop where you feel a stretch or end of range.
Note how far each side goes.
Repeat on the other arm.

exercises.name: shoulder internal rotation test
exercises.description: A simple check of how far your shoulder turns inward, handy for spotting tightness before you train.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach one arm behind your back with the palm facing out.
Slide your hand slowly up your spine as far as is comfortable.
Note how high your thumb reaches, keeping your chest open.
Lower the arm, then repeat with the other side to compare.

exercises.name: shoulder level test
exercises.description: A quick posture check to see whether one shoulder sits higher than the other.
steps: Stand relaxed with your feet hip-width apart and arms hanging loose.
Look straight ahead and let your shoulders settle naturally.
Check in a mirror, or ask a friend, whether both shoulders are at the same height.
Roll the shoulders once and re-check without shrugging.
Note any difference and repeat now and then to track it.

exercises.name: posterior chain flexibility test
exercises.description: A forward-fold style check of how flexible the back of your body is, from calves up to your lower back.
steps: Stand with your feet together and your knees straight.
Hinge at the hips and slowly reach down toward your toes.
Let your head and arms hang relaxed without bouncing.
Note how far your fingertips reach.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Rise slowly, rolling up one vertebra at a time.

exercises.name: thomas test
exercises.description: A hip flexor length test where you lie on the edge of a bench and see how freely the thigh hangs.
steps: Sit at the end of a bench, then lie back and hug one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang off the edge with the thigh relaxed.
Keep your lower back flat on the bench.
Notice whether the hanging thigh rises above the bench or the knee straightens.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.

exercises.name: thomas frontal test
exercises.description: The frontal-view version of the Thomas test, checking for tight hip flexors and inner thighs while you lie on a bench.
steps: Sit at the end of a bench and lie back, pulling one knee to your chest.
Let the other leg hang down off the edge, fully relaxed.
Keep your lower back pressed down and your pelvis still.
Watch whether the hanging leg drifts outward or the thigh lifts.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs and compare.

exercises.name: smith sumo chair squat
exercises.description: A wide-stance squat on the smith machine down to a chair. The seat gives a consistent depth.
steps: Place a chair behind you and set the bar on your upper back.
Take a wide stance with toes turned out.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the chair.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your heels to stand up.

exercises.name: barbell bench lateral step up
exercises.description: A sideways step up onto a bench with a barbell on the back. It builds single-leg strength in the quads and glutes.
steps: Place the bar on your upper back and stand beside a bench.
Put the inside foot flat on the bench.
Press through that heel and stand up on the bench.
Lower the other foot back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band standing balance glute kickback
exercises.description: A standing band kickback that builds the glutes while challenging your balance on one leg.
steps: Loop the band around your ankles or hold it under your standing foot.
Stand on one leg with a slight bend in the knee and brace your abs.
Kick the other leg straight back against the band.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your lower back.
Return slowly with control.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell lying oblique v up
exercises.description: A lying V-up to the side while holding a dumbbell. It works the abs and obliques hard.
steps: Lie on your back holding a dumbbell with both hands overhead.
Lift your legs and torso together, angling toward one side.
Reach the dumbbell toward your feet.
Lower back down slowly.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: dumbbell military press russian twist with legs floor off
exercises.description: A seated combo that pairs an overhead press with a Russian twist, feet off the floor. It challenges the trunk and shoulders together.
steps: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead.
Lower them, then twist your torso to one side.
Twist to the other side and repeat the sequence.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated military press in out leg raise on floor
exercises.description: A seated overhead press combined with in and out leg movements. It works the shoulders and the lower abs together.
steps: Sit on the floor leaning back slightly, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead.
Pull your knees in, then extend the legs out as the weights stay up.
Lower the dumbbells to your shoulders.
Repeat, keeping your back long and core braced.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated military hold alternate leg raise on floor
exercises.description: You hold dumbbells overhead while raising the legs alternately. It trains the lower abs and shoulder stability.
steps: Sit on the floor leaning back a little and press the dumbbells overhead.
Keep your arms locked and steady.
Raise one leg off the floor.
Lower it and raise the other leg.
Keep alternating, then lower the weights.

exercises.name: side and front in out
exercises.description: A seated in and out leg drill that goes to the side and then to the front. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit on the floor leaning back, hands behind you for support.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Extend your legs out to one side and pull them back in.
Extend them straight in front and pull back in.
Repeat the pattern on the other side.

exercises.name: plank alternate anti gravity pull up
exercises.description: From a plank you alternately pull one arm up toward your chest as if climbing. It builds core stability and shoulder control.
steps: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Pull one arm up and back toward your ribs.
Return it to the floor under control.
Alternate arms without rocking your hips.

exercises.name: dumbbell alternate v up
exercises.description: A V-up where one arm and the opposite leg meet, holding a dumbbell. It trains the abs through a big range.
steps: Lie on your back with a dumbbell in each hand, arms overhead.
Lift your torso and one leg at the same time.
Reach the weights toward your raised foot.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Alternate legs each rep.

exercises.name: dumbbell military press russian twist with legs floor off v. 2
exercises.description: A variation of the seated overhead press and Russian twist combo with feet off the floor. It works the trunk and shoulders.
steps: Sit leaning back slightly with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Hold dumbbells at your shoulders.
Press both dumbbells overhead and lower them.
Twist your torso to one side, then the other.
Keep your chest tall and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: dumbbell overhead sit up with legs on bench
exercises.description: A sit-up holding a dumbbell overhead with the legs resting on a bench. The extra reach makes the abs work harder.
steps: Lie on the floor with calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands above your chest or overhead.
Curl up into a sit-up, keeping your arms extended.
Reach toward your knees at the top.
Lower back down slowly.

exercises.name: band lying bent knee raise
exercises.description: A lying knee raise against band resistance. It builds the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with a band looped around your feet or anchored.
Place your hands by your sides and brace your core.
Bring your knees toward your chest against the band.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your feet slowly without arching your back.

exercises.name: stick subscapularis muscle relax
exercises.description: A gentle release for the muscle under the shoulder blade using a stick for leverage. It helps the shoulder feel looser.
steps: Hold a stick in one hand and bend your elbow to 90 degrees.
Place the other hand on the stick and rotate the arm outward.
Gently push into a comfortable stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Release and repeat on the other arm.

exercises.name: roll ball seated pectineus activation
exercises.description: A seated move using a ball to wake up the inner upper thigh. It works the pectineus and the nearby adductors.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with a ball between your knees.
Place your feet flat and keep your back straight.
Squeeze the ball gently with your thighs.
Hold the squeeze for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and repeat several times.

exercises.name: barbell bench press (side pov)
exercises.description: The barbell bench press seen from the side to check bar path and form. It builds the chest, shoulders and triceps.
steps: Lie on a bench with your eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width and unrack it.
Lower the bar to your mid chest with elbows at about 45 degrees.
Touch lightly and press back up over your shoulders.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched throughout.

exercises.name: kettlebell incline fly
exercises.description: A fly on an incline bench using kettlebells. It stretches and works the upper chest.
steps: Lie on an incline bench holding a kettlebell in each hand above your chest.
Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
Open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze the chest to bring the weights back together.
Control the weights and keep your wrists stable.

exercises.name: kettlebell seated lateral raise
exercises.description: A seated side raise using kettlebells. It isolates the side delts without leg drive.
steps: Sit upright on a bench holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: sitting yoga pose siddhasana
exercises.description: A calm cross-legged seat that opens the hips and teaches you to sit tall.
steps: Sit on the floor and bend your knees.
Place one heel against your inner thigh and the other foot in front of it.
Rest your hands on your knees and lengthen your spine.
Relax your shoulders and look straight ahead.
Hold for 30-60 seconds, breathing slowly.
Switch the cross of your legs and repeat.

exercises.name: supported headstand yoga pose sirsasana
exercises.description: An inversion where your forearms and head share the load, building shoulder strength and balance.
steps: Kneel and place your forearms on the mat with your fingers interlaced.
Set the crown of your head lightly on the floor against your hands.
Lift your knees and walk your feet toward your face.
Lift your legs slowly, using your core, until they point to the ceiling.
Keep most of the weight in your forearms and shoulders.
Hold briefly, then lower with control and rest in child's pose.

exercises.name: forearms stand yoga pose pincha mayurasana
exercises.description: A forearm balance that builds strong shoulders and core, also known as feathered peacock pose.
steps: Start on your forearms and knees with your elbows under your shoulders.
Press your forearms into the floor and tuck your toes.
Lift your hips high and walk your feet toward your elbows.
Swing or float one leg up, then bring the other to meet it.
Keep your ribs in and your gaze between your hands.
Hold briefly, then lower with control.

exercises.name: lever cross lat pulldown
exercises.description: A machine pulldown where the arms cross the body path. It builds the lats and upper back.
steps: Adjust the seat and thigh pad, then grab the handles.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handles down and across toward your torso.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom.
Return slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: dumbbell z press v. 2
exercises.description: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. The position removes leg drive and demands a strong core.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs extended and dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and keep your back tall.
Press both dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower them to your shoulders under control.
Avoid leaning back during the press.

exercises.name: dumbbell alternate z press
exercises.description: A seated floor press that alternates arms, which adds anti-lean trunk work. It trains the shoulders and the core.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs extended, dumbbells at your shoulders.
Brace your core and sit tall.
Press one dumbbell overhead.
Lower it and press the other arm.
Keep alternating without tilting your torso.

exercises.name: cow yoga pose bitilasana
exercises.description: A gentle spinal extension from all fours that wakes up the back and often pairs with cat pose.
steps: Start on hands and knees, with wrists under shoulders and knees under hips.
Inhale and let your belly drop toward the floor.
Lift your chest and tailbone while your gaze goes slightly forward.
Keep your shoulders away from your ears.
Hold for 3-5 breaths.
Return to a neutral spine.

exercises.name: cow face yoga pose gomukhasana
exercises.description: A seated pose that stretches the shoulders, triceps and hips together.
steps: Sit with one knee stacked over the other and your feet beside your hips.
Reach one arm up and bend the elbow, hand down your back.
Sweep the other arm behind you and try to clasp your fingers.
Keep your spine tall and your chest open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides and repeat.

exercises.name: deep push up on parallel bars
exercises.description: A push-up between parallel bars that lets you sink deeper than the floor allows. It gives the chest a greater stretch.
steps: Grip two parallel bars and hold a straight plank position.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Lower your chest below the level of your hands.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your body in one line throughout.

exercises.name: sitting scapular adduction
exercises.description: A seated drill squeezing the shoulder blades together. It strengthens the muscles that support good posture.
steps: Sit tall with arms relaxed at your sides or held in front.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Pull your shoulder blades together and slightly down.
Hold the squeeze for 2-3 seconds.
Release slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: sitting scapular adduction v. 2
exercises.description: A variation of the seated shoulder blade squeeze with the arms held out. It strengthens the upper back and posture muscles.
steps: Sit tall with elbows bent and hands by your ribs.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Draw your elbows back and pinch your shoulder blades together.
Hold for 2-3 seconds.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: swimming crawl style
exercises.description: A standing or floor drill that copies the front crawl arm stroke. It raises your heart rate and warms the shoulders.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Swing one arm forward and over in a crawl stroke.
Alternate arms in a smooth, continuous rhythm.
Rotate your torso slightly with each stroke.
Keep going at a steady pace for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: lateral hurdle jump
exercises.description: A side-to-side jump over a low hurdle. It builds explosive power and quick landings.
steps: Stand beside a low hurdle with feet together.
Swing your arms and jump sideways over it.
Land softly on both feet with knees bent.
Jump straight back over the other way.
Keep your ground contact quick and controlled.

exercises.name: band assisted push up
exercises.description: A push-up with a band supporting the body to make the rep easier. It helps you build toward full push-ups.
steps: Anchor a band across a rack or set of bars at chest height.
Rest your torso on the band in a plank position.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at 45 degrees.
Press up using the bounce of the band as help.
Keep your body in a straight line.

exercises.name: uneven pull up
exercises.description: A pull-up with the hands at different heights or one hand doing more work. It gently trains one-arm pulling strength.
steps: Hang from the bar with one hand higher or on a towel and the other lower.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Lead with the working arm and pull your chin toward the bar.
Lower yourself under control.
Switch the hand positions on the next set.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing t spine press
exercises.description: A standing dumbbell press that adds upper back extension, training shoulder strength and posture together.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and the dumbbells at shoulder height.
Brace your abs and lift your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead while gently extending your upper back.
