Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your lower back.
Lower to your shoulders with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: wrist full push up
exercises.description: A full push-up focusing on wrist position and control. It builds the chest while preparing the wrists for load.
steps: Start in a plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Spread your fingers and keep your wrists stacked.
Lower your chest to the floor under control.
Press back to the top.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.

exercises.name: downward dog push up against wall
exercises.description: A wall-assisted version of a downward dog push-up with a push off at the top. It trains the shoulders in a bent-hip position.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your hands on it with hips back.
Lower your head toward the wall, bending the elbows.
Push explosively away from the wall.
Land softly back into the start position.
Keep your core braced and back flat.

exercises.name: stability ball rollout on knees
exercises.description: A kneeling rollout with the forearms on a stability ball. It builds deep core strength.
steps: Kneel facing a stability ball with your forearms resting on top.
Brace your abs and keep your hips in line with your back.
Roll the ball forward, extending your body.
Stop before your lower back sags.
Pull the ball back in using your abs.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing hands torsion
exercises.description: A standing twisting move holding a dumbbell that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell by its handle in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate your forearms and wrists inward and outward.
Move slowly through the full range.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: weight plate standing hands torsion
exercises.description: A standing twisting move holding a plate that works the forearm rotators. It builds wrist and grip strength.
steps: Stand holding a plate at its sides in front of you.
Keep your elbows bent and close to your sides.
Rotate the plate left and right using your wrists and forearms.
Move slowly and under control.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing reverse curl rotate
exercises.description: A standing reverse curl that ends with a forearm rotation. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
steps: Stand holding dumbbells with an overhand grip at your thighs.
Curl the weights up while keeping your elbows tucked.
At the top, rotate your forearms so the palms turn up.
Rotate back and lower slowly.
Keep your wrists strong and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: lever seated single leg press v. 2
exercises.description: A machine press done with one leg at a time. It helps fix strength imbalances between legs.
steps: Sit in the machine and put one foot on the platform.
Keep your back against the pad.
Press the platform away until your leg is almost straight.
Lower slowly until your knee bends to about 90 degrees.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lever seated leg extension v. 3
exercises.description: A machine leg extension that isolates the front of the thigh. It builds quad size and strength.
steps: Sit with your back against the pad and shins behind the roller.
Align your knees with the machine pivot.
Extend your legs until they are nearly straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: dumbbell straight arm pullover v. 2
exercises.description: A pullover variation with straight arms that stretches and works the chest and lats through a long arc.
steps: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell above your chest with straight arms.
Keep a slight softness in your elbows and brace your core.
Lower the weight in an arc back over your head until you feel a stretch.
Keep your ribs down and your hips on the bench.
Pull the dumbbell back over your chest.
Repeat with a smooth tempo.

exercises.name: ez barbell standing upright row
exercises.description: A vertical pull with an EZ bar that builds the side shoulders and upper traps.
steps: Stand tall holding the EZ bar with a shoulder-width grip.
Let the bar hang in front of your thighs.
Pull it up along your body, leading with your elbows.
Stop around chest height without shrugging hard.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your torso upright throughout.

exercises.name: bodyweight lying alternate legs curl
exercises.description: A floor hamstring curl using your own weight, alternating legs to keep it easy on the joints.
steps: Lie face down with your legs straight and your forehead on your hands.
Bend one knee and bring the heel toward your glute.
Squeeze the back of your thigh at the top.
Lower the leg slowly.
Repeat with the other leg.
Alternate for the planned reps.

exercises.name: side shuffle high knee
exercises.description: A lateral shuffle where each step brings the knee high. It raises your heart rate and builds agility.
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Shuffle sideways for a few steps.
Lift your knees high with each step.
Stay light on your feet and pump your arms.
Change direction and continue for 30-60 seconds.

exercises.name: cable seated reverse shrug
exercises.description: A seated shrug with the cable pulling from behind the body. It trains the traps and the upper back.
steps: Sit with a low cable behind you, holding the handle behind your back.
Keep your arms straight and chest tall.
Shrug your shoulders up and slightly back.
Hold for a second.
Lower slowly to the start.

exercises.name: inline skating
exercises.description: Gliding on inline skates for steady cardio that also works the legs and balance.
steps: Put on skates, helmet and pads, and stand with your knees slightly bent.
Push one skate out to the side and glide on the other.
Alternate pushes with a relaxed arm swing.
Keep your chest up and your weight over the skates.
Skate at a steady pace for 10-30 minutes.
Slow down gradually to stop.

exercises.name: lever seated calf press v. 2
exercises.description: A seated machine calf press that pushes through the balls of the feet. It builds the calf muscles.
steps: Sit in the machine and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Extend your knees almost fully.
Press up as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause at the top.
Lower your heels slowly for a good stretch.

exercises.name: lever seated single calf press
exercises.description: A seated machine press working one calf at a time to build lower leg strength.
steps: Sit in the machine and place the ball of one foot on the platform.
Rest the other foot on the floor or the support.
Press up through your toes as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze your calf.
Lower your heel slowly for a full stretch.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: criss cross stepback hops
exercises.description: A quick hopping drill that crosses the feet and steps back, building agility and leg power.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and your knees soft.
Hop and cross one foot in front of the other.
Hop back out, then step one foot back behind you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet each time.
Keep a quick, rhythmic pace.
Alternate sides for the planned time.

exercises.name: resistance band glute bridge abduction
exercises.description: A glute bridge with a band around the knees, pressing out to light up the side glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and the band just above your knees.
Press through your heels to lift your hips.
At the top, push your knees apart against the band.
Bring the knees back together.
Lower your hips slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: resistance band lying bent knee hip abduction
exercises.description: A lying hip abduction with bent knees that targets the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with the band above your knees and your knees bent.
Stack your hips and rest your head on your arm.
Lift your top knee up against the band without rolling back.
Pause, then lower slowly.
Keep your feet together like a clamshell.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band seated bent knee abduction
exercises.description: A seated band move pressing the knees apart to work the outer hips.
steps: Sit tall on a bench or chair with the band just above your knees.
Plant your feet flat and hip-width apart.
Press your knees out against the band.
Hold briefly at the widest point.
Bring the knees back slowly.
Keep your back straight throughout.

exercises.name: resistance band lying leg raise v. 2
exercises.description: A leg raise with band tension that challenges the lower abs and hip flexors.
steps: Lie on your back with the band around your feet or anchored behind your head.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Raise your legs together toward the ceiling.
Lower them slowly without arching your back.
Stop just above the floor.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: resistance band side lunge
exercises.description: A side lunge with band tension that works the legs and hips from a different angle.
steps: Stand with the band under your feet or around your thighs, feet together.
Step wide to one side.
Sit your hips back and bend that knee, keeping the other leg straight.
Keep your chest up and your heel down.
Push back to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band squat step out
exercises.description: A squat that steps sideways against a band, firing up the glutes and hips.
steps: Place the band around your thighs and stand with feet hip-width.
Sit into a squat and stay low.
Step one foot out to the side against the band.
Bring the other foot in to follow.
Take several steps, then return the other way.
Keep your knees pushed out.

exercises.name: resistance band standing balance glute kickback v. 2
exercises.description: A second take on the band glute kickback, balancing on one leg while the other presses back.
steps: Place the band around your ankles and stand tall on one leg.
Hold a wall or rail for balance if needed.
Keep a slight bend in your standing knee.
Kick the other leg back, squeezing the glute.
Return slowly without leaning forward.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band squat jump
exercises.description: A squat jump with a band around the thighs to keep the knees driving outward.
steps: Place the band above your knees and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest up.
Explode upward into a jump.
Land softly, absorbing into the next squat.
Keep your knees pressing out against the band.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: resistance band lateral step and squat
exercises.description: A sideways step into a squat with band tension to train the glutes and legs.
steps: Put the band around your thighs and stand tall.
Step one foot out to the side.
Sit down into a squat.
Stand up and bring your feet together.
Keep the knees from caving in.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band bulgarian squat
exercises.description: A single-leg squat with the rear foot elevated and a band adding resistance.
steps: Stand in front of a bench, band under your front foot and held at your shoulders.
Rest the top of your back foot on the bench.
Lower straight down until your front thigh is parallel.
Keep your torso tall.
Press through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band kneeling back kick
exercises.description: A kneeling donkey-kick style move with band resistance for the glutes.
steps: Start on hands and knees with the band around your foot and hands.
Keep your back flat and your core braced.
Kick one leg straight back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band kneeling leg half circle
exercises.description: A kneeling leg sweep against a band that works the glutes and outer hips.
steps: Start on hands and knees with the band around your thighs or foot.
Lift one leg out to the side with a bent knee.
Sweep it in a half circle, back and up.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Reverse the circle to return.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: resistance band plank jack
exercises.description: A plank with jumping feet and a band around the legs, working your core while the hips resist.
steps: Place the band above your knees and get into a high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Jump your feet out wide.
Jump them back together.
Keep your hands under your shoulders.
Repeat at a steady pace.

exercises.name: resistance band lying hyperextension abduction
exercises.description: A face-down hip extension combined with outward leg movement against a band.
steps: Lie face down with the band around your ankles.
Rest your forehead on your hands.
Lift both legs slightly off the floor.
Open your legs out against the band.
Bring them back together and lower slowly.
Keep the movement small and controlled.

exercises.name: resistance band air bike v. 2
exercises.description: An air bike crunch with band tension for extra work on the abs and hips.
steps: Lie on your back, hands behind your head, band around your feet.
Lift your shoulders and bring one knee toward your chest.
Rotate your opposite elbow toward that knee.
Extend the other leg against the band.
Alternate in a pedalling motion.
Keep a steady rhythm.

exercises.name: side lying internal rotation
exercises.description: A light rotation exercise lying on your side that turns the arm inward. It strengthens the rotator cuff gently.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked to your ribs.
Rest the forearm on the floor in front of you.
Rotate your forearm up toward your belly.
Lower it slowly back to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: opposite arm and leg raise against wall
exercises.description: A wall-supported raise of the opposite arm and leg. It trains balance and lower back stability.
steps: Stand facing a wall in a bent over position with your hands on it.
Brace your core.
Lift one arm and the opposite leg at the same time.
Hold for a second without twisting.
Lower and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: floor t raise v. 2
exercises.description: A face-down raise with the arms out to form a T. It strengthens the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor and neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by pinching your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: ring wide pull up
exercises.description: A pull-up on rings with a wide grip. The unstable rings make the lats and stabilizers work harder.
steps: Grab the rings with a wide overhand grip and hang with arms straight.
Brace your core.
Pull your chest toward the rings, driving elbows down and out.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.name: kettlebell plank pass through
exercises.description: From a plank you slide a kettlebell under your body from one hand to the other. It works the core and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a high plank with a kettlebell beside one hand.
Spread your feet wide for balance.
Grab the kettlebell and slide it across under your body.
Place it down on the other side.
Keep your hips level and repeat in the other direction.

exercises.name: kettlebell gorilla row
exercises.description: A wide-stance row between two kettlebells, alternating arms. It trains the lats and the core.
steps: Place two kettlebells on the floor between your wide stance.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and grab both handles.
Row one kettlebell to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it and row the other side.
Keep your hips and shoulders square.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline single arm y raise
exercises.description: A chest-supported raise on an incline bench to a Y position with one arm. It builds the lower traps and rear delts.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight down.
Raise your arm forward and up in a Y shape, thumb up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your reps.

exercises.name: standing scapular rotation
exercises.description: A standing drill that moves the shoulder blades in circles. It improves shoulder mobility and control.
steps: Stand tall with arms relaxed at your sides.
Lift your shoulders up toward your ears.
Roll them back, then down.
Bring them forward and up again in a circle.
Reverse the direction after several reps.

exercises.name: standing scapular rotation (front pov)
exercises.description: A standing shoulder blade rotation that warms up the upper back and improves control of the scapulae.
steps: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Lift your shoulders gently up.
Roll them back and down in a smooth circle.
Reverse the direction.
Keep your neck relaxed.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing scapular external rotation
exercises.description: Light dumbbell rotation that strengthens the small muscles behind the shoulder and between the shoulder blades.
steps: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Keep your upper arm still and your shoulder blade pulled back and down.
Rotate your forearm outward as far as you comfortably can.
Pause briefly, then slowly return to the start.
Finish all reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing scapular external rotation (front pov)
exercises.description: A light dumbbell rotation that trains the rear shoulder and rotator cuff.
steps: Stand tall holding a light dumbbell with your elbow tucked and bent to 90 degrees.
Keep your upper arm against your side.
Rotate your forearm outward, away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blade back.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: barbell hook grip deadlift
exercises.description: Deadlift using a hook grip, where the thumb is trapped under the fingers, for a secure hold on heavy pulls.
steps: Stand with the bar over mid-foot and grip it with your thumbs under your fingers.
Hinge down, brace your core and keep your back flat.
Push the floor away and stand up, keeping the bar close to your legs.
Lock out with hips and knees extended.
Lower the bar under control by hinging at the hips first.

exercises.name: hanging front lever raise
exercises.description: Hanging straight-body raise toward a front lever position that challenges your abs and lats.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your core.
Raise your straight body up toward horizontal, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top position for a moment.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline powell raise
exercises.description: Raise performed lying face down on an incline bench, hitting the rear delts and the small rotator muscles.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight below your shoulder.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, leading with your elbow, up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

exercises.name: seated frog half to full sit up
exercises.description: Sit-up started from a seated frog position, with knees out and soles together, to work the abs and open the hips.
steps: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out.
Lower your back halfway to the floor under control.
Pause, then lower fully to lie flat.
Curl your torso back up to sitting, using your abs.
Keep your feet together and avoid yanking on your neck.

exercises.name: sitting uppercut on chair
exercises.description: Seated punching move that fires the abs and shoulders with quick uppercut punches.
steps: Sit tall on the edge of a chair with your fists up by your chin.
Brace your core.
Rotate your torso and punch one fist upward in an uppercut.
Snap it back and punch with the other hand.
Keep a quick, steady rhythm for the set.

exercises.name: suspension trainer pike
exercises.description: Plank with feet in suspension straps, piking the hips up to work the abs and shoulders.
steps: Place your feet in the straps and get into a plank with hands on the floor.
Keep your arms straight and body in a line.
Lift your hips toward the ceiling, pulling your feet in.
Pause at the top with legs fairly straight.
Lower back to plank with control.

exercises.name: suspension trainer front plank
exercises.description: Front plank with feet in straps, making the hold wobbly and demanding for the whole core.
steps: Set your feet in the straps and place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Form a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Hold without letting your hips sag or rise.
Keep breathing steadily for the whole hold.

exercises.name: bottle weighted gorilla row
exercises.description: Gorilla row using a weighted bottle in each hand, a handy way to train the back at home.
steps: Stand wide with a bottle on the floor between your feet and hinge forward.
Keep your back flat and grip a bottle in each hand.
Row one bottle up to your hip while the other stays down.
Lower it, then row with the other side.
Keep your hips steady and alternate sides.

exercises.name: resistance band hip thrusts on knees
exercises.description: Kneeling hip thrust against a band that targets the glutes without any bench.
steps: Kneel with a band anchored low in front and looped around your hips.
Start with your hips back and chest up.
Drive your hips forward, squeezing your glutes hard.
Pause at full hip extension.
Return slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: suspension trainer lat stretch
exercises.description: Hanging stretch using straps that opens the sides of your back and your shoulders.
steps: Hold the straps and lean back with straight arms.
Sit your hips back and drop your chest between your arms.
Feel the stretch along the sides of your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return slowly to standing.

exercises.name: suspension trainer squat power pull
exercises.description: Squat paired with an explosive pull on the straps, linking legs and back in one move.
steps: Hold the straps with arms extended and sink into a squat.
Keep your chest tall and knees tracking over toes.
Drive up through your legs.
As you rise, pull the straps toward your chest.
Lower your arms and sit back into the next squat.

exercises.name: resistance band leg kickback
exercises.description: Standing band kickback that isolates the glutes.
steps: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it low and loop it on one foot.
Stand tall holding something for balance.
Kick the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

exercises.name: resistance band walk
exercises.description: Walking with a band around the legs to fire up the outer hips and glutes.
steps: Place a band around your thighs or ankles.
Sit into a slight squat with feet hip width apart.
Step sideways, keeping tension in the band.
Bring the trailing foot in without letting the band go slack.
Walk back the other way to even it out.

exercises.name: trap bar overhead press
exercises.description: Overhead press using a trap bar, giving a neutral grip that can be easier on the shoulders.
steps: Stand inside the trap bar and hold it at shoulder height with a neutral grip.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Press the bar overhead until your arms lock out.
Pause, then lower to your shoulders.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

exercises.name: lying pelvic tilt
exercises.description: A small floor movement that teaches you to control the tilt of your pelvis and relax the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Take a breath in with a neutral spine.
Exhale, tilting your pelvis so your lower back presses into the floor.
Hold for a moment.
Release back to neutral.
Repeat slowly.

exercises.name: standing side neck stretch
exercises.description: A gentle side stretch for the neck and upper traps, useful after desk work.
steps: Stand tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Tilt your head toward one shoulder.
Rest a hand lightly on your head for slight pressure.
Keep the opposite shoulder low.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: seated hamstring stretch with chair
exercises.description: A seated stretch using a chair to lengthen the back of the thigh without a deep fold.
steps: Sit on the front edge of a chair.
Straighten one leg with the heel on the floor and toes up.
Keep the other foot flat and your back long.
Hinge forward at the hips until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing calmly.
Switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell reverse lunge from deficit
exercises.description: Reverse lunge with the front foot raised for a deeper range, hitting the glutes and quads.
steps: Stand with your front foot on a low platform, holding dumbbells at your sides.
Step one foot back and lower until the back knee nearly touches the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee steady.
Push through the front heel to return.
Finish reps and switch legs.

exercises.name: lever leg extension (inward toes)
exercises.description: Leg extension with toes angled in to shift the emphasis on the quads.
steps: Sit in the machine with the pad on your lower shins.
Turn your toes slightly inward.
Extend your knees until your legs are straight.
Squeeze your quads for a second.
Lower the weight slowly.

exercises.name: dumbbell hyperextension
exercises.description: Hyperextension with a dumbbell held to your chest to load the lower back and glutes.
steps: Set up on a hyperextension bench with the pads at your hips.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest.
Lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise up until your body forms a straight line.
Avoid overarching at the top.

exercises.name: dumbbell jefferson curl
exercises.description: Slow, light-loaded spinal roll down and up that builds control and flexibility in the back and hamstrings.
steps: Stand on a low step holding a light dumbbell in front of you.
Tuck your chin and slowly roll down one vertebra at a time.
Let the dumbbell hang near your shins.
Pause at the bottom, then roll up slowly.
Keep the weight light and the movement smooth.

exercises.name: hopping pendulum
exercises.description: Side to side hopping that swings your legs like a pendulum, training balance and leg power.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways to land on the other foot.
Swing the free leg across behind you for balance.
Land softly and stay controlled.
Keep alternating at a steady pace.

exercises.name: wide plank side tap
exercises.description: Wide-stance plank with alternating side taps that challenge core stability.
steps: Start in a high plank with feet wider than your hips.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one hand and tap your opposite hip or thigh.
Return the hand and tap with the other side.
Move slowly without rocking.

exercises.name: smith sumo deadlift
exercises.description: Wide-stance deadlift on the smith machine that trains glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet wide, toes turned out, and grip the bar inside your knees.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Push your feet into the floor and stand tall.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar by pushing your hips back.

exercises.name: lever hip thrust (plate loaded)
exercises.description: Plate-loaded machine hip thrust for heavy glute work.
steps: Sit with your back against the pad and belt secured over your hips.
Plant your feet flat, shoulder width apart.
Drive your hips up until your body is level.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: pull up (negative)
exercises.description: Slow lowering phase of a pull-up that builds strength for full pull-ups.
steps: Jump or step up so your chin is above the bar.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower yourself slowly over 3-5 seconds.
Stop at a full hang with straight arms.
Step back up and repeat.

exercises.name: wall plank
exercises.description: A standing plank against a wall, an easy way to learn core bracing.
steps: Stand facing a wall and place your forearms or hands on it.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a slanted line.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Keep your head neutral.
Hold for 20-40 seconds.
Step in to finish.

exercises.name: weighted full squat from deficit
exercises.description: Deep weighted squat with heels raised to increase depth and quad work.
steps: Stand with your heels on a low plate or platform, holding a weight at your chest.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Squat as deep as comfortable.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Drive up to standing.

exercises.name: reverse lunge high knee forward lunge
exercises.description: Combo lunge: step back, drive the knee up, then step forward into a lunge.
steps: Stand tall with hands on hips.
Step back into a reverse lunge.
Drive that back leg forward into a high knee.
Step the same leg forward into a forward lunge.
Push back to standing and switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: elevated two legs hip thrust
exercises.description: A hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, driving both hips up to train the glutes.
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and knees bent.
Plant your feet hip-width apart.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: crunch against wall
exercises.description: A crunch with your legs against a wall that keeps your hips steady and works the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet and calves resting on a wall, knees bent about 90 degrees.
Place your hands lightly behind your head.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: planche dip on parallel bars
exercises.description: Dip with a leaning body angle that loads the shoulders and triceps hard.
steps: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Lean forward and shift your weight over your hands.
Bend your elbows to lower your body under control.
Keep your core tight and elbows close.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: cable standing neutral grip fly
exercises.description: Standing cable fly with palms facing each other to squeeze the chest.
steps: Set the pulleys at chest height and grab the handles.
Step forward with a staggered stance and a slight elbow bend.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your pecs for a moment.
Return slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: overhead sit up with legs on bench
exercises.description: Sit-up with arms overhead and calves on a bench for a longer lever on the abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your calves resting on a bench, knees bent.
Extend your arms overhead.
Curl your torso up, keeping your arms by your ears.
Reach toward your knees.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: staggered leg glute bridge
exercises.description: A glute bridge with one foot placed forward to shift more load to one side.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent, one foot forward of the other.
Press through both heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your hips level.
Lower slowly.
Switch the foot position halfway through.

exercises.name: straight leg glute bridge
exercises.description: A bridge with straight legs that shifts more work to the hamstrings and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs straight and your heels on the floor.
Press your heels down and lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Keep your ribs down.
Lower slowly.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell standing front and lateral raise
exercises.description: Combined raise that hits the front and side delts in one rep.
steps: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides.
Raise both arms to the front up to shoulder height.
Lower them back down.
Raise them out to your sides to shoulder height.
Lower with control and repeat.

exercises.name: single leg lateral hop
exercises.description: One-legged sideways hop that builds power and ankle stability.
steps: Stand on one leg with a slight knee bend.
Hop sideways a short distance.
Land softly on the same foot and hold your balance.
Hop back the other way.
Complete reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: spider mountain climber
exercises.description: Mountain climber where each knee drives toward the same-side elbow, adding side work for the core.
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Drive one knee toward the outside of your elbow.
Return that foot and switch legs.
Keep your hips low and your core braced.
Move at a quick, controlled pace.

exercises.name: dumbbell goblet squat with calf raise
exercises.description: Goblet squat finished with a calf raise as you stand.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up to standing.
Rise onto your toes at the top.
Lower your heels and go into the next squat.

exercises.name: double plank jack to 4 mountain climber
exercises.description: Conditioning combo of two plank jacks followed by four mountain climbers.
steps: Start in a high plank.
Jump your feet wide and together twice.
Do four mountain climbers, driving your knees alternately.
Keep your hips level.
Flow through the sequence at a steady pace.

exercises.name: ring archer pull up
exercises.description: Pull-up on rings where you pull toward one hand with the other arm extended.
steps: Hang from rings with a wide grip.
Pull up toward one hand, leaving the other arm straight.
Reach the top with your chin by that hand.
Lower under control.
Alternate sides each rep.

exercises.name: ring one arm pull up
exercises.description: Advanced single-arm pull on a ring that demands serious back and arm strength.
steps: Hang from one ring with a firm grip.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Pull your chin up toward the ring.
Lower with control to a full hang.
Complete reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: lying floor slide
exercises.description: Floor slide that improves shoulder mobility and activates the upper back.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and arms in a goalpost position.
Keep your back and wrists on the floor.
Slide your arms up overhead.
Return slowly to the start.
Move within your comfortable range.

exercises.name: forward backward hop
exercises.description: A light hop forward and back that builds ankle spring and coordination.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Hop forward a short distance on the balls of your feet.
Hop back to the start.
Land softly with your knees slightly bent.
Keep a quick tempo.
Repeat for the planned time.

exercises.name: dumbbell goblet sumo squat
exercises.description: Wide-stance goblet squat that targets the glutes and inner thighs.
steps: Stand with feet wide and toes out, holding a dumbbell at your chest.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down between your legs.
Keep your knees pointing over your toes.
Drive up and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: kettlebell swing to goblet squat
exercises.description: Kettlebell swing flowing into a goblet squat for hips, legs and grip.
steps: Swing the kettlebell up to chest height from a hip hinge.
Catch it at your chest in a goblet hold.
Sit into a deep squat.
Stand up and lower the bell back between your legs.
Hinge and swing again.

exercises.name: dumbbell goblet bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with a dumbbell held at the chest.
steps: Place your rear foot on a bench and hold a dumbbell at your chest.
Step the front foot forward.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your torso tall.
Push through the front heel and switch legs after your reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell bulgarian split squat from deficit
exercises.description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the front foot raised for greater depth.
steps: Stand with your front foot on a low platform and your rear foot on a bench.
Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lower until your back knee is near the floor.
Keep your front knee steady.
Drive up and switch legs.

exercises.name: bodyweight heel elevated bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: Split squat with the front heel raised, loading the quads more directly.
steps: Place your rear foot on a bench and front heel on a small plate.
Hold your hands at your chest.
Lower straight down.
Keep your front knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

exercises.name: barbell zercher bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: Rear-foot elevated split squat with the barbell in your elbow crooks.
steps: Rest the barbell in the crooks of your elbows.
Put your rear foot on a bench.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up and switch legs.

exercises.name: doorway chest stretch
exercises.description: Doorway stretch that opens up the chest and the fronts of your shoulders.
steps: Stand in a doorway with forearms on the frame, elbows at 90 degrees.
Step one foot forward.
Lean gently through the door until you feel a stretch.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Breathe slowly and step back.

exercises.name: parallel bars bent knee inverted row
exercises.description: Easier bodyweight row under parallel bars with knees bent.
steps: Lie under parallel bars and grab them.
Bend your knees with feet on the floor.
Keep your body straight from shoulders to knees.
Pull your chest to the bars.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: jumping jack high knee
exercises.description: Jumping jack paired with a high knee for a lively cardio drill.
steps: Stand tall with arms at your sides.
Jump your feet out and raise your arms overhead.
Jump back in and bring one knee high.
Alternate knees each rep.
Stay light on your feet.

exercises.name: squat jack
exercises.description: Jumping jack variation that stays in a squat for a leg-burning cardio move.
steps: Start in a squat with hands at your chest.
Jump your feet out wide.
Hop back to the narrow squat stance.
Stay low the whole time.
Land softly and keep your chest up.

exercises.name: wall sit (narrow stance)
exercises.description: Wall sit with feet close together to focus on the quads.
steps: Lean your back on a wall with feet close together.
Slide down until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep knees over ankles.
Hold for 20-60 seconds.
Slide back up slowly.

exercises.name: wall sit from deficit
exercises.description: Wall sit with heels raised for a tougher quad hold.
steps: Stand with your heels on a low platform and your back on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your back flat.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Slide up carefully.

exercises.name: dumbbell goblet wall sit
exercises.description: Wall sit holding a dumbbell at the chest for extra load.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and lean on a wall.
Slide down until thighs are parallel.
Keep your knees above your ankles.
Hold for 20-45 seconds.
Stand up slowly.

exercises.name: bodyweight single leg squat
exercises.description: Squat on one leg, building strength and balance.
steps: Stand on one leg with the other lifted in front.
Extend your arms for balance.
Lower down with control.
Keep your knee over your toes.
Push up and switch legs.

exercises.name: bodyweight single leg squat with support
exercises.description: Supported single leg squat that helps you progress toward the full version.
steps: Hold a stable support with one hand.
Stand on one leg with the other lifted.
Lower down as far as you can with control.
Use the support only as much as needed.
Push up and switch legs.

exercises.name: seated quadriceps stretch v. 2
exercises.description: Seated stretch for the front of your thigh.
steps: Sit sideways on a bench or chair edge.
Bend one knee, tucking your foot behind you.
Hold your ankle and gently pull it toward your glutes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch sides.

exercises.name: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat
exercises.description: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: cable split stance single arm row
exercises.description: Single-arm cable row in a split stance for stable pulling.
steps: Stand in a split stance facing a low cable.
Grab the handle with one hand.
Row to your hip, squeezing the shoulder blade.
Keep your torso steady.
Return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: barbell bent arm pullover v. 2
exercises.description: Pullover with slightly bent arms using a barbell for lats and chest.
steps: Lie on a bench holding a barbell above your chest.
Keep a slight elbow bend.
Lower the bar behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest.
Keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: dumbbell hack squat
exercises.description: Hack squat with dumbbells held behind the legs.
steps: Hold dumbbells behind you with your heels slightly raised.
Keep your chest up.
Squat down.
Stay tall.
Drive up through your feet.

exercises.name: bodyweight heel elevated squat
exercises.description: Squat with heels raised to emphasize the quads.
steps: Stand with your heels on a small plate.
Extend your arms in front.
Squat deep with your chest up.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.
Stand back up.

exercises.name: cable front squat with v bar
exercises.description: Front squat holding a V bar on a low cable.
steps: Hold a V bar at chest height.
Stand a step back from the cable.
Squat down with your elbows up.
Keep your chest tall.
Stand up.

exercises.name: kettlebell contralateral reverse lunge
exercises.description: Reverse lunge with the kettlebell in the opposite hand to the working leg.
steps: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the opposite leg.
Lower until the back knee nears the floor.
Push through the front foot.
Finish reps and switch sides.

exercises.name: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge
exercises.description: Reverse lunge with the kettlebell on the same side as the working leg.
steps: Hold a kettlebell in one hand.
Step back with the leg on the same side.
Lower under control.
Keep your torso upright.
Push back up and switch sides.

exercises.name: cable neutral grip lat pulldown
exercises.description: Pull a neutral-grip handle down to your upper chest on a cable stack. It builds the lats and the muscles between your shoulder blades.
steps: Sit at the lat pulldown station, thighs secured, and grab the neutral-grip handle.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Pull the handle down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the bottom.
Let the handle rise slowly until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: cable kneeling high low anti rotation chop
exercises.description: A kneeling cable chop that moves from high to low while your torso resists twisting. It trains the deep core and obliques to stay stable.
steps: Kneel side-on to a high cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core and keep your hips square.
Chop the handle diagonally down across your body, arms mostly straight.
Do not let your torso rotate; the arms and shoulders do the travel.
Return slowly under control, finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: twist turn lift
exercises.description: A floor core move that combines a twist with a leg or torso lift. It works the abs and obliques through rotation.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and arms extended.
Lift your shoulders and legs off the floor.
Twist your torso and bring your knees toward one side.
Turn back through the centre and lift again.
Repeat to the other side, keeping the movement smooth and controlled.

exercises.name: cable ipsilateral glute dominant step up
exercises.description: A step-up with a cable held on the same side as the working leg, leaning forward to bias the glutes.
steps: Stand in front of a box with a cable handle in the hand on your working side.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Drive through the heel to stand up.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable single arm high row with chest support
exercises.description: A one-arm cable row from a high pulley while your chest rests on a pad. The support lets you focus on the upper back without cheating.
steps: Set a handle on a high pulley and lean your chest against the support.
Grab the handle with one hand and let your arm extend.
Pull your elbow back and down toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade at the end of the pull.
Return slowly to full extension, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: weighted front raise hold
exercises.description: Hold a weight plate out in front of you at shoulder height. It builds endurance in the front delts.
steps: Stand tall holding a weight plate with both hands at your thighs.
Raise it straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Keep your arms nearly straight and your ribs down.
Hold the position, breathing steadily, for 20-40 seconds.
Lower the plate slowly with control.

exercises.name: cable kneeling glute kickback
exercises.description: A kneeling cable kickback that isolates the glutes.
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and kneel on hands and knees facing it.
Brace your core and keep your back flat.
Kick the cuffed leg back and up.
Squeeze at the top.
Return slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell glute dominant bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with a forward lean, loading the glutes.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with your back foot on a bench.
Step the front foot out far enough for your shin to stay near vertical.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the thigh is parallel.
Drive through your front heel to rise.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable lying face pull
exercises.description: A face pull performed lying on your back with a cable. It hits the rear delts and upper back with little help from momentum.
steps: Lie on your back with the cable set low behind your head and hold the rope ends.
Start with your arms extended.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows flaring out and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: cable incline rear delt fly with back support
exercises.description: A rear delt fly with cables while your chest rests on an incline bench. It isolates the back of the shoulders.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench between two cable stations.
Grab the opposite handles, arms hanging with a slight bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they reach shoulder level.
Pause and squeeze your rear delts.
Lower slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: sled glute dominant leg press
exercises.description: A sled leg press with a foot position that puts more load on the glutes. It also works the quads and hamstrings.
steps: Sit in the sled and place your feet high and wide on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the sled until your knees reach about 90 degrees.
Keep your lower back pressed into the seat.
Push through your heels to extend your legs without locking the knees.
Lower under control for each rep.

exercises.name: cable high row with chest support
exercises.description: A two-handed cable row from a high pulley with your chest braced on a pad. It trains the upper back and rear shoulders.
steps: Set the cable high and lean your chest against the support pad.
Grab the handles and extend your arms.
Pull your elbows back and slightly down.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Let your arms extend slowly to the start.

exercises.name: dumbbell contralateral glute dominant bulgarian split squat
exercises.description: A Bulgarian split squat with one dumbbell held in the opposite hand to the front leg.
steps: Hold one dumbbell in the hand opposite your front leg.
Put your back foot on a bench and step the front foot forward.
Lean your torso forward slightly.
Lower until the front thigh is parallel.
Drive up through the front heel.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: jack burpee v. 2
exercises.description: A burpee that finishes with a jumping jack. It raises your heart rate and works the whole body.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.

exercises.name: barbell banded bench press
exercises.description: A bench press with bands attached to the bar, so resistance rises toward lockout. It builds pressing power across the chest and triceps.
steps: Set bands on the bar and lie on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Unrack the bar over your chest with a firm grip.
Lower it to your mid chest under control.
Press up and out until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet down.

exercises.name: barbell pin bench press conventional grip
exercises.description: A bench press started from a dead stop on safety pins, using a standard grip. It builds strength off the chest without any bounce.
steps: Set the pins at a height just above your chest and lie on the bench.
Grab the bar at about shoulder-width plus a little.
Pause the bar on the pins to remove momentum.
Press the bar straight up until your arms lock out.
Lower back to the pins with control and reset for each rep.

exercises.name: lying single leg hamstring stretch against wall
exercises.description: Lie by a wall and rest one leg up against it to stretch the hamstring. Easy to relax into and good after leg days.
steps: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.

exercises.name: single arm lat stretch against wall
exercises.description: Stretch one side of your back by reaching an arm overhead against a wall. It lengthens the lat and side of the torso.
steps: Stand beside a wall and place one hand on it above head height.
Step your feet back slightly.
Press your hips away and lean your chest down toward the floor.
Feel the stretch along your side and under the armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

exercises.name: flying lizard yoga pose utthan pristhasana
exercises.description: A deep lunge-based hip opener with a twist and reach, stretching the hips and inner thighs.
steps: Start in a low lunge with your front foot between your hands.
Lower your forearms to the floor or blocks.
Drop your back knee or keep it lifted.
Let your hips sink.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Step back and switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell bent over curl
exercises.description: A biceps curl performed while hinged forward at the hips. The position removes swing and keeps tension on the biceps.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: landmine squat
exercises.description: A squat holding the end of a landmine bar at your chest. The angled bar helps you stay upright and load the legs.
steps: Hold the end of the landmine bar against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

exercises.name: landmine overhead rear lunge
exercises.description: A reverse lunge while pressing a landmine bar overhead. It trains the legs, glutes and shoulders together.
steps: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you rise, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulder while you lunge back again.
Complete your reps and switch legs.

exercises.name: dumbbell ipsilateral single leg stiff leg deadlift
exercises.description: A one-leg deadlift holding the dumbbell on the same side as the standing leg, for hamstrings and balance.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: sitting alternate knee to elbow twist
exercises.description: From a seated position, twist to bring an elbow toward the opposite knee. It works the abs and obliques.
steps: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

exercises.name: cable half kneeling face pull
exercises.description: A face pull from a half-kneeling stance. The stable position keeps the focus on your rear delts and upper back.
steps: Set a rope at head height and half kneel facing the stack.
Hold the rope ends with your palms facing in.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly. Switch the leading knee after your set.

exercises.name: cable standing supinated face pull (with rope)
exercises.description: A standing face pull using a rope with an underhand grip. It trains the rear shoulders and upper back, and is gentle on the wrists.
steps: Set the rope at face height and grip it with your palms facing up.
Step back and stand tall.
Pull the rope toward your face, elbows leading.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end.
Return slowly to the start.

exercises.name: standing supinated face pull (with towels)
exercises.description: A face pull using a towel looped around a fixed anchor and an underhand grip. A simple way to train the rear delts without a cable.
steps: Loop a towel around a sturdy anchor and hold both ends, palms up.
Lean back with your arms extended.
Pull your hands toward your face, elbows wide.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower yourself slowly. Walk your feet in to make it harder.

exercises.name: nordic hamstring curl
exercises.description: Kneel with your feet anchored and lower your body forward slowly. It is a demanding hamstring strengthener.
steps: Kneel on a pad with your ankles held down firmly.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower forward as slowly as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands at the bottom.
Push back up and repeat.

exercises.name: dumbbell prone w raise
exercises.description: Lying face down, you raise light dumbbells while bending the elbows into a W shape. It works the rear delts and the upper back.
steps: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your elbows to about 90 degrees.
Lift your arms out and up into a W shape.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: kettlebell swing clean grip front squat v. 2
exercises.description: A combo that swings the kettlebell into a clean grip and finishes with a front squat for legs and hips.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and the kettlebell on the floor in front of you.
Hinge back and swing the bell between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to swing, catching it in a clean position at your chest.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Stand back up and lower the bell to swing again.
Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: dead bug v. 3
exercises.description: A back-lying core drill that moves opposite arms and legs while keeping the lower back flat.
steps: Lie on your back with arms straight above you and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor.
Return to the start.
Alternate sides with a slow tempo.
Keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: reverse air cycling
exercises.description: Lie on your back with your hips raised, pedalling the legs in a backward motion. It targets the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back and lift your hips slightly with hands under your glutes.
Raise your legs.
Pedal backward in a smooth circle.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue for a set time or reps.

exercises.name: side plank twist arm delt raise
exercises.description: A side plank with a twist that ends in an arm raise. It challenges your obliques and shoulders.
steps: Set up in a side plank on your forearm.
Raise your top arm up toward the ceiling.
Rotate and thread your arm under your torso.
Open back up and raise the arm again.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: explosive dynamic plank
exercises.description: A plank with fast, powerful movements from the hands or feet. It builds core strength and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a high plank, hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Move quickly, hopping or shifting your hands and feet.
Keep your hips level and avoid sagging.
Rest when your form slips.

exercises.name: lever overhead triceps extension
exercises.description: A machine overhead triceps extension. The lever path keeps the movement smooth and the focus on the triceps.
steps: Adjust the seat and sit with your back supported.
Grip the handles overhead with your elbows pointing up.
Extend your arms until they are almost straight.
Squeeze your triceps at the top.
Lower slowly behind your head.

exercises.name: dumbbell incline triceps kickback
exercises.description: A chest-supported kickback on an incline bench that isolates the triceps.
steps: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Pin your upper arms to your sides.
Straighten your elbows to kick the weights back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Return slowly.
Keep your upper arms still.

exercises.name: dumbbell kneeling triceps kickback
exercises.description: A kickback done in a kneeling position, with one hand on a bench for support.
steps: Kneel beside a bench with one hand and the same-side knee on it.
Hold a dumbbell in the free hand with your upper arm against your side.
Extend your elbow to kick the weight back.
Squeeze your triceps.
Lower slowly.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: plate push
exercises.description: An explosive push of a weight plate out from your chest for upper-body power.
steps: Stand with a weight plate held at your chest, elbows bent.
Brace your abs and bend your knees slightly.
Push the plate out explosively with both arms.
Fully extend your arms.
Pull the plate back to your chest with control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: landmine deadlift
exercises.description: A deadlift with the end of a landmine bar, easier on the back and good for hips and hamstrings.
steps: Load one end of the barbell in a landmine and stand facing it, feet hip-width.
Hinge back and grip the bar end with both hands.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
Lower the bar under control.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: lever push up with towels
exercises.description: A push-up with your hands on towels, adding instability for the chest and shoulders.
steps: Place your hands on towels on the floor in a plank.
Keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up.
Keep your elbows at about 45 degrees.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated triceps extension v. 2
exercises.description: A seated overhead extension with a dumbbell that builds the triceps.
steps: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core tight.
Repeat for the planned reps.

exercises.name: kneeling rotation torso rear fly to thread through
exercises.description: A kneeling thoracic mobility move combining a rear fly and a thread-the-needle reach.
steps: Start on hands and knees.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your torso open, elbow to the ceiling.
Return and thread that arm under your chest.
Let your shoulder reach toward the floor.
Keep your hips still.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable seated unilateral bicep curl
exercises.description: A seated biceps curl with a cable, working one arm at a time. It gives constant tension throughout the movement.
steps: Sit facing a low cable and hold the handle with one hand.
Rest your elbow near your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your set.

exercises.name: cable seated single arm unilateral bicep curl
exercises.description: A seated one-arm cable curl that keeps tension on the biceps. Good for fixing strength gaps between arms.
steps: Sit upright with a low cable handle in one hand.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Curl up toward your shoulder without leaning back.
Squeeze at the top for a second.
Lower under control, then switch arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell glute bridge chest press
exercises.description: A dumbbell chest press done lying in a glute bridge. It works the chest and triceps while the glutes hold your hips up.
steps: Lie on your back holding dumbbells at chest level, knees bent.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest.
Lower with control while holding your hips high.
Finish your reps, then lower your hips.

exercises.name: dumbbell bent over y raise
exercises.description: Hinge forward and raise light dumbbells out and up into a Y shape. It trains the shoulders and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
steps: Hold a light dumbbell in each hand and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Let your arms hang below your shoulders, palms facing each other.
Raise both arms forward and up at about 45 degrees to form a Y.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower the weights slowly under control.
Keep your neck long and avoid swinging your torso.

exercises.name: resistance band 45 degree hip extension glute focused
exercises.description: A hip extension on a 45 degree bench with a band added for extra glute load. It builds the glutes and the back of the thighs.
steps: Set up on a 45 degree hip extension bench with the band anchored under your feet and held across your upper back.
Cross your arms or hold the band at your shoulders.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back until you feel your hamstrings stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes to come back up.
Stop when your body is in a straight line.
Do not over-arch your lower back at the top.

exercises.name: resistance band wide stance anti rotation chop
exercises.description: A band chop in a wide stance where you resist twisting. It strengthens the abs and obliques.
steps: Anchor the band at one side and stand sideways with your feet wide.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Brace your core.
Press or chop diagonally while keeping your torso square.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: kettlebell wood chop
exercises.description: A rotational chop holding a kettlebell from high to low across the body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.
steps: Hold a kettlebell with both hands and stand with your feet wide.
Start with it high beside one shoulder.
Rotate and chop down to the opposite knee.
Pivot your back foot as you turn.
Return with control and switch sides.

exercises.name: kneeling thoracic rotation
exercises.description: A kneeling rotation that opens up the mid back. Good for loosening your upper spine before training or after sitting.
steps: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your upper body and point that elbow toward the ceiling.
Follow your elbow with your eyes and keep your hips square.
Return and touch the elbow toward the opposite arm.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: dumbbell single leg hip thrust v. 2
exercises.description: A one-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell across your hips. It hits the glutes hard and shows up strength imbalances.
steps: Sit with your upper back against a bench and a dumbbell on your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg.
Drive your hips up until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: weighted plate push up
exercises.description: A push-up with a weight plate on your upper back. The added load makes it harder once regular push-ups feel easy.
steps: Have a partner place a plate on your upper back, or set it carefully yourself.
Get into a high plank.
Lower your chest to the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your body in a straight line.

exercises.name: cable straight leg diagonal kickback
exercises.description: A standing cable kickback with a straight leg, driven back and slightly out to the side. It isolates the glutes.
steps: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Keep your leg straight and kick it back and slightly out to the side.
Squeeze your glute at the top without leaning forward.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: negative biceps leg concentration curl
exercises.description: A seated concentration curl braced against the thigh with a slow lowering phase. It emphasises the biceps through the negative.
steps: Sit with your legs apart and hold a weight in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the weight up with help from your other hand if needed.
Lower it very slowly over about 3 to 4 seconds.
Keep your upper arm still against your leg.
Do your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: resistance band standing balance hip abduction
exercises.description: A standing hip abduction with a band that also challenges your balance. It targets the outer hips.
steps: Put a band around your ankles and stand on one leg.
Hold something for balance if needed.
Lift the free leg out to the side.
Keep your torso upright.
Lower slowly and switch legs after your set.

exercises.name: moving child pose
exercises.description: A flowing version of child's pose that rocks the body to stretch the back, hips and shoulders.
steps: Start on all fours with your knees slightly wider than your hips.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and reach your arms forward.
Let your chest sink toward the floor.
Rock forward and back slowly, then walk your hands to each side.
Breathe deeply and relax your neck.
Move gently for 30 to 60 seconds.

exercises.name: cable standing crossover
exercises.description: A standing cable fly where your hands cross in front of the chest. It focuses on squeezing the pecs.
steps: Set the pulleys at a high position and grab a handle in each hand.
Step forward with a slight lean.
Bring your hands together in a wide arc.
Squeeze your chest as your hands cross.
Return slowly to a stretch.

exercises.name: resistance band lying leg press
exercises.description: A leg press performed lying on your back using a band around your feet. It works the quads and glutes.
steps: Lie on your back and loop a band around your feet, holding the ends.
Bring your knees toward your chest.
Press your feet away until your legs are almost straight.
Control the band as it pulls you back.
Repeat for your reps.

exercises.name: triceps dip on high parallel bars
exercises.description: A dip on high parallel bars with an upright torso. It builds the triceps and chest.
steps: Grip the bars and lift yourself with straight arms.
Keep your body upright and elbows close.
Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Press back up to straight arms.
Avoid shrugging your shoulders.

exercises.name: lying pelvic floor relaxation and deep breathing
exercises.description: A gentle lying breathing drill that lets the pelvic floor and belly relax. It helps you learn calm, deep breathing.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your hands on your lower belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose and let your belly rise.
Let your pelvic floor and hips soften as you inhale.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes at a relaxed pace.

exercises.name: deep lunge to hamstring stretch
exercises.description: A flowing stretch from a deep lunge into a straight front leg. It opens the hip flexors and stretches the hamstrings.
steps: Step into a deep lunge with both hands on the floor.
Hold for a breath and feel the front of the back hip open.
Shift your hips back and straighten the front leg.
Flex your front foot and fold gently over it.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Return to the lunge and switch legs.

exercises.name: standing ankle circles v. 2
exercises.description: A standing mobility drill that rotates the ankle through its full range. It warms up the ankle joints.
steps: Stand tall and hold a wall or chair for balance.
Lift one foot slightly off the floor.
Draw slow circles with your toes.
Do about 10 circles in one direction.
Switch to the other direction.
Change feet and repeat.

exercises.name: wide chin up
exercises.description: A chin-up with a wider underhand grip. It hits the lats and biceps.
steps: Hang from a bar with an underhand grip wider than shoulders.
Brace your core.
Pull until your chin is over the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

exercises.name: cable standing hip flexion
exercises.description: A standing leg raise to the front against cable resistance. It trains the hip flexors and front thigh.
steps: Attach an ankle strap and face away from a low cable.
Hold a support for balance.
Lift your knee in front of you.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Switch legs after your set.

exercises.name: dumbbell sumo deadlift
exercises.description: A deadlift with a wide stance holding a dumbbell between your legs. It works the glutes, inner thighs and back.
steps: Stand with a wide stance, toes turned out, and a dumbbell between your feet.
Hinge down and grab it with both hands.
Keep your chest up and back flat.
Drive through your feet to stand tall.
Lower the weight under control.

exercises.name: cable reverse woodchop
exercises.description: A cable chop that travels from low to high across your body. It trains the obliques and builds rotational power.
steps: Set the cable low and stand side-on to the stack.
Hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it diagonally up across your body.
Pivot your back foot and rotate your torso.
Return slowly. Switch sides after your set.

exercises.name: lying knee raise
exercises.description: From lying on your back, you draw your knees toward your chest. It works the lower abs.
steps: Lie on your back with your legs extended.
Press your lower back into the floor.
Draw your knees up toward your chest.
Pause briefly.
Lower slowly without arching.

exercises.name: sitting side bend on a chair
exercises.description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides. Easy to do at a desk.
steps: Sit tall on a chair with feet flat.
Place one hand behind your head.
Bend sideways toward the floor.
Return to upright using your side muscles.
Repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: sitting swimmer on a chair
exercises.description: A seated move where your arms alternate in a swimming motion. A gentle shoulder warm-up for any time.
steps: Sit upright near the edge of a chair.
Lean forward slightly with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the other back, then alternate.
Move in a steady rhythm.
Keep your core braced.

exercises.name: sitting woodchopper on a chair
exercises.description: A seated woodchop with the hands clasped. It works the obliques with no equipment.
steps: Sit tall on a chair and clasp your hands together.
Raise your arms diagonally up to one side.
Chop down across your body to the opposite knee.
Rotate through your torso.
Alternate sides at an easy pace.

exercises.name: sitting prayer chest squeeze on a chair
exercises.description: Seated, you press your palms together in front of your chest. It trains the chest with no equipment.
steps: Sit tall on a chair.
Bring your palms together in front of your chest.
Press your palms firmly into each other.
Hold for 10-15 seconds.
Release and repeat.

exercises.name: sitting alternate abduction twist on a chair
exercises.description: A seated move combining a leg out to the side with a twist. It gently works the hips and waist.
steps: Sit tall near the edge of a chair.
Lift one leg and open it out to the side.
Twist your torso toward that leg.
Return to centre.
Alternate sides.

exercises.name: sitting russian twist on a chair
exercises.description: A Russian twist done seated on a chair. It works the obliques with low impact.
steps: Sit near the edge of a chair and lean back slightly.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Return to centre and rotate to the other side.
Keep your chest tall.

exercises.name: deep knee bend
exercises.description: A full-depth bodyweight squat. It builds leg strength and works the mobility of hips and ankles.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back and down as deep as you can.
Keep your heels down and chest up.
Pause at the bottom.
Drive up to standing.

exercises.name: dumbbell lateral raise plank
exercises.description: In a plank, you raise a dumbbell out to the side. It challenges the core and shoulders together.
steps: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells.
Brace your core and widen your feet.
Lift one dumbbell out to the side.
Avoid twisting your hips.
Lower and alternate arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell underhand renegade row
exercises.description: A renegade row with an underhand grip on the dumbbells. It builds core stability and works the lats and biceps.
steps: Set up in a plank with your hands on dumbbells, palms facing forward.
Widen your feet for balance.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell renegade row on stability ball
exercises.description: A renegade row with your feet on a stability ball. The unstable base makes the core work harder.
steps: Place your feet on a stability ball and your hands on dumbbells.
Brace into a strong plank.
Row one dumbbell up to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Lower and alternate arms.

exercises.name: resistance band renegade row
exercises.description: A renegade row using a resistance band. It trains the core while the lats and back do the pulling.
steps: Anchor a band and get into a plank facing it.
Hold the band in one hand.
Row your elbow back to your ribs.
Keep your hips level.
Return slowly and alternate arms.

exercises.name: dumbbell renegade row walk
exercises.description: A renegade row combined with walking forward in plank. It is a demanding move for core and shoulder stability.
steps: Start in a plank with a dumbbell in each hand.
Row one dumbbell up.
Place it down and step the hands forward.
Repeat with the other arm.
Keep your hips level.

exercises.name: biceps curl under table
exercises.description: Lie under a sturdy table and curl your body up by gripping the edge. A bodyweight biceps exercise.
steps: Lie under a strong table and grip its edge with an underhand grip.
Keep your body straight with heels on the floor.
Pull your chest toward the table by bending the elbows.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: side lying chest stretch
exercises.description: Lying on your side, you open one arm backward to stretch the chest. It loosens tight pecs.
steps: Lie on your side with your knees bent and arms in front of you.
Lift your top arm and open it back like a book.
Let your chest rotate open.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return and switch sides.

exercises.name: cable straight arm pulldown (with rope attachment)
exercises.description: A straight-arm pulldown using a rope. It isolates the lats with no help from the arms.
steps: Set a rope on a high pulley and stand facing it.
Hinge forward slightly with arms extended.
Pull the rope down to your thighs.
Spread the rope at the bottom.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: cable half kneeling single arm row v. 2
exercises.description: A one-arm cable row from a half-kneeling stance. It works the lats and challenges your core stability.
steps: Half kneel facing the cable with the handle in one hand.
Keep your torso tall.
Row your elbow back past your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: seated upright twists on a chair
exercises.description: A seated trunk twist done tall on a chair. It loosens the spine and works the obliques gently.
steps: Sit tall with feet flat and arms crossed over your chest.
Rotate your torso to one side.
Pause briefly.
Rotate to the other side.
Keep your hips still.

exercises.name: seated side bend on a chair
exercises.description: A gentle seated side bend that works the obliques and loosens the sides of the trunk.
steps: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair with your feet flat on the floor.
Brace your core and keep your shoulders relaxed.
Reach one arm overhead and lean slowly to the opposite side without twisting.
Pause briefly, then return to upright.
Repeat on the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: resistance band drag curl
exercises.description: A curl variation where the elbows travel back as you pull, putting the biceps under steady band tension.
steps: Stand on the band with feet hip-width apart and hold the handles at your thighs.
Keep your chest up and core braced.
Curl by dragging your hands up your body while the elbows move behind you.
Squeeze at the top for a moment.
Lower under control until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: kettlebell half kneeling halo
exercises.description: A kettlebell circle around the head from a half kneeling stance that mobilises the shoulders and challenges core stability.
steps: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold the kettlebell upside down at chest height.
Squeeze your glutes and keep your ribs down.
Circle the bell around your head slowly, keeping it close.
Complete the reps, then reverse the direction.
Switch the kneeling leg and repeat.

exercises.name: bodyweight standing scapular external rotation
exercises.description: A standing drill that rotates the arms outward while drawing the shoulder blades back. It wakes up the rotator cuff and upper back.
steps: Stand tall with your elbows bent at your sides.
Keep your palms facing forward.
Rotate your forearms outward and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Hold for a second.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down and your shoulders away from your ears.

exercises.name: bodyweight standing t spine press
exercises.description: A standing movement that presses the arms overhead to open up the thoracic spine. It improves upper back extension.
steps: Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Clasp your hands in front of your chest.
