steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly.

exercises.name: dumbbell single arm chest supported row
exercises.description: A one-arm row with your chest braced on an incline bench. It lets you focus on each side of the back.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Let your arm hang straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: bodyweight walking low lunge
exercises.description: A walking lunge with a deep, low position that opens the hips and works the glutes and thighs.
steps: Stand tall with your hands on your hips.
Step forward into a long stride.
Lower your back knee close to the floor.
Push through your front foot and step the back leg forward.
Continue walking forward, alternating legs.

exercises.name: long distance lunge (low lunge)
exercises.description: A lunge with an extra-long stride into a low position. It stretches the hips while working the glutes and thighs.
steps: Stand tall with hands on your hips.
Take a very long step forward.
Sink down until your back knee hovers above the floor.
Keep your torso upright and front knee over the ankle.
Push back to the start and switch legs.

exercises.name: bodyweight pulse goblet squat
exercises.description: A squat held low with small pulses, with your hands clasped at your chest as if holding a weight. It builds thigh endurance.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands clasped at your chest.
Squat down to a deep position.
Pulse up and down a few centimetres at the bottom.
Keep your chest tall and heels down.
Stand up after the planned pulses.

exercises.name: kettlebell z press
exercises.description: An overhead press done seated on the floor with legs straight. It removes leg drive and challenges the core.
steps: Sit on the floor with legs extended and hold a kettlebell at your shoulder.
Sit tall and brace your core.
Press the kettlebell overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

exercises.name: suspender headstand
exercises.description: A headstand variation using suspension straps for support. It builds balance and shoulder strength.
steps: Set the straps at a low height.
Place your forearms or hands on the floor.
Lift your hips and place your feet in the straps.
Press your body up into a stable position.
Hold for 10 to 20 seconds.
Lower slowly and rest.

exercises.name: cable lying floor front raise
exercises.description: Lying on the floor, you lift a cable handle up in front of you to isolate the front delts.
steps: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and hold the handle.
Start with your arm by your thigh.
Raise your arm up over your chest with a slight elbow bend.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.name: standing tibialis raise wall supported
exercises.description: Leaning against a wall, you lift your toes toward your shins to train the muscle at the front of your lower leg.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and feet a little forward.
Keep your legs straight.
Lift your toes as high as you can, keeping your heels down.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: hanging knee raise
exercises.description: From a hang, you bring your knees up toward your chest to work the lower abs.
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight.
Brace your abs and avoid swinging.
Raise your knees toward your chest.
Tilt your pelvis up at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

exercises.name: plank leg lift mountain climber
exercises.description: A plank with a leg lift into a mountain climber. It trains the core and raises the heart rate.
steps: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders.
Lift one leg straight back.
Bring that knee in toward your chest.
Return and switch legs.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.

exercises.name: leverage standing hip thrust
exercises.description: A standing hip thrust on a lever machine. It targets the glutes with a smooth, guided path.
steps: Adjust the machine so the pad sits across your hips.
Stand with your feet hip width apart.
Lower your hips back slightly.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.
Return slowly to the start.
Keep your ribs down.

exercises.name: side plank clamshell
exercises.description: A side plank where you open and close your top knee. It works the outer hips and the obliques.
steps: Lie on your side in a side plank, supported on your forearm with knees bent.
Lift your hips so your body is in a line.
Keep your feet together and open your top knee upward.
Close it under control.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lever single arm preacher curl (plate loaded)
exercises.description: A one-arm curl on a plate-loaded preacher machine, isolating the biceps.
steps: Sit at the machine with your upper arm resting on the pad and grip the handle.
Start with your arm almost straight.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable side lying floor single leg kickback
exercises.description: A side-lying leg kickback with a cable. It isolates the glutes.
steps: Lie on your side with a cuff on your top ankle.
Position the cable behind you.
Kick your top leg back and slightly up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Return slowly.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: lever belt deadlift (v bar)
exercises.description: A belt-machine deadlift using a V handle, so the load hangs from your hips.
steps: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the V bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: lever belt deadlift (straight bar)
exercises.description: A belt-machine deadlift using a straight bar, so the load hangs from your hips.
steps: Stand on the platform with the belt around your hips and grip the straight bar.
Bend your knees and hinge with a flat back.
Brace your core.
Drive your feet down and stand tall.
Lower with control.

exercises.name: cable 45 degrees reverse grip reverse fly
exercises.description: A cable reverse fly with a palms-up grip, angled at 45 degrees to hit the rear delts and upper back.
steps: Stand at a cable station and grab the handles with palms up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arms out and back in a wide arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

exercises.name: cable 45 degrees single arm reverse fly
exercises.description: A one-arm cable reverse fly, hinged at 45 degrees to target the rear delt.
steps: Stand at a cable station and take one handle.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: cable 45 degrees single arm reverse grip reverse fly
exercises.description: A one-arm cable reverse fly with a palm-up grip, hinged at 45 degrees.
steps: Stand at a cable station and take one handle with your palm up.
Hinge forward about 45 degrees.
Pull your arm out and back in an arc.
Squeeze your shoulder blade.
Return slowly and switch sides.

exercises.name: cable incline single arm y raise with back support
exercises.description: A single-arm Y raise while supported on an incline bench, working the shoulders and upper back.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with a cable handle in one hand.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause with your thumb up.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable incline single arm y raise wrist straps with back support
exercises.description: A single-arm cable Y raise using wrist straps, so your grip does not limit the shoulder work.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with the strap on one wrist.
Let your arm hang down.
Raise it up and out in a Y shape.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, then switch arms.

exercises.name: cable lying bench cross lateral raise
exercises.description: A lying lateral raise where each hand grips the opposite cable handle and the arms sweep up and across. It hits the side delts with constant tension.
steps: Lie on a flat bench between two low cable pulleys and grab each handle with the opposite hand.
Start with your arms crossed over your body and a slight bend in the elbows.
Raise both arms out and up in a wide arc until your hands are about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the crossed position.
Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: cable lying bench single arm cross lateral raise
exercises.description: A one-armed lying lateral raise across the body with a low cable. It isolates a single side delt and lets you fix imbalances.
steps: Lie on a flat bench next to a low pulley and take the handle with the far hand.
Start with your arm across your body and a soft bend in the elbow.
Raise the arm out and up in an arc until it reaches about shoulder height.
Hold for a moment, then lower with control.
Keep your torso still and your shoulder away from your ear.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable lying single arm cross lateral raise
exercises.description: A single-arm lateral raise done lying on your side or back on the floor with a low cable crossing the body. It trains the side delt under steady tension.
steps: Lie on the floor next to a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Begin with your arm across your body and the elbow slightly bent.
Raise your arm out and up in a smooth arc to about shoulder height.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly back across your body without letting the weight stack rest.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable sitting bench single arm twisting row
exercises.description: A seated one-arm cable row where you rotate the torso and wrist as you pull. It works the lats and mid back through a longer range.
steps: Sit on a bench facing a low cable with your feet braced and take the handle in one hand.
Sit tall with your arm extended and your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Pull the handle back while rotating your torso and wrist toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine at the end.
Return slowly with your arm extended and your torso rotating back.
Keep your chest up, then switch sides after your reps.

exercises.name: lever belt romanian deadlift (straight bar)
exercises.description: A Romanian deadlift on a belt-loaded lever machine using a straight bar. It builds the hamstrings and glutes while sparing the grip and spine from heavy free weight.
steps: Step into the machine, set the belt securely and hold the straight bar with an overhand grip.
Stand tall with your knees slightly bent and your chest up.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down along your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch while your back stays flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.

exercises.name: lever belt romanian deadlift (v bar)
exercises.description: A belt-loaded lever machine Romanian deadlift using a V bar for a neutral grip. It targets the hamstrings and glutes with a comfortable hand position.
steps: Step into the machine, secure the belt and take the V bar with both hands.
Stand tall with soft knees and your shoulders back.
Hinge at the hips, pushing them back as the bar slides down your thighs.
Lower until your hamstrings are well stretched, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward and stand up straight.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: cable zercher squat
exercises.description: A squat holding a low cable in the crook of your elbows in front of you. The front load keeps you upright and works the quads, glutes and core.
steps: Attach a bar or handle to a low cable and hook it in the bends of your elbows, close to your chest.
Stand facing away from the stack with your feet shoulder width apart.
Brace your core and sit down and back until your thighs are about parallel.
Keep your chest tall and your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your whole foot to stand back up.
Keep your elbows tucked and the load close to your body.

exercises.name: standing pelvic lift
exercises.description: A gentle standing move where you tilt and lift the pelvis by squeezing the glutes and abs. It teaches pelvic control and activates the hips.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip width apart and your hands on your hips.
Soften your knees slightly.
Tuck your tailbone under and lift the front of your pelvis by squeezing your glutes and lower abs.
Hold for 2 seconds.
Release slowly to a neutral pelvis.
Keep your upper body still and breathe normally.

exercises.name: cable lying incline side leg raise
exercises.description: A side-lying leg raise with a cable on an incline. It works the outer hip and glutes.
steps: Lie on your side on an incline surface.
Attach the cuff to your top ankle.
Raise your top leg out to the side.
Pause at the top.
Lower with control.
Do your reps, then switch sides.

exercises.name: cable lying incline single leg kickback
exercises.description: A single leg kickback lying on an incline with a cable. It focuses on the glutes.
steps: Lie on an incline surface with the cuff on one ankle.
Hold the support for stability.
Kick your leg back and up.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: leverage single leg squat on hack squat machine
exercises.description: A single leg squat on a hack squat machine. It adds stability while loading one leg at a time.
steps: Set your back against the pad and step onto the platform.
Place one foot on the platform and lift the other slightly.
Lower into a squat with control.
Keep your knee tracking over your toes.
Press back up through the working leg.
Do your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: barbell california press
exercises.description: A hybrid of a skull crusher and a bench press where the bar lowers toward the forehead then presses up and back over the chest. It hits the chest and triceps together.
steps: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell above your chest with a shoulder width grip.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead like a skull crusher.
As it nears your head, let the elbows travel down so the bar moves toward the upper chest.
Press the bar up and slightly back over your shoulders.
Lower again along the same path and repeat.
Use a lighter weight and keep your wrists straight.

exercises.name: dumbbell spider curl
exercises.description: A curl performed chest-down on an incline bench so the arms hang straight. It removes swing and puts the stress on the biceps.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your arms hanging straight down.
Keep your upper arms vertical and your palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are fully extended.
Keep your chest on the pad and avoid swinging.

exercises.name: barbell banded weighted plate bench press
exercises.description: A bench press with resistance bands and plates added to the bar so the load gets heavier as you lock out. It builds chest and triceps strength through the top range.
steps: Lie on a bench and make sure the bands and plates are secured on the barbell.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest with your arms extended.
Lower the bar to your mid chest under control.
Press it back up, fighting the rising band tension.
Lock out your elbows without losing shoulder position.
Keep your feet planted and shoulder blades pinched together.

exercises.name: dumbbell seated alternating lateral raise
exercises.description: A seated lateral raise lifting one dumbbell at a time. Sitting reduces body swing so the side delts do the work.
steps: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise one arm out to the side until it reaches shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, then raise the other arm.
Keep your torso still and avoid shrugging.
Alternate sides for your reps.

exercises.name: power sled pull
exercises.description: A drag-style move where you pull a loaded sled toward you with a rope or strap, walking backward. It trains the back, arms and legs together.
steps: Attach a rope or strap to a loaded sled and grip it with both hands.
Face the sled, hinge slightly and set your feet.
Pull the rope hand over hand while walking backward.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Drive through your legs as the sled comes toward you.
Stop when the sled reaches you and reset.

exercises.name: weighted sandbag forward lunge
exercises.description: A forward lunge holding a sandbag at your chest or on your shoulders. The awkward load challenges your legs and core.
steps: Hold a sandbag against your chest or across your shoulders and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are about 90 degrees with your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and the bag tight to your body.

exercises.name: standing cross legs core stretch
exercises.description: A standing stretch with your legs crossed that lengthens the sides of the trunk. It loosens the obliques and waist.
steps: Stand tall and cross one leg in front of the other.
Raise the arm on the same side as the back leg overhead.
Reach and lean gently toward the opposite side.
Feel the stretch along your side and abs.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to standing and repeat on the other side.

exercises.name: lying supine heel slide
exercises.description: A gentle floor move where you slide your heel toward your hips and back. It restores knee and hip bend with low strain.
steps: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks.
Bend the knee as far as feels comfortable.
Pause for a second.
Slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lying supine straight knee raise
exercises.description: A lying straight-leg raise that lifts the leg with the knee locked. It wakes up the quads and hip flexors in a gentle way.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and the other leg straight.
Tighten the thigh of the straight leg so the knee is locked.
Lift the leg to the height of your bent knee.
Hold for a moment.
Lower slowly to the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

exercises.name: lying supine abdominal breathing
exercises.description: A calm lying breathing drill that focuses on belly breathing. It helps you relax and learn core control.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands on your belly.
Breathe in slowly through your nose.
Feel your belly rise under your hands.
Breathe out slowly through your mouth.
Let your belly lower gently.
Continue for 1 to 2 minutes.

exercises.name: stick assisted standing shoulder flexion
exercises.description: A shoulder mobility drill where a stick helps one arm lift forward and overhead. The other hand guides the movement.
steps: Stand tall holding a stick with both hands at hip level, palms down.
Keep the working arm relaxed and let the other hand lead.
Raise the stick forward and overhead as far as is comfortable.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.

exercises.name: standing towel foot crunch
exercises.description: A foot exercise where you scrunch a towel on the floor with your toes. It strengthens the muscles of the foot and arch.
steps: Stand with one foot flat on a towel laid on a smooth floor.
Keep your heel down.
Curl your toes to pull the towel toward you.
Release and repeat until the towel is bunched under your foot.
Hold on to a support if you need balance.
Do your reps, then switch feet.

exercises.name: resistance band kneeling sissy squat
exercises.description: A kneeling sissy squat with a resistance band for assistance or load. It places a big stretch on the quads.
steps: Set the band at a stable anchor and kneel with it around your body or hands.
Keep your hips forward and your body in a straight line from knees to head.
Lean back slowly, keeping your hips extended.
Go as far as you can control.
Use your quads to pull yourself back up.
Keep your core braced and your movement smooth.

exercises.name: stick assisted standing shoulder internal rotation
exercises.description: A mobility drill where you use a stick behind your back to help rotate the shoulder inward. It improves reach and range.
steps: Stand tall holding a stick behind your back, one hand low and the other high.
Let the lower hand grip the stick as the working arm.
With the top hand, gently pull the stick up so the lower hand rises along your back.
Go until you feel a mild stretch.
Hold for 2 seconds, then release.
Keep your shoulders level, then switch sides.

exercises.name: standing isometric shoulder internal rotation against wall
exercises.description: An isometric hold pressing the inner forearm into a wall to work the shoulder rotators. There is no movement, only steady tension.
steps: Stand sideways to a wall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees and tucked at your side.
Place the inside of your fist or forearm against the wall.
Press into the wall as if rotating your arm inward.
Hold the contraction for 5-10 seconds.
Relax and rest briefly.
Keep your elbow at your side, then switch arms.

exercises.name: ball assisted lying bent knee isometric hip adduction
exercises.description: A lying hip adduction hold squeezing a ball between the knees. It trains the inner thighs.
steps: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Place a ball between your knees.
Squeeze the ball with your inner thighs.
Hold for 5 to 10 seconds.
Release slowly.
Repeat for several reps.

exercises.name: isometric wrist extension
exercises.description: A static hold where you press the back of your hand upward against resistance. It strengthens the wrist extensors without moving the joint.
steps: Sit with your forearm resting on a table, palm down and wrist at the edge.
Place your other hand on top of the working hand.
Try to lift the hand up while the top hand resists.
Hold for 5-10 seconds with no movement.
Relax slowly.
Repeat, then switch arms.

exercises.name: resistance band isometric thumb extension
exercises.description: A thumb hold against a band that builds strength in the muscles that extend the thumb. It is small and controlled.
steps: Loop a light resistance band around your thumb and the base of your fingers.
Rest your hand on a table or your thigh.
Push your thumb out against the band.
Hold the tension for 5-10 seconds without moving.
Release slowly.
Repeat, then switch hands.

exercises.name: plank knee tap
exercises.description: A plank with alternating knee taps to the floor. It trains the abs and anti-rotation control.
steps: Start in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your core.
Lower one knee gently toward the floor.
Return it and switch sides.
Keep your hips level.
Breathe steadily.
